coinbase-new-user-bonus.title: [US] Coinbase: random BTC reward on your first buy
coinbase-new-user-bonus.highlight: Buy $50+ of crypto after signing up and get a random $3–$2,000 BTC reward, about $25 on average
coinbase-new-user-bonus.regions: [US] US and other countries Coinbase onboards (check the signup page)
coinbase-new-user-bonus.content: Register with Coinbase and make one crypto purchase of $50 or more to receive a random Bitcoin reward between $3 and $2,000; Coinbase puts the average at about $25. The reward pool is limited and closes when it runs out or Coinbase ends the offer.
coinbase-new-user-bonus.conditions: New users only; first purchase of at least $50; limited pool, first come first served; some regions and ID checks are restricted.
steps: Sign up for Coinbase through the offer page and complete identity verification (KYC)
Buy any crypto in your account, at least $50 in one order
Check your portfolio for the randomly issued BTC reward
coinbase-new-user-bonus.risk: Coinbase labels this "up to $2,000" and most people get the small end; crypto price risk after buying is yours, and the reward is not investment advice.
coinbase-new-user-bonus.source: Coinbase official offer page (the terms state an average reward of about $25)

usbank-business-checking-1500.title: [US] U.S. Bank business checking: up to $1,500 bonus + $250 Bill Pay
usbank-business-checking-1500.highlight: Platinum Business Checking: deposit $25k of new money, hold it to day 60 and make 6 qualifying transactions — $1,200 on the official page, $1,500 with code Q4BUS26; another $250 on top with Bill Pay for Business
usbank-business-checking-1500.regions: [US] US businesses (SSN/EIN) in a state with U.S. Bank branches or with an existing relationship
usbank-business-checking-1500.content: Open online with at least $25, then hold $25,000 in new money in Platinum Business Checking within 30 days, keep the daily balance through day 60 and make six qualifying transactions in 60 days to earn the bonus. The official page shows Platinum $1,200 and Essentials $400 with code Q4DIG26; the tested code Q4BUS26 pays Platinum $1,500, Gold $900 with $10k, and Essentials $500 with $5k. Add $250 from Bill Pay for Business by enrolling and making five qualifying bill payments within 60 days. Bonuses post within 30 days after the qualifying month ends and are reported on a 1099-INT.
usbank-business-checking-1500.conditions: A US business with an SSN or EIN; enroll in Business Online Banking within 30 days of opening; fund within 30 days, hold through day 60 and complete six qualifying transactions; one bonus per business, and anyone with a business checking account in the past 12 months or a recently closed one is excluded; Platinum has a $30 monthly fee waived with a $25k average balance.
steps: Open Platinum Business Checking online at the U.S. Bank business page with code Q4BUS26 (or the default code), depositing at least $25
Move $25,000 of new money in from outside the bank within 30 days (internal transfers don't count)
Keep the daily balance until day 60 and make 6 qualifying transactions (ACH/Zelle/debit card/cheques)
Enrol in Business Online Banking within 30 days; for the extra $250, enrol in Bill Pay for Business and make 5 bill payments
usbank-business-checking-1500.risk: Ties up $25,000 for about 60 days and requires a US business entity; the $1,500 tier comes from invite code Q4BUS26 (the official page shows $1,200 and the code changes the amount); the $30 monthly fee needs a balance waiver; bonuses are taxable interest.
usbank-business-checking-1500.source: U.S. Bank official Business Checking and Online Banking Bonus page (terms to 2027-01-13) + Doctor of Credit, updated 2026-09-29 + US card forum data point, 2026-11-18

binance-lite-vouchers.title: [Global] Binance new-user tasks: up to $1,100 in fee vouchers
binance-lite-vouchers.highlight: A first $50 fiat/card/P2P buy plus $100 of spot volume unlock two fee-rebate vouchers
binance-lite-vouchers.regions: [Global] Countries served by Binance's global site (entity terms differ by region)
binance-lite-vouchers.content: Register through a referral link (Lite mode) and new users get two fee-rebate vouchers: one of up to $100 for a first fiat, card or P2P purchase of $50+, and one of up to $1,000 for $100 in combined spot or Convert volume. Binance sets each voucher's face value when it is issued.
binance-lite-vouchers.conditions: New accounts registered through a referral only; fiat, card and P2P purchases count toward the first task but on-chain deposits do not; activate each voucher within seven days and spend it within 14 days of activation.
steps: Sign up with the referral link and complete KYC
Buy $50 or more of crypto with a credit/debit card or P2P
Complete $100 of spot or Convert volume
Activate the fee vouchers under Rewards and use them within 14 days
binance-lite-vouchers.risk: The vouchers only offset spot trading fees, so they are worth $0 if you don't trade; the "up to" amounts aren't guaranteed — what the issued voucher says is all you get.
binance-lite-vouchers.source: Binance official referral programme page + third-party terms check (2026-09)

jetbrains-student-pack.title: [Global] JetBrains student pack: every IDE free
jetbrains-student-pack.highlight: All desktop IDEs and Ultimate subscriptions free, renewed yearly, then 40% off for two years after graduating
jetbrains-student-pack.regions: [Global] Students and teachers at accredited institutions
jetbrains-student-pack.content: Students and teachers can apply for a JetBrains educational licence and use every desktop IDE and Ultimate subscription free, including IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate, PyCharm, WebStorm, CLion and GoLand, renewing as long as they are enrolled; graduates get two more years at 40% off.
jetbrains-student-pack.conditions: Enrolled at an accredited university or college; verify with a school email, ISIC/ITIC card or GitHub Student Pack; renew once a year.
steps: Open the JetBrains student application page and verify with your school email or the GitHub Student Pack
Click the confirmation link in the email
Download the IDEs and sign in with your JetBrains Account
jetbrains-student-pack.risk: The licence runs for a year: forget to renew and it lapses; commercial use must follow the educational licence terms.
jetbrains-student-pack.source: JetBrains official student pack page + support docs (2026-10-29)

hostinger-black-friday.title: [Global] Hostinger Black Friday: hosting from $1.99/mo
hostinger-black-friday.highlight: 48-month plans 85% off, with a free domain, SSL and double AI credits
hostinger-black-friday.regions: [Global] Prices vary slightly by country and currency
hostinger-black-friday.content: Black Friday runs to 14 December: Premium costs $1.99 a month on a 48-month term (down from $12.99, about 85% off, $95.52 paid up front) and Unlimited $2.79 a month, with a free domain for a year, SSL, weekly or daily backups and double AI credits; domains are up to 99% off.
hostinger-black-friday.conditions: Pay for 48 months up front; renewal returns to list price (Premium $10.99 a month); the discount applies automatically with no code; 30-day money-back guarantee.
steps: Open the Black Friday page and choose a plan on the 48-month term
Check whether the free domain is included and add it to the cart
Check the total and the renewal price before checkout
hostinger-black-friday.risk: You pay for four years up front and renewals cost several times more; if you're unsure you'll keep the site, start monthly rather than locking in four years for the discount.
hostinger-black-friday.source: Hostinger official Black Friday page (offer dates and prices as published)

bybit-referral-tasks.title: [Global] Bybit referral tasks: up to 250 USDT for each side
bybit-referral-tasks.highlight: From a first $50 trade, tiers at $500 and $10,000 of volume pay 50+100+100 USDT
bybit-referral-tasks.regions: [Global] Countries served by Bybit Global (some regions restricted)
bybit-referral-tasks.content: Register with an invitation link and the new user and the referrer each clear three tiers: 50 USDT each for a first trade of $50 within 14 days, 100 USDT each for $500 in volume within 30 days of that first trade, and another 100 USDT each at $10,000. Both sides can total 500 USDT, and new users also get a tiered Welcome Gift worth about $100.
bybit-referral-tasks.conditions: Sign up with the invitation link or code; deposit more than $100; volume excludes zero-fee pairs; rewards pay out after a three-day risk review and must be claimed within 10 days.
steps: Sign up for Bybit with the invite link and complete KYC
Deposit $100 or more within 7 days
Make a first trade of $50 or more within 14 days, then reach the volume tiers
Claim the rewards in the Rewards Hub
bybit-referral-tasks.risk: Rewards arrive as Bonus / Fee Saver / Position Airdrop, which can't be withdrawn directly and only offset fees or margin; the monthly pool is 500,000 USDT, first come first served.

okx-new-user-bonus.title: [EEA] OKX new-user pack (tiered tasks)
okx-new-user-bonus.highlight: Verify, deposit €100 and trade through the tiers; vouchers by task, and the amounts vary a lot by region
okx-new-user-bonus.regions: [EEA] Example is EUR 400 in the EEA; other regions differ
okx-new-user-bonus.content: Register with OKX through a designated promotion channel and Rewards then Welcome Rewards shows a personal task card: the European example pays EUR 50 for identity verification, EUR 50 for a EUR 100 deposit and X-Perps vouchers for trading volume at EUR 1, EUR 1,000, EUR 10,000 and EUR 50,000, up to EUR 400 in total. Tasks and amounts vary by region, campaign period and user tier.
okx-new-user-bonus.conditions: Sign up through the designated invitation link or official campaign page, as ordinary signups cannot be retrofitted; deposits are counted net; trading tasks must be finished within 14 days of registering.
steps: Sign up with the campaign link and complete KYC
Deposit what the task card asks (e.g. €100 or more)
Complete the matching trading volume
Claim in Rewards → My Rewards and watch the lock-up period
okx-new-user-bonus.risk: Crypto rewards can be locked for up to 45 days and can't be withdrawn; rewards are futures/perpetual vouchers, not cash; sign-ups outside the designated channel are void.

citizens-bank-400-checking.title: [US] Citizens Bank first checking account: $400 for a single $1,000 direct deposit (to 12/20)
citizens-bank-400-checking.highlight: Open your first personal checking account online and take one qualifying direct deposit of $1,000+ within 60 days to get $400; only in CT, DC, DE, FL, MA, MD, MI, NH, NJ, NY, OH, PA, RI, VA, VT
citizens-bank-400-checking.regions: [US] Only CT, DC, DE, FL, MA, MD, MI, NH, NJ, NY, OH, PA, RI, VA and VT; SSN/ITIN required
citizens-bank-400-checking.content: Open a first Citizens personal checking account online through the offer link between 5 October and 20 December 2026 and receive one direct deposit of $1,000+ within 60 days for a $400 promo bonus. Choose from One Deposit Checking ($9.99 monthly, waived with one deposit per statement), Citizens Quest Checking, Student Checking and others. Bonuses pay by opening month: October openings by 28 February 2027, November by 31 March 2027 and December by 30 April 2027.
citizens-bank-400-checking.conditions: The primary owner must not have held any Citizens personal checking or savings account in the previous six months; start from the Open Account link on the official offer page, not the homepage; Zelle, Cash App, Venmo, PayPal and other P2P or one-off deposits do not count, only recurring income such as salary or pension; keep a positive balance and an active account through payout; once per person, not combinable with other Citizens checking offers; the bonus is taxable.
steps: Check your state is covered and have a US address, SSN/ITIN and photo ID ready
From https://www.citizensbank.com/promo/checking/26-q4-bau-gm.aspx click Open Account for the account you want
Complete the application online and save or print the terms page as proof
Get one direct deposit of $1,000 or more (salary or pension) into the new account within 60 days
Track progress in the app's Promo Tracker and check the account at the end of the payout month
citizens-bank-400-checking.risk: Only some states can open online, so non-residents can't apply; One Deposit Checking charges $9.99 a month (waived with a deposit) and EverValue's $5 fee can't be waived; the bonus takes 2–4 months and closing the account in between forfeits it; the bank can withdraw the offer at any time.
citizens-bank-400-checking.source: Citizens Bank official offer page (footnote 1, read 2026-11-19)

sofi-checking-400-direct-deposit.title: [US] SoFi checking direct-deposit bonus: $5,000 in 25 days for $400 (to 12/31)
sofi-checking-400-direct-deposit.highlight: Take $1,000–$4,999.99 in qualifying direct deposits within 25 days of your first one for $50, or $5,000+ for $400; no monthly fee, no minimum balance
sofi-checking-400-direct-deposit.regions: [US] All states (SoFi Bank, N.A., FDIC member); US ID and address required
sofi-checking-400-direct-deposit.content: After a first qualifying direct deposit of $1 or more before 31 December 2026, SoFi totals qualifying deposits over the next 25 calendar days: $1,000–$4,999.99 pays $50 and $5,000+ pays $400, within seven business days of qualifying. The account has no monthly fee, no minimum balance and pays salary two days early.
sofi-checking-400-direct-deposit.conditions: Any member, new or existing, who has never set up direct deposit with SoFi; once per person; qualifying deposits must be recurring ACH from an employer, payroll provider or government agency (salary, pension, Social Security); check deposits, Zelle, PayPal, Venmo, Wise and other P2P, merchant transfers, external bank ACH, wires and tax refunds do not count; the account must be in good standing at payout.
steps: Open SoFi Checking and Savings through the invite link or the website
Switch your direct deposit to SoFi in your employer's payroll system (or set up a government benefit deposit)
Confirm the first direct deposit of $1 or more has landed, then accumulate $5,000 within 25 days
Check the bonus in the checking account within 7 business days
sofi-checking-400-direct-deposit.risk: Reaching the $400 tier means moving $5,000 in within 25 days, which really means relocating your salary; SoFi decides what counts as a direct deposit and some payroll providers need a manual appeal; the bonus is taxable.
sofi-checking-400-direct-deposit.source: SoFi official Checking Offer page terms (read 2026-11-19)

chase-total-checking-400.title: [US only] Chase Total Checking $400 sign-up bonus
chase-total-checking-400.highlight: Open a new account and take $1,000 in direct deposits within 90 days; the bonus lands within 15 days
chase-total-checking-400.regions: [US only] Online excludes Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico
chase-total-checking-400.content: New customers who open Chase Total Checking and register a coupon code qualify with $1,000+ in salary or government direct deposits within 90 days. The account carries a $15 monthly fee, waivable with $1,000 in monthly direct deposits or other conditions.
chase-total-checking-400.conditions: New Chase checking customers only (an account closed within 90 days or closed at a negative balance within three years disqualifies); one sign-up bonus every two years; direct deposits exclude Zelle, transfers and check deposits.
steps: Enter your email on the offer page to get the coupon code
Open Total Checking online or in a branch with that code
Complete $1,000 of direct deposits within 90 days
Keep the account in good standing until the bonus arrives
chase-total-checking-400.risk: The $15 monthly fee eats the bonus if you don't get it waived; closing early can claw it back; needs a US address and SSN/ITIN, and non-residents face extra restrictions.
chase-total-checking-400.source: Chase official offer page + Bankrate / BankDealGuy (updated 2026-11-11)

santander-everyday-switch-240.title: [UK] Santander Everyday switch bonus £240: switch + 2 household Direct Debits + deposit £1,500 (from 10/27)
santander-everyday-switch-240.highlight: Full CASS switch into Santander Everyday: complete the switch, two household direct debits, a £1,500 deposit and £200 into the Regular Saver within 60 days to get £240 about 90 days later. Apply through the MSE link before 15:00 on 2026-11-25 and add a £25 Amazon gift card.
santander-everyday-switch-240.regions: [UK] UK residents switching from another UK bank or building society
santander-everyday-switch-240.content: Apply for the switch from 27 October 2026: within 60 days complete a full CASS switch (the old account closes), hold at least two household Direct Debits (council tax, mobile, landline, broadband, pay TV, utilities and other designated payees), deposit at least £1,500 into the Everyday Current Account and at least £200 into your own Santander Regular Saver. Eligibility is checked on day 60 and £240 follows within 30 days, about 90 days in, provided both accounts and the two active household Direct Debits remain on payout day. Apply through the MoneySavingExpert link by 15:00 on 25 November 2026 and the same criteria also earn a £25 Amazon.co.uk gift card (£265 in total), with instructions emailed within 120 days of qualifying and 30 days to claim.
santander-everyday-switch-240.conditions: UK residents; no Santander current account on 1 January 2026 and no Santander switch bonus ever for the applicant or any joint holder; a full CASS switch closing the old account; two designated household Direct Debits plus £1,500 deposited and £200 into the Regular Saver within 60 days; one payout per joint account; the gift card requires the MSE link and an application by 15:00 on 25 November 2026.
steps: Open an Everyday Current Account at santander.co.uk (or use the one you have)
Choose a full switch through the Current Account Switch Service and enter the old account details correctly
Move at least 2 household Direct Debits (mobile, broadband, utilities, council tax) across within 60 days
Deposit a total of £1,500 into the new account and £200 into your Regular Saver within 60 days
Check the £240 around 90 days later; if it's missing call 0330 9123123
santander-everyday-switch-240.risk: The headline £240 needs the switch, 2 household Direct Debits, £1,500 of deposits and £200 into a Regular Saver — miss one and there's nothing; the £1,500 and £200 are your own money (you can take them back out, but they must still be there on payout day); the switch closes your old account, so check salary and subscriptions can move; the bank can withdraw the offer at any time (applications already submitted are still paid if eligible).
santander-everyday-switch-240.source: Santander UK official switch page "Switch. Save. Get £240." + official £240 Switcher T&Cs (2026-10 edition, offer from 2026-10-27) + official press release (2026-09-01)

ally-spending-300.title: [US] Ally checking $300: $1,000 of direct deposits for 6 months (code ALLY300, to 11/30)
ally-spending-300.highlight: Open your first Spending Account with code ALLY300 and get $50 for every month with $1,000 of direct deposits, up to 6 months and $300 in total; no monthly fee, no minimum balance
ally-spending-300.regions: [US] Online nationwide with Ally Bank, an FDIC member, needing US identity and address
ally-spending-300.content: Ally Bank's Spending Account bonus, per terms effective 16 November 2026: open a first Ally Spending Account with code ALLY300 between 16 and 30 November 2026, fund it within 30 days or the account closes, and set up qualifying direct deposits of at least $1,000 a month. The first month's deposit arrives within 60 days of opening for the first $50, and five more qualifying months each pay $50, up to $300, with each $50 arriving within 30 days of that month's deposit. Missing the first month forfeits everything after, and a missed month later ends the remaining months. Ally may shorten or end the offer at any time.
ally-spending-300.conditions: New customers with no prior Ally Spending Account, once per person; code ALLY300 in the campaign link; transfers between your own accounts do not qualify; the account must stay in good standing to collect; unfreeze any ChexSystems or credit freeze first.
steps: Open your first Spending Account from the Ally offer page with code ALLY300
Fund the account within 30 days so it doesn't close automatically
Move $1,000 or more of monthly salary direct deposit to the account
Keep it up for 6 consecutive months and check the $50 each month
ally-spending-300.risk: You need $1,000 a month for 6 straight months, and a missed month costs the remaining bonuses; the offer ends 11/30 and funding must happen within 30 days of opening; the terms page couldn't be reached from here, so confirm the code and end date on ally.com before applying.
ally-spending-300.source: Ally official ALLY300 terms (checked line by line by Perkful 2026-11-17, cited by CNBC Select 2026-11-18; the official page returned 500 from this environment)

surfshark-black-friday.title: [Global] Surfshark Black Friday: 2 years at $2.49/mo + 3 months
surfshark-black-friday.highlight: One plan 88% off, with VPN + antivirus + breach monitoring
surfshark-black-friday.regions: [Global] Payment or compliance limits apply in some countries
surfshark-black-friday.content: Black Friday runs to 1 December: Starter and One cost $2.49 a month on a two-year plan ($67.23 in total with three months added, about 88% off), One+ is $3.99 a month and annual plans start at $2.99 a month. A 30-day refund applies, and One adds antivirus, ad blocking and leak monitoring.
surfshark-black-friday.conditions: Pay 24 months up front; renewal is at list price; the seven-day free trial is only on some platforms; refunds must be requested within 30 days.
steps: Open the Black Friday page and pick the Starter / One two-year plan
Check the total, the free months and the renewal price
After paying, download the app — unlimited devices can connect at once
surfshark-black-friday.risk: VPN prices are "Black Friday" all year round, so don't stock up on four years for the discount; auto-renewal is at list price, so remember to turn it off.
surfshark-black-friday.source: Surfshark official Black Friday page + Cybernews / Security.org (2026-11)

td-bank-checking-300.title: [US] TD Bank new checking: $300 / $200 direct-deposit bonus (to 2027-01-30)
td-bank-checking-300.highlight: Open TD Beyond Checking ($25 monthly fee) and take $2,500 of salary/pension/government direct deposits within 60 days for $300; TD Complete Checking pays $200 for $500, and a savings bonus stacks on top
td-bank-checking-300.regions: [US] Only the 16 states with TD branches plus DC (CT, DC, DE, FL, MA, MD, ME, NC, NH, NJ, NY, PA, RI, SC, VA, VT)
td-bank-checking-300.content: Open TD Beyond Checking and take $2,500+ in qualifying direct deposits within 60 days for $300, or open TD Complete Checking with $500+ for $200. Bonuses post within 180 days of qualifying and stack with the paired savings bonus, up to $500 in total. Qualifying deposits are electronic salary, pension and government benefit payments of at least $250 each; P2P and bank-to-bank transfers do not count.
td-bank-checking-300.conditions: New customers only: no current TD personal checking account, none closed in the past 12 months and no TD checking bonus ever; open from a qualifying official entry point; residents of the 16 states and DC only; Beyond costs $25 a month (waived with $5,000 in monthly direct deposits, a $2,500 daily balance or $25,000 in linked balances) and Complete $15; closing within six months lets the bank claw back the bonus.
steps: From the TD Special Offers page choose Beyond ($300) or Complete ($200)
Get salary, pension or government payments to arrive as electronic direct deposits within 60 days ($2,500 for Beyond, $500 for Complete)
Keep the account in good standing and don't close it within 6 months
Wait for the bonus within 180 days of opening and file the tax form the bank sends
td-bank-checking-300.risk: Open to residents of the 16 states and DC only, so other states are declined; the $300 tier needs $2,500 of direct deposits, not the "$500 gets $300" version circulating online (that's the $200 tier); an unwaived monthly fee eats the bonus, so check the deposit or balance condition.
td-bank-checking-300.source: TD Bank official Special Offers and Checking & Savings bonus pages (offer to 2027-01-30, terms in Important Disclosures)

oracle-always-free.title: [Global] Oracle Cloud always free: 2 ARM cores + 200GB
oracle-always-free.highlight: Always-free 2 OCPU/12GB ARM or 2 small AMD instances, plus $300 for 30 days
oracle-always-free.regions: [Global] Commercial regions worldwide (US government cloud excluded); A1 only in the home region, not Chuncheon
oracle-always-free.content: Always Free includes 1,500 OCPU hours and 9,000 GB hours a month (an ARM A1 instance of 2 OCPU and 12GB), up to two AMD micro instances, 200GB of block storage, object storage and load balancing; new accounts also get $300 for 30 days.
oracle-always-free.conditions: Card verification required; Always Free resources run only in the home region; instances whose 95th-percentile CPU and network use stay under 20% for seven days (memory too for A1) can be reclaimed; capacity shortages that block new instances are normal.
steps: Sign up for Oracle Cloud and pick a suitable home region (it sets latency and which shapes you can launch)
Create a VM.Standard.A1.Flex (2 OCPU/12GB) or a micro instance under Compute
Attach a boot volume within the 200GB of block storage
Before the trial ends, keep A1 within 2 OCPU/12GB so it isn't deleted
oracle-always-free.risk: Since 2026-07 the free ARM allowance is 2 OCPU/12GB (was 4 OCPU/24GB); older 4-core instances are stopped and deleted after 30 days, and idle instances can be reclaimed.
oracle-always-free.source: Oracle official Always Free documentation + official change notice of 2026-07-21

gcp-300-credit.title: [Global] Google Cloud $300 for new customers / 90 days
gcp-300-credit.highlight: Use it freely for 90 days without being charged, plus always-free usage on 20+ products
gcp-300-credit.regions: [Global] Billing address in a supported country
gcp-300-credit.content: New customers who have never paid for Google Cloud get $300 in welcome credit, usable on eligible products for 90 days without being charged, along with the monthly Free Tier (e2-micro instances, Cloud Run, BigQuery and more).
gcp-300-credit.conditions: Never a paying Google Cloud, Maps or Firebase customer; a valid card or payment method is required; during the trial GPUs, Marketplace and Windows Server images are unavailable and concurrency is capped at eight cores.
steps: Sign up for Cloud with a Google account and create a billing account
Add a card and pass the temporary $0–1 verification
Create a project and deploy an instance or service
Decide within 90 days whether to upgrade to a paid account
gcp-300-credit.risk: The credit expires after 90 days; without an upgrade resources are stopped and deleted after a 30-day grace period; from 2026-11-16 new $300 credits can't be used for Gemini/Vertex AI.
gcp-300-credit.source: Google Cloud official free programme documentation (checked 2026-11)

vultr-credit.title: [Global] Vultr new-customer credit up to $300
vultr-credit.highlight: Codes FLY300VULTR / FLY200 / VULTRMATCH, use within 30 days
vultr-credit.regions: [Global] 30+ locations worldwide (credit applies to selected products)
vultr-credit.content: Vultr's official offers page carries three new-customer tiers: FLY300VULTR gives $300, FLY200 or FLYTWOHUNDRED gives $200, and VULTRMATCH matches a first deposit up to $100. Credit applies to selected products, lasts up to 30 days and one promotion is allowed per account.
vultr-credit.conditions: New accounts only; attach a card or PayPal after signing up (a $0 verification works); no stacking with other offers; unused balance expires.
steps: Sign up for a new Vultr account from the offers page
Enter the code under Billing → Summary and click Apply
Deploy an instance and destroy it before the credit runs out to avoid charges
vultr-credit.risk: The credit expires and the balance isn't refunded; forgetting to destroy instances turns into real charges.

hsbc-uk-bank-account-switch-220.title: [UK] HSBC Bank Account switch bonus £220: open in the app + 2 Direct Debits + deposit £2,000 + spend £500
hsbc-uk-bank-account-switch-220.highlight: Only counts if you open the Bank Account inside the HSBC mobile app: full CASS switch within 60 days (with 2 Direct Debits), deposit £2,000 and spend £500; the bonus lands within 60 days
hsbc-uk-bank-account-switch-220.regions: [UK] UK residents; HSBC Bank Account (Basic Bank Account excluded)
hsbc-uk-bank-account-switch-220.content: Open HSBC Bank Account inside the HSBC UK mobile banking app (web, branch and phone applications do not count), then within 60 days complete a full CASS switch bringing at least two Direct Debits, deposit £2,000+ and spend £500+ on the account's HSBC debit card (Apple, Google and Samsung Pay count; cash withdrawals, fees, refunds, gambling, credit card or insurance payments and card-to-card transfers do not). The £220 is paid in GBP within 60 days of qualifying, once per person.
hsbc-uk-bank-account-switch-220.conditions: UK resident, 18+, a new customer; open in the app; two Direct Debits plus £2,000 deposited and £500 card spend within 60 days; anyone who held an HSBC UK or first direct current account since 1 January 2023 cannot take part; the account must be open and unfrozen at payout.
steps: Download the HSBC UK app and apply for the HSBC Bank Account inside it
Within 60 days start a full CASS switch in the app, making sure 2 Direct Debits come across
Deposit a total of £2,000 into the new account within 60 days (salary, transfers or cash; you don't have to keep it there)
Spend £500 in total on the HSBC debit card within 60 days (mobile wallet payments count)
The bonus arrives within 60 days of qualifying; contact HSBC support if it doesn't
hsbc-uk-bank-account-switch-220.risk: The account must be opened in the app — web or branch accounts don't count, which is where many people come unstuck; the £500 must be genuine spending, not cash withdrawals or fees; holding an HSBC or first direct account since 2023 makes you ineligible outright; the bank can withdraw the offer at any time.
hsbc-uk-bank-account-switch-220.source: HSBC UK official switch page "Current switch offers: Get £220" + Bank Account eligibility page + official £220 T&Cs (from 2026-06-15)

Claim the 7-day 20% HKD time-deposit boost and the welcome voucher pack in ZA Quest

steps: Sign up at deepgram.com and open the Console
Create an API key (scoped to what you need)
Call /v1/listen with the official SDK or REST API to transcribe audio
Watch the balance in the Console and decide about adding a card before the $200 runs out

Link a UK bank account and deposit at least £1
When the app notifies you, claim the reward and choose the stock within 60 days

On 17 November Mistral AI marked the open-weight Le Chonk (Mistral Large 4 at a trillion parameters with about 52 billion active) arriving with Vibe by releasing a limited run of three free months of Vibe Pro to European developers under code LECHONK. Vibe Pro lists at $14.99 a month before tax, about $45 across three months, with higher message and web-search limits, expanded Vibe capacity, round-the-clock agentic coding in CLI, IDE and web, and monthly API credit. The run sold out the same day, X hinted at more the next day and a batch arrived on 18 November with Vibe Desktop only to report the code unavailable again; third parties marked it dead from 19 November. It could return if Mistral restocks.
mistral-vibe-pro-lechonk-3m.conditions: European developers only; limited and first come, with the code reading unavailable until restocks; a Mistral account on the redemption page; a valid payment method; renews at $14.99 a month unless cancelled.
steps: Connect through a European node and sign in to a Mistral account (register first if needed)
Open the redemption page at admin.mistral.ai and enter code LECHONK
Confirm Vibe Pro is $0 for the first 3 months and submit
Cancel the renewal on the subscription page before it ends
mistral-vibe-pro-lechonk-3m.risk: Archived as sold out: stock can return at any time, and failing to redeem is normal. Non-European accounts or risk checks may fail outright. Anyone who already redeemed still auto-renews at $14.99/month unless cancelled.
mistral-vibe-pro-lechonk-3m.source: Mistral official campaign post on X (2026-11-17) + NodeSeek hands-on thread of 2026-11-18 (including the restock data point) + DDay.it coverage

unicom-esim-xianxian-2026.regions: [CN] Mainland China (a Unicom number and an eSIM-capable mainland handset, at an own store or in the Unicom app)
unicom-esim-xianxian-2026.content: Activate eSIM (new line, physical SIM to eSIM, eSIM to eSIM, or after porting in) and claim one benefit pack within 30 calendar days, once per handset. On Unicom-supplied models you choose one of three: overseas eSIM data, an international roaming voucher or domestic data; on self-bought models outside that list it is usually overseas data or the roaming voucher. Domestic data includes 100GB (plus 50GB for six months and 200/300/500GB annual packs), with the activation month counting as the first of 6 or 12 calendar months and no rollover; the roaming voucher is worth ¥300. Benefits cannot be unsubscribed, renewed or given away.
unicom-esim-xianxian-2026.conditions: A Unicom number with eSIM activated (handset on Unicom's list and a mainland-market version); claim within 30 days in the Unicom app, from a store poster QR code or the card in a Unicom-supplied device box; domestic data is limited to Unicom-supplied models and invalid on numbers with clashing plans or throttled packages; an eSIM standalone number counts toward the five-lines-per-ID limit, with at most two eSIM numbers per device across carriers; third-party eUICC cards have no mainland CI certificate and eSIM here needs device binding with IMEI and EID registered, so they cannot be written.
steps: Check in the Unicom app under Services → eSIM zone, or at a nearby own-brand store, that your model qualifies
Set up the eSIM (new line, physical SIM to eSIM, or number port-in)
Within 30 days choose one benefit on the campaign page (domestic data, or overseas data/roaming voucher)
Use it before it expires; domestic data doesn't roll over
unicom-esim-xianxian-2026.risk: Domestic data only goes to carrier-supplied models, so self-bought phones usually get overseas data or a roaming voucher; throttled or conflicting plans make the domestic data claim void; overseas data must be installed and activated abroad within 365 days and doesn't support hotspot; in-store processing means visiting an own-brand store.

Receive the text and install the trial eSIM
Switch data to the Verizon line; it ends automatically after 30 days

swarms-cloud-black-friday.highlight: Redeem code SWARMSFLASH under Credits for $15 of free credit (new accounts also get $5 signup credit) and 20% extra on every top-up; Pro is half price at $10/mo for the first 3 months, and subscribers get free tokens on Black Friday and Cyber Monday
swarms-cloud-black-friday.regions: [Global] Swarms Cloud (cloud.swarms.world); new and existing accounts can redeem, email signup
swarms-cloud-black-friday.value: $15 free credit (about $20 with the $5 signup credit)
swarms-cloud-black-friday.content: Five Black Friday offers: the code SWARMSFLASH gives $15 of free credit (once per account, to 2 December Pacific), and new accounts get another $5 at signup, so $20 to start; free-plan accounts taking monthly Pro or Premium pay half for three months (Pro from $19.99 to $10, Premium from $100 to $50) with a seven-day Pro trial; new annual subscriptions take another 10% off the usual 15% (Pro $183.51 for the first year); every top-up adds 20% (pay $25, get $30); and Pro and Premium subscribers get free tokens on 27 November and 30 November (agents, images and search excluded). Credit works on GPT-5.6, Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, image workflows and agent batch endpoints.
swarms-cloud-black-friday.conditions: SWARMSFLASH once per account under Settings > Credits > Redeem a code; the half price applies only to accounts without an active subscription and for three months; the annual discount is first-year only; free tokens apply to Pro and Premium subscribers on 27 and 30 November only; everything ends 2 December 2026 Pacific.
steps: Register or sign in at cloud.swarms.world
Go to Settings → Credits, enter SWARMSFLASH and redeem; $15 lands immediately
Top up if you need more — every top-up gets 20% extra
For longer use, take Pro on the Black Friday page ($10/mo for 3 months) and schedule batch jobs for 11/27 and 11/30
swarms-cloud-black-friday.risk: The free credit expires and burns fast on some models; subscriptions renew at full price, so cancel when you're done; agent, image and search fees at premium endpoints sit outside the free tokens.
swarms-cloud-black-friday.source: Swarms Cloud official Black Friday page (checked 2026-11-18)

taptap-send-uk-first-transfer.title: [UK] TapTap Send first-transfer reward: £5 standard, up to £20 to Turkey (code to be confirmed)
taptap-send-uk-first-transfer.highlight: New customers enter a referral code before their first transfer and get £5 off a first transfer of £25+; Budgetfitter separately lists a Turkey-specific £20 code (expires 2026-12-31). The reward is transfer credit, not cash, and lasts 90 days
taptap-send-uk-first-transfer.regions: [UK] UK (the US, Europe, Canada, Australia and the UAE can also send); Turkey has a dedicated code
taptap-send-uk-first-transfer.content: New customers enter an invite code on their first transfer and complete a successful send of at least the app's minimum to someone other than the referrer for a reward, with the amount and minimum shown in the app (the UK standard is £5 on £25+). The reward sits in the app balance, offsets a whole transfer, cannot be withdrawn and expires after 90 days. Budgetfitter's brand page lists three more: £20 off a first transfer to Turkey (code Budgetfitter), £15 extra on £100+ (code Budget100) and code FATIH2945 for £5 on £25+, all stated to end 31 December 2026; Finder's FINDER10 is £10 off £20+ and needs rechecking.
taptap-send-uk-first-transfer.conditions: First-time users only; the first transfer must meet the app's minimum (£25 standard, £100 for some codes); one code per first transfer, and a promo code rules out an invite code; rewards expire after 90 days; the recipient cannot be the referrer.
steps: Download the TapTap Send app, register and complete KYC
Start the first transfer, enter the code under "Have a referral code?" and confirm the reward shows
Complete the transfer (you can send to your own Wise euro or Turkish lira account)
Use the reward on your next transfer within 90 days
taptap-send-uk-first-transfer.risk: Only affiliate pages advertise the "£20 to Turkey" tier — it isn't published officially or in the app and is to be confirmed, so check the app shows a discount before ordering; the reward is used as a whole and may exceed what you meant to send; only one code, so choosing the £20 means no standard referral code.
taptap-send-uk-first-transfer.source: TapTap Send official referral terms (amounts and minimums as shown in the app, 90-day expiry) + ReferMonkey (£5 / first transfer £25) + Budgetfitter brand page (2026-11: Turkey £20, Budget100, FATIH2945) + Finder UK (2026-07: FINDER10)

revolut-uk-signup-20.title: [UK] Revolut signup bonus £20: first card purchase of £1+, to 12/31
revolut-uk-signup-20.highlight: New UK customers get a personal link by phone number, open an account, verify their identity and make a first card purchase of £1+ for £20 straight into the account; the campaign ends 2026-12-31 23:59 CET
revolut-uk-signup-20.regions: [UK] Great Britain (England, Scotland, Wales) and a dozen-plus euro-area markets
revolut-uk-signup-20.content: New customers enter a phone number for a personal download link, pass identity checks and make a first card purchase of £1+ (physical or virtual) for £20 straight into the Revolut account, with the offer running to 23:59 CET on 31 December 2026. A Manchester City Women version pays the same £20 but needs a first purchase of £20+, to the same deadline. Revolut has held a UK banking licence since 2026, with eligible deposits covered by the FSCS.
revolut-uk-signup-20.conditions: New Revolut customers 18+; pass identity checks and make one qualifying card purchase (gambling, gift cards and transfers do not count); one offer per person across campaigns; availability rolls out by region, so trust the app's rewards page at signup.
steps: Enter your phone number on the campaign page and get the personal download link
Open the account and verify your identity (passport or licence plus a selfie)
Order a physical card or use the virtual one for a purchase of £1+
The £20 usually lands a few business days after you complete the steps
revolut-uk-signup-20.risk: Rewards are split across campaigns and regions, and the campaign behind a link can rotate, so always check the in-app rewards page at signup; the promotion may involve withholding tax; existing Revolut customers can't take part.
revolut-uk-signup-20.source: Revolut official campaign page (Sziget edition £20 / first purchase £1+; Man City W.F.C. edition £20 / first purchase £20+, both dated 2026-12-31) + Revolut Help Centre referral conditions

remitly-first-transfer.title: [Multi-region] Remitly $20 off your first transfer
remitly-first-transfer.highlight: New customers get $20 off a first transfer of $40+, and the inviter gets $20 back each time
remitly-first-transfer.regions: [Multi-region] Sending from the US, Canada, UK, EU, Australia and others, with local first-transfer thresholds
remitly-first-transfer.content: New customers enter a referral or ambassador code on the Redeem Offer page and send a first international transfer of $40+ for $20 off; the referrer gets $20 off a later transfer once the friend sends. Some regions add exchange-rate boosts and fee waivers.
remitly-first-transfer.conditions: First-time Remitly users only, once per person; the discount applies to the first transfer only and does not reduce the minimum; the sending and receiving countries must be supported.
steps: Sign up for Remitly through the referral link
Enter the promo code on the Redeem Offer page and confirm it's applied
Complete a first transfer of $40 or more
The inviter uses their credit on their next transfer
remitly-first-transfer.risk: The discount is transfer credit, not cash; rates and fees are whatever the day's quote says, so don't ignore the FX spread just because of the $20.
remitly-first-transfer.source: Remitly official referral and offer terms (2026-10)

sendwave-referral.title: [US/EU] Sendwave invite: transfer credit for both sides
sendwave-referral.highlight: Enter a referral code before your first transfer and both sides get credit (the amount varies by country and corridor)
sendwave-referral.regions: [US/EU] The US and Europe are separate entities and corridors, with credit amounts differing by corridor
sendwave-referral.content: New users enter a referral code before their first transfer and, once it arrives, both sides get the credit shown in the app (commonly $5 on US corridors, €20 seen on French and euro accounts, about $10 for Brazil and Latin America), usable in parts on later transfers.
sendwave-referral.conditions: First-time senders only; some corridors, minimum amounts and KYC rules apply; the referrer must be on the same corridor for the reward to count.
steps: Download the app, register and pick up a code under Me → Refer a Friend, or use a friend's
Enter the referral code before the first transfer
Complete the first transfer and wait out the 24-hour reversal period
Check the credit in your balance
sendwave-referral.risk: The exact amount is to be confirmed: the official figure changes by country and promotion, so only what the app shows counts; test transfers (under $1) don't count.
sendwave-referral.source: Sendwave official referral terms (valid 12 months) + third-party app screenshots checked 2026-11

gigsky-free-esim.title: [Multi-region] GigSky free eSIM: 100MB / 7 days / 125 countries
gigsky-free-esim.highlight: 100MB with no card needed; 500MB in India; up to 5GB / 15 days with a Visa card
gigsky-free-esim.regions: [Multi-region] 125 countries on the base allowance; 500MB in India; up to 500MB in Europe; 175+ destinations for Visa cards
gigsky-free-esim.content: New users get one free trial eSIM: 100MB for seven days across 125 countries with no credit card, 500MB for seven days in India, up to 500MB in Europe, and eligible Visa cards unlock 1-5GB for 15 days or three to seven days unlimited at selected destinations (see the Visa entry).
gigsky-free-esim.conditions: One per person; an unlocked eSIM phone; Visa tiers need a qualifying card from an eligible issuer; data simply stops when the free allowance runs out.
steps: Download the GigSky app and register
Enter your destination and pick the free Standard allowance
Check out at $0 and install the eSIM
Turn on data roaming when you arrive
gigsky-free-esim.risk: 100MB is only enough to check that you can connect; cruises and some countries are charged separately, so don't treat the trial as your main data.

worldremit-uk-refer-a-friend.title: [UK] WorldRemit invite: a £10 voucher for the new customer, £20 for the inviter
worldremit-uk-refer-a-friend.highlight: New customers sign up with the referral link or code and after a first transfer of £30+ both sides get transfer vouchers: £10 for the new UK customer and £20 for the inviter; the voucher only offsets the next transfer and is subject to a minimum
worldremit-uk-refer-a-friend.regions: [UK] UK to most destinations (UK to Australia, Ghana, India, Nigeria, Pakistan, the US and Bangladesh excepted)
worldremit-uk-refer-a-friend.content: A new UK customer registers through the inviter's link or enters the code at signup and sends £30+, earning a £10 voucher while the inviter gets £20 (the FAQ: UK to countries other than Australia, Ghana, India, Nigeria, Pakistan, the US and Bangladesh pays £20/£10, and to Ghana £25/£10). Vouchers appear under Discounts in the app, work once and carry a minimum transfer; the inviter must have sent a transfer before to get a code.
worldremit-uk-refer-a-friend.conditions: New customers only; the code must be entered at registration and cannot be added later; £30+ first transfer; inviting someone at the same address or using the voucher to send back to the inviter does not count; the inviter needs a transfer history.
steps: Get the inviter's link or code (or make a transfer yourself first to become an inviter)
Enter the code on the WorldRemit signup page and complete signup and KYC
Send a first transfer of £30+ to a third party (your own Wise foreign-currency account works)
Find the £10 voucher under Discounts in the app and use it on your next transfer
worldremit-uk-refer-a-friend.risk: The voucher is transfer credit, not cash, and its real value depends on how you use it: community testing found that after the second transfer, fees and FX losses left about £7; WorldRemit reserves the right to cancel rewards and even close accounts for same-address referrals, multiple accounts or sending back to the inviter.
worldremit-uk-refer-a-friend.source: WorldRemit official Refer a Friend FAQ (UK reward table) + Refer a Friend terms + referralplug's UK referral index check (2026-11-18: new customer £10 / inviter £20 / first transfer £30)

ria-uk-refer-a-friend-20.title: [UK] Ria invite: £20 off each side on a first app transfer of £50+ (plus £4 and £6 add-ons)
ria-uk-refer-a-friend-20.highlight: New customers enter the inviter's code at signup and get £20 off a first app transfer of £50+; the inviter gets £20 too. A first transfer placed before 12/31 also earns £4 and £6 add-ons on the second and third transfers, stacking with HELLORIA's fee-free first transfer
ria-uk-refer-a-friend-20.regions: [UK] Register in the UK and order in the app; the add-on campaign excludes the Philippines
ria-uk-refer-a-friend-20.content: An existing UK customer generates a code in the app; a new UK customer enters it at signup and makes a first international transfer of £50+ in the app that arrives in full, earning £20 off that first transfer only (lapsing if unused), while the inviter gets £20 off a later £50+ transfer, up to two vouchers per transfer (£40). A separate UK New Customer £4 + £6 offer pays £4 on a second £50+ transfer and £6 on a third for first transfers ordered between 14 September and 31 December 2026, with those later transfers ordered by 31 March 2027. The same first transfer can also use HELLORIA for no fee (to 31 January 2028) and still earn the £4 and £6.
ria-uk-refer-a-friend-20.conditions: New UK customers ordering in the Ria app only; £50+ first transfer; the £20 covers the first transfer only, at most two vouchers per transfer; the £4 and £6 need £50+ second and third transfers, with the first ordered by 31 December 2026 and the Philippines outside the add-on list; no stacking with other offers on one transfer.
steps: Get the inviter's personal Ria app code
At signup choose "I have a referral code", enter it and complete KYC (a Chinese passport works, usually without proof of address)
Send a first transfer of £50+, checking the -£20 is applied on the confirmation page before paying (HELLORIA can waive the fee on the same order)
Watch for ADD4 / ADD6 on the second and third transfers of £50+
ria-uk-refer-a-friend-20.risk: The £20 first-order codes circulating in Chinese communities in mid-October were largely shut down around 10/20 and only some inviters' codes still work — if the app shows no discount, it's gone; the £20 only applies to a qualifying first transfer; multiple accounts and sending to yourself easily trigger a freeze; the add-on list excludes the Philippines, so the Maya route doesn't get £4/£6.
ria-uk-refer-a-friend-20.source: Ria official UK Promotional Terms (Refer-a-Friend, UK New Customer £4+£6, HELLORIA, Welcome Rates, captured 2026-11) + NodeSeek hands-on report 2026-10

lg-exaone-25-free-api.title: [Global] LG K-EXAONE 2.5 API open free: 750B parameters / 512K context / OpenAI compatible
lg-exaone-25-free-api.highlight: Register on the EXAONE API Platform for a key and call K-EXAONE 2.5 free: 750B total parameters, 31B active, 512K context, an OpenAI-compatible API and no card needed
lg-exaone-25-free-api.regions: [Global] Open to developers, startups, enterprises and research institutes; signup only in some countries, with mainland China restricted
lg-exaone-25-free-api.value: Free API (quota unpublished, roughly $20/mo of calls)
lg-exaone-25-free-api.content: LG AI Research announced at Seoul's NVIDIA AI Day on 9 November 2026 that the K-EXAONE 2.5 API is free: a 750B-parameter technical preview with 31B active, a 524,288-token maximum context counting input plus max_tokens, text only in Korean and English, with tool calling, structured output and streaming. The endpoint is OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/chat/completions under model name k-exaone_v2.5 at https://api.exaone.ai/v1. Register at docs.exaone.ai and create an API key with no card; over-quota requests return 429, rate limits appear in x-ratelimit-* headers, and agreeing to service-improvement use raises the daily limit.
lg-exaone-25-free-api.conditions: Register an EXAONE API Platform account (open only in some countries and possibly needing the right network); the free period, allowance and rate limits are unpublished; the model does not support Chinese, only Korean and English; input plus output must stay under 524,288 tokens.
steps: Open docs.exaone.ai, register and verify your email
Create an API key in the console
Point any OpenAI-compatible client at https://api.exaone.ai/v1 with model k-exaone_v2.5
Send a small request to check connectivity and limits (failures are usually region or quota; check the x-ratelimit-* headers)
lg-exaone-25-free-api.risk: "Free" comes with no promise on duration or quota, there's no price page, and it can start charging or throttling at any time; Korean and English only, so it's not for Chinese content; direct access from mainland China is limited; a technical-preview model is weaker and less stable than commercial ones, so don't put it straight into production.
lg-exaone-25-free-api.source: LG AI Research official news of 2026-11-09 "K-EXAONE 2.5 API Available for Free" + official API docs (524,288 context / OpenAI compatible, rechecked 2026-11-19)

sendwave-latam-tshirt.title: [US only] Sendwave Latin America invite: 3 friends for a limited T-shirt
sendwave-latam-tshirt.highlight: Refer 3 new Brazil or Latin America customers between 10/10 and 11/28 for a commemorative T-shirt
sendwave-latam-tshirt.regions: [US only] Residents of the 50 US states as referrers
sendwave-latam-tshirt.content: Sendwave's Viva LATAM campaign from 10 October to 28 November gives existing US customers a Hispanic Heritage T-shirt for bringing in three qualifying new customers through the in-app invite code who send a first transfer at their market's referral amount.
sendwave-latam-tshirt.conditions: The referrer must be a legal resident of the 50 states with an account in good standing; invitees must be brand new with a first transfer at or above their market's credit, about $10 for Brazil and Latin America.
steps: Open the Sendwave app and tap the gift icon for your invite code
Share the code with new users sending to Latin America
Each successful first transfer counts as one
After 3, follow the email to give your shipping details
sendwave-latam-tshirt.risk: The reward is physical, not cash, and shipping is limited to some regions; the campaign ends 11/28 23:59 Eastern, after which qualifying referrals don't count.
sendwave-latam-tshirt.source: Sendwave official campaign terms (promotion period specified)

databasemart-black-friday-vps.title: [Global] Database Mart Black Friday VPS: from $0.99/mo (up to 80% off, ends Nov 28)
databasemart-black-friday-vps.highlight: Black Friday from November 15 to 28 (US Central): Linux VPS from $0.99/mo (the Lite plan with 1 core, 1GB RAM and 30GB disk at -80% on a 3-year term), Basic Linux VPS (4 cores, 8GB) at $4.55/mo on 3 years, GPU VPS from $11.60/mo and dedicated servers from $29.40/mo, with some plans locking in a lifetime price and a 24-hour free trial on request
databasemart-black-friday-vps.regions: [Global] Database Mart's own site with US data centres, accepting Visa, Mastercard, Amex and PayPal
databasemart-black-friday-vps.content: Database Mart's 2026 Black Friday sale runs November 15 to 28 (Central Time): VPS from $0.99/mo (the Linux VPS Lite with 1 core, 1GB RAM, 30GB disk and 50Mbps at -80% on a 3-year term), the Basic Linux VPS (4 cores, 8GB RAM, 140GB disk) at $4.55/mo on three years, the Professional Linux VPS (8 cores, 18GB, 240GB) at $9.12/mo, GPU VPS from $11.60/mo with 2GB of GPU memory and dedicated servers from $29.40/mo, up to 80% off across the page. Some plans lock in a lifetime renewal price. Eligible VPS orders can ask for a 24-hour free trial in the order notes, and customers normally cap at three servers.
databasemart-black-friday-vps.conditions: Discounts depend on the billing term (monthly -30% to -55%, quarterly -35% to -58%, annual -40% to -63%, two years -55% to -68%, three years -60% to -80%), so the longer term means paying it all up front; new orders only, paid add-ons excluded; limited stock; three servers per customer; the cheapest tier is a small 1-core 1GB box.
steps: Open the Database Mart Black Friday page and pick a Linux or Windows VPS plan
Choose the billing term at checkout and confirm the discounted monthly and total price
Ask for the 24-hour trial in the order notes if you want to test first
The server comes online within 1 to 10 minutes after payment
databasemart-black-friday-vps.risk: The $0.99/mo figure is the smallest box stretched across a three-year prepayment, so you pay years up front; a 1-core 1GB box will not run a modern panel or database; renewal pricing depends on whether the plan is one of the lifetime-price ones, otherwise the second year reverts to list price; the countdown widget on the page read zero at check time, so the Nov 15-28 window in the page copy is the reference.
databasemart-black-friday-vps.source: Database Mart's official 2026 Black Friday page (read 24 November 2026: sale Nov 15-28 CST, VPS from $0.99/mo, up to 80% off, GPU from $11.60/mo, dedicated from $29.40/mo)

airalo-first-order.title: [Global] Airalo new-customer code NEWTOAIRALO15: 15% off the first eSIM, up to $100 (valid to 1 Jan 2027)
airalo-first-order.highlight: Airalo's official partner code for new customers, NEWTOAIRALO15, takes 15% off the first eSIM up to $100, with terms running to 1 January 2027 or until redemptions run out; the separate BLACK25 Unlimited deal is covered in its own entry
airalo-first-order.regions: [Global] Any country Airalo sells; new accounts only, one code per order
airalo-first-order.content: Airalo's current 15% new-customer code is NEWTOAIRALO15: 15% off any eSIM on the first order, capped at $100, with official terms running to 1 January 2027 or until redemptions run out. It works on the website and in the app and accepts card, PayPal, Alipay, Apple Pay and Google Pay. One code per order, it cannot be combined with an Airmoney referral code, and orders that use a code do not earn Airmoney. The monthly code that used to sit on the official discounts page (for example NOVEMBER15!) now 302s to the homepage, so confirm the new code at checkout (unverified as of 25 November 2026).
airalo-first-order.conditions: New accounts on a first order only; one code per order and no stacking with Airmoney referral codes; orders that use a code earn no Airmoney; the checkout total is the final word; Airalo can revoke a code for abuse or multiple accounts.
steps: Pick a destination and plan on the Airalo website or app
Enter NEWTOAIRALO15 in the Redeem code field at checkout
Confirm the price actually dropped before paying
Install the eSIM when you arrive
airalo-first-order.risk: The official discounts page is gone, so the code only counts if checkout accepts it; it can run out or be revoked early; plans are sold by data and days and are not refundable if you buy too much; it cannot be stacked with a referral code.
airalo-first-order.source: Airalo official terms (NEWTOAIRALO15: 15% off, capped at $100, valid to 1 January 2027) + Traviva 18 November 2026, eSIMDiscountCodes 18 November 2026 and NETZWELT 23 November 2026 checks; re-checked 25 November 2026: the official discounts page now 302s to the homepage, so verify at checkout

flexiroam-mastercard-gdr-3gb.title: [Global] FlexiRoam × Mastercard: free 3GB / 15-day global roaming eSIM
flexiroam-mastercard-gdr-3gb.highlight: Eligible Mastercard holders get 3GB / 15 days free a year across 150+ countries, with 20% off later plans
flexiroam-mastercard-gdr-3gb.regions: [Global] 150+ countries and 520+ partner networks; eligibility depends on issuer and card tier (World Elite generally included)
flexiroam-mastercard-gdr-3gb.content: A Mastercard benefit: verify a 16-digit card at gdr.flexiroam.com and claim a 3GB, 15-day global roaming pack (150+ countries) in the FlexiRoam app, as eSIM or physical card, then take 20% off FlexiRoam plans paid with that card. Each eligible card account claims once a calendar year, must activate within the card's year of issue, gets 15 consecutive days from activation and can book a later start date.
flexiroam-mastercard-gdr-3gb.conditions: A valid eligible Mastercard (World Elite carries the 3GB/15-day standard, some World and co-branded cards differ); once per card account per calendar year; verification places about a US$1 pre-authorisation that is later released; an unlocked eSIM phone.
steps: Open gdr.flexiroam.com and enter the 16-digit Mastercard number to check eligibility
Once approved, confirm the benefit and watch for FlexiRoam's activation-code email
Download the FlexiRoam app, enter the code and choose eSIM or a physical SIM
Activate in the app before you go (or schedule the start date) and turn on data roaming on arrival
flexiroam-mastercard-gdr-3gb.risk: Not every Mastercard qualifies, and entering a wrong number more than twice can lock the account (you'd have to send ID photos to support to unlock); once per card per year and it must be activated in that year; data beyond 3GB is charged at standard rates.
flexiroam-mastercard-gdr-3gb.source: FlexiRoam official Global Data Roaming page (read 2026-11-19) + Westpac benefit note + The MileLion guide (2026-02-04)

openrouter-qwen4-max-free.title: [Global] OpenRouter free flagship models: Qwen4-Max / Hy4 Flash (1M context, $0 API)
openrouter-qwen4-max-free.highlight: Alibaba's Qwen4-Max (released 11/16) and Tencent's Hy4 Flash are open on OpenRouter's :free endpoints with $0 input and output, 1M context and rate-limited calls
openrouter-qwen4-max-free.regions: [Global] Any OpenRouter account; free endpoints are rate-limited and Qwen4-Max does not yet route inside the EU
openrouter-qwen4-max-free.content: OpenRouter has put two new flagships on free endpoints: Alibaba's Qwen4-Max (qwen/qwen4-max:free, 1M context, text, image and video input, tool calls and structured output, reasoning on by default) and Tencent's Hy4 Flash (tencent/hy4-flash:free, 1M context, reads images). Both cost $0 for prompts and completions and work with an API key from a registered account, subject to official rate limits.
openrouter-qwen4-max-free.conditions: An OpenRouter account and API key; free endpoints carry request and daily limits that may change; Qwen4-Max does not yet route inside the EU, so EU users may be sent outside; free endpoints have no SLA and are not for production.
steps: Register at openrouter.ai and create an API key
Set base_url to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 and the model to qwen/qwen4-max:free or tencent/hy4-flash:free
Call within the official rate limits (exceeding them returns 429)
Top up or switch to a paid endpoint if you need more
openrouter-qwen4-max-free.risk: Free endpoints are throttled and can be withdrawn or turned paid at any time; output quality matches the paid versions but availability is not guaranteed, so don't put important work on them; no EU routing, so assess data leaving the region yourself.
openrouter-qwen4-max-free.source: OpenRouter official model page (qwen/qwen4-max:free, Price: Free, 1M context, released 2026-11-16) + Tencent Hy4 Flash free endpoint page

cricket-free-trial-14d.title: [US] Cricket 14-day free trial: 3GB + unlimited calls and texts (eSIM, no credit card)
cricket-free-trial-14d.highlight: Use the tryCricket app on an unlocked eSIM phone for a 14-day trial with 3GB of data and unlimited US calls and texts, without disturbing your current plan and without a credit card
cricket-free-trial-14d.regions: [US] Inside the US only; an unlocked eSIM phone
cricket-free-trial-14d.content: Cricket Wireless, AT&T's prepaid brand, runs tryCricket: download the app and confirm the phone is unlocked with eSIM for a 14-day free trial with 3GB of data (video limited to SD), unlimited US calls and texts and 5G where supported, on a temporary Cricket number that leaves your existing service alone, with the option to switch to a paid plan at any time.
cricket-free-trial-14d.conditions: Inside the US only; an unlocked eSIM phone; one trial per person and at most five per address; the temporary number belongs to Cricket and cannot be ported or kept; no international calls; it runs on AT&T and follows US eUICC EID allowlists, so third-party physical cards need support registration.
steps: Download tryCricket from the App Store or Google Play
Follow the prompts to check the IMEI is unlocked and eSIM-ready
Get a temporary number and activate the eSIM
Switch data to the Cricket line and test it for 14 days
cricket-free-trial-14d.risk: It only works inside the US, so it's useless abroad; the number and data both stop when the trial ends; 5G needs a compatible handset.
cricket-free-trial-14d.source: Cricket Wireless official free-trial page and the tryCricket EULA (read 2026-11-19)

topcashback-uk-signup-10.title: [UK] TopCashback UK: £10 new-member bonus (sign up 11/16–11/29)
topcashback-uk-signup-10.highlight: Sign up through an invite link between 10:00 GMT on 16 November and 10:00 on 29 November and earn £10 of confirmed cashback at eligible merchants within 180 days for a £10 bonus
topcashback-uk-signup-10.regions: [UK] The UK site topcashback.co.uk only, for UK new members aged 18+
topcashback-uk-signup-10.content: TopCashback UK's referral offer: register through an invite link and verify the account between 10:00 GMT on 16 November and 10:00 GMT on 29 November 2026, then earn £10 of approved cashback at eligible merchants within 180 days, and £10 lands as a new-member bonus by bank transfer while the referrer gets £20-25. The amount and threshold change each round, £15 in early November, so the figure on the signup page is the one for your order.
topcashback-uk-signup-10.conditions: UK site new users aged 18+; register through the invite and verify; the £10 must be approved cashback from eligible merchants, with brand or goodwill cashback and other new-member bonuses excluded; once per person.
steps: Register through the UK-site invite link and verify the account
Click through to eligible merchants and shop as normal
Accumulate £10 of confirmed cashback within 180 days
The bonus is paid out with the cashback by bank transfer

skrill-uk-raf-10-off-100.title: [UK] Skrill cross-border transfer: £10 off £100 (and a Mastercard if you want one)
skrill-uk-raf-10-off-100.highlight: New UK customers register through a referral link or code and, after a first cross-border transfer of £100+, both sides get £10 of transfer credit; verify KYC with a passport plus UK proof of address, pay with a UK card, and you can also open a euro-denominated Skrill Prepaid Mastercard (virtual card instantly, works with Apple/Google Pay)
skrill-uk-raf-10-off-100.regions: [UK] A UK Skrill account (FCA-regulated) sending to about 39 countries incl. Germany, Italy, the US and the Philippines; sender and recipient in different countries
skrill-uk-raf-10-off-100.content: The UK row of the terms sets a £100 minimum transfer (or the sending currency's equivalent) and a £10 referral credit for both sides. The new customer registers through the link or enters the code on the first-transfer page (valid three months from signup) and makes a cross-border transfer of £100+ that is delivered in full excluding fees and taxes; once the recipient is credited, Skrill places £10 under My Account then Refer a Friend, usable on a later qualifying transfer within three months, up to £50 per transfer across five credits. KYC needs ID and address proof (passport plus UK address proof, with four days to complete), and payment must come from a UK-issued debit or credit card or UK bank account, not the Skrill balance. The same account can apply for a Skrill Prepaid Mastercard (UK and EEA residents, digital instantly, physical in 15 working days, euro-denominated). Tests show UK-card transfers to Germany, the US, Italy and the Philippines arriving in seconds, done on the website, since app orders do not qualify.
skrill-uk-raf-10-off-100.conditions: New Skrill customers only, one account per person; register through the link or enter the code on the first transfer and complete it within three months; the first transfer must be cross-border, £100+ and delivered; card payments, wallet top-ups and withdrawals, moving money between your own accounts and sending back to the referrer do not count; pay by card or bank account only; complete KYC within four days; the £10 lasts three months, caps at £50 per transfer and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.
steps: Ask an existing Skrill Money Transfer user for a referral link or code (they must have sent a transfer themselves to generate one)
Register a UK Skrill account through the link, or tap "Got a referral code?" on the first transfer page and enter it
Complete KYC: passport plus UK proof of address with matching name and address
Do everything on skrill.com: choose UK → Germany/US/Italy/Philippines, at least £100, paid with a UK debit or credit card
Once the recipient's funds are confirmed, the £10 appears under My Account → Refer a Friend
Spend the credit on a second cross-border transfer of £100+ within 3 months; for the card go to Skrill Card → Apply now — the virtual card is immediate
skrill-uk-raf-10-off-100.risk: The terms contradict themselves: 3.4 says the credit applies to "the next transfer" while 3.6 and the marketing page say new customers can use it on the first, so go by the quote at checkout and plan for a second £100+ transfer; it isn't free to run — 1% card top-up plus 3.99% FX (with Skrill's own rate mark-up) makes two £100 transfers cost about £7–8, leaving roughly £5, so it's only worth it if you meant to send money anyway; "instant" and "must use the website, not the app" are user data points, and the official promise is minutes to 2 business days; the card is euro-denominated with a €10 annual fee (some users also pay a €10 issuance fee), 1.75% at ATMs and 3.99% FX, so only open it if you'll really spend; the UK proof of address must genuinely be yours, since borrowing an address is a compliance risk that can freeze the account and make the balance hard to recover; accounts with no transactions for 12 months pay a €5/mo inactivity fee; from 2027-02-01 the UK Skrill business moves from Skrill Limited to Paysafe Financial Services Limited and the terms will change with it.
skrill-uk-raf-10-off-100.source: Skrill Money Transfer Refer a Friend terms (skrill.com/en/footer/terms-conditions/skrill-money-transfer-raf/: UK row GBP 100 → GBP 10; when the page refused crawling, cross-checked against the same page's 2027-02-01 version and the terms PDF, 2026-11-19) + Skrill official transfer-money FAQ (new customers get "£10 off their first transfer", KYC needs ID plus proof of address within 4 days) + Skrill Prepaid Mastercard page and terms (UK/EEA residents only, €10 annual fee, €10 issuance fee for some users, virtual card immediate) + Skrill UK fee notes of 2026-11-03 (1% card top-up, 3.99% FX, 1.75% withdrawal) + a UK user's hands-on data point (UK card payment, instant to Germany/US/Italy/Philippines, all on the website)

etisalat-wasel-flexi-10gb-esim.title: [AE] e& (etisalat) eSIM: a new Wasel Flexi line gets 10GB of local data

steps: Choose a Wasel Flexi plan on the e& website or the e& UAE app
Select eSIM as the SIM type when activating the new line
Complete the purchase and activation
Open My Rewards in the app and claim the 10GB

etisalat-wasel-flexi-10gb-esim.source: e& (etisalat) official Wasel Flexi promotion FAQ

du-uae-free-tourist-esim.title: [AE] du free tourist eSIM: 10GB / 24 hours (scan on arrival)
du-uae-free-tourist-esim.highlight: Scan after landing in Dubai or Abu Dhabi for 10GB of free local data for 24 hours, with no plan to buy and no number to swap
du-uae-free-tourist-esim.regions: [AE] UAE-local data only (no roaming); claim after arriving at Dubai, Abu Dhabi or Sharjah airports
du-uae-free-tourist-esim.content: du's official tourist eSIM gives arrivals 10GB of UAE-local data for 24 hours, activated entirely online: scan the QR code at the airport or on du's free tourist eSIM page after landing and register passport and visa details, with no physical card and no need to remove your own SIM. When the 24 hours end, tourist plans continue it in the du app or a store: 4GB for 28 days at AED 49, 10GB for 28 days at AED 99, unlimited for 7 days at AED 199, 14 days at AED 299 or 28 days at AED 499.
du-uae-free-tourist-esim.conditions: Tourists arriving in the UAE, 18+, with a valid passport and entry stamp or visa; at most two du cards per passport; UAE-local data only; an unlocked eSIM phone; activation inside the UAE.
steps: After landing and clearing immigration, open du's free tourist eSIM page (du.ae/tourist redirects to shop.du.ae) or scan the airport QR code
Scan the on-page QR code with your phone and register your passport and visa details
Install the eSIM, switch the data line to it and enable data roaming
When the 24 hours end, top up a tourist plan in the du app to keep going
du-uae-free-tourist-esim.risk: Only 24 hours, so use it on landing day; UAE local only, so it won't roam into Saudi Arabia or Europe; 2 cards per passport; it must be activated inside the country, so it can't be installed before you fly.
du-uae-free-tourist-esim.source: du official free tourist eSIM page (still showing Free / 10GB / 24 hours when checked 2026-11-19) + du tourist handbook PDF; Gulf News (2025-09-12) on where to get it and the passport limit

eand-uae-free-visitor-line-esim.title: [AE] e& (etisalat) Free Visitor Line eSIM: 10GB / 24 hours for AED 0
eand-uae-free-visitor-line-esim.highlight: AED 0 including a new number, self-activated with a face scan, usable straight after landing at Abu Dhabi or Sharjah airport
eand-uae-free-visitor-line-esim.regions: [AE] UAE-local data only; arrivals at Zayed International in Abu Dhabi or Sharjah airport, or online at e&
eand-uae-free-visitor-line-esim.content: e& UAE's Free Visitor Line lists at AED 0 plus 5% VAT with 10GB of local data for 24 hours and a new number. Tourists clear immigration, scan the on-site code, upload a passport and complete face recognition to self-activate the eSIM, or pick an eSIM on the Visitor Line page at e& online. Since November 2025 Abu Dhabi airport and e& have given the same 10GB one-day card to all international arrivals, with Sharjah following in October. After 24 hours, Visitor Line plans continue it: 4GB for 28 days at AED 46.66, 10GB for 28 days at AED 94.28, unlimited for seven days at AED 190.47, each plus 5% VAT.
eand-uae-free-visitor-line-esim.conditions: Tourists arriving in the UAE, 18+, with a valid passport and visa or entry record; at most two Visitor Lines per passport; UAE-local data only; the eSIM must be requested inside the UAE, not while roaming; an unlocked eSIM phone.
steps: After immigration, scan the airport QR code or choose Free Visitor Line (AED 0) on eand.ae's Visitor Line page
Select eSIM as the SIM type, upload your passport and finish the face check
Install the eSIM QR code you receive on your phone
Turn on data roaming on arrival and use the 10GB within 24 hours
eand-uae-free-visitor-line-esim.risk: Only 24 hours; after that, out-of-plan data is charged by usage (third-party guides say about AED 1.05/20MB capped at AED 9.45 a day, to be confirmed), so turn data off or buy a plan before it ends; the eSIM must be requested inside the UAE.
eand-uae-free-visitor-line-esim.source: e& UAE official Visitor Line page (checked 2026-11-19: Free Visitor Line AED 0 / 10GB / 24 hours / includes a new SIM); e& press releases of 2024-09-16 and 2025-11-20 (Abu Dhabi airport partnership); Telecompaper 2025-10 (Sharjah airport)

steps: Register a free account at 1free.eu without a card
Take the Free hosting plan and attach your own or the provided subdomain
Upload the site or install a supported PHP app and enable free SSL
Order a paid VPS plan when you need root

1free-eu-host-vps.source: 1free.eu official home page (read 2026-11-24: free ad-free hosting forever) + official VPS page (read 2026-11-24: VPS is now paid, VPS S 20 zloty a year, VPS M 8.50 zloty a month, cheapest 2.50 zloty a month; no 30-day free trial found)

ace-money-transfer-uk-india-10.title: [UK] ACE Money Transfer: £10 off a first transfer to India (£100 minimum)

steps: Download the app from ACE's official campaign page, register and complete KYC
Start a first transfer to India for £100 or more
Enter the campaign page's promo code and confirm the £10 comes off before paying
To earn the referral reward, have a friend use your invite code for £10 of wallet points each

Open the model plaza and click "New user benefits · free trial" at the top right
Tick the models you want (Hunyuan, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi and so on) and click "Claim now"
Get an API key under Online inference in the console and use it within the year

tencent-tokenhub-new-user-pack.source: Tencent Cloud TokenHub official docs "New-user free trial pack" (updated 2026-11-16, campaign to 2026-12-31) + product page "New users claim a million free tokens with no threshold"

klook-data-bank-gift.title: [TW/TH/MY/VN] Klook Data Bank launch gift: 0.5–50GB of free travel data (to 12/31)
klook-data-bank-gift.highlight: Klook accounts in Taiwan, Thailand, Malaysia or Vietnam can open a mystery data gift box (0.5–50GB), store it in the Data Bank to add to a later eSIM purchase, or pass it to 2–5 friends
klook-data-bank-gift.regions: [TW/TH/MY/VN] Klook users whose account residence is Taiwan, Thailand, Malaysia or Vietnam
klook-data-bank-gift.content: Klook's Data Bank campaign (16 November to 31 December 2026, or while boxes last) gives signed-in users in those markets one mystery data box of 0.5GB to 50GB, with larger amounts less likely. Claiming your own box unlocks two to five gifts for friends (0.5, 1 or 3GB unlocks five of the same size, 7GB two of 3.5GB, 15GB three of 5GB, 25GB five of 5GB and 50GB five of 10GB).
klook-data-bank-gift.conditions: Klook accounts resident in Taiwan, Thailand, Malaysia or Vietnam; one claim per account; Data Bank data must stack on a purchased eligible eSIM and cannot stand as a free eSIM; no mixing with promo codes or vouchers; home-market eSIMs are excluded; destinations such as Argentina, Brunei, Latin America, Guam, the Maldives and Mongolia are unsupported.
steps: Sign in with a qualifying Klook account and open the Data Bank campaign page on klook.com
Tap a gift box to claim the mystery data, revealed on the spot and stored in the Data Bank
When you next buy an eligible eSIM, add the Data Bank balance at checkout (gift data is used first)
To give to friends, use "Gift a friend" on the campaign page; they must also be in a qualifying market and can receive only one
klook-data-bank-gift.risk: The box is random and mostly small (0.5–3GB); you must buy an eSIM to use it, so it isn't free data on its own; residency is decided by the Klook profile and mainland Chinese accounts don't see the entry; the data isn't cash, can't be withdrawn and disappears if unused for 180 days.
klook-data-bank-gift.source: Klook official Data Bank campaign page + official T&C (databank_gtm_2026, markets limited to TW/TH/MY/VN, 2026-11-16 to 12-31)

Choose your destination and claim the trial eSIM
Install it on Wi-Fi with one tap before you travel
It activates on arrival; use the 1GB within 3 days

moneygram-uk-invite-friends.title: [UK] MoneyGram invite friends: a discount on a new customer's first transfer (about £10, to be confirmed)
