moneygram-uk-invite-friends.regions: [UK] UK, with transfers through moneygram.com or the MoneyGram app
moneygram-uk-invite-friends.content: MoneyGram UK's Invite Friends lets an existing customer who has sent one online transfer generate a personal link or code; a new customer registers with it and gets a discount on a first online international transfer, and the existing customer earns one once the friend's money arrives, for up to 10 friends. The official Program Information (UK 2026) sets only the mechanics and leaves the amount, minimum transfer and number of vouchers to the Refer and Earn page in the app, so no figure appears officially; third parties such as My Side Gig on 14 November 2026 say £10. The newcomer's discount does not expire, the existing customer's lasts 60 days and neither stacks with other promo codes; Plus Rewards members also get 50% off the second transfer fee.
moneygram-uk-invite-friends.conditions: A new customer has never opened an online MoneyGram profile (store-only senders still count as new); the transfer must be online or in the app, not in a store; the amount and minimum are whatever Refer and Earn shows; one voucher per transfer with no other promotions stacked.
steps: Ask a friend who has used MoneyGram for their Refer and Earn link or code
Register an online MoneyGram profile with that link and complete verification
Confirm the discount is applied on your first online international transfer (card payments don't get the related fee waiver)
Once it arrives, the existing customer's discount appears on their next transfer
moneygram-uk-invite-friends.risk: The amount isn't published — £10 comes from third parties, so confirm it in the app after registering; the discount covers only one transfer and can't be stacked; MoneyGram can change or end the programme at any time, and the FX spread is still there.
moneygram-uk-invite-friends.source: MoneyGram UK official Invite Friends page + Invite Friends Program Information (UK 2026) + My Side Gig's UK transfer ranking (2026-11-14, listing £10)

The 47 destinations include Egypt, Turkey, Malaysia, Singapore, Japan, Korea and much of Europe but not the UAE, Saudi Arabia and other Gulf states.
opera-android-free-esim-3gb.conditions: Opera for Android from Google Play (not Opera Mini or Opera GX mobile), Android 10+, an unlocked eSIM phone; the free 3GB only goes to users located in the 11 listed markets; one eSIM per phone; the destination must be on the 47-country list.
steps: Install or update Opera for Android from Google Play
Tap the profile icon at the bottom right, scroll to eSIM and tap Claim now
Choose and confirm the destination country
Install the eSIM on Wi-Fi
Turn on data roaming on arrival and the 3 days start

remitly-uk-cashback.title: [UK] Remitly new-customer cashback: TopCashback £8 / Quidco £6.40 (stackable with the first-transfer offer)
remitly-uk-cashback.highlight: New customers click through from a cashback site, register via the link and send a first transfer of £100+: TopCashback £8, Quidco £6.40 (Premium rate), KidStart up to £15; Remitly's own first-transfer fee waiver or rate boost applies at the same time, but don't add third-party promo codes
remitly-uk-cashback.regions: [UK] UK senders only; unlike the US $20-$25 coupons
remitly-uk-cashback.content: Click Get cashback on a UK cashback site's Remitly page, register a UK Remitly account in the same browser session and send a first international transfer for a fixed payment. TopCashback UK pays £8 for new customers on £100+; Quidco shows £6.40 at its Premium rate (about £6 standard); KidStart pays up to £15 into a child's savings account rather than withdrawable cash; ShopBuddies pays up to £8 and Rakuten up to £7. Cashback shows as pending within 24 hours and becomes withdrawable once Remitly confirms (Quidco pays within six months). Remitly's own first-transfer offer (no fee, rate boost or discount, per the signup quote) usually applies automatically and stacks, but cashback sites generally void rewards for unapproved promo codes.
remitly-uk-cashback.conditions: New Remitly customers; £100 minimum first transfer (some comparison sites say £200, so follow the order page); start from the cashback link and finish in one session with ad and price-comparison blockers off; TopCashback excludes unapproved codes and Quidco excludes extra discounts that cut the sale price, so a friend's referral code can void cashback; Quidco's £6.40 needs Premium (£1 a month deducted from cashback).
steps: Register or sign in to TopCashback UK or Quidco (or check GotCashback first to see who pays most that day)
Search Remitly on the cashback site and click Get cashback, with ad blockers and coupon extensions off
Register a new UK Remitly account in the same browser session, complete KYC and confirm the first-transfer offer has applied
Send a first transfer of £100+ to a third-party recipient (not yourself and not the inviter) and let it be delivered
Check the pending record on the cashback site within 24 hours; it becomes withdrawable after the merchant confirms (Quidco up to 6 months)
remitly-uk-cashback.risk: The "$25 off Remitly" links circulating online are almost all US-only codes and do nothing in the UK; cashback is confirmed after the fact, so a cancelled transfer, closed account or merchant rejection means nothing at all — don't budget it into the first transfer; KidStart's £15 is a tier cap and only goes into a child's savings account; "fee-free" usually just moves the cost into the FX spread, so compare what the recipient actually receives.
remitly-uk-cashback.source: TopCashback UK Remitly merchant page (rechecked 2026-11-19: new customers £8, first transfer £100+; the official site returns 403 to non-UK IPs, so terms were cross-checked against search caches and comparison sites) + Quidco Remitly merchant page (captured 2026-11-19: £6.40 is the Premium rate, first transfer from £100, tracked within 24 hours, paid within 6 months) + GotCashback comparison page (captured 2026-11-18: KidStart up to £15, ShopBuddies up to £8, Rakuten up to £7, all tier caps) + Remitly UK referral page and referral terms (friend's first-transfer discount / rate boost / fee waiver, amounts vary by campaign)

hoody-free-cloud-computers.regions: [Global] Shared Hoody hosting (preferred regions requested, actual placement subject to capacity and fallback); no KVM
hoody-free-cloud-computers.content: A platform selling each cloud computer as a Linux host reachable at a URL, free at $0 a month with no card and no expiry: up to three computers sharing 2 CPU cores, 3GB of RAM, 20GB of storage and 10Mbps, each keeping two snapshots, with five .hoody.bot bot domains, five Realms and free Hoody AI credit. Root and systemd let it run code, browsers, GUI desktops, scheduled jobs and HTTP services that publish a URL on binding a port, and it can back up to S3, Google Drive, Dropbox or WebDAV. It suits practice, small scripts, throwaway sites and browser automation; Paid Plus at $10 a month gives 12 computers (3 cores, 6GB, 75GB) across eight regions.
hoody-free-cloud-computers.conditions: The free quota is shared across three computers; hosts are shared with others and capacity is limited, so a region at signup is only a preference; no virtual machines (that needs the paid Bare Metal tier); free Hoody AI models and availability are not guaranteed; activity and capacity limits may change.
steps: Open hoody.com and sign up (no credit card needed)
Claim the free server and open the web terminal or log in over SSH
Install dependencies and run scripts; for a public service, bind the port and the URL is published
Sync important files to external storage so they aren't lost when the instance is cleaned up
hoody-free-cloud-computers.risk: The free tier has no SLA on shared hosts, so resources can be reclaimed or changed at any time; don't keep the only copy of important data there; the platform is new and its terms and free policy can change.
hoody-free-cloud-computers.source: Hoody official pricing page (checked 2026-11-19 for the free-tier specs and "no card / 3 computers")

cloady-free-tier.regions: [Global] Free-tier regions EU1 Germany, USE1 US East and USW1 US West (Japan takes no new free apps)

It deploys from GitHub pushes, Docker images, direct uploads or a template market (WordPress, Vaultwarden, Nginx Proxy Manager and more), gives every web app an xxx.cloady.io subdomain with TLS, and offers a REST API, CLI, Terraform and MCP. cloady-free-tier.conditions: Register with a real mailbox that receives mail (temporary and bulk signups banned); the free quota is shared across the workspace, so extra apps exceed it; going over without a card prompts an upgrade rather than charging; mining, Tor and IRC are banned; free tiers and trial regions may change.

The workspace is created automatically; click Deploy and choose a GitHub repo, image, directory upload or template
Pick EU1, USE1 or USW1, keep resources within the workspace's free quota and confirm the page shows $0.00/mo
Open the assigned cloady.io domain after deployment (if a Docker image's port isn't detected, use a Dockerfile with EXPOSE or specify the port in the API)
cloady-free-tier.risk: "Free forever" is a community claim — the official site only promises a free tier plus free trials in some regions, and users report it becoming free for one month, so long-term availability is unclear; the free specs are tiny, so a real site will exceed them; the Japan region has workspaces but restricted free apps, so choose the region manually.

jetpac-eterna-free-esim.title: [Global] Jetpac Eterna lifetime free eSIM: 4 × 100MB a year
jetpac-eterna-free-esim.highlight: Claim once and it lasts for life: 100MB per trip, up to 4 times a year (2 months apart); WhatsApp / Google Maps / Uber / Grab use zero data (throttled to 1Mbps)
jetpac-eterna-free-esim.regions: [Global] International roaming (mainland China tests rode China Mobile or Unicom with a Singapore exit IP); eligible users in 10 countries only
jetpac-eterna-free-esim.content: A lifetime-free travel eSIM: once claimed it stays on the device, installing brings 100MB and another 100MB can be claimed in the app every two months, up to four a year (about 400MB). Even with the 100MB spent, WhatsApp, Google Maps, Uber and Grab keep working unlimited at about 1Mbps without touching the allowance. It is data only with no number, no calls or texts, and works only abroad, not at home. Forums ran restock reports through October and November 2026.
jetpac-eterna-free-esim.conditions: Eligible users in the US, UK, Australia, Canada, Germany, Spain, Italy, the Netherlands, New Zealand and France, registering with a number from those countries (Google Voice passes in tests); install through the Jetpac app; not for domestic data; one account per person; existing paid plans must end first; contact support before changing phones or reinstalling.
steps: Open the Jetpac Eterna claim page, tap redeem and fill in name, mobile and email
Choose the US or Canada as the country (it goes through more smoothly) and verify with a number that receives codes
Download the Jetpac app, sign in with the same email and install the eSIM
Enable the line abroad; after that you can claim another 100MB in the app every 2 months
jetpac-eterna-free-esim.risk: 100MB a time is very little and only an arrival stopgap; the official terms limit it to eligible international roaming and exclude domestic use; the zero-data apps are only those four and throttled to 1Mbps, so it's not main data.
jetpac-eterna-free-esim.source: Jetpac official Eterna page (eligibility, 4 times a year and the zero-data apps are all stated); NodeSeek post-969696 / 969051 (2026-10-07), post-1030534 (2026-11-04), Naixi forum thread-15892 (2026-10-07), Shaobing forum t/16798 (2026-11-04)

eskimo-free-esim.title: [Global] Eskimo free eSIM: 250MB of global data for new users (126 countries, no expiry)
eskimo-free-esim.highlight: Enter FREE250MB as the referral or gift code at signup for 250MB of free global data covering 126 countries and regions, with no expiry and no credit card
eskimo-free-esim.regions: [Global] 126+ countries including Japan, China, the US, Italy and Thailand; new users only
eskimo-free-esim.content: A free trial from travel eSIM brand Eskimo (Singapore's Datapro): new users enter FREE250MB in the referral or gift code field when registering in the app for 250MB of global data across 126+ countries. The page says no card is needed, one install covers many countries and the data never expires, suiting maps, rides and messages on arrival. When rechecked on 2026-11-26 the official page kept only the 250MB tier (the older 500MB FREE500MB code is gone from it, though some older accounts still work); see the separate entry for the larger 1GB gift code.
eskimo-free-esim.conditions: New Eskimo users only; enter the code at signup in the app, or within 24 hours after; once per account; data never expires, though accounts unused for about two years are closed; mainland-China phones without native eSIM need a QR code from support for a writable card (APN Singtel Postpaid, do not delete after installing).
steps: Download the Eskimo app (developer Datapro Technologies)
Register a new account with email or Google and enter FREE250MB as the referral or gift code
Check the Data page for the Global 250MB plan
Install directly on an eSIM-capable phone, or ask support for the QR code to write to a blank card on a mainland-China handset
On arrival set mobile data to that eSIM and turn on data roaming
eskimo-free-esim.risk: 250MB is only enough for emergencies (a few hours of maps and messages) with no calls; the official tier has dropped from 500MB to 250MB, so check the amount shown in the app after entering the code; mainland-China phones need an extra blank eUICC card, and a failed write has to be redone.
eskimo-free-esim.source: Eskimo official free eSIM page (eskimo.travel/en/free-esim, rechecked 2026-11-26: FREE250MB / 250MB / 126 countries / no expiry)

gohub-free-trial-esim.title: [12 Asian countries] GoHub free trial eSIM: 300MB / 1 day
gohub-free-trial-esim.highlight: New users get 300MB of high-speed data in the app, valid 1 day, across 12 Asian destinations including China, Japan, Korea, Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand, with no card needed
gohub-free-trial-esim.regions: [12 Asian countries] China, Japan, Korea, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, Indonesia, the Philippines, Hong Kong, Taiwan and India
gohub-free-trial-esim.content: A one-time free trial eSIM for new users: 300MB of fast data for one day at any of 12 Asian destinations including mainland China. Claiming happens entirely in the GoHub app without a card; the day starts at the first connection at the destination, data simply stops when spent without auto-renewal, and more can be bought for that destination in the same app without reinstalling. It is data only with no number, calls or texts.
gohub-free-trial-esim.conditions: New GoHub users, one each; an unlocked eSIM phone (most mainland-China iPhones cannot, though a writable card works); claim in the app only; install and activate within 30 days; the day counts from first connection at the destination, not installation; data only with no number.
steps: Download the GoHub app from the App Store or Google Play and register
Find "Free Trial eSIM" in the app and choose your Asian destination
Install the eSIM as prompted (you can install it at home on Wi-Fi without using the trial data)
On arrival set GoHub as the mobile data line and turn on data roaming — the clock starts on first connection
gohub-free-trial-esim.risk: Only 300MB / 1 day, enough for a ride, navigation and a few messages but not a whole day; it stops when the data runs out with no charge and no auto-renewal; don't treat a 1-day trial as main data for a whole trip.
gohub-free-trial-esim.source: GoHub official claim page + official blog (updated 2026-11-17); recommended in the same thread on NodeSeek post-1055219, NodeLoc topic/117906, 1A2X t/881 and Naixi forum thread-16496 (all 2026-11-15), with a test from mainland China roaming on China Unicom at about 40Mbps

gomoworld-free-trial-esim.title: [Multi-region] GoMoWorld free trial eSIM: up to 1GB / 1 day
gomoworld-free-trial-esim.highlight: Ireland's eir travel eSIM gives a 200MB–1GB trial by destination, valid just 1 day and with no card; forum testing finds about 100MB for mainland China

gomoworld-free-trial-esim.conditions: Claim in the app only, with the amount shown for the chosen destination; one per new user; an unlocked eSIM phone; one day of validity for arrival-day use; no separate trial terms are published, so follow what the app shows.
steps: Download the GoMoWorld app (iOS / Android) and register
Choose the destination and claim the free trial on its page (amounts vary by country)
Install the eSIM as prompted (at home on Wi-Fi first)
Enable the eSIM at the destination and turn on data roaming; the 1 day starts then
gomoworld-free-trial-esim.risk: The amount varies by destination and it lasts only 1 day; the roughly 100MB for mainland China comes from forum testing and isn't published officially, so test small first; don't expect it to cover a whole day.
gomoworld-free-trial-esim.source: GoMoWorld official app store description (updated 2026-11) + official FAQ + third-party per-provider check (2026-10-31); recommended in the same thread across four forums on 2026-11-15

roroesim-cs-trial-300mb.content: Roro eSIM, run by Sweden's DDUP Business Service AB across 190+ countries, gives 300MB of test data: register and ask live support for a test, and they issue a 300MB global pack valid 800 days after activation on China Mobile Hong Kong's CMLink network with a Hong Kong exit IP, a good long-term emergency backup. roroesim-cs-trial-300mb.conditions: Register a Roro account (any email, QQ included) and ask live support, limited and first come; an eSIM phone or a writable card; data only with no number or codes; one eSIM survives about 10 phone changes.

Scroll to the bottom, click Contact us → live chat and ask for a test
Install the QR code you're given and check the plan shows 800 days after activation
It can sit unused as an emergency backup; turn on data roaming when you use it
roroesim-cs-trial-300mb.risk: This is test data handed out by support, not a public campaign, so it can stop at any time; replies already report being given a QR code someone else had used, or support going quiet; 300MB is only for emergencies, not main data; the code in the original post earns the poster a referral, so ask support directly if that bothers you.
roroesim-cs-trial-300mb.source: Naixi forum thread-16230 (2026-10-27, with hands-on screenshots and several user reports); the official site only states that physical cards come with 300MB of global data, while the eSIM test pack is issued by support with no published terms (to be confirmed)

ooredoo-qatar-easysim-welcome.title: [QA] Ooredoo EasySIM welcome: a free new card + 300MB / 3 days

ooredoo-qatar-easysim-welcome.content: Ooredoo Qatar's EasySIM welcome offer online lists at Free with 300MB of local data and 10 local minutes for three days. Choose eSIM or physical SIM, scan the QR code to pick a plan, scan an ID with a selfie for AI identity checks and it activates immediately without a queue. When the 300MB runs out, top up a Hala plan in the Ooredoo app.
ooredoo-qatar-easysim-welcome.conditions: A new Ooredoo Qatar line with real-name registration (Qatari ID or passport depending on channel); the data and minutes are Qatar-local; three days without carry-over; an unlocked eSIM phone.
steps: Open the EasySIM page on ooredoo.qa and click Get it now
Confirm the Welcome Offer and choose eSIM as the SIM type
Scan your ID and take a selfie to pass the identity checks
Install the eSIM QR code you receive and use the 300MB within 3 days

ooredoo-qatar-easysim-welcome.source: Ooredoo Qatar official EasySIM page (checked 2026-11-19, Welcome Offer at Free: 300MB + 10 local minutes / 3 days); Ooredoo tariff document C11-01 v195 (effective 2026-10-06)

iroamly-free-500mb-trial.title: [Global] iRoamly free trial eSIM: 500MB / 1 day (100+ destinations)

Choose the country or region you're going to
Claim the 500MB trial eSIM
Install it on Wi-Fi before departure
Enable the eSIM on arrival and turn on data roaming

Enter a valid referral code in the referral or gift code field at signup (from the official invite page or a friend)
Check the Data page for the 500MB and add the official 250MB new-user allowance
Install the eSIM and turn on data roaming on arrival

roamless-free-trial-500mb.conditions: New Roamless users, once per account and device; download the app, register and install the eSIM; the free credit arrives on activation; a few destinations exclude it.

Tap Install eSIM on the home screen and install the Roamless eSIM
Set it as the mobile data line as prompted
The $1.25 credit appears in the balance after activation
roamless-free-trial-500mb.risk: The 500MB is the upper bound at the $1.25 rate and pricier destinations such as Canada yield less; running out doesn't stop automatically — with no balance you simply lose connection; it's a pay-as-you-go product, so topping up later is easy.
roamless-free-trial-500mb.source: Roamless official help centre (2026-09-08 "What Type of Rewards Can I Get?", "How to Use Roamless", "Roamless Overview") + the destination page line "Your first 500 MB is on us"

roami-free-100mb-esim.title: [Global] Roami free 100MB eSIM (200+ countries / 7 days)

keepgo-free-trial-100mb.title: [Global] Keepgo free trial eSIM: 100MB / 7 days (lifetime data on the same card)
keepgo-free-trial-100mb.highlight: New users place a $0 trial order in the app for 100MB over 7 days, then top up the same card where the data never expires
keepgo-free-trial-100mb.regions: [Global] 150+ countries and 500+ networks; trials vary by plan (Chitra for the US, Corvus for 30+ European countries)
keepgo-free-trial-100mb.content: Keepgo's free trial eSIM gives new users 100MB for seven days on real Keepgo lines rather than a demo card, and topping up the same eSIM afterwards makes the data never expire as long as the balance is positive. Claim it in the Keepgo app by choosing a plan marked Free trial: checkout shows $0.00 but a bank card must confirm the order without charging (Apple and Google Pay do not work), and the eSIM must be installed within 24 hours or the trial lapses.
keepgo-free-trial-100mb.conditions: New Keepgo users, once per account; the Keepgo app is required; the $0 checkout needs a card for confirmation without charge; install within 24 hours; trial plans cover specific regions, so pick the one matching your destination.
steps: Download the Keepgo app from the App Store or Google Play and register a new account
Find the plan marked Free trial that covers your destination and add it to the cart (don't add paid plans at the same time)
Tick the confirmation on checkout, add a card and place the order once the total shows $0.00
Install the eSIM on Wi-Fi within 24 hours
Switch mobile data to that eSIM and use the 100MB within 7 days
keepgo-free-trial-100mb.risk: 100MB is only enough to install and test the card, open maps and check in; a card is required for the $0 order, so skip it if that bothers you; claiming without installing within 24 hours voids it.
keepgo-free-trial-100mb.source: Keepgo official blog (2026-11-18, "Try a Keepgo eSIM for Free: 100MB for 7 Days") + Keepgo FAQ

firsty-free-esim-global.title: [Global] Firsty free eSIM: watch an ad for data, up to 360MB a day (176 countries)

firsty-free-esim-global.regions: [Global] 176 countries including China, the US, the UK, Japan, Thailand, Turkey and the UAE
firsty-free-esim-global.content: Firsty, a Dutch travel eSIM brand, runs Firsty Free at no charge and no card: a roughly 30-second ad unlocks 20MB at 1Mbps, the balance caps at 240MB and more ads refill it, up to 360MB a day, with earned data lasting seven days. firsty-free-esim-global.conditions: An unlocked eSIM phone; the free tier only uses ad-earned data at 1Mbps; a 360MB daily cap, a 240MB balance cap and seven-day validity; no calls, data only.
steps: Install Firsty from the App Store or Google Play
Register, install the free eSIM, switch mobile data to Firsty and turn on data roaming
Watch an ad to unlock 20MB and repeat when it runs out, up to 360MB a day
firsty-free-esim-global.risk: 1Mbps only covers maps and messages and video is effectively out; refilling depends on watching ads, so an ad-service outage means no top-up; the official policy can change the allowances or retire the free tier at any time.
firsty-free-esim-global.source: Firsty official home page and free-tier description (read 2026-11-19)

Bind a custom domain (optional) and deploy

huawei-codearts-200-voucher.title: [CN] Huawei Cloud ¥200 no-threshold voucher: enter the Xiaohongshu Skill contest (to 11/24)
huawei-codearts-200-voucher.highlight: Register for the 2026 Huawei Developer Contest · Xiaohongshu Skill Innovation with a real-name main account, then send a command in CodeArts to claim a ¥200 cloud voucher, with 1,000 released each weekday at 10:00
huawei-codearts-200-voucher.regions: [CN] Huawei Cloud with a real-name-verified mainland master account, since sub-accounts cannot claim
huawei-codearts-200-voucher.content: The 2026 Huawei Developer Competition's Xiaohongshu Skill contest, run with Xiaohongshu and a ¥500,000 prize pool, gives every entrant a ¥200 no-threshold Huawei Cloud resource voucher. Entries and submissions close at 23:59 on 24 November 2026, and vouchers are released at 10:00 each working day from 12 to 24 November, 1,000 a day first come. After entering with the verified master account, send CodeArts the passphrase asking to collect the contest voucher and it lands in the Huawei Cloud account. Tests put validity at 31 December 2026 per the billing centre, covering Flexus and other cloud servers but not domains or flash-sale items and stacking with nothing.
huawei-codearts-200-voucher.conditions: Enter the contest first with a verified Huawei Cloud master account, as entries without it or from sub-accounts earn nothing; one voucher per person, not stackable with the ¥100 tier; 1,000 a day at 10:00, so wait for the next working day if they go; validity about three months with late vouchers reclaimed; opening CodeArts' free personal tier and claiming spend a few CodeArts points; no release on Sunday, leaving 10:00 on 23 and 24 November as the last chances.
steps: Register and complete real-name verification for the contest with the main account at developer.huaweicloud.com/competition/information/1300000350/html1
Open CodeArts (personal trial at ¥0/mo) and install the HuaweiCloud DevKit plugin
Enter the CodeArts chat before 10:00 on a weekday and send the claim command
Check Billing Centre > Discounts & coupons > Vouchers (the chat may say "claimed / 0 credited", so trust the billing centre)
Use the voucher on a Flexus cloud server at the normal monthly price, avoiding flash and sale items
huawei-codearts-200-voucher.risk: Registering is a precondition and the voucher is issued after checking contest eligibility, so entering purely for the voucher without a submission may not get it; only 1,000 a day, gone in under a minute at peak; some users report getting only the ¥10 tier, so trust the voucher face value; the voucher can't be used for domains or sale plans and expires.
huawei-codearts-200-voucher.source: Huawei Cloud official contest benefits page + Huawei Cloud community blog hands-on notes (2026-11-15 and 11-17, bbs.huaweicloud.com/blogs/534936) + Wubianyi's terms check of 2026-11-14

pickle-ai-free-agent-jpkr.title: [JP/KR] Pickle: a free AI agent that calls and browses the web for you
pickle-ai-free-agent-jpkr.highlight: Books, orders and fills forms in its own cloud browser — and phones the place itself when a site can't (restaurants, clinics, landlords, support), with the call audible live. Japan/Korea accounts are free, the daily limit resets at 4 AM and reset tickets continue.
pickle-ai-free-agent-jpkr.regions: [JP/KR] Japanese and Korean accounts are free with no paid plans, resetting at 04:00 local time
pickle-ai-free-agent-jpkr.content: A personal AI agent that actually does things rather than chats: it works in a real cloud browser the way a person would, booking, buying tickets, ordering, cancelling, checking bank or investment records and filing government forms, in a browser separated from your phone and handed to you when only you can act (a code, a password you want to type). It also makes phone calls, dialling restaurants without booking pages, clinic desks, landlords and call centres while you listen live, then reporting back with the recording under Other chats. Before paying or booking it shows a card of what it will do and the cost and asks, and asks again if the amount rises. Per the Japanese help centre, all Japanese accounts are free with no paid plans under a daily usage limit resetting at 04:00 JST: replies, chat calls, tasks and scheduled tasks count, while 3D World calls and built-in routines do not, and at the limit the input closes and scheduled tasks are skipped. Reset tickets zero the day's usage (a full ticket) or cut 50 points (a half), one comes at signup, one each when a friend completes signup, and more can be bought in the app (US App Store $3.99 full and $1.99 half, about ¥600 in Japan).
pickle-ai-free-agent-jpkr.conditions: Automatic on Japanese and Korean accounts with no card or subscription; reset tickets restore only that day's used allowance without raising the daily cap and expire at the 04:00 reset (the ticket itself does not expire); at the limit new tasks cannot start and scheduled ones are skipped; use the iOS or Android app, as there is no web version.
steps: Install Pickle from the App Store or Google Play and finish sign-up (Japan/Korea accounts are free, no card)
Say what you need in Chat, e.g. "Book a table for two at 7 PM Friday and ask if they have parking"
Pickle works the site in its cloud browser; where a site can't help, it calls and the call shows in Other chats
Check the task card for what it will do and what it will cost, then let it run (it always checks before paying or booking)
Out of usage: My Pickle → Daily usage limit → use a reset ticket, or continue right away from the "Continue using" card
Want more tickets: invite friends — you and each friend who completes sign-up get one Full reset ticket
pickle-ai-free-agent-jpkr.risk: Terms differ sharply by region: the Japanese and Korean help pages say all accounts are free with no paid plan, while the English (US) pages still require a subscription and list Plus/Pro/Max/Ultra, so check the card in your own app. A ticket only rescues the current day and does not raise the base limit. Pickle has not published the exact daily credit allowance, how many points each action costs, or ticket prices (prices show on the purchase screen) — those are marked unverified. Pickle can make mistakes: check the task card and the result before paying or booking, and never type passwords or card numbers into the chat.
pickle-ai-free-agent-jpkr.source: Pickle official help centre (Japanese, checked 2026-11-19): Check your plan / How does the usage limit work? / Use reset tickets / Give your Pickle a task / Take over the browser; Pickle website and App Store listing

meta-muse-referral-1b-tokens.title: [US/CA/JP/SG/MX/AU] Meta Muse: enter an invite code within 48 hours, both get 1 billion tokens
meta-muse-referral-1b-tokens.highlight: Meta's personal AI agent Muse comes with its own Linux computer in the cloud (Muse Secure VM) and a full browser, so it can compare prices, book, email and order by itself; new users who enter a friend's invite code in Settings within 48 hours of joining get 1,000,000,000 tokens each, on top of the free weekly allowance.
meta-muse-referral-1b-tokens.regions: [US/CA/JP/SG/MX/AU] Live markets only (US 8 Sept, Canada 18 Sept, Japan 23 Oct, Singapore 27 Oct, Mexico 5 Nov, Australia 17 Nov)
meta-muse-referral-1b-tokens.content: Meta's personal AI agent, launched on 8 September 2026 on iOS, Android, muse.ai, Mac and WhatsApp. Each user gets a persistent cloud Linux computer (Muse Secure VM) with a full browser where the agent browses, fills forms and gets things done, asking approval before sensitive acts such as emailing or paying and keeping a full action log. It connects Gmail, Google Calendar and Instagram and supports voice calls and custom Spaces. Basic use is free with a weekly allowance; Power costs $20 a month for 500M tokens a week and 10 calls a day, Maximum $100 for 3B tokens a week and 20 calls a day, and running out means waiting for a reset or buying tokens, which never expire. The official account announced on 16 September 2026 that inviting up to 20 friends who complete onboarding and redeem your code pays both sides 1 billion Muse tokens, up to 20 grants (20 billion) per person.
meta-muse-referral-1b-tokens.conditions: Aged 18+; located in a live Meta market (US, Canada, Japan, Singapore, Mexico or Australia); a new account redeeming under Settings within 48 hours of signup, after which the entry disappears; one invite code per account; Meta has not published a single redemption limit per code.
steps: Sign up at muse.ai/join or in the Muse app with a Meta account (must be in a launched market; the web works)
Within 48 hours of joining open Settings: web Settings → General → Usage → Redeem invite code; app Settings → Redeem token
Enter your friend's invite code and confirm — each side gets 1 billion tokens, added on top of the weekly free allowance
Later, share your own code from Invite friends: each friend who redeems gives you another 1 billion (up to 20; filling all 20 unlocks early access to new features)
meta-muse-referral-1b-tokens.risk: Meta's help centre does not publish whether bonus tokens expire, how they are drawn down against a subscription allowance, or an official dollar value for 1 billion tokens (the ~$9 in this listing is our arithmetic at the Power rate, so it is unverified). Each code has a limited number of redemptions and public codes are often used up. Redeem only inside Settings in the app or on muse.ai; anyone asking for your password, a code, card details or money to "activate" a code is scamming you. Missing the 48-hour window cannot be fixed. Meta has not published the free tier's exact weekly token figure (Zuckerberg said about 100 million a week; it is not in the help page).
meta-muse-referral-1b-tokens.source: Meta's official @Muse post (2026-09-16) on the referral and 48-hour window; Meta Help Center "About Muse subscriptions" and "How to buy additional Muse tokens"; Meta Newsroom launch announcements by market (US from 2026-09-08, Australia 2026-11-17); checked 2026-11-19

aws-kiro-free-500-trial-credits.title: [Global] AWS Kiro: perpetual free 50 credits/mo, first Pro upgrade free + 500 credits
aws-kiro-free-500-trial-credits.highlight: Kiro Free is a perpetual free tier: no card, 50 credits a month, with Claude Sonnet 4.5 and open-weight models such as DeepSeek 3.2 / MiniMax M2.5 / GLM-5 / Qwen3 Coder Next. From 2026-11-01, a first upgrade to Pro is free for the rest of the month (prorated to the second) and adds 500 trial credits (about $20, valid 12 months), unlocking Claude Opus 5.5 / GPT-5.6 Sol / Grok 4.7.
aws-kiro-free-500-trial-credits.regions: [Global] Free signs in with GitHub, Google or AWS Builder ID without an AWS account; paid plans need a billing address in a supported country
aws-kiro-free-500-trial-credits.content: Kiro Free is permanent: 50 credits a month, reset monthly without rollover, for Claude Sonnet 4.5 and open-weight models such as DeepSeek 3.2, MiniMax M2.5, GLM-5, MiniMax M2.1 and Qwen3 Coder Next, with rate limits; Kiro Web needs a paid plan while the IDE and CLI are free. From 1 November 2026, a first upgrade from Free to Pro is free for the rest of the month, prorated by the second with the first bill on the 1st, plus 500 trial credits (about $20) valid 12 months and spent after plan credits, unlocking Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-5.6 Sol and Grok 4.7. Upgrading to Pro+, Pro Max or Power also gets the free month, paying only the difference from the prorated Pro price. Unused trial credits survive a downgrade but only work on free-tier models.
aws-kiro-free-500-trial-credits.conditions: The free tier needs no card (GitHub, Google or AWS Builder ID sign-in); paid upgrades need a valid card and renew monthly; 50 credits reset monthly without rollover; the 500 trial credits are first-upgrade only and last 12 months; model availability depends on country and provider policy; Enterprise and GovCloud exclude the free tier.
steps: Download Kiro IDE or the CLI at kiro.dev and sign in with GitHub, Google or AWS Builder ID to land on the Free tier (no card)
Use the 50 monthly credits to try Claude Sonnet 4.5 and DeepSeek 3.2 / MiniMax M2.5 / GLM-5 / Qwen3 Coder Next
For Claude Opus 5.5 / GPT-5.6 Sol / Grok 4.7, upgrade to Pro for the first time (card required): the rest of the month is free and you get 500 trial credits
Trial credits kick in after plan credits are used and stay valid for 12 months
To avoid the charge, downgrade to Free before billing on the 1st; unused trial credits remain usable on free-tier models
aws-kiro-free-500-trial-credits.risk: Upgrading needs a card, so forgetting to downgrade before the 1st means $20/month and up. The free month and 500 trial credits are first-upgrade-only; after a downgrade the trial credits are limited to free-tier models. The free tier's 50 credits a month don't accumulate and run out quickly on full spec tasks. Premium models are not available in every country. Kiro has not quantified the credit multiplier for each model, the Sonnet 4.5 rate limit, or the exact draw-down order of trial credits — those are marked unverified.
aws-kiro-free-500-trial-credits.source: Kiro official pricing page kiro.dev/pricing (including the free-trial FAQ), official blog "Kiro's new free trial gives you 500 extra credits" (2026-10-27) and kiro.dev/faq; checked 2026-11-19

hark-pro-free-agent.title: [US/UK/EU] Hark Pro: a fully free personal AI agent with its own cloud computer
hark-pro-free-agent.highlight: Hark Labs' (founded by Brett Adcock) personal AI agent: every Hark Pro feature is free forever with no ads, on web, iOS, Android and Mac. It brings Handoff, its own cloud computer — a real browser, file system and terminal, up to six browsers at once — that signs into sites, places orders, fills forms, runs your email and calendar and builds mini apps for you.
hark-pro-free-agent.regions: [US/UK/EU] Live in the US, UK and 27 EU countries (free on the App Store, no invite code)
hark-pro-free-agent.content: A personal AI agent launched on 6 October 2026 by Brett Adcock's Hark Labs as a life operating system: work happens in one long conversation, with projects on separate threads and a customisable home. The core is Handoff, which spins up a separate cloud computer per request with its own browser, file system and terminal that can sign in to millions of sites like a person, order, cancel, fill forms, file expenses, book tables and build slides; Hark says it handles six browsers at once, and beyond the browser it reaches Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 by API, reads files, queries external databases and uses MCP. Memory, Action Buttons, Panels that turn a sentence into a mini app, Scheduled Tasks and Specialties round it out. Hark Pro is fully free forever without ads, limited only by an unpublished base allowance; Pro² is $20 a month for double and Pro³ $100 for ten times, with identical features, and the US App Store adds Pro⁴ at $259.99 (ten times Pro², from 11 November 2026) at a higher in-app price. Passwords and card numbers sit in an encrypted vault Hark itself cannot see, sensitive actions ask first, and Hark promises not to sell data or share it with advertisers.
hark-pro-free-agent.conditions: The free tier needs no invite code or card; cards are needed only to upgrade or enable auto top-up; Memory is unavailable in the EEA, the UK and Switzerland; the free allowance is unpublished with no reset rules, and continuing past it needs an upgrade or top-up; signing in, paying and ordering need authorisation and confirmation inside Hark; Handoff depends on the accounts you connect (Gmail, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365).
steps: Sign up at hark.com, or install the app from the App Store, Google Play or hark.com/mac (no card needed for the free plan)
Connect Gmail, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365 and other accounts in settings so it can read mail and see your calendar
Ask for what you need in Chat, e.g. "Book a table for two at 7 PM Friday and check parking nearby"; anything that needs the web goes to the Handoff cloud computer
Before paying, ordering or cancelling, check the confirmation card (what it will do and what it costs) and approve it
Need more usage: upgrade to Pro² ($20/mo, 2x) or Pro³ ($100/mo, 10x); the free plan keeps working without an upgrade
hark-pro-free-agent.risk: Hark has not published the free plan's usage cap, how usage is consumed, or when it resets, so "free forever" only promises that no feature is paywalled — heavy use may hit the cap quickly (marked unverified). The ≈$10/mo in the value line is an estimate derived from Pro² at $20 for 2x the usage, not an official price. Once a card is bound or auto top-up is on, it charges when credits run low — stay unbound if you only want the free tier. The EEA, the UK and Switzerland get no Memory, so the experience differs from the US. The agent makes mistakes: check the confirmation card and the result before paying, ordering or cancelling, keep passwords and card numbers in Secured by Hark and never type them into the chat. The US App Store also has Pro⁴, and its in-app prices ($26 / $129.99 / $259.99) are higher than the website's, which is the reference.
hark-pro-free-agent.source: Hark official: pricing page hark.com/pricing (Free to use, Pro² $20 / Pro³ $100), Using Hark Pro at hark.com/using-hark (what Handoff is, platforms iOS/Android/web, Pro² 2x / Pro³ 10x), launch post "Introducing Hark Pro" 2026-10-06 (all features always free), engineering post "Introducing Hark Handoff" 2026-08-05 (dedicated virtual computer with browser, file system and terminal; six browsers; logs in for you), privacy policy 2026-11-05 (no Memory in the EEA, UK or Switzerland); availability: Personal Agent Atlas 2026-11-01 and App Store lookups (US/UK/DE/FR); checked 2026-11-19.

sesame-voice-ai-free.title: [Multi-region] Sesame: lifelike voice AI with 30 free minutes a day, and phone control for Claude Code
sesame-voice-ai-free.highlight: Sesame's Maya, Miles and other characters are known for unusually lifelike real-time voices: the free plan gives 30 minutes of calls a day plus limited weekly credits, straight from iOS or Android. Sesame Link also lets one phone call walk you through your Claude Code and Codex sessions — hear each one's status, focus on a session and talk to it live, approve permissions, start new work.
sesame-voice-ai-free.regions: [Multi-region] In 98 countries (US and UK, 27 EU states, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, Canada, Mexico, Australia, the Middle East); not mainland China, Hong Kong or India
sesame-voice-ai-free.content: Sesame, from Oculus co-founders, is a voice-first personal AI with four characters (Maya, Miles, Simone and Charlie) that you call or text on iOS and Android, with each character remembering past conversations once signed in. The free tier costs $0 for 30 minutes of talk time a day, reset daily, plus limited weekly credits for text, tasks and higher intelligence, reset weekly, with every feature available; running out still allows text at lower intelligence. Plus at $20 a month gives two hours a day and four times the credits, Pro at $100 gives ten hours, with add-ons of one hour for $5 or five for $20 and 1,000 credits for $5 or 5,000 for $20 that never expire. Sesame Link (link.sesame.com) brings coding agents to the phone: install the CLI on the machine running Claude Code or Codex, sign in to the same account, then call and ask what your sessions are doing, focus on one and talk to it live, approve permissions by voice or start and end sessions, with code and accounts staying on your computer.
sesame-voice-ai-free.conditions: No card for the free tier; talk time resets daily and credits weekly; text still works when depleted but limited; Link needs a Sesame account, the CLI on a computer and the agent already signed in (Claude Code needs tmux 3.4+ and the desktop app does not count), on macOS or x86-64 Linux in preview; Claude Code is fully supported, Codex, Pi and Cursor are preview and Hermes and OpenCode experimental; regions without the app only get the web Research Preview.
steps: Install "Sesame: Personal Agents" from the App Store or Google Play (or use the web app at app.sesame.com where it isn't listed) and sign up
Pick a character (Maya, Miles, Simone or Charlie) and call or text; the free plan gives 30 minutes a day and limited weekly credits
To steer coding agents: on the Mac or Linux machine running Claude Code or Codex, run the curl install script, then sesame-link auth login and pick the default folder
Add Sesame Link to the character in the Sesame app, then call and say "What are my sessions doing?" or "Focus on …"; you can also use the web client at link.sesame.com
Out of allowance: upgrade to Plus or Pro or buy a top-up in the app's Plan screen, or wait for the daily or weekly reset
sesame-voice-ai-free.risk: Sesame hasn't published the size of the free plan's weekly credits, so how fast task use burns through them is unknown (marked unverified). The ≈$5/mo in the value line is an estimate derived from Plus at $20 for 4x the free talk time, not an official price. Sesame Link has no separate pricing page and Sesame doesn't say whether Link itself costs extra; voice control draws on Sesame's talk time and credits (marked unverified). The app isn't listed in mainland China, Hong Kong or India, where only the more limited web version works. Coding agents run on your own computer, and long plans, file contents and most MCP arguments can't be read aloud in full — confirm those in the web client or terminal. Paid plans are in-app purchases managed by the App Store or Google Play; cancel there, and don't forget after the trial.
sesame-voice-ai-free.source: Sesame official: plans page sesame.com/plans (Free $0 = 30 min/day + limited weekly credits, Plus $20 4x, Pro $100 20x, top-up prices, Plus 7-day trial), help page sesame.com/journal/getting-started (list of 98 countries, language support), Sesame Link site link.sesame.com and docs at link.sesame.com/docs (Claude Code / Codex / Pi / Cursor / Hermes / OpenCode, macOS/Linux, voice control and approvals), changelog v0.1.44 (2026-11-17); checked 2026-11-19.

call-e-free-credits.title: [US/CA] CALL-E: your AI assistant dials real phone calls (100 free credits for new users)
call-e-free-credits.highlight: Hand the "I'll have to call them" errands to ChatGPT / Claude / Muse / Claude Code: it plans the call, you confirm, it dials a real US or Canadian number, gets through phone menus and hold, then brings back a summary, the transcript and a structured result.
call-e-free-credits.regions: [US/CA] Dials real US and Canadian numbers; about 20 other countries are mainly for developer testing
call-e-free-credits.content: A calling agent from Singapore's AI Rudder launched in November 2026 that only makes outbound calls: install the official calle skill in an existing assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, Muse, OpenClaw, Hermes and others) or a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor), or reach it over MCP, TypeScript, Python, REST or WhatsApp, describe the job and it plans the call — whom to ring, when, in which language and what counts as success — asking for missing details and showing the plan for confirmation before dialling. It handles real people, voicemail, holds, transfers, muting and interruptions, navigates phone menus by keypad (IVR) and returns a summary, a full transcript and a structured result validated against your schema with quotes and confidence. It schedules and batches. Typical jobs are reservations, rescheduling, quotes, stock checks, cancellations and reaching a human. New accounts get 100 credits, which the company puts at roughly US$1, a usage allowance rather than a fixed number of calls.
call-e-free-credits.conditions: 100 one-time credits for new accounts; per-second billing where a US or Canadian Goal call costs about $0.0148 per 10 seconds of model time plus $0.02 a minute of line time (about $0.06 for 30 seconds), or $0.0296 per 10 seconds plus $0.04 a minute for one-off calls (about $0.13 for 30 seconds); preparation can spend credits even if the call never connects; outbound only, no answering; numbers outside the US and Canada are mainly for testing, with production needing your own SIP trunk.
steps: Install the official calle skill in an MCP-capable assistant or coding agent (or use the API/SDK) and sign in — a CALL-E account with 100 credits is created automatically
Ask in your own words: "Book a table for two at 7 PM Friday at Bella's Bistro and ask about parking"
It fills the gaps (who to call, the name for the booking, what counts as done) and shows you the call plan
Confirm, and it dials, presses through the phone menu and waits on hold; you can take over or add instructions mid-call
Read the summary, transcript and structured result afterwards; schedule or batch calls when you need many
call-e-free-credits.risk: 100 credits buy only a few trial calls — a real test needs a top-up. Billing combines model and carrier fees, and planning can burn credits even when no call happens. The AI tells the person on the line it is an assistant, and some businesses refuse such calls. Before letting it book, cancel or pay, read the call plan it shows you. Whether you can sign up from mainland China and similar regions is not documented — check the site or login page.
call-e-free-credits.source: CALL-E official site FAQ and llms.txt (checked 2026-11-19) plus the Product Hunt launch page (No. 3 on the 2026-11-11 daily leaderboard)

dusk-bot-free.title: [Global] dusk bot: a free open-source Grok Bot alternative that runs a crew of AI helpers on the ChatGPT / Claude plan you already pay for
dusk-bot-free.highlight: Each bot gets its own computer (browser and desktop), an editable memory and schedules, and several bots can hand work to each other in one thread. Free for personal use, no card and no new account — sign in with the ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / Grok plan you already have.
dusk-bot-free.regions: [Global] A desktop app on your machine (or your own server); needs one of the subscriptions or your own API key
dusk-bot-free.value: Free (every app feature of the $20/mo Plus plan)
dusk-bot-free.content: A desktop app that installs a crew of AI helpers on your own computer (launched on Product Hunt on 18 November 2026, described as 100% free and open source). It sells no models: you connect the ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Cursor, Copilot or DeepSeek plan you already pay for, or your own API key, and each bot gets a job, a chat window and a memory you can read and edit; bots sign in and click through sites in their own browser and desktop, and you can watch live or take the mouse back. One bot per task, more on demand, and several can share a group thread and hand work over, checking with you at key steps. Say a routine once (compare prices at 9 on Monday, clear the inbox at 8 daily) and it runs on schedule or on events. Pricing: free at $0 forever with every app feature on your machine, no card or account, stopping when the computer sleeps and without a commercial licence; Plus $20 a month puts bots in dusk cloud (2 vCPU, 4GB, 20GB, always on); Pro $50 (4 vCPU, 8GB, 60GB, one commercial licence); Teams $119 for two seats.
dusk-bot-free.conditions: Free is personal use only and must run on your own computer or server (it stops when the computer sleeps); business use needs a work licence (Pro includes one, or add one for $12 a month); model usage still counts against your own ChatGPT or Claude plan and its limits.
steps: Download the desktop app from dusk.bot/download (Mac or Windows); the free plan needs no sign-up and no card
Sign in with your existing ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / Grok account, or paste your own API key
Name the first bot and give it one job (researcher, inbox helper, code reviewer, bookkeeper, travel planner)
Describe the work in chat and watch it operate on its own computer; press "take the mouse" whenever you want control
Turn repeats into routines ("summarise my inbox every weekday at 8") and move to the $20/mo Plus cloud when you need it running with the lid shut
dusk-bot-free.risk: The free plan runs on your machine, so it stops when the computer sleeps — don't rely on it for anything time-critical. Model quota comes from your existing subscriptions and several bots burn it faster. Business or work use requires a paid licence. Product Hunt describes it as 100% free and open source, but the pricing page does not link the repository, so the open-source claim is unverified. Bots log in to sites and click for you — start with low-risk tasks and watch the first runs.
dusk-bot-free.source: dusk bot official site and pricing page (checked 2026-11-19) plus the Product Hunt launch page (2026-11-18)

scalekit-agentkit-free-tier.title: [Global] Scalekit AgentKit: an MCP gateway with a free tier of 10,000 tool calls a month
scalekit-agentkit-free-tier.highlight: One MCP gateway across 1,100+ connectors and 55,000+ tools (Salesforce, GitHub, Slack, Google Drive…), with every action run as the user who asked, inside the scopes they granted. The free tier includes 10,000 tool calls and 10,000 trigger events a month.
scalekit-agentkit-free-tier.regions: [Global] Developer and team SaaS accounts; the free tier costs nothing, Growth is $99 a month
scalekit-agentkit-free-tier.content: An MCP gateway for agents heading to production: 1,100+ connectors and 55,000+ tools including Salesforce, GitHub, Slack and Google Drive behind one gateway, with AgentKit handling OAuth and integration and every action running as the user who asked, within the scopes they granted. Virtual MCP Servers give each agent only the tools it needs, custom connectors bring in internal APIs, Triggers start an agent the moment an email arrives and every call is logged. Free is $0 a month with 10,000 tool calls, 10,000 trigger events, unlimited connected accounts, your own credentials and community and email support. Growth at $99 a month gives 100,000 calls plus $0.50 per extra 1,000 and 50,000 events plus $3 per 1,000.
scalekit-agentkit-free-tier.conditions: The free tier needs your own OAuth credentials for each service (Scalekit does not obtain them); allowances reset monthly; beyond them, upgrade to Growth or pay as you go; SSO, SCIM, BYOK, HIPAA BAA and VPC or on-premises are Enterprise only.
steps: Sign up at scalekit.com and create an environment
Pick the connectors you need in the dashboard (GitHub, Slack, Google Drive…) and enter your own OAuth credentials
Create a Virtual MCP Server carrying only the tools this agent needs and copy its MCP address
Add the address to Claude, Cursor or your own agent and complete one authorised call end to end
Watch the 10,000-calls-a-month free allowance on the usage page before deciding to upgrade
scalekit-agentkit-free-tier.risk: The official page contradicts itself: the Free card says 10,000 tool calls a month while the comparison table below lists 5K for Free, so check your own dashboard after signing up. The free tier needs your own OAuth apps and credentials, so it is not plug-and-play. Overage is $0.50 per 1K calls, which adds up quickly on busy agents.
scalekit-agentkit-free-tier.source: Scalekit official pricing page (checked 2026-11-19) plus the Product Hunt November 2026 monthly leaderboard (No. 6)

nestdaddy-mcp-free.title: [Global] NestDaddy MCP: give your AI today's internet — 1,000 free credits a month, no card
nestdaddy-mcp-free.highlight: One MCP URL plugs into Claude / Claude Code / Cursor / VS Code / Windsurf / n8n and gives it live web search, breaking world news, full article text and papers, from its own index, on a flat monthly price rather than per search.
nestdaddy-mcp-free.regions: [Global] Any MCP client (Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, n8n and others)
nestdaddy-mcp-free.content: A real-time-internet MCP server built for agents (launched on Product Hunt in November 2026) with its own search index rather than reselling others' results, offering nine read-only tools: live web search, global breaking news, full-text page fetching and research papers. Take a key and add the Streamable HTTP address https://mcp.nestdaddy.com/mcp to a client (Claude via Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector, or claude mcp add, Cursor's mcp.json, VS Code, Windsurf or n8n's MCP Client Tool). It is free at 1,000 credits a month with no card and no time limit; paid plans start at $19 a month at a flat rate rather than per search, and the launch code PH50 takes 50% off any paid plan for three months until 24 November 2026.
nestdaddy-mcp-free.conditions: The free tier gives 1,000 credits a month with no card and no trial period; credits burn with calls and fetches, and full-text fetching costs more than a search; PH50 works only when getting a key on the official MCP page before 24 November 2026; read-only, so it will not operate sites for you.
steps: Register at nestdaddy.com/mcp for a free key (1,000 credits a month, no card)
Add a custom MCP connector in your client: https://mcp.nestdaddy.com/mcp?key=YOUR_KEY (or an Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY header)
Ask directly, e.g. "what new free APIs launched in the AI news today?" or "what method does this paper use?"
If you want a paid plan, use PH50 before 11/24 for 50% off three months
Track credit use on the dashboard so full-article fetches do not drain the month in one sitting
nestdaddy-mcp-free.risk: 1,000 credits look generous until you pull full articles and poll news, which burn them fast. PH50 ends 2026-11-24. The site does not say whether unused free credits roll over or reset monthly. Results come from its own index, so obscure long-tail sites may be covered less thoroughly than Google.
nestdaddy-mcp-free.source: NestDaddy official MCP page (checked 2026-11-19), the Product Hunt launch post and the DEV launch write-up (PH50 until 11-24)

rankspot-1-credit.title: [Global] RankSpot: an SEO execution layer for agents — $1 of credit at sign-up, no subscription
rankspot-1-credit.highlight: Connect its MCP to Claude or ChatGPT and the agent does the work per action: write and publish an article $3, an AI-visibility check $0.004, a keyword update $0.15, an outreach email found $0.065. Sign-up gives $1, reading your data is free, top-ups start at $10 and roll over.
rankspot-1-credit.regions: [Global] Any MCP-capable agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, n8n); works on a site's data in Google and AI search
rankspot-1-credit.value: $1 of starter credit + free data reads
rankspot-1-credit.content: An SEO execution layer billed per action (second on Product Hunt's 17 November 2026 daily chart): model costs stay on your own Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or n8n subscription while RankSpot charges only for what it does, quoting a price before each action. The account and reading your own site's data are free, with a one-time $1 welcome credit for paid actions; top-ups start at $10, roll over and never auto-renew. Prices: writing and publishing an indexed article $3, images at AI cost plus 30%, a Google indexing request $0.01, rewrites through MCP with your own AI free; an AI visibility check (one prompt's answer in one AI, brands mentioned, pages cited) $0.004 with forum and link opportunities, keyword rank updates $0.15, backlink updates $0.07, competitor tracking free, email finding $0.065 each (nothing if not found), sending $0.025 a message from your own mailbox and inbox and replies free.
rankspot-1-credit.conditions: The $1 is a one-time welcome credit usable only once an agent is connected; top-ups start at $10; model tokens are not included and come from your own AI subscription; writing, publishing and indexing trigger several paid actions in sequence.
steps: Sign up at rankspot.ai (free, with the $1 welcome credit)
Connect its MCP to Claude or ChatGPT in about two minutes
Do the free work first: read your site data, add competitors, look at the link opportunities inside AI-visibility checks
Ask for a price before writing ($3 an article) and only then let it run; editing with your own AI is free
Top up from $10 when the credit runs out — it rolls over and never auto-renews
rankspot-1-credit.risk: $1 is a third of one $3 article, so a real run costs far more than the free credit. The Product Hunt copy mentions a free article with sign-up, but the pricing page lists only the $1 welcome credit — unverified. Publishing puts content on your live site and requests indexing, so test on a small scale first. Outreach sends from your own mailbox, so watch your sending-domain reputation.
rankspot-1-credit.source: RankSpot official pricing page (checked 2026-11-19) plus the Product Hunt launch page (No. 2 on the 2026-11-17 daily leaderboard)

gemini-tasks-free-jpkr.title: [JP/KR/US/CA/AU/IN] Gemini Tasks is now free: hand bookings, price checks and bill sorting to it in the background
gemini-tasks-free-jpkr.highlight: Flip the toggle in Gemini from Chat to Task and give it multi-step, recurring work: a morning brief across Gmail and Calendar, a trip itinerary, long-running research — it runs in the background and tells you when it's done. Free in Japan, Korea, the US, Canada, Australia and India since 2026-11-17.
gemini-tasks-free-jpkr.regions: [JP/KR/US/CA/AU/IN] Free in six markets (Gemini 4 Hydrogen on free plans); phone calls and checkout are US only
gemini-tasks-free-jpkr.value: Free (previously an AI Pro feature at $19.99/mo)
gemini-tasks-free-jpkr.content: From 17 November 2026 Gemini Spark, once limited to AI Pro and Ultra, became Tasks in Gemini and opened free to users in the US, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia and India (Gemini 4 Hydrogen on free plans, Gemini 4 Neon on paid). Flip the switch above the input box from Chat to Task and describe the job in plain language: multi-step work across Gmail, Calendar and 60+ connected apps such as daily briefings, trip itineraries, recurring research and subscription tracking, run on a schedule, notified when done, with mid-run instructions accepted. Each task runs in a hardware-isolated VM tied to your account on Google Cloud's Agent Compute Engine, with prompt-injection filtering and Safe Browsing limits, and purchases or payments need confirmation by default. The US also gets calling businesses for quotes, stock or bookings, comparing and ordering through Google Pay within a set limit, emailing tasks to gemini@google.com and texting Gemini.
gemini-tasks-free-jpkr.conditions: Aged 18+, signed in with a personal Google account and Web & App Activity on; the Gemini iOS, Android and Mac apps and the web; in Japan, Korea and elsewhere only task delegation works, while calls, Google Pay checkout and SMS or email entry are US only (English, 18+); tasks can still fail.
steps: Update the Gemini app (iOS / Android / Mac or web) and confirm you're signed in with a personal Google account, 18+, with history on
Flip the toggle above the input box from Chat to Task
Describe the job: "Every morning at 7, list the three things in my mail and calendar that can't slip" or "Plan next week's Osaka trip with transport and restaurants"
Let it run in the background and open the task to watch progress or add instructions; it pauses to ask before important steps
Check the result when it notifies you, then turn recurring jobs into scheduled tasks
gemini-tasks-free-jpkr.risk: In Japan and Korea only the task-running core is open — phone calls, Google Pay orders and text/email task entry stay US-only, so don't expect the US demo. Tasks read your mail, calendar and connected apps, so start with small jobs before granting anything that spends money. Gemini still fails and misreads instructions; confirm before it buys or books. It requires activity history, which leaves a record.
gemini-tasks-free-jpkr.source: Google official blog "Put Gemini to work for you" (2026-11-17) plus the Gemini app release notes and Japanese launch coverage (checked 2026-11-19)

iijmio-gigaplan-half-price.title: [JP] IIJmio Giga Plan half-price campaign: voice SIM or eSIM at half the monthly fee for 3 months (from ¥475)
iijmio-gigaplan-half-price.highlight: On a 5/10/15/25/35 GB voice SIM or voice eSIM the monthly fee drops by ¥475/700/800/1,000/1,200 for months 1–3; the 15 GB plan also gets 5 GB extra for 3 months, and stacked with the call-option discount that is 20 GB with unlimited 5-minute calls for about ¥800 a month.
iijmio-gigaplan-half-price.regions: [JP] New or MNP signups on IIJmio's site; voice eSIM works; BIC SIM and JAL Mobile channels excluded
iijmio-gigaplan-half-price.content: Running since 5 November 2026 with no end date, for Giga Plan voice SIMs and voice eSIMs at 5, 10, 15, 25 and 35GB, whether new, ported in or moved from older plans: months 1 to 3 take ¥475 off at 5GB, ¥700 at 10GB, ¥800 at 15GB, ¥1,000 at 25GB and ¥1,200 at 35GB (tax included). The 15GB plan also adds 5GB a month for up to three months, so 20GB for three months. A parallel call-option discount makes unlimited call options free for up to three months, and together 15GB (20GB) with the 20GB unlimited-call bundle comes to about ¥800 a month (¥700 with the family discount). The first month is prorated and discounts cap at the bill without rollover.
iijmio-gigaplan-half-price.conditions: Apply for a voice SIM or eSIM at 5/10/15/25/35GB during the campaign and activate it; keep the same tier until the benefit ends, since changing size, switching to data or SMS only or cancelling forfeits it (swapping SIM and eSIM form is fine); 25GB cannot also take the 25GB trial discount; BIC SIM, JAL Mobile and mere size changes on an existing Giga Plan do not qualify.
steps: On iijmio.jp pick the Giga Plan, choose voice eSIM or voice SIM, and a 5/10/15/25/35 GB tier
Order as a new line or MNP transfer (or switch from an old plan in My IIJmio) and finish identity verification and payment setup
Activate the eSIM profile; the discount starts automatically from the activation month, with no separate application
Add the flat-rate call option (Tsūwa Teigaku) while the campaign runs to get up to three months of it free
Keep the same tier through month three; after that the normal fees apply (5 GB ¥950 / 10 GB ¥1,400 / 15 GB ¥1,600 / 25 GB ¥2,000 / 35 GB ¥2,400)
iijmio-gigaplan-half-price.risk: You need a Japanese address, Japanese payment method and identity verification, so it is effectively closed to overseas users. The end date is unannounced and can come at any time. Only three months are discounted — from month four you pay full price, so work out the long-run cost. Changing capacity or SIM type voids the discount, and a prorated first month can make the discount look smaller than advertised.
iijmio-gigaplan-half-price.source: IIJ official announcement of the IIJmio Giga Plan half-price campaign (2026-11-05, iijmio.jp/info/iij/1793256547.html) and the official IIJmio Q&A (updated 2026-11-10)

ymobile-yahoo-store-benefits.title: [JP] Y!mobile via the Yahoo! store: up to ¥15,000 PayPay for switching carriers, Black Friday waives the setup fee (eSIM works)
ymobile-yahoo-store-benefits.highlight: Black Friday add-on (11/20–12/1 14:59): the online store waives the activation fee for new and switching lines; a SIM-only line (eSIM included) switching from another carrier earns ¥15,000 in PayPay on Simple 3 S, M and L (Simple 3 S is normally excluded), and an existing customer's second line on M/L rises from ¥5,000 to ¥15,000; on top, a Yahoo-only coupon returns up to 20% (capped at ¥6,000 for M/L).
ymobile-yahoo-store-benefits.regions: [JP] Japan; a Yahoo! JAPAN ID is required and used for the Y!mobile service login
ymobile-yahoo-store-benefits.content: Y!mobile's SIM offer in the Yahoo! Shopping store (no stated end date): order a SIM-only plan (physical SIM or eSIM) from that page and add the Data Boost option at order (¥550 a month, free for six months from the month after joining). Switching from another carrier on Simple 3 M/L pays ¥15,000 in PayPay, S pays ¥5,000; new lines on M/L pay ¥5,000 and ages 5-18 pay ¥10,000 (not S new lines); points arrive by the end of the second month after ordering to the Yahoo! JAPAN ID used for the service login. Claim a Yahoo limited coupon before ordering for up to 20% extra back on Yahoo! Shopping in month four (M/L capped at ¥6,000, S at ¥500). Black Friday (20 November to 14:59 on 1 December): the online store waives the ¥3,850 setup fee for new lines and carrier switches (not handset changes); SIM or eSIM only on Simple 3 S/M/L with Data Boost pays ¥15,000 for a carrier switch (including S, normally excluded), and existing customers adding a second line on M/L rise from ¥5,000 to ¥15,000; with a one-off handset purchase on M/L, the OPPO A5 5G and certified used iPhone SE(3) cost ¥1 and a certified used iPhone 14 128GB costs ¥23,040.
ymobile-yahoo-store-benefits.conditions: Order from the designated page and add the Data Boost option at the same time, or no points are paid; a SIM-only plan with the Y!mobile service login completed by the end of the month after ordering; one per line; carrier switches exclude SoftBank, LINEMO and SoftBank-line MVNOs; PayPay points cannot be cashed out or transferred and need a linked Yahoo! JAPAN ID and PayPay account; the coupon must be claimed before ordering and applies only to month four; the Black Friday terms need the online store (not a shop) and the second-line boost only for the customer's own Simple 3 M/L.
steps: Claim the Yahoo-only coupon on this page first — claiming after ordering does not count
Choose Simple 3 S / M / L, pick eSIM or a physical SIM, and tick the Data Boost option when ordering
Complete Y!mobile service registration with your Yahoo! JAPAN ID by the end of the following month
Keep the line; the PayPay points arrive at the end of the month after next; use the 20% coupon in month four
After six months the Data Boost option starts charging ¥550/month — cancel it once the points are paid if you don't need it
ymobile-yahoo-store-benefits.risk: Without the ¥550/month Data Boost option you get none of the points, and it is only free for six months. Lines activated on or after 2026-07-01 pay an ¥858 cancellation fee if cancelled within a year. The coupon must be claimed before ordering and only counts on month-four shopping, which is easy to forget. Points go to the Yahoo! JAPAN ID, so a wrong ID loses them. The end date is unannounced. The waived activation fee lasts only to 12/1 14:59 and then returns to ¥3,850; the SIM-only points are still tied to the ¥550/month Data Boost option and the Y!mobile registration, so don't skip either while racing the deadline.
ymobile-yahoo-store-benefits.source: Y!mobile official Yahoo! store pages and terms for the SIM contract benefit and the Yahoo-only coupon (checked 2026-11-19)

wooriwon-mobile-black-friday.title: [KR] Woori WON Mobile Black Friday: 11 plans at an effective ₩0 — six months of 꿀머니, ₩50,000 Naver Pay, free eSIM activation
wooriwon-mobile-black-friday.highlight: The Woori Bank MVNO pays six months of 꿀머니 (₩10,500–29,500 a month, 1꿀 = ₩1) plus a ₩5,000 membership coupon each month on nine plans, once you activate and enter the event page; three value plans add ₩50,000 of Naver Pay, the youth plans add a chicken coupon, and the ₩2,750 eSIM fee is refunded.
wooriwon-mobile-black-friday.regions: [KR] Korea with local verification and payment (foreigners need an alien registration card); a new line or number port
wooriwon-mobile-black-friday.content: Woori Bank's MVNO runs a Black Friday offer from 1 to 30 November 2026 on nine plans (Youth Dream 5G 125GB+, LTE 71GB+, 5G 50GB+ and 100GB+, LTE 15GB+; Membership Data Up LTE 17GB+ and 10GB+; Double Coupon LTE 71GB+ and 15GB+; WON Celeb and Samsung Wallet Money have their own pages): activate and apply on the campaign page for six months of 꿀머니 at 1 to 1 won, 10,500 to 29,500 won a month by plan, plus a 5,000 won monthly membership voucher to claim yourself. New lines get 50,000 won of Naver Pay on the 500MB/50-minute and the two Membership Data Up plans, and the six Youth Dream plans add a bhc Bburinkle chicken and 1.25L cola voucher. USIM is free and the 2,750 won eSIM fee is refunded as a bill discount, with 10,000 꿀머니 for both sides on a referral. The bank calls it an effective zero bill once points and vouchers are counted, while bills still charge full price.
wooriwon-mobile-black-friday.conditions: 19 or over, activated during the campaign by new line or port and applied on the campaign page; keep the line, plan and owner unchanged without pausing and keep agreeing to marketing and SMS; 꿀머니 pays monthly from the month after next (January 2027) for six months with a Woori WON membership; one line per person; Naver Pay arrives by 18 March 2027; vouchers last 60 days.
steps: Pick an event plan on the Woori WON Mobile site or in the Woori WON banking app (work out monthly fee minus 꿀머니 minus coupons first)
Choose eSIM (the ₩2,750 fee is refunded) or a free USIM and complete Korean identity verification
Enter the ★ Black Friday event on the event page and keep marketing/SMS consent on
Join Woori WON Members, claim the ₩5,000 coupon each month, and watch for 꿀머니 from January 2027
Keep the plan and line until the six months are paid out; inviting a friend earns ₩10,000 of 꿀머니 each
wooriwon-mobile-black-friday.risk: "₩0" is an effective price after points and coupons — the bill is charged at full price, so model the cash flow yourself. Cancelling, changing plan, suspending or transferring the line forfeits the remaining points and coupons. Points only work inside the Woori WON Members and Naver Pay ecosystems; they cannot be withdrawn or carried over. Foreigners need an Alien Registration Card and a Korean number. Per-plan 꿀머니 amounts come from third-party breakdowns (₩10,500–29,500); the official page only gives the range, so confirm on the activation screen.
wooriwon-mobile-black-friday.source: Woori WON Mobile official event page EVT0014805 (2026-11-01 to 11-30, checked 2026-11-19) plus Woori Bank's 2026-11-09 press release and Korean press coverage

yahoo-japan-agent-i-stamp-rally.regions: [JP] Residents of Japan with a Yahoo! JAPAN ID
yahoo-japan-agent-i-stamp-rally.content: A LINE Yahoo campaign on Yahoo! Zubatoku (09:00 on 9 November to 23:59 on 15 December 2026): sign in with a Yahoo! JAPAN ID and use each task's own button to reach Agent i pages, earning one stamp per completed task up to ten. At 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 stamps you draw once, up to five times: first prize 500 yen of PayPay to 200 winners, second 10 yen to 20,000 and third 1 yen to 200,000. Ten stamps earn a completion reward of 50 yen in PayPay for the first 20,000; once that runs out after 27 November the campaign ends early and leftover stamps cannot be drawn.
yahoo-japan-agent-i-stamp-rally.conditions: A Yahoo! JAPAN ID and Japanese residence; enter task pages from the buttons on the campaign page, not by opening a browser yourself; one stamp per task and ten maximum; draws and the completion reward must happen during the campaign; PayPay points need a linked Yahoo! JAPAN ID and expire in 28 days otherwise; points cannot be withdrawn or transferred.
steps: Open stamp.yahoo.co.jp/stamp/exc-agenti202611p and sign in with your Yahoo! JAPAN ID
Work through the mission list, pressing the button inside each mission to open the Agent i page, then return and check the stamp landed
Draw at 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 stamps (up to five draws)
Finish all ten and claim the ¥50 PayPay reward — the first-20,000 cap can close it early, so do it soon
Make sure your Yahoo! JAPAN ID is linked to PayPay; unlinked points expire in 28 days
yahoo-japan-agent-i-stamp-rally.risk: The money is small: ¥50 for finishing plus ¥1–500 per draw, worth only a few yen in expectation — the real value is trying Agent i. The completion reward is capped at the first 20,000 and can close any time after 2026-11-27. Missions only count when entered from the event page buttons. Unlinked points expire in 28 days, and the ¥2,500 ceiling needs five first prizes, which will not happen.

envato-minimax-h3-unlimited-24h.regions: [Global] Wherever Envato signups are open, needing only a free account and no card

poke-devin-bots-free-credits.title: [Global] Poke × Devin Bots: pitch your idea, get a free Devin Bot + 1 month of Max ($200) + up to $10,000 in credits
poke-devin-bots-free-credits.highlight: Text Poke what you want to build and convince it how many free credits you deserve; 10,000 accounts, up to $10,000 each, plus a month of Devin Max
poke-devin-bots-free-credits.regions: [Global] Regions where Poke can be reached over iMessage or SMS and Devin activated (checkout says no card)
poke-devin-bots-free-credits.value: Up to $10,000 (includes 1 month of Devin Max, normally $200/mo)
poke-devin-bots-free-credits.content: Cognition launched Devin Bots on 17 November 2026, where a lead agent runs many Devin sessions in parallel, each bot with its own cloud computer. Cognition's Walden Yan says 10,000 accounts are open with up to $10,000 each and a month of Devin Max, normally $200 a month; Poke then sends a personal link to sign into Devin and activate through Stripe with no card.
poke-devin-bots-free-credits.conditions: A phone that can receive Poke messages (iPhone Safari or Mac iMessage); Poke decides the amount from your pitch; 10,000 places first come; the offer ends at 16:00 Beijing time on 23 November 2026.
steps: Open poke.com/bots in Safari on an iPhone (or message via iMessage on a Mac)
Tell Poke the outcome you want it to own, your stack, and what you will handle yourself
Agree on an amount, confirm, and get your exclusive link
Open the link, sign in to Devin and complete the Stripe checkout (no card required) to activate the membership and credits
poke-devin-bots-free-credits.risk: Poke decides the amount, so most people will not get the maximum; this is described as a one-week experiment and can be tightened or ended at any time; Devin quotas refresh daily and weekly, so the advertised credit value is not usable all at once; a vague pitch tends to get the lowest tier.
poke-devin-bots-free-credits.source: Poke official release notes (Devin Bots, 2026-11-17) + Cognition announcement and sulat.com report (2026-11-19) + jidan.si summary

workbuddy-hy4-flash-free-nov2026.regions: [CN/International] WorkBuddy's China site workbuddy.cn and international site workbuddy.ai
workbuddy-hy4-flash-free-nov2026.value: Free daily allowance (0 credits during the promo)

workbuddy-hy4-flash-free-nov2026.conditions: Download and sign into the WorkBuddy client; the exemption applies only inside it and quota cannot be exported as an API key; credits apply after the daily allowance; switched multimodal models for images and video are excluded.

Switch the model picker to Hy4 flash (marked limited-time free)
Chat, read documents, build slides or simple front-end code without spending credits until 23:59 Nov 30
For API access outside the client, use Tencent Cloud TokenHub or OpenCode's hy4-flash-free tier
