firefox-builtin-vpn-unlimited-2027.title: [Global] Firefox built-in VPN with unlimited data, free until Jan 31, 2027
firefox-builtin-vpn-unlimited-2027.highlight: Sign in with a Mozilla account and the built-in VPN in Firefox for desktop and Android drops its 50GB monthly cap until Feb 1, 2027
firefox-builtin-vpn-unlimited-2027.regions: [Global] Regions where the built-in VPN is live (desktop and Android; iOS not yet)
firefox-builtin-vpn-unlimited-2027.content: Mozilla announced that from 10 November 2026 to 31 January 2027 Firefox's free built-in VPN drops its 50GB monthly cap: signing in to a Mozilla account activates it and the panel shows unlimited. It encrypts only Firefox's traffic through a proxy and hides your IP without covering other apps, and the 50GB cap returns at 00:00 UTC on 1 February 2027.
firefox-builtin-vpn-unlimited-2027.conditions: Sign in to a Mozilla account, since no sign-in means no unlimited data; only regions with the built-in VPN; Firefox traffic only, not other apps; local browsing history is not hidden.
steps: Update Firefox on desktop or Android
Sign in to or create a Mozilla account
Turn on the VPN icon in the toolbar (desktop) or Settings → VPN (Android)
The panel shows unlimited; you can switch among 28 locations
firefox-builtin-vpn-unlimited-2027.risk: Only Firefox traffic is protected, so downloads and other apps still use your real connection; some sites add checks or slow down behind a VPN; the 50GB cap returns automatically on 1 February 2027.
firefox-builtin-vpn-unlimited-2027.source: Mozilla official blog (2026-11-10) + Mozilla Connect staff post + Cheapies.nz and PCMag coverage

raisin-stack-welcome-bonus-1000.title: [US] Raisin STACK welcome bonus: up to $1,000 (deposit $10,000+, hold 90 days, first deposit by Nov 30)

raisin-stack-welcome-bonus-1000.regions: [US] US residents new to Raisin US, with an SSN or ITIN and a US bank account
raisin-stack-welcome-bonus-1000.content: Raisin's welcome bonus: enter STACK at signup, start the first deposit by 23:59 ET on 30 November 2026 and put in at least $10,000 within 14 days, holding it 90 days, with tiers by minimum balance — $40 for $10,000-24,999, $100 for $25,000-49,999, $200 for $50,000-99,999, $425 for $100,000-199,999 and $900 from $200,000. The bonus lands in the Raisin Cash account within 30 days of qualifying.
raisin-stack-welcome-bonus-1000.conditions: New Raisin customers only; STACK at signup; the first deposit started by 23:59 ET on 30 November; $10,000 within 14 days; tiers follow the minimum balance over 90 days, and dropping a tier cuts or loses the bonus; no stacking with other Raisin offers.

Initiate your first deposit before 23:59 ET on 30 November
Top up to your target tier within 14 days (multiple transfers are fine)
For the boost, put $1,000+ into a second product category such as a CD

clearstreet-3pct-cash-match.title: [US] Clear Street 3% cash match: up to $10,000 ($5,000 minimum, funds must stay 5 years)
clearstreet-3pct-cash-match.highlight: Open and fund a brokerage account between Nov 9 and Dec 31 for a 3% match on net deposits within 14 days, up to $10,000 — but the matched money has to stay for 5 years
clearstreet-3pct-cash-match.regions: [US] US residents (18+, US tax ID and address)
clearstreet-3pct-cash-match.content: Open an individual cash or margin account and make a first deposit: Clear Street pays a 3% cash match on net deposits made within 14 days of that first deposit, minimum $5,000 and capped at $10,000. ACH, wire and ACATS transfers all count, and the match arrives as a lump sum within 30 days after the 14-day window. The match and the deposits behind it must stay five years; early withdrawal can be clawed back at 3%, and idle cash under $50,000 earns 0%. Third-party reports of an older version ($5,000 in, $250, locked 90 days) are outdated — the terms above govern.
clearstreet-3pct-cash-match.conditions: New Clear Street customers who have never had a sign-up reward; US resident with a US tax ID and address; net deposits of $5,000 within the 14-day window; match funds kept five years; not combinable with other Clear Street promotions, though referral rewards can stack.
steps: Open a Clear Street individual brokerage account through the offer page before 31 December
Within 14 days of your first deposit, top up to your target net deposit (ACH, wire or ACATS)
The match is credited within 30 days after the window and can be used as buying power
Do not withdraw the matched funds for 5 years or you may be charged back
clearstreet-3pct-cash-match.risk: The 5-year hold is very long and ties up your money; cash under $50,000 earns 0%, so parking $5,000 for $150 of match has a real opportunity cost; early withdrawals can be clawed back; investments can lose value; terms can change.
clearstreet-3pct-cash-match.source: Clear Street official offer page and Offer Disclosure (2026-11-09 to 12-31) + US Card Forum discussion (2026-11-17) + Doctor of Credit (older $250 version delisted 11/17)

chatgpt-pro-business-api-credits.title: [Multi-region] ChatGPT Pro / Business subscriptions now include API credits, up to $500 a month
chatgpt-pro-business-api-credits.highlight: Pro $100/$200/$500 tiers receive matching API credits monthly; Business gets $20 per Standard seat or $100 per Premium seat, capped at $500 per workspace
chatgpt-pro-business-api-credits.regions: [Multi-region] Where live (check whether the option shows in ChatGPT settings)
chatgpt-pro-business-api-credits.content: Eligible paid ChatGPT Pro and Business plans come with free API credits: the Pro 100, 200 and 500 tiers get $100, $200 and $500 a month; Business earns per paid seat (Standard $20, Premium $100), capped at $500 per workspace a month (annual plans pay the year at once, capped at $6,000). Open Settings → Billing (Pro) or the workspace billing settings (Business) and find the API credits benefit
Select the API organization to receive the credits and confirm
Check API Platform billing to see the credits, then use that organization's API keys

chatgpt-pro-business-api-credits.source: OpenAI official API docs (API credits for ChatGPT subscribers) + ChatGPT Business release notes (2026-10-28) + Korean Naver blog walkthrough (2026-10-31)

capy-free-local-agent.title: [Global] Capy: desktop coding agent with a $0 plan, 100 reviews a month and three free models
capy-free-local-agent.highlight: Runs on your own computer, plugs into the ChatGPT / Copilot / SuperGrok plan you already pay for, and the Free tier includes 100 review credits a month with unlimited members.
capy-free-local-agent.regions: [Global] The free plan runs on your own computer; cloud machines and Capy-hosted models are paid
capy-free-local-agent.content: A desktop AI coding agent: once installed it opens threads, writes code, runs commands and reviews code on your own machine or its cloud machines. The pricing page lists Free at $0 with the agent on your computer, your own subscriptions and keys, 100 review credits a month, unlimited members and one subscription per organisation. Low, Medium and High reviews cost 1, 5 and 10 credits, so 100 is about 20 Medium reviews. The launch post adds that Particle-1, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM 5.3 are free on every plan and a comment earns a month of Lite, neither of which is on the pricing page, so follow the app. Free uses local compute without machine minutes, and credits start only with cloud machines or hosted models (Lite: 30,000 machine minutes and $20 of model credit, $1 for the first week).
capy-free-local-agent.conditions: The free plan needs your own ChatGPT (Codex), Copilot or SuperGrok subscription or API key; local only with no cloud machine minutes; 100 review credits reset monthly without accumulating; the three free models and comment bonus are announced rather than listed, so follow the app.
steps: Download the macOS / Windows / Linux app at capy.ai/download and sign in
Connect your ChatGPT (Codex), Copilot or SuperGrok subscription or API keys under Settings → Models
Pick your own computer as the machine, open a thread and hand over the task; choose Low / Medium / High when you want a review
capy-free-local-agent.risk: The free plan is local only and depends on your own model subscription, so nothing continues in the cloud. The free models and the free Lite month appear only in the launch post and can be withdrawn.
capy-free-local-agent.source: Capy official pricing page and docs.capy.ai (checked 2026-11-19) + X @okeyccronald launch post (2026-11-19)

tesseract-free-desktop-agent.title: [Global] Tesseract: a free desktop AI agent that turns one sentence into a deck, site, logo or video
tesseract-free-desktop-agent.highlight: It produces finished files rather than chat: PowerPoint, PDF, websites, brand kits, fonts and video. The app is free, and free of charge entirely if you already pay for Claude or ChatGPT.
tesseract-free-desktop-agent.regions: [Global] Desktop on macOS, Windows and Linux; entirely free if you already have a Claude or ChatGPT subscription
tesseract-free-desktop-agent.value: Free app ($0 with your own AI subscription)
tesseract-free-desktop-agent.content: A free desktop AI agent from Eightcell Labs, launched on Product Hunt on 14 November 2026. It does not chat but delivers finished work: say your bakery needs an investor deck and it returns a plan, then an editable PowerPoint or PDF; the same flow builds websites on 220+ templates and 14 themes, logos and brand kits, fonts, videos, spreadsheets and research reports, with files landing on your computer. It sells no subscription or credits, reusing the AI plan you already pay for across more than a dozen agents including Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cursor Agent, Kimi Code and Qwen Code with your own login, and says usage costs nothing extra with a Claude or ChatGPT subscription; when one account's allowance runs out it switches to the next. Those with no AI plan use a built-in free allowance that refills, with more from $10 prepaid.
tesseract-free-desktop-agent.conditions: Fully free only with an existing Claude or ChatGPT subscription, whose own limits still apply; without one, only the official free allowance, whose size is unpublished (unverified); no mobile version.
steps: Download the build for your OS at tesseract.dev (no credit card)
On first launch pick the agent you already use and sign in, or start on the free allowance
Pick one of the 33 guided makers or describe the job in one sentence and collect the editable files
tesseract-free-desktop-agent.risk: The free allowance size is unpublished. A desktop agent reads and writes local files, so try it in an empty folder first. Third-party agent CLIs may need their own authorisation.
tesseract-free-desktop-agent.source: Tesseract official site and launch blog (checked 2026-11-19; Product Hunt launch 2026-11-14)

pollyreach-free-credits-number.title: [Global] PollyReach: a real phone number and voice for your AI agent — 200 free credits plus a free number
pollyreach-free-credits-number.highlight: Say "book me a table for 7pm" and the agent finds the number, dials, navigates the IVR and reports back with a summary, recording and transcript. It also answers your phone 24/7.
pollyreach-free-credits-number.regions: [Global] Calls in 50+ languages; the free number is a US number with calls billed in credits
pollyreach-free-credits-number.content: It hands phone calls to an AI agent: give it a real number and say book a table for two at seven and it finds the number, dials, works through IVR menus, talks to people and handles interruptions, then sends a summary, recording and transcript; it also answers your calls around the clock, filtering spam and classifying messages. New users get 200 credits and a free number per the Product Hunt launch post with no card, enough for several rounds of outbound and inbound calls, after which Star costs $20 a month (2,000 credits, one agent, one US number), Pro $40 (4,000 credits, two agents) and Max $100 (10,000 credits, five agents), about 15% off annually.
pollyreach-free-credits-number.conditions: Paid once the 200 free credits run out, with the credit-to-minute conversion unpublished (unverified); outbound calls have a daily cap and high-volume dialling is banned; complex IVRs may still need a person.
steps: Sign up at pollyreach.ai (no credit card) and collect the 200 credits
Claim a free number and set the agent's identity and script
Send it a task in chat, e.g. "book a table for two on Friday at 7pm", then read the summary and recording
pollyreach-free-credits-number.risk: Paid tiers are only in the page script and not fully published, so confirm charges in the app. The callee is talking to an AI and some businesses refuse. The free number is US-based, so international calls can cost the other side.
pollyreach-free-credits-number.source: PollyReach official pricing page + Product Hunt launch post (checked 2026-11-19)

instabox-free-cloud-machine.title: [Global] InstaBox free cloud computer: 4 vCPU / 8GiB with Claude Code and Codex preinstalled, no card
instabox-free-cloud-machine.highlight: One Firecracker microVM per agent, Debian 13 with a desktop and Chromium, pausing after 30 idle minutes and resuming in under a second at $0.
instabox-free-cloud-machine.regions: [Global] Machines run in US datacentres; one free machine that pauses after 30 idle minutes and resumes in a second
instabox-free-cloud-machine.content: Each AI agent gets its own cloud Linux machine: a Firecracker microVM on Debian 13 with 4 vCPU, 8 GiB of RAM, a 16 GiB root disk and a 20 GiB persistent disk at /data, preinstalled with Chromium, a desktop, Docker, Node.js, Python, Go, Rust and the Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode agents, with login state in /data/home that travels between machines. Free costs $0 for one machine, five snapshots and 100 GiB of egress a month, pausing after 30 idle minutes with state kept and nothing billed, running up to 120 minutes at a time extended to 480 with use; InstaBox says free machines have no uptime cap and simply pause when off, designed for bursty agent work. Sign in with GitHub or Google, run npx instabox@latest sh for the CLI, or create machines in the web console, and free machines start only from the agent-browser, android, omarchy and ci templates.
instabox-free-cloud-machine.conditions: Free means one machine, five snapshots, 100 GiB of egress a month, a 30-minute idle pause and 120-minute sessions; whether a new free account needs a card is unstated (the API has a cardMissing state, unverified); machines are US-only.
steps: Sign in at instabox.sh with GitHub or Google and create a free machine from a template
Open the machine desktop, or connect with npx instabox@latest sh
Run Claude Code / Codex with your own model keys; let it pause when the task ends
instabox-free-cloud-machine.risk: It pauses when idle, so it is not a always-on server. GitHub, Claude and Codex logins live inside the machine and travel into snapshots. US-only nodes mean high latency from Asia.
instabox-free-cloud-machine.source: Visitor submission (Gmail 2026-11-19 19:49) + InstaBox official pricing page and docs (checked 2026-11-19)

ethena-pay-virtual-visa-4pct.title: [47 non-US countries] Ethena Pay free virtual Visa: 4% back in AVAX on the first $2,500 each month
ethena-pay-virtual-visa-4pct.highlight: Self-custody Visa Platinum issued on a Puerto Rico BIN, no account or monthly fee, free virtual card, up to $100 of AVAX cashback a month on the Standard tier.
ethena-pay-virtual-visa-4pct.regions: [47 non-US countries] Live in Latin America, the Caribbean, Asia and the Middle East, Africa and Oceania; US and restricted jurisdictions excluded, not yet in Europe
ethena-pay-virtual-visa-4pct.content: Ethena Pay is a self-custodial Visa card (issued by Third National, programme by Rain, BIN in Puerto Rico) with no account, monthly, minimum-balance or virtual-card fees, linkable to Apple and Google Pay. Standard earns 4% on the first $2,500 a month, 1% from $2,500 to $4,000 and nothing above; Pro (unlocked at 10 referrals) pays 4.5% on the first $8,000 and invite-only VIP 5% on the first $20,000. Cashback is calculated in dollars and paid daily in AVAX with no monthly or lifetime cap, so Standard tops out near $100 a month. It is live in 47 countries, officially extended to 48 including Japan, for non-US persons only; US, UK and EU residents cannot use it, mainland China and Taiwan are not open and overseas ID is needed. KYC takes a passport, residence permit or licence, with a self-declared address and no proof; it used to need an invite code and this submission says the waitlist is gone (unverified). A virtual IBAN converts fiat to USDe automatically, transfers between users are free and non-USD spending costs about 1% in FX.
ethena-pay-virtual-visa-4pct.conditions: Non-US persons only, with KYC; cashback counts only eligible purchases, not cash withdrawals, crypto or gift card buys, P2P transfers, bill or tax payments; transactions under $1 earn nothing; Standard stops earning above $4,000 a month. A KOL invite link can speed onboarding and about two weeks of activity adds $30 (third-party reports, not in the official terms, unverified).
steps: Download the app at pay.ethena.fi and finish KYC with a passport as a resident of one of the 47 countries
Issue the free virtual Visa and add it to Apple Pay / Google Pay
Spend on the card; AVAX cashback lands a few days after each transaction settles
ethena-pay-virtual-visa-4pct.risk: Cashback is paid in AVAX, so price moves can eat the gain. Rewards are discretionary and can be cut at any time. The whitelist removal is only the submitter's word, so check before signing up. Whether mainland Chinese residency passes KYC is unverified.
ethena-pay-virtual-visa-4pct.source: Visitor submission (Gmail 2026-11-19 19:49) + Ethena Pay official pricing page and FAQ (checked 2026-11-19)

ig-uk-refer-free-share-1000.title: [UK] IG share dealing referral: a random US share worth £50-£1,000 for the friend, £100 cash for the referrer
ig-uk-refer-free-share-1000.highlight: Put in £1,000, hold it three months and submit a W-8BEN to receive a randomly allocated US share; 70% of them land at £50-£70.
ig-uk-refer-free-share-1000.regions: [UK] UK residents 18+ who are new to IG and do not live at the referrer's address
ig-uk-refer-free-share-1000.content: The invitee opens a GIA, ISA or SIPP through the link and invests £1,000+ within 30 days, then keeps an average invested value above £1,000 for three months, earning one randomly assigned US-listed share worth £50 to £1,000; the referrer gets £100 in cash (with a GIA). The odds are uneven: 70% at £50-70, 20% at £70-100, 7% at £100-250 and 3% at £250-1,000, so expect about £70-90. The invitee must submit a valid W-8BEN before the holding period ends or the share is forfeited; the share pays at the end of the month after the holding period; links may only be shared privately and public posts are void.
ig-uk-refer-free-share-1000.conditions: A first investment of £1,000+ within 30 days of opening; an average invested value of £1,000+ for three months (pure market falls excepted); a valid W-8BEN; one referral per person; up to 10 valid referrals a month for the referrer.

schwab-referral-brokerage-1000.regions: [US] US residents only (including foreign nationals resident in the US), excluding US territories
schwab-referral-brokerage-1000.content: The referred customer opens a Schwab One brokerage account, IRA or other eligible account with an existing customer's code and makes a net deposit within 45 days: $25,000-49,999 pays $100, $50,000-99,999 pays $300, $100,000-499,999 pays $500 and $500,000+ pays $1,000, arriving about a week after the 45 days. Net deposit means new money from outside Schwab minus withdrawals, with internal transfers excluded; in taxable accounts the net deposit, after market losses, must stay a year or the bonus can be clawed back. The Investor Checking offer of up to $1,000 closed on 10 November 2026 and this referral excludes Investor Checking.
schwab-referral-brokerage-1000.conditions: An existing Schwab customer must supply the code; net deposit of external new money within 45 days; hold it a year in taxable accounts; one per account and one account per person; no stacking with other offers; US residents only, excluding territories.
steps: Get a referral code or link from a friend who already has a Schwab account and enter it during the application
Open a Schwab One brokerage account or IRA and fund it from an outside bank within 45 days
Hold the deposit for a year in a taxable account; the award arrives about a week after day 45
schwab-referral-brokerage-1000.risk: The tiers are steep: $1,000 needs half a million dollars parked for a year, which can cost far more than the award. It must be outside money, and a US residency plus SSN/ITIN is required. Terms can be withdrawn.

Within 30 days download the Monzo app, open a personal current account and top it up

qiniu-conatus-free-100m-daily.conditions: Sign in and pass real-name verification; only a single cleared top-up above ¥100 raises the limit to a billion a day, past top-ups counting but multiples not adding; risk-flagged accounts cannot call; the campaign ends at 23:59 on 30 November 2026, after which calls stop even with quota left.

Create an API key on the models page (every key on the account shares the quota)
Point the base URL at https://api.qnaigc.com/v1, set the model to qiniu/conatus-free and call it over the OpenAI or Messages protocol

heygen-voice-turbo-free.highlight: The top-ranked TTS model on Artificial Analysis is free through Nov 30 when the model name is heygen-voice-1-turbo-free; public voices and instant clones both work.
heygen-voice-turbo-free.regions: [Global] A HeyGen account and API key, with no card or balance needed

POST to https://api.heygen.com/v3/models/audio/tts with model set to heygen-voice-1-turbo-free
Start with a public voice from the docs, then switch to your own instant clone
heygen-voice-turbo-free.risk: Free only until Nov 30, then list price applies; a wrong model name is charged; 429s are frequent at peak; do not build a production SLA on it.

jetbrains-junie-lite-free.title: [Global] JetBrains Junie Lite: a free coding agent for every JetBrains account, no card
jetbrains-junie-lite-free.highlight: Not a trial and no countdown: a free JetBrains account gets it in Air and the Junie CLI, activated on the first request with no card at all.
jetbrains-junie-lite-free.regions: [Global] Any JetBrains account (free, AI Pro or AI Ultimate) in Air and the Junie CLI
jetbrains-junie-lite-free.content: Included with every JetBrains account, not a trial and with no countdown: the first request activates it automatically with no extra signup and no card. It works in JetBrains Air inside the IDE and in the Junie CLI, where /model selects it manually and otherwise Junie routes by task. The documentation says the underlying model is currently OpenAI GPT-6 Luna (the launch post said Qwen 3.6 27B) and JetBrains may swap it, so do not hardwire workflows to a model name. Usage is described as nearly unlimited with no published quota: at capacity requests simply stop rather than falling back. Inference runs on JetBrains' own infrastructure, and prompts, code and output never reach model vendors or train anything.
jetbrains-junie-lite-free.conditions: Only in JetBrains Air and the Junie CLI, not JetBrains AI Assistant; a JetBrains account without an AI subscription; no quota published; the launch post's footnote mentioned an end date of 31 December 2026 while the documentation calls it a long-term free tier — the two disagree, so treat the end date as unconfirmed.
steps: Install a JetBrains IDE with Air, or the Junie CLI, and sign in with your JetBrains account
In Air go to Settings → AI | Air | Accounts and pick 'Junie Lite Only'; in the CLI run /model and choose Junie Lite
Hand it the mechanical work — renames, test scaffolds, changelogs — and keep frontier models for the hard parts
jetbrains-junie-lite-free.risk: The underlying model can change, the quota is unpublished and requests stop at the ceiling, and it covers JetBrains tooling only.
jetbrains-junie-lite-free.source: JetBrains official Junie Lite docs and launch post (checked 2026-11-20) + JetBrains Air authorization help (updated 2026-11-11) + tahoo.tech recheck (2026-11-13)

Collect the free conversion and number-change coupons under Rewards > My Coupons and use them within seven days
