bitrefill-free-1gb-esim.title: [Global] Bitrefill app: claim a free 1GB eSIM, one per account, no code needed
bitrefill-free-1gb-esim.highlight: Only inside the official app: an account with a verified email that has never bought or claimed an eSIM sees a free banner on the eSIM tab and can pick a destination.
bitrefill-free-1gb-esim.regions: [Global] Official iOS and Android apps only; destinations follow the app's list
bitrefill-free-1gb-esim.content: Per Bitrefill's help centre (updated 17 November 2026), an account with a verified email using the official iOS or Android app, never having bought or claimed an eSIM, picking a destination on the free list can tap the free banner on the eSIM tab and order a 1GB eSIM. One per account, non-transferable, with no code, and it runs on the same networks as paid plans. Missing banners usually mean the web version, a VPN or private relay, an unverified email, a previous eSIM, a destination off the list or an unsupported region.
bitrefill-free-1gb-esim.conditions: The official app; VPN and private relay off; once per account and non-transferable; destinations change with the campaign; accounts that have bought or claimed an eSIM cannot claim again.
steps: Install the official Bitrefill app, sign in and confirm the email is verified
Open the eSIM tab and tap the 1GB free banner
Pick a destination, confirm the order and install from the email or on-screen steps
bitrefill-free-1gb-esim.risk: The destination list and stock change, the website and a VPN hide the entry point, older accounts cannot take part, and community reports mention regional limits.
bitrefill-free-1gb-esim.source: Bitrefill help centre article on the free eSIM (updated 2026-11-17) + bitrefill.com/free-esim destinations page (checked 2026-11-20)

remitly-us-global-card.title: [US] Remitly Global Card and bank account: a bonus after $300 of wages lands, no monthly fee
remitly-us-global-card.highlight: A Lead Bank Visa debit card on a Stripe account that can hold USD or USDC, with no monthly or foreign transaction fees; a first qualifying $300 payroll deposit pays a bonus about seven business days later.
remitly-us-global-card.regions: [US] US only, from Lead Bank and Stripe (funds held at Fifth Third Bank); expanding to the UK and EU
remitly-us-global-card.value: Bonus after $300 of wages (amount shown in the app, $50 per the submission)
remitly-us-global-card.content: Remitly launched Global Card on 30 July 2026: a Lead Bank Visa debit card with an account from Stripe Payments Company and funds held at Fifth Third Bank (FDIC), holding dollars or USDC, 40,000+ free US ATMs, no monthly or FX fees and the best available Remitly rate when sending with the card's money; salary direct deposit arrived on 29 September 2026. The official direct-deposit promo (10 August to 31 December 2026) pays a sign-up bonus about seven business days after the first qualifying salary, wage, pension or government benefit ACH of $300+, once per customer and account, with the amount shown in the app (submission says $50). The $9.99-a-month Global Card Plan is an optional upgrade (Pay Later credit, 1% cashback); the bonus pays without it.
remitly-us-global-card.conditions: The card goes only to invited or eligible US users (a waitlist); deposits must be recurring ACH from an employer or payroll provider, not transfers, P2P, wallets, cheques, cash, wires or tax refunds; the bonus is one-time; amounts and first-transfer discounts vary by region and campaign.
steps: Confirm the Global Card invitation in the Remitly app, open the card and activate it
Generate a direct deposit form in the app for your employer, or link the employer directly
Check the bonus in the app about seven business days after the first $300 deposit; send a transfer in the same session if you also want the first-transfer discount
remitly-us-global-card.risk: US only and invitation-based; Remitly alone decides what counts as a qualifying deposit, and a disguised transfer will not pay. The amount is not fixed in the terms, and the first-transfer discount may overlap with our multi-region $20 Remitly entry, so do not count both. The card is not a bank account.
remitly-us-global-card.source: Remitly Global Card official landing page and Direct Deposit Promotional Terms (2026-11 version) + official press releases (card 2026-07-30, direct deposit 2026-09-29) + visitor submission email (2026-11-19 23:28; the accompanying invite link carried a referral code, so the page links to the official landing page instead)

payangel-referral-10.title: [UK/US/CA/AU] PayAngel referrals: £10 / $10 / CAD 10 / AUD 10 per friend, no cap
payangel-referral-10.highlight: When a friend signs up through your link, passes KYC and sends a first international transfer, you are paid instantly in your own currency with no limit on referrals.
payangel-referral-10.regions: [UK/US/CA/AU] £10 in the UK, $10 in the US, CAD 10, AUD 10 and €10 in Europe; mainly sending to Africa and South Asia
payangel-referral-10.content: Get a personal link from Referral Rewards in the app or on the web and share it: when a friend registers through it, completes one-time KYC in their own name and sends a first qualifying international transfer, you receive £10, $10, €10, CAD 10 or AUD 10 in your local currency with no cap on referrals. Friends get fee-free transfers on several corridors. KYC usually needs a valid government ID (passport, licence, ID card or residence permit) plus a selfie in the app, with proof of address for some higher limits.
payangel-referral-10.conditions: The friend must register through your link or code, pass KYC and send a first qualifying transfer (the minimum shows in the app by currency); self-referral, multiple accounts and shared family identities are blocked by AML checks; rewards pay in the sending country's currency.
steps: Register with PayAngel, pass KYC and copy your referral link from the Rewards tab
Send it to people who genuinely send money, and ask them to open the link before registering
Check the Rewards balance once their first qualifying transfer clears; the reward is immediate
payangel-referral-10.risk: The first-transfer minimum varies by currency and corridor, so check the app; self-referral and multiple accounts are blocked and can close an account; tax on rewards is the user's own affair; only sending markets in the UK, US, Canada, Australia and the EU qualify.
payangel-referral-10.source: PayAngel official Referral Rewards and Rewards pages (checked 2026-11-20) + official send-from guides (2026-11-12) + visitor submission email (2026-11-19 19:49)

starryblu-free-virtual-card.title: [Global] Starryblu free virtual Mastercard from Singapore's Wotransfer, openable with a passport (queue applies)
starryblu-free-virtual-card.highlight: A sister brand of Panda Remit with a MAS major payment institution licence and OCBC-segregated funds; the free tier issues a Singapore-BIN 228001 Mastercard that community tests use for Claude.
starryblu-free-virtual-card.regions: [Global] A mainland passport and domestic address proof work in tests; the card is Singapore-issued (BIN 228001)
starryblu-free-virtual-card.value: Free virtual card (physical card $9.9 shipping, plans $9.99-19.99 a month)
starryblu-free-virtual-card.content: Starryblu is a multi-currency account from Singapore's Wotransfer Pte. Ltd. (sister brand of Panda Remit, holding MAS major payment institution licence PS20200501 with client funds segregated at OCBC), supporting CNY, SGD, USD, EUR, HKD and GBP, cross-border transfers and a Mastercard debit card. The free tier opens a virtual Mastercard at no charge (Singapore BIN 228001, accepted for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other overseas subscriptions) and a physical card ships for about US$9.9; memberships at $9.99 or $19.99 a month or $999.99 a year waive shipping and allow custom numbers. Fund it by HKD FPS, SGD PayNow or international wire, and withdraw back to Alipay or WeChat in China at a small loss. Releases began in batches on 29 October 2026; new signups still queue, and a whitelist or invite code speeds things up.
starryblu-free-virtual-card.conditions: Passport, face check and address proof (a mainland ID works); new accounts still queue; the free card cannot join Apple or Google Wallet per multiple reports; enter any invite code at signup, as it cannot be added later; physical cards and memberships carry fees and auto-renewal.
steps: Download the app from the official site or an app store, pick your country of residence and enter an invite code if you have one
Photograph the passport photo page, complete the face check and upload proof of address
Once approved, open the card page, choose the free plan and apply for the free virtual card; order a physical card separately if needed
Fund a small amount first to test linking and spending before leaving a balance
starryblu-free-virtual-card.risk: The queue can run for months and cards are released in batches; this is a payment account, not a bank deposit, so segregated custody is not deposit insurance; Alipay and WeChat QR spending carries noticeable loss; wallet and merchant acceptance varies; watch plan auto-renewal.
starryblu-free-virtual-card.source: Starryblu official site and app walkthrough (checked 2026-11, licence and free tier) + linux.do submission thread (2026-11-19) + NodeSeek datapoint (2026-11-11: free virtual card now live, BIN and queue) + HuoKe and Carddoger guides

revolut-mobile-ireland.title: [IE] Revolut Mobile eSIM: €9.99 a month for the first 25,000 (then €12.99), with 20GB of UK and EEA roaming
revolut-mobile-ireland.highlight: Unlimited 5G in Ireland plus 20GB of UK and EEA roaming, a 1GB Messaging Pass across 120 countries and free NordVPN, activated as an eSIM in the app with no contract.
revolut-mobile-ireland.regions: [IE] Irish number and Revolut Ireland account; roaming covers the UK and EEA
revolut-mobile-ireland.content: Launched in Ireland on 9 November 2026 as an eSIM with network capacity from Gigs on Vodafone 5G, set up in the app in seconds, contract-free and monthly with cancellation any time. It includes unlimited Irish data, calls and texts under fair use, 20GB of UK and EEA roaming, a 1GB low-speed Messaging Pass across 120+ non-EU countries and free NordVPN. The first 25,000 pay €9.99 a month (to 31 January 2027 or while stock lasts, first come), then €12.99; RevPoints can offset the bill, fully for Ultra users at about €1,400 of spending a month at €9.99, and you can keep your number, switch free or buy a vanity number for €10, with two more numbers for €2 a month.
revolut-mobile-ireland.conditions: A Revolut Ireland account (Revolut Bank UAB's Irish branch) and an Irish number; 18+; €9.99 applies to the first 25,000 or until 31 January 2027; fair use limits hotspotting and abuse; the phone must support eSIM.
steps: In the Revolut app open RevPoints → eSIM and choose the mobile plan
Pick a number: keep yours (text PAC to 65075 and give the code to Revolut), take a free new one or buy a VIP number
Check out, install the eSIM from the QR code; porting normally completes within one working day
revolut-mobile-ireland.risk: Irish numbers and Irish Revolut accounts only; the €9.99 can end early when the allocation runs out and reverts to €12.99; unlimited data is subject to fair use; the app price is authoritative.
revolut-mobile-ireland.source: Revolut Mobile official plans page (UK, same mechanism) + Revolut/Gigs Ireland launch release (2026-11-09, prices, deadline and terms) + RTÉ, Irish Examiner and TheJournal coverage + visitor submission email (2026-11-19 19:50)

barclays-uk-switch-300.title: [UK] Barclays switch offer worth up to £300: £150 to open plus £30 a month for five months
barclays-uk-switch-300.highlight: The biggest switch bonus in the UK right now: switch in with CASS and three direct debits plus a £2,000 salary to earn £150, then £30 a month for five months by spending 10 times and keeping the salary coming.
barclays-uk-switch-300.regions: [UK] UK residents 18+ opening a sole account in the Barclays app
barclays-uk-switch-300.content: Open a sole Barclays Bank Account in the Barclays app and switch in full from another UK bank through CASS with at least three active Direct Debits, submitting the switch within 30 days and receiving £2,000+ in salary within 30 days of opening, for £150 paid within 28 working days of qualifying. Over up to five full months afterwards, each month with 10+ qualifying debit card purchases, £2,000+ salary and the account still open pays £30, up to £300 in total; for October starters the first month is November, paid in December, through the March 2027 month paid in April. Salary must come by employer Bacs, state or private pension Bacs, or a UK business account paying a personal account; qualifying card spend excludes cash withdrawals, ATM, gambling, refunds, P2P and internal Barclays transfers, and pending transactions do not count.
barclays-uk-switch-300.conditions: UK resident, 18+, opening in the app with a mobile number; no Barclays current account held on or before 1 October 2026, no previous Barclays CASS reward, no joint account and not limited to a Basic Account; the switch must include three active Direct Debits; the first £2,000 salary must land within 30 days of opening; the total is capped at £300.
steps: Download the Barclays app and open a sole Barclays Bank Account (finish the application within 21 days)
Complete a full CASS switch within 30 days of opening, carrying three active direct debits
Have £2,000 or more of salary paid in by Bacs within 30 days
For the next five months, make 10 eligible debit card purchases and keep the £2,000 salary arriving
barclays-uk-switch-300.risk: Barclays says the offer can be withdrawn at any time and publishes no end date. Salary must arrive by Bacs and cannot be a transfer between personal accounts. The 10 card purchases must clear within the month, and every missed month costs £30 of the £300 ceiling.
barclays-uk-switch-300.source: Barclays official switch-offer page and October 2026 terms (checked 2026-11-20) + Barclays press release (2026-10-01) + Proper Money comparison (2026-11-16) + Martin Lewis and Birmingham Live coverage (2026-11-15)

chatgpt-business-plugin-credits.title: [Multi-region] ChatGPT Business: $50 PayPal and Oracle plugin credits, $25 HubSpot, $50 Klaviyo
chatgpt-business-plugin-credits.highlight: Inside a ChatGPT Business workspace, accept the offer in the plugin directory, install and connect the plugin, then run one real workflow within 7 days and the workspace gets $25–$50 of agentic credits. PayPal and Oracle pay $50 each, HubSpot $25, Klaviyo $50, and the four caps stack independently.
chatgpt-business-plugin-credits.regions: [Multi-region] PayPal US only; Oracle worldwide; November HubSpot and Klaviyo roll out by workspace
chatgpt-business-plugin-credits.value: $25–$50 per grant, up to about $550 per workspace
chatgpt-business-plugin-credits.content: Eligible ChatGPT Business workspaces see promo banners in the plugin directory: accept the offer, install and connect the plugin and complete one real successful workflow with it in time, and credit is added automatically after checks, with no code or separate application and a confirmation email. Current offers: PayPal $50 each, US users only, once per person and up to three people per workspace ($150); Oracle QuickStart $50 each worldwide, once per person and up to five per workspace ($250); HubSpot $25 each (two per workspace, $50, 8,000 in total); Klaviyo $50 each (two per workspace, $100, 10,000 in total). The four pools are independent, so a workspace can reach $550. Credit is agent credit, usable only for ChatGPT Work, Codex, ChatGPT for Excel and Sheets, ChatGPT for PowerPoint and Workspace Agent, without changing the subscription or plan limits, and November credit expires 30 days after it lands.
chatgpt-business-plugin-credits.conditions: A ChatGPT Business workspace member on a paid seat (Standard, Premium or legacy Codex all count) with the plugin enabled by an admin; anyone who already installed or connected the plugin when accepting is ineligible; November HubSpot and Klaviyo need a successful call in ChatGPT Work or Codex in the same workspace within seven days of accepting, PayPal and Oracle within seven days of installing; first come, first served; PayPal is US only.
steps: Sign in to a Business account on ChatGPT web or the desktop app and open the plugin directory
Open the plugin with the promo banner (PayPal, Oracle QuickStart, HubSpot or Klaviyo) and accept the offer first
Then install and connect that plugin (an admin may need to enable it for the workspace)
Run one real successful workflow with the plugin inside the window; installing alone does not count
Wait for the confirmation email and check the workspace usage or billing page; spend the credit within 30 days
chatgpt-business-plugin-credits.risk: You need a paid Business seat to be eligible, and the credit only offsets agentic usage for 30 days, so it is not cash. Banners are rolled out per user and workspace, so not seeing one means no eligibility this round. Doing it in the wrong order (installing the plugin before accepting) disqualifies you. Supplies are limited and OpenAI can change or end an offer at any time.
chatgpt-business-plugin-credits.source: OpenAI Help Centre "ChatGPT Business plugin credit promotions" (updated 2 days ago; credit table checked 2026-11-20) + NodeSeek report and DPs 2026-11-19 + VPSlu review 2026-11-19

vercel-parallel-search-free.title: [Global] Vercel AI Gateway x Parallel web search: fast mode free until 2027-01-31
vercel-parallel-search-free.highlight: Parallel web search inside AI Gateway is free through 2027-01-31 as long as you set the tool to fast mode, with no separate Parallel account. eve agents use the free fast mode by default.
vercel-parallel-search-free.regions: [Global] Any Vercel account; model tokens still bill normally
vercel-parallel-search-free.content: Updated 18 November 2026: Parallel web search in fast mode on AI Gateway is free until 31 January 2027, and Parallel is now the default search tool for the eve agent. It finds relevant pages and returns links and short summaries, filterable by site or publication date, works with any AI Gateway model and needs no separate Parallel API key. Use gateway.tools.parallelSearch({ mode: 'fast' }) in the AI SDK's tools, set "mode": "fast" in the config of the vercel:parallel_search tool for Chat Completions, or rely on eve, which defaults to free fast. List price is $5 per 1,000 requests (up to 10 results each, then $1 per 1,000).
vercel-parallel-search-free.conditions: A Vercel account with AI Gateway enabled; only searches with mode:'fast' set explicitly in the tool config are free, while basic, advanced and turbo stay at $5 per thousand; free searches are shared and may be rate-limited, in which case the request fails over without charging; free search does not count in gatewayToolCalls but tokens still bill; list price returns on 1 February 2027; ZDR is on by default and Parallel keeps no free-search data or trains on it.
steps: Sign in to Vercel, create or open a project and enable an AI Gateway key
Add gateway.tools.parallelSearch({ mode: 'fast' }) to your AI SDK tools (or mode: fast in the Chat Completions tool config)
Call it from any AI Gateway model; the search bills at $0
Confirm in AI Gateway logs that searches were not billed (tokens still are)
vercel-parallel-search-free.risk: Only the search call is free; model tokens are charged in full. Without an explicit fast mode you pay $5 per 1,000. The free pool is shared and rate limited at peak times, and forgetting to change the config after the deadline starts billing.
vercel-parallel-search-free.source: Vercel changelog (2026-11-18) + AI Gateway web search billing docs (checked 2026-11-20)

agnes-ai-flash-free-api.title: [Global / China site] Agnes AI Flash models at $0: free text, image and video API (OpenAI compatible)
agnes-ai-flash-free-api.highlight: Singapore's Sapiens AI lists agnes-2.5-flash, agnes-3.0-flash, three image Flash models and agnes-video-2.5-flash at $0 for input and output, with the China site also at ¥0. Sign up, no card needed.
agnes-ai-flash-free-api.regions: [Global / China site] USD pricing internationally, ¥0 on the China site; signup only, no card but rate limited
agnes-ai-flash-free-api.value: Text, image and video Flash models all $0 (list price $0.05–$0.15 per million tokens, $10 per 1,000 images)
agnes-ai-flash-free-api.content: The official price page checked on 20 November 2026 shows $0 Angel User Trial pricing for cached input, input and output on agnes-2.5-flash and agnes-3.0-flash (list prices $0.005, $0.05 and $0.15 per million tokens); images from agnes-image-2.0-flash, 2.1-flash and 2.5-flash are $0 for 1K-4K output and reference images from the fourth onward (list $10-$24 per 1,000); and video from agnes-video-2.5-flash is $0 per second at 720P (list $0.025). agnes-video-2.5 and agnes-2.5-pro still charge. The API is OpenAI-compatible with a key from a registered account, about 512K of text context, tool calls and image input; the FAQ calls the core models free long-term with RPM limits only, and free and paid rate pools are separate. Measured limits are roughly 10-20 RPM for text, 1-20 for images and 1 for video, whose $0 price is a time-limited promotion.
agnes-ai-flash-free-api.conditions: Register and create an API key; no card; the free tier is limited only by requests per minute with no published daily quota; video at $0 is promotional while text and image Flash are listed as long-term free; Agent and Token plan quotas do not get model-level free use.
steps: Register at agnes-ai.com (the China site is also ¥0)
Create a free API key in the console and note the base_url
Call agnes-2.5-flash, agnes-3.0-flash, agnes-image-*-flash or agnes-video-2.5-flash with OpenAI-compatible requests
Watch RPM and usage in the console and wait out the minute when limited
agnes-ai-flash-free-api.risk: Free access is gated by RPM limits that the provider says may change, so do not build a production SLA on it. Free video is a limited-time promotion that can close without notice. The provider publishes no end date. Free and paid keys use separate pools.
agnes-ai-flash-free-api.source: Agnes AI official pricing page and FAQ (checked 2026-11-20) + aifree.dev free-API listing (human verified 2026-11-06, rechecked 2026-11-19) + Chinese X deal digest 2026-11-19

fireworks-glimmer-free-training.title: [Global] Fireworks Free Weights Club: train Muse Glimmer 30B free (SFT/DPO/RL through 11/30)
fireworks-glimmer-free-training.highlight: Fireworks' Free Weights Club opens with multimodal Muse Glimmer 30B: SFT, DPO and RL training are free through 2026-11-30 with no credit card, enough for your own LoRA experiments.
fireworks-glimmer-free-training.regions: [Global] A Fireworks account with no card required
fireworks-glimmer-free-training.value: Free training (LoRA SFT normally $3 per million training tokens)
fireworks-glimmer-free-training.content: Fireworks' blog post Train Muse Glimmer for free opens Free Weights Club: the multimodal 30B Muse Glimmer trains free with SFT, DPO and RL until 30 November 2026, without a card, through Managed Training in the UI or API for SFT or the Serverless Training API for your own loop. The docs and cookbook add that LoRA SFT is free in the UI and Serverless Training API only for jobs started before 2026-12-01T00:00:00-08:00, with the scripts refusing later starts without --allow-paid. Its sample trains a LoRA on the Kalshi forecasting cookbook and lifts accuracy on unseen questions from 53.2% to 58.3%, 11.2 points above the Jev baseline. Training yields a LoRA adapter that can be promoted to a model, though serving it still needs an on-demand deployment billed by GPU hour.
fireworks-glimmer-free-training.conditions: A Fireworks account without a card; free applies to training only, with inference and in-training evaluation sampling billed by token; Muse Glimmer 30B left serverless on 25 September 2026; the blog says SFT, DPO and RL, while the cookbook names only LoRA SFT, so follow the job page's billing.
steps: Register a Fireworks account (no card)
In Managed Training or the Serverless Training API, pick accounts/fireworks/models/muse-glimmer-30b
Prepare chat JSONL data and start a LoRA SFT job (the muse_glimmer starter in the cookbook works)
Read the cost line the launcher prints and confirm only evaluation sampling is billed
Promote the LoRA adapter to a model; open an on-demand deployment only if you need to serve it
fireworks-glimmer-free-training.risk: Only training is free; inference and evaluation sampling are charged and a large eval run will create a bill. Serving the tuned model bills per GPU-hour. The blog and docs differ on whether DPO and RL are covered. Jobs started after 11-30 are no longer free.
fireworks-glimmer-free-training.source: Fireworks official blog (2026-10-20, updated 2026-11-17) + official cookbook and model page promotion notes (checked 2026-11-20) + that.promo and Token Thrift re-checks 2026-11-19

tabstack-free-10k-credits.title: [Global] Tabstack by Mozilla: 10,000 free credits for new accounts, no card
tabstack-free-10k-credits.highlight: Mozilla's web API for agents gives every new account 10,000 credits with no card, enough for 1,000 page-to-Markdown extractions or 40 cited fast research runs. The trial stops when the credits run out.
tabstack-free-10k-credits.regions: [Global] Sign up and get it with no credit card
tabstack-free-10k-credits.value: 10,000 credits (about 1,000 Markdown extractions or 40 fast research runs)
tabstack-free-10k-credits.content: Mozilla's web API for agents: the pricing page gives every new account 10,000 free credits without a card. Actions cost credits: Extract to Markdown 10, Extract to structured JSON 50, Generate 100, Automate browser actions 100, Research Fast 250 and Research Balanced 350, so 10,000 is about 1,000 Markdown extracts or 40 Fast Research runs. Search, page reading, gap checking, synthesis and citations all happen outside the model, returning a cited Markdown report, and Mozilla says it never trains on your data and is private by default. Trial accounts cannot overspend: requests stop when credits run out. Paid plans are Starter at $10 a month (100,000 credits), Team $99 and Pro $499.
tabstack-free-10k-credits.conditions: An account with no card; the 10,000 credits are one-time and do not refresh; Balanced research needs Team or above, leaving Fast for trials; one account is limited to 15 requests a minute.
steps: Register at tabstack.ai with no card
Create an API key in the console and confirm the balance shows 10,000 credits
Call /extract (Markdown or JSON) or /research with mode: fast
Check in the console how many credits each action spent; requests stop when they are gone
tabstack-free-10k-credits.risk: At the published overage rate the 10,000 credits are worth only about $3, so this is a trial rather than a lasting free tier. Research can chain several actions and bills each one, so use the console estimate before running it. Do not point production at a trial account.
tabstack-free-10k-credits.source: Tabstack official pricing page and docs FAQ (checked 2026-11-20) + Product Hunt launch 2026-11-19

sspace-30day-max-trial.title: [Global] S.Space by the AutoGen team: 30-day Max trial, no card
sspace-30day-max-trial.highlight: A workspace where people and their own agents share rooms, built by AutoGen's creators: every new account starts a 30-day Max trial with no card, and you plug in your own Claude Code or Codex.
sspace-30day-max-trial.regions: [Global] Sign up to get it; the bundled agent (Sutando) is macOS-only for now
sspace-30day-max-trial.value: 30-day Max trial (Max pricing not public; pricing unconfirmed)
sspace-30day-max-trial.content: From AG2ai (AutoGen creators Chi Wang and Qingyun Wu), it puts people and their own AI agents in one room: each person runs an agent called Sutando on macOS whose core is their own Claude Code or Codex subscription session rather than a per-token API key, while other apps' agents join through MCP at https://mcp.s.space/mcp. Agents can ask each other for data, output lands in shared Commons documents and sheets, and anything sent outside needs a human click. The free plan costs $0 and lets you join rooms and run Sutando on your subscription but carries no usage allowance; every new account gets a 30-day Max trial with no card; cloud tools bill per use (market map $5, qualified leads $0.15 each, competitor scan $20) and hosted Gemini voice needs a paid plan; Sutando itself is MIT-licensed.
sspace-30day-max-trial.conditions: A 30-day Max trial at signup with no card; Sutando has a macOS 12+ client only (Apple Silicon or Intel); Windows and Linux users can join rooms on the web or iPhone and connect other agents; the free plan has no usage allowance, with cloud tools and hosted voice needing a paid plan; room content is not yet end-to-end encrypted.
steps: Register at s.space and confirm the account is on the 30-day Max trial
On macOS, install the S.Space app and connect your Claude Code or Codex subscription
Create a room and invite teammates, or add ChatGPT / Grok / Muse agents over MCP
Work in Commons on what the agents produce, approving anything that leaves the room
Decide before the trial ends whether to move to a paid plan, and watch per-use cloud tools
sspace-30day-max-trial.risk: Max has no public price, so the value of 30 days can only be estimated from comparable $200/month tiers and is marked unverified. The free plan carries no credits. The local agent needs a Mac and draws down your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription. Cloud tools bill per use, so do not click through them carelessly during the trial.
sspace-30day-max-trial.source: S.Space official site + TechLogHub pricing check (2026-11-19) + Product Hunt leaderboard 11-18 + NewAIToolsToday board 2026-11-19

onlook-free-designer-desktop.title: [Global] Onlook (YC W25) open-source agentic design tool: free desktop app
onlook-free-designer-desktop.highlight: Design on top of your real codebase: Onlook overlays a canvas on your repo, and clicking an element and saying 'make this a card layout' drives the Claude Code or Codex you already run to produce a git diff or PR. The desktop app is free and open source.
onlook-free-designer-desktop.regions: [Global] macOS, Windows and Linux desktop; you need your own Claude Code or Codex subscription
onlook-free-designer-desktop.value: Free and open source (Apache-2.0); cloud collaboration to be paid later
onlook-free-designer-desktop.content: Onlook (YC W25) launched on Hacker News on 19 November 2026, rebuilt as an agentic design tool and open sourced end to end under Apache-2.0. The Electron desktop app imports a GitHub repo or local folder, creates its own git worktree, starts a dev server and lets an agent install what is missing; you select elements on the canvas and give instructions, changes appear as git diffs for pushing as a PR or discarding, and one project can hold several worktrees at once. Onlook trains no models, running your existing Claude Code or Codex subscription and turning agent output into a typed event stream for the chat pane, with design-specific tools for laying out frames, generating variants and suggesting. The desktop editor is free and open source, with team cloud collaboration to be charged later.
onlook-free-designer-desktop.conditions: Free and open source with your own working Claude Code or Codex subscription (no model credit is provided); desktop support is mainly macOS and Windows, with no official Linux build; an imported repo needs a runnable dev server for the canvas to start.
steps: Download the desktop app from onlook.com, or build it from github.com/onlook-dev/onlook
Import a project from GitHub or a local folder and let it create the worktree and start the dev server
Select elements on the canvas and give instructions; the agent edits code through your own Claude Code or Codex
Review the diff and open a PR or discard it
onlook-free-designer-desktop.risk: The tool is free but model usage comes out of your own subscription. It is early software, so complex repos may fail to start. When cloud collaboration and image, vector or font generation ship as paid features, the free boundary may narrow.
onlook-free-designer-desktop.source: Launch HN thread (2026-11-19, founder D_R_Farrell) + official GitHub onlook-dev/onlook (Apache-2.0)

tsb-uk-25-amazon-gift-card.title: [UK] TSB Spend & Save: £25 Amazon gift card for opening an account by 12/16 and making 3 payments
tsb-uk-25-amazon-gift-card.highlight: No switch and no direct debits needed: open a TSB Spend & Save or Spend & Save Plus account through the MoneySupermarket link, make three payments of any value by 12/31, and a £25 Amazon gift card is emailed to you. It stacks with £5 a month card cashback for six months.
tsb-uk-25-amazon-gift-card.regions: [UK] UK residents 18+ opening a new Spend & Save or Spend & Save Plus account
tsb-uk-25-amazon-gift-card.content: From 16:00 on 17 November to 16 December 2026 (or earlier withdrawal), open an account at tsb.co.uk via MoneySupermarket's TSB Spend & Save or Spend & Save Plus page and make at least three payments of any size on the new card by 31 December (by posting date) for a £25 Amazon.co.uk gift card. The flow is the promo link, registering at Giftcloud with an email, then Continue Purchase to TSB; once TSB confirms the account and payments, Giftcloud emails the claim link by 31 January 2027, with 60 days to claim, and the account must stay open until the card is issued. The account also pays £5 a month for 20 card payments in the first six months (up to £30) and offers a 5% Regular Saver (up to £250 a month).
tsb-uk-25-amazon-gift-card.conditions: UK residents 18+; start from the designated promo link (Giftcloud tracks it, other entries and Quidco do not count); no TSB Spend & Save or Plus account before; three payments of any size by 31 December; once per person; keep the account open until issue; Safari or leaving mid-flow can break tracking, so allow third-party cookies and finish in one session.
steps: Open the TSB Spend & Save listing on MoneySupermarket, click the offer link and register your email with Giftcloud
Click Continue Purchase to reach TSB and open a Spend & Save or Spend & Save Plus account online
Make three debit card payments of any value by 2026-12-31, counting when they clear
Wait for the Giftcloud claim email by 2027-01-31 and claim the £25 gift card within 60 days
Optionally make 20 card payments a month to collect £5 monthly cashback for six months
tsb-uk-25-amazon-gift-card.risk: Only applications arriving through the promotional link count; going straight to tsb.co.uk gets you nothing. TSB runs a hard credit search that stays on your file. Tracking failure is the most common way this offer fails, so keep the Giftcloud emails. Closing the account early forfeits the card.
tsb-uk-25-amazon-gift-card.source: TSB and Mony Group official terms (effective 2026-11-17 16:00, transcribed in full on the MSE forum) + MoneySavingExpert round-up 2026-11-19 + Daily Record report 2026-11-19

gate-convert-new-user-20usdt.title: [Global site] Gate Convert for new users: $1 in, 20 USDT out, plus 10 WLFI daily check-ins (11/19–11/26)
gate-convert-new-user-20usdt.highlight: Users who have never used Gate Convert can register and make one Convert trade of at least 1 USDT to get 20 USDT (first 500 only). Trade 20 USDT a day to check in for 10 WLFI, out of an 80,000 WLFI pool.
gate-convert-new-user-20usdt.regions: [Global site] KYC required; restricted regions excluded, with rewards paid as dual-currency trial funds or spot WLFI
gate-convert-new-user-20usdt.value: 20 USDT (first 500) plus up to 70 WLFI from check-ins
gate-convert-new-user-20usdt.content: Gate's announcement of 09:00 UTC on 19 November runs a Convert new-user campaign to 09:00 UTC on 26 November 2026. Under New User Convert Gift, a user who has never converted on Gate registers, passes KYC and makes a first convert of 1 USDT or more for 20 USDT, limited to the first 500 and paid automatically as dual-currency investment trial funds. Under Daily Convert Check-In, converting 20 USDT or more across any UTC day counts as that day's check-in for 10 WLFI from a pool of 80,000, up to seven days for 70 WLFI paid in spot WLFI. Both run together after clicking Join Now on the campaign page and completing KYC.
gate-convert-new-user-20usdt.conditions: Join Now on the campaign page and pass KYC first; a convert new user has never completed a Gate Convert before registering; the first 500 only for the 20 USDT; check-ins follow UTC days with 20 USDT converted each, missed days not made up; rewards come as trial funds and spot WLFI rather than withdrawable USDT.
steps: Sign in to Gate, open the event page, click Join Now and complete KYC
Make one Convert trade of at least 1 USDT to receive the 20 USDT trial funds
Trade at least 20 USDT through Convert each day to check in for 10 WLFI
Confirm WLFI in your wallet and use the trial funds under Dual Investment rules
gate-convert-new-user-20usdt.risk: The 20 USDT is Dual Investment trial funds rather than withdrawable cash. The first 500 places can run out. Check-ins follow UTC days with no catch-up. KYC is required and some regions are excluded. WLFI is volatile, so its real value is below face value.

reducto-150-free-usage.title: [Global] Reducto: $150 of free usage on the document-parsing API for new accounts
reducto-150-free-usage.highlight: A document parsing and structured-extraction API for AI agents. The Standard pay-as-you-go tier starts with $150 of free usage, then bills per page ($1 per 1,000 pages on r-1 mini).
reducto-150-free-usage.regions: [Global] No country limit stated; whether a card is needed depends on the signup or console
reducto-150-free-usage.value: $150 of usage on the Standard pay-as-you-go tier
reducto-150-free-usage.content: A document platform for agents with Parse (PDFs, images, tables and scans to structured text), Extract (schema-based fields), Split, Classify and Edit endpoints, covering 30+ file types with no page limit. The Standard pay-as-you-go tier includes $150 of free usage, then bills at list rates: r-1 mini Parse $1 per 1,000 pages, r-1 Parse $10, Extract $20, Deep Extract and Deep Split $40 and Classify $7.50. A Startup Program (under $15M raised, under $3M revenue, fewer than 50 staff) adds migration credit and Growth-tier discounts.
reducto-150-free-usage.conditions: The Standard tier includes $150 of free usage at signup and switches to metered billing when it runs out; no end date is published; validity and whether a card is required depend on the console (community reports say not); the Startup Program needs an application and eligibility review.
steps: Sign up at reducto.ai/pricing or app.reducto.ai
Create an API key and confirm $150 of usage is available on the Standard tier
Parse one PDF and check that pages are deducted from the balance
Decide before the balance runs out; do not add a card just to keep the trial
reducto-150-free-usage.risk: The $150 is usage credit, not cash, and deep extraction burns it quickly. No validity period or card requirement is published, so the console is the source of truth. Parsing accuracy still needs spot checks, and confidential documents raise data-retention questions.
reducto-150-free-usage.source: Reducto official pricing page (read 2026-11-20, states "Free $150 in free usage") plus the perq.sh AI credits directory, re-checked 2026-11-19 against the same page

lindy-50-free-credits.title: [Global] Lindy: $50 in free credits at signup (valid 7 days)
lindy-50-free-credits.highlight: An automation and AI-teammate platform whose Free plan starts with $50 in credits. Connect Slack, email, calendar and 3,000+ integrations and run scheduled routines; the credits expire after 7 days and nothing converts to paid on its own.
lindy-50-free-credits.regions: [Global] Email or Google sign-in; the free plan is $0 with no card
lindy-50-free-credits.content: An AI teammate that works when mentioned in a Slack thread, with scheduled routines, meeting notes and prep, inbox management, drafting, computer use (Pro and Max) and 3,000+ integrations plus MCP. The free plan costs $0 with $50 of credits that expire after seven days without auto-upgrading; paid plans start at Team for $29.99 a month (3,000 credits), and top-ups cost $10 per 1,000 credits.
lindy-50-free-credits.conditions: New accounts get $50 of free credits on the free plan, valid seven days; one trial per member; actions with external effects (sending email, editing tickets, posting messages) need human approval by default; the free plan is listed at $0 and signup does not ask for a card (check the actual page).
steps: Open lindy.ai/pricing and choose Try for free with email or Google
Mention it in Slack or build one automation in the web app
Connect a read-only source such as a calendar and run it once
Spend the credits on a workflow you actually need before the 7 days end, and confirm no card is on file
lindy-50-free-credits.risk: The credits last only 7 days and do not roll over, so this is a one-shot trial. Tool calls and automations burn credits fast. Paid plans start at $29.99/month, so keep payment details off the account, and review approval settings before letting it touch anyone's inbox or calendar.
lindy-50-free-credits.source: Lindy official pricing page (read 2026-11-20: "$50 in credits for free", "Free credits last 7 days") plus perq.sh directory, re-checked 2026-11-19

keenable-100k-search-free.title: [Global] Keenable search API: 100,000 free requests a month, no card ($4 per 1,000 after)
keenable-100k-search-free.highlight: A realtime search and page-fetch API for AI agents with 100,000 free requests per organisation per month and no card required. Overage is $4 per 1,000 requests (about $400 a month at list price), and an official MCP server plugs into Claude Code or Codex.
keenable-100k-search-free.regions: [Global] Sign up and search; the free allowance resets monthly per organisation, with cards only for top-ups
keenable-100k-search-free.value: 100,000 requests a month ($4 per 1,000 beyond that)
keenable-100k-search-free.content: A search and scraping API for AI agents that says its 1.0 release topped the Artificial Analysis Search Index. The pricing page gives every organisation 100,000 free requests a month with no card, using an API key from the console; beyond that it is $4 per 1,000, or $1 per 1,000 for dedicated 100+ RPS capacity for labs and inference platforms. Each request counts one credit whether search.realtime, search.pro, fetch or fetch.live, and responses report the spend. An MCP server at api.keenable.ai/mcp and a CLI use the same allowance, and even without an account a shared public pool allows 1,000 requests an hour and 10 RPS per IP.
keenable-100k-search-free.conditions: 100,000 free requests a month per organisation, resetting on the day the organisation was created; 10 RPS by default with no hourly cap; beyond the allowance /v1/search returns 402 until credit is bought or it resets; no card is needed to keep using the free tier; academic projects can request 100,000 extra monthly credits and startups $5,000 by application.
steps: Open keenable.ai/pricing, choose Get Free 100K requests and create an organisation
Create an API key in the console; no card required
Run one /v1/search call using the quickstart at docs.keenable.ai
For Claude Code or Codex, connect the MCP server at https://api.keenable.ai/mcp
keenable-100k-search-free.risk: The allowance is per organisation, does not roll over and stops service with a 402 once used up. Result quality and any affiliate or sponsored links in results need checking before an agent relies on them. The terms state no end date, so the allowance could change at any time.
keenable-100k-search-free.source: Keenable official pricing page (read 2026-11-20, including the Free 100K requests tier and FAQ) plus perq.sh directory, re-checked 2026-11-19

neevcloud-1500-sandbox-min.title: [Global] NeevCloud: 1,500 free sandbox minutes every month for verified accounts (no card)
neevcloud-1500-sandbox-min.highlight: A free tier added in the November release: every verified account gets 1,500 sandbox minutes a month, fully covering sandboxes up to 2 vCPU / 4 GB with disk included, on templates that ship Claude Code, Codex CLI, opencode and OpenClaw.
neevcloud-1500-sandbox-min.regions: [Global] A verified account (personal KYC) is required; the notes say no card
neevcloud-1500-sandbox-min.value: 1,500 sandbox minutes a month (2 vCPU / 4 GB covered, disk included)
neevcloud-1500-sandbox-min.content: NeevCloud's November 2026 v0.8.1 to v0.9.0 notes add a free tier to Agentic Studio's Sandboxes: 1,500 sandbox minutes a month per verified account, renewed monthly, with no credit card once the account is verified for new and existing accounts alike and the console showing the remainder. Minutes are weighted by size: sandboxes at 2 vCPU and 4 GB or below are fully covered, smaller ones burn slower and larger ones proportionally more, and sandbox disks cost nothing inside the allowance. The platform ships OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex CLI, opencode and Hermes templates and supports Docker, a Playwright and Chromium template, snapshots and MCP endpoints.
neevcloud-1500-sandbox-min.conditions: A verified NeevCloud account (personal KYC, with a separate process for businesses); 1,500 minutes a month without accumulating; 2 vCPU and 4 GB is the covered core size; idle sandboxes pause and the first request wakes them; overage bills as you go.
steps: Sign up at neevcloud.com and complete account verification (no card needed)
Open Agentic Studio, then Sandboxes, and confirm the 1,500-minute monthly allowance
Create a sandbox from a template such as Playwright + Chromium or Claude Code
Watch the remaining minutes in the console before committing to paid usage
neevcloud-1500-sandbox-min.risk: Minutes are weighted by size, so large sandboxes drain them quickly. KYC means handing over identity details. The allowance resets monthly with no carry-over, and sandboxes that pause still consume minutes while awake. The platform is young, so stability and retention policies deserve a look.
neevcloud-1500-sandbox-min.source: NeevCloud official November 2026 release notes (read 2026-11-20: "1,500 free sandbox minutes every month, for every verified account, no card required") plus perq.sh directory, re-checked 2026-11-19

freebuff-free-coding-agent.title: [Global] Freebuff: an ad-funded free coding agent with 100 Freebucks a day, no card or API key
freebuff-free-coding-agent.highlight: A free coding agent from the Codebuff team, launched on 19 November: terminal, desktop, mobile and web, with no API key and no credit card. Small text ads in the terminal pay for the models, and 100 Freebucks refill at midnight Pacific time.
freebuff-free-coding-agent.regions: [Global] The full model list covers 25+ countries; elsewhere it drops to a limited mode
freebuff-free-coding-agent.value: Free ($0, with 100 Freebucks a day; comparable to a $20/month coding agent)
freebuff-free-coding-agent.content: The free tier from the Codebuff open-source agent team, launched on 19 November 2026. Its site calls it the 100% free coding agent, $0 forever with unlimited usage, no card and no credit watching, funded by text ads in the terminal. It runs as a CLI (npm install -g freebuff), desktop apps on macOS, Windows and Linux, iOS and Android and on the web, with threads stored in the cloud to continue across devices. Models include DeepSeek v4, MiMo 2.5 Pro, GLM 5.2 and MiniMax M3, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite finds files and you can bring your own Claude key. The allowance is 100 Freebucks a day, reset at midnight Pacific without rollover, spent at hourly rates that heavy models can burn in a few hours.
freebuff-free-coding-agent.conditions: 100 Freebucks a day, reset at midnight Pacific without carry-over; the full model list is for 25+ countries only, with others pushed into limited mode (DeepSeek V4 Flash only, six one-hour sessions a day) even behind a VPN; text ads appear in the terminal, the company says messages, traces and files may be used for ad targeting and some models for training (marked in the picker); sign in once to start.
steps: Install with npm install -g freebuff, or download the desktop app from freebuff.com
Log in once, then open /model and pick a model without the training note
Give it one verifiable change in a small project
Continue the same thread from mobile or the web, remembering the daily reset
freebuff-free-coding-agent.risk: The price is privacy: the launch material admits messages, traces and files may feed ad targeting and some models train on data, so keep private code on a non-training model or your own key. Region limits can hide the best models, hourly rates drain the allowance quickly, and a brand-new service has no reliability record.
freebuff-free-coding-agent.source: Freebuff official site (read 2026-11-20: $0 forever, no card, ads pay for models) plus the DEV Community launch write-up (2026-11-19, with the 100 Freebucks and region rules)

opencode-go-glm500-usage.title: [Global] OpenCode Go: $10/month covers $500 of GLM-5.3 usage (through 11/22; Go Plus doubles it)
opencode-go-glm500-usage.highlight: Operation GLM phase two: the Go plan's monthly GLM-5.3 allowance is temporarily raised to $500 (from $200) and Go Plus to $1,000, for new and existing subscribers, with the official docs stating it runs only through 2026-11-22.
opencode-go-glm500-usage.regions: [Global] For international users; Console subscriptions to Go or Go Plus need a payment method
opencode-go-glm500-usage.value: $500 of GLM-5.3 monthly usage on Go ($10/month); Go Plus pays $40 for $1,000
opencode-go-glm500-usage.content: Ended, with 22 November 2026 the last day. OpenCode announced Operation GLM's first stage on 17 November, $100 of GLM-5.3 usage for a $10 Go subscription, and about 11 hours later a second stage raising that to $500 a month for $10, or $1,000 for Go Plus at $40. The Go docs say higher GLM-5.3 limits apply through 22 November 2026. The $500 is the usage a plan covers on GLM-5.3 alone, not a balance, shared with every paid model in Go, capped at 20% of the monthly allowance in any five hours and 50% a week, resetting at 00:00 UTC on Mondays. Subscribe to Go, choose OpenCode Go under /connect and paste the API key, pick GLM-5.3 under /models, or call https://opencode.ai/inference/go directly; checked on 22 November it still held, falling back to normal limits the next day.
opencode-go-glm500-usage.conditions: A Go ($10) or Go Plus ($40) subscription with a payment method; the boost ran only to 22 November 2026; $500 is a monthly usage cap rather than withdrawable balance; 20% in five hours and 50% a week; shared across paid models; China-region users must set Regions to Global under Settings, Privacy.
steps: Sign in at opencode.ai/console, subscribe to Go, add billing details and copy the API key
Run /connect in OpenCode, choose OpenCode Go and paste the key
Select GLM-5.3 with /models and work normally
Use the allowance before 11/22 and cancel the subscription once it reverts if you do not need it
opencode-go-glm500-usage.risk: The $500 is a usage cap, not cash, and cannot be read as a 20% discount on real money. The 5-hour and weekly limits are real and heavy users will hit them, users report 529 errors at peak times, and the allowance drops after 11/22, so do not budget against it.
opencode-go-glm500-usage.source: OpenCode official Go docs (read 2026-11-20: "Higher usage limits apply through November 22, 2026") plus the official X phase-two announcement (2026-11-18) and reports from MoZhenZhen and AI Promo Now ($500 on Go, $1,000 on Go Plus)

exa-api-40-credits-codes.title: [Global] Exa search API: two stackable $20 codes plus $10 of free credit a month
exa-api-40-credits-codes.highlight: A semantic search API for agents. Redeem EXA20FREEBUFF and then EXA20FIRESHIP under Billing for $20 each on the same account, on top of the Free plan's $10 a month and a one-time $10 onboarding bonus.
exa-api-40-credits-codes.regions: [Global] Any new account; the official free tier needs no card
exa-api-40-credits-codes.value: $40 in codes plus $10 of free credit a month (another $10 in the first month)
exa-api-40-credits-codes.content: A semantic neural search API for AI with Search, Contents and Answer endpoints, where Lite search costs about $4 per 1,000 calls. The Free (Starter) tier gives each team $10 of credit a month, resetting on the 1st without rollover and needing no payment method, plus a one-time $10 for finishing onboarding, so $20 in month one. Two creator and partner codes circulating in the community, EXA20FREEBUFF and EXA20FIRESHIP, are $20 each and stacked on one account in a 3 November 2026 test, taking the balance from $20 to $60 with no expiry shown; the older EXA50API is dead and EXA50FIRESHIP has hit its limit.
exa-api-40-credits-codes.conditions: Both codes come from creators and partners rather than the official price page and may expire or hit limits at any time; one redemption per team each; some accounts must verify a non-prepaid card before using gift credit; the free $10 a month does not carry over; redeemed credit remains subject to change.
steps: Sign up at dashboard.exa.ai (no card needed)
Open Billing, redeem EXA20FREEBUFF, then EXA20FIRESHIP
Reload Billing to confirm the balance, then finish onboarding for the extra $10
Make one Search or Contents call; usage beyond the credits bills at list rates
exa-api-40-credits-codes.risk: Both codes are unofficial and can be withdrawn or capped. Some accounts hit a non-prepaid card check that virtual cards fail. The credits are API usage, not cash, and usage beyond the allowance bills at $4 per 1,000 requests.
exa-api-40-credits-codes.source: NodeSeek thread (2026-11-06, with the codes and failure reports) plus tahoo.tech testing (2026-11-03, two codes taking the balance from $20 to $60) and AIdeal's re-check of the official Free tier terms (2026-11-18)

gravatar-free-domain-1y.title: [Global] Gravatar: a free top-level domain for one year (.bio, .link, .social and more, usable as a Bluesky handle)
gravatar-free-domain-1y.highlight: Claim a .bio, .link or .social domain from your Gravatar account free for the first year, wired to redirect to your Gravatar profile, and usable as a Bluesky handle or a custom email address.
gravatar-free-domain-1y.regions: [Global] Any Gravatar (WordPress.com) account; no card needed
gravatar-free-domain-1y.value: A free domain for the first year (renews at $9+ a year)
gravatar-free-domain-1y.content: Gravatar's link-in-bio page promises a free custom domain for one year in popular suffixes such as .link, .bio and .social, free the first year and then $9+ a year, and points out you can use it for a Bluesky handle too. Claim it from the top of the Gravatar dashboard or the sidebar of the profile editor; Smart Redirects are on by default and send the domain to your Gravatar profile. The domain can carry a custom address such as hello@yourname.bio that forwards to the mailbox tied to Gravatar, though the free tier cannot send from it.
gravatar-free-domain-1y.conditions: Free for a year, then $9+ a year by suffix (the domain is released if unpaid); a Gravatar or WordPress.com account; how many an account can claim depends on the dashboard; on the free tier the custom mailbox only receives and forwards, it cannot send.
steps: Sign in at gravatar.com and open the profile editor
Choose the claim-domain option at the top or in the sidebar
Pick an available suffix (.bio, .link, .social and others) and claim it
Confirm the redirect works, then set a reminder for the one-year renewal
gravatar-free-domain-1y.risk: Only the first year is free and the second is billed at $9+ a year, so a forgotten renewal costs money. The domain is tied to your Gravatar account, free-tier mail only forwards, and Gravatar labels the offer limited time.
gravatar-free-domain-1y.source: Gravatar official link-in-bio page (read 2026-11-20: "First year free (then $9+ per year)") plus Gravatar support docs on custom domains, Bluesky handles and email forwarding, and a linux.do thread from 2026-11-19

doubao-work-30day-sub.title: [China] Doubao Work: a 30-day subscription for new users on desktop, plus 8,800 credits for 30 days of check-ins
doubao-work-30day-sub.highlight: New users of the Doubao Work desktop app get a 30-day subscription with no card. Daily check-ins pay 200 credits (double on Mondays) with milestone bonuses, adding up to 8,800 over 30 days, more than the 8,400 a standard ¥68 plan includes.
doubao-work-30day-sub.regions: [CN] Sign in on the Doubao or Doubao Work desktop app for Windows or macOS; there is no mobile entry
doubao-work-30day-sub.value: A 30-day standard subscription (¥68/month tier) plus 8,800 credits from 30 days of check-ins
doubao-work-30day-sub.content: Doubao Work, Doubao's AI agent office suite, updated on 12 November 2026 with third-party models including Kimi K3.1 Pro, GLM 5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, labelling credit multipliers per model and cutting Doubao 2.1 Lite and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash to a 0.01 multiplier for a limited time. Two perks follow: first-time desktop sign-ins get a 30-day free plan covering everything but video generation and Pro models, and every user's daily check-in gives 200 credits doubling to 400 on Mondays, with 200, 500 and 1,300 more at 500, 2,000 and 5,000 accumulated, reaching 8,800 over 30 straight days. Gift credits last 30 days, are spent first and cannot power Pro models or video generation on unpaid accounts.
doubao-work-30day-sub.conditions: The 30-day plan is for first desktop sign-ins only, with no mobile entry; check in from the bottom-left pop-up or the avatar menu once a day, doubled on Mondays, with missed days not made up; gift credits expire in 30 days; unpaid accounts cannot use them on Pro models or video; the 0.01 multiplier is temporary with no end published.
steps: Download Doubao Work for Windows or macOS and sign in with a phone number
Confirm the 30-day free subscription shows as active on the subscription page
Check in daily from the bottom-left pop-up, remembering Monday doubles
Run everyday tasks on the 0.01x models and use the gift credits within 30 days
doubao-work-30day-sub.risk: The promotion can change or end early, so the client's own display is the source of truth. Gift credits expire in 30 days and skip Pro models and video generation. A missed day delays milestone progress. The desktop entry point is China-only, so accounts elsewhere may not see it.
doubao-work-30day-sub.source: Tencent News and The Beijing News report on 2026-10-30 (official Doubao terms for the 30-day trial and the 8,800 check-in credits) plus National Business Daily on the 2026-11-12 update and an mmmy.net hands-on post on 2026-11-13

quilter-invest-isa-100.title: [UK] Quilter Invest: open an ISA with £1,000, hold it 4 months, get £100 cashback via TopCashback (≈$130)
quilter-invest-isa-100.highlight: Go through TopCashback, open a stocks and shares ISA, fund it with £1,000 and hold that balance for the four-month validation period to collect £100, a 10% cash bonus on the deposit, with market risk attached.
quilter-invest-isa-100.regions: [UK] UK residents 18+ with unused ISA allowance who are new to Quilter Invest
quilter-invest-isa-100.content: Click through from the cashback portal (TopCashback), open a stocks and shares ISA in the app, deposit £1,000+ within 30 days and keep a £1,000+ balance through the four-month validation period for £100 cashback paid by TopCashback, up to a month after validation. Opening a new TopCashback account first adds its own sign-up reward.
quilter-invest-isa-100.conditions: New Quilter Invest customers only; UK residents 18+ with unused ISA allowance; deposit £1,000+ in one go within 30 days of opening; keep the account open with a £1,000+ balance for four months; start from the cashback portal in the same browser session with ad blockers off; once per person; no coupons the portal does not list.
steps: Join TopCashback UK first to stack its new-member bonus
Click Get This Offer on the activity page to reach Quilter through the portal
Open the stocks and shares ISA in the Quilter Invest app and check the cashback tracks
Fund £1,000 within 30 days, hold it four months, and pick a lower-risk portfolio if the £100 is the point
quilter-invest-isa-100.risk: The £1,000 is invested and four months of market movement can wipe out £100, with platform and fund fees on top. It uses £1,000 of this year's ISA allowance, which only resets on 6 April. Cashback frequently fails to track, so check the tracked status before funding. UK residents only.
quilter-invest-isa-100.source: BeerMoneyUK listing (read 2026-11-20, with the funding and four-month validation terms) plus Quilter Invest's own in-app ISA process

webull-uk-5-free-shares.regions: [UK] New Webull UK customers with UK ID verification and funding from a local bank
webull-uk-5-free-shares.value: 5 fractional shares (about $15 in practice; $3-$300 each, mostly the low end)
webull-uk-5-free-shares.content: After registering and verifying your identity, opt in manually under Menu then Promotion Centre, deposit £500+ in one go (split deposits and transferred shares count), hold for 60 days and claim five US fractional shares in My Rewards within 30 days. Shares are worth $3 to $300 and most testers got an Apple share worth about $3, roughly £11. The offer adds 12 months of free Nasdaq TotalView Level 2 data, a 90-day commission-free card for UK shares and ETFs (GIA or ISA) and, on enabling options, 90 days of commission-free trades up to 100 contracts plus 30 days of OPRA real-time data; fund by 31 March 2027.
webull-uk-5-free-shares.conditions: New Webull UK customers only; opt in first; a single £500+ deposit (transferred shares count) held 60 consecutive days; withdrawals within 60 days cannot exceed what was deposited; claim within 30 days of the reward becoming available or lose it; each share is random from $3 to $300 and mostly the minimum.
steps: Sign up through the offer page and verify identity in the Webull app
Opt in under Menu → Promotion Centre before depositing, or there is no reward
Deposit at least £500 in one go and leave it for 60 consecutive days
Claim the five shares in My Rewards within 30 days of them appearing
webull-uk-5-free-shares.risk: The five shares are random and most people get about $3 each, so do not expect anything near the $1,500 headline. Forgetting to opt in or to claim within 30 days wastes the 60-day hold. The £500 is locked for 60 days, investing carries risk, and a throwaway account brings idle-fee and tax-reporting chores.
webull-uk-5-free-shares.source: BeerMoneyUK listing (read 2026-11-20, covering the opt-in, the single £500 deposit, the 60-day hold and the $3-$300 range with most near $3) plus Webull's own new-customer terms

coop-bank-switch-200.title: [UK] Co-op Bank switch: £125 upfront plus 3×£25 (up to £200)

coop-bank-switch-200.regions: [UK] UK residents only; Standard Current Account or Everyday Extra

steps: Apply for the Standard Current Account or Everyday Extra on Co-op Bank's site
Move your main external account across with CASS
Within 30 days deposit £1,500, set 2 direct debits, make 5 card payments, register for online banking
After £125 lands, keep the activity for 3 more months to collect £25 each month
coop-bank-switch-200.risk: The £125 pays in one go but the three £25 payments depend on keeping up the activity, so stopping the card spend or direct debits loses them; CASS closes your old account, so check salary and subscriptions move cleanly; banks may refuse serial switchers.
coop-bank-switch-200.source: Moneyfactscompare (18 Nov 2026) + Be Clever With Your Cash November switching round-up (read 18 Nov 2026)

uq-mobile-sim-debut-20000.title: [Japan] UQ mobile SIM-only switch: ¥20,000 au PAY back (≈$130)
uq-mobile-sim-debut-20000.highlight: Port in from any carrier except au or povo and take a SIM or eSIM only (no handset), choosing Komikomi Plan Value or Tokutoku Plan 2 plus the Data Increase Option II, and ¥20,000 of au PAY balance arrives in one payment the month after activation; lifted from ¥15,000 on 17 Sep 2026 with the spend requirement removed

Order SIM-only or eSIM-only on UQ mobile's online store with Komikomi Plan Value or Tokutoku Plan 2
Tick the Data Increase Option II during checkout
Activate by the end of the month after applying
Log in to the au PAY app with that line's au ID and collect the ¥20,000 from late next month

ahamo-mnp-20000-points.regions: [JP] Japanese residency, d account and ID verification; docomo plan changes do not count
ahamo-mnp-20000-points.content: Port in (MNP) to ahamo on a SIM-only or eSIM plan, register on the campaign page with the same d account you will apply with, and activate by the end of the following month for 20,000 d points (period- and use-restricted), paid 4,000 at a time over five months, the first around the end of the second month after activation, each tranche valid 94 days. ahamo-mnp-20000-points.conditions: Live in Japan with ID verification; port in from another carrier on SIM or eSIM only; register and apply with the same d account; register in the month before or of activation and activate by the end of the next month; docomo plan changes, new lines and adding JAL Mobile at the same time do not qualify; the points need d Point Club membership.

Get an MNP reservation number from your current carrier (one-stop carriers need none)
Apply on ahamo.com choosing SIM-only and porting in (MNP) with the same d account
Activate by the end of the month after entry
From late the second month after activation, check d POINT CLUB for 4,000 points a month
ahamo-mnp-20000-points.risk: Points arrive over five months and each expires in 94 days, so cancelling or deleting the d account forfeits the rest; entering the referral or welcome-back campaign instead drops you from 20,000 to 13,000; missing entry or activating late voids the whole offer.
ahamo-mnp-20000-points.source: ahamo official campaign terms + Naruhayanet (read 17 Nov 2026) + Mynavi SimSim World (14 Nov 2026) + DX Magazine (19 Nov 2026)

ymobile-parent-child-discount.title: [Japan] Y!mobile parent-child discount: ¥1,100 off per month for 12 months (≈¥13,200)

A PayPay Card boost from the same date raises the PayPay Card discount from ¥300 to ¥500 a month (¥550 with tax) for 5-18s and their families, and the two combine: Simple 3 M with the Ouchi Wari Hikari Set (A) comes to ¥780 a month (¥858 with tax), returning to ¥1,958 from month 14. JAPAN ID; ports from SoftBank, LINEMO and LINE Mobile fall outside the SIM cashback.

Order Simple 3 M/L as a new line or MNP on Y!mobile's official online store or Yahoo! store
Link the PayPay Card and Yahoo! JAPAN ID as prompted
After activation confirm the bill drops by ¥1,100 with tax from the next month
Apply separately for the Hikari set discount or SIM cashback if you want them stacked
ymobile-parent-child-discount.risk: The discount lasts only 12 months and the price returns to normal from month 14, so it is poor value long term; the SIM cashback conflicts with some older campaigns and excludes past Y!mobile online-store PayPay recipients; a PayPay Card is a credit card, so decide whether it is worth opening one for this.
ymobile-parent-child-discount.source: SoftBank official press release (16 Nov 2026) + Mynavi SimSim World November round-up (read 19 Nov 2026)

US or Canadian degree-granting university students only, present in the country when claiming; French students claim EUR 50 (about 1,250 credits) through UNiDAYS. steps: Sign in to your own ChatGPT account (the free plan works)
Open the Codex for University Students page and press Claim now
Complete SheerID verification with your school email
The credits are added to your personal workspace automatically
Check the Codex usage page for 2,500 credits
codex-students-100.risk: Usable only inside Codex, not the API; unused credits expire after 12 months; a VPN will not pass student verification, so ignore agents offering to claim it for you; one shot per student with no fallback if verification fails.

Claim the €50 OpenAI offer on UNiDAYS

Check the usage page to confirm the credits arrived

google-ai-studio-monthly-credits.regions: [Global] A Google AI Pro/Ultra plan is required (availability per the subscription page); no family sharing

Link a Cloud billing account and claim the current month's credits
Prepay at least $5 before calling the Gemini API
Return each month to claim the new grant and watch the 12-month expiry order

google-ai-studio-monthly-credits.source: Google official blog (13 Nov 2026) + Google Developer Program benefits and FAQ (checked via duckssi, 18 Nov 2026)

telnyx-pretrial-25-ai.regions: [Global] Sign up with an email; the credit covers AI products only

Click the magic login link in the email (no password needed)
Confirm $25 of AI credits and one US number in the console
Create an API key and point the base URL at https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/openai
Pick a model and call it; do not upgrade before the credit runs down

Open the AI Services getting-started guide and the AI Services console
Confirm the 1 million credits have landed
Create an API token or try models in the web app

Get your invite link under Settings > Account > Invite friends
Have a friend sign up through it and use Foxl credits on two days
Check the referral credits, which may arrive over several days

airtel-jio-bogo-recharge.highlight: Airtel and Jio are rolling out a buy-one-get-one to selected prepaid users: recharge the 28-day ₹349 or ₹399 plan in the Airtel Thanks or MyJio app and qualifying accounts get a second recharge of the same plan, doubling validity to 56 days and cutting the effective monthly cost to ₹175 or ₹200
airtel-jio-bogo-recharge.regions: [IN] Indian prepaid numbers only, rolled out by account rather than to everyone
airtel-jio-bogo-recharge.content: Airtel and Jio are testing buy-one-get-one for some prepaid users: recharge the ₹349 or ₹399 28-day plan in the Airtel Thanks or MyJio app and eligible accounts get a second helping of the same plan, doubling validity to 56 days and halving the effective monthly cost to ₹175 or ₹200. Airtel shows a 1+1 Recharge Free label, paying for ₹349 (2GB a day plus unlimited 5G) or ₹399 (unlimited 4G and 5G) and receiving the same plan again; Jio's version appears as a Buy One Get One Free banner in MyJio or a gold badge on recommended plans, with support saying the bonus arrives as a voucher in MyJio's Vouchers within seven days. Eligibility is algorithmic, so no label means no offer.
airtel-jio-bogo-recharge.conditions: Indian prepaid customers; account-by-account rollout visible only in Airtel Thanks or MyJio; only the ₹349 and ₹399 28-day plans; Jio pays the bonus as a voucher to redeem manually in Vouchers after seven days; some other offers cannot stack.
steps: Open the Airtel Thanks or MyJio app and sign in with the prepaid number
Check whether the ₹349 or ₹399 plan carries the 1+1 tag
Complete the recharge as prompted
On Jio, collect the bonus voucher under Menu > Vouchers after seven days
Activate the bonus once the first plan expires so nothing is wasted
airtel-jio-bogo-recharge.risk: A trial rollout, so most accounts will not see the tag; the carriers have not detailed how the bonus activates and Jio needs a manual voucher redemption; you are locking in 56 days of prepaid service rather than getting cash.

spellar-chrome-300-minutes.highlight: Spellar's Chrome edition, launched on Product Hunt on 19 Nov 2026, records Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and Webex in your own browser tab without a bot joining or appearing on the participant list; it comes with 300 free minutes, no card, a choice of Claude, GPT or Gemini, and notes that push to Slack, Notion or the whole invite list
spellar-chrome-300-minutes.regions: [Global] Chrome on desktop, able to install the extension and sign in to the meeting web apps
spellar-chrome-300-minutes.content: Spellar for Chrome, launched on Product Hunt on 19 November 2026, records Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and Webex straight from your own browser tab without sending a bot or appearing on the participant list; it captures the tab's audio, shows speaker names on Meet and shares one memory with the Mac and iPhone versions so a single question covers meetings from either. Choose Claude, GPT or Gemini and send notes to Slack, Notion or every invitee. New users get 300 minutes free without a card.
spellar-chrome-300-minutes.conditions: Chrome on desktop with the extension; it records only meetings in a browser tab (web Meet, Zoom, Teams or Webex); 300 free minutes with no card; beyond that, subscribe at official pricing.
steps: Install the Chrome extension from the Product Hunt launch page or spellar.ai
Sign up with an email and confirm the 300 free minutes
Pick Claude, GPT or Gemini and a notes destination in settings
Open the meeting in Chrome and start recording
Review notes afterwards or push them to Slack or Notion
spellar-chrome-300-minutes.risk: 300 minutes is roughly ten meetings, so heavy use runs out fast; recording meetings involves other people's consent, so tell them in formal settings; it only works in browser tabs, not desktop meeting apps.
spellar-chrome-300-minutes.source: Product Hunt official launch post (read 18 Nov 2026) + Spellar launch page (19 Nov 2026)

zcode-daily-build-cards.title: [Global/China] ZCode nightly card: 300M GLM-5.3-Flash tokens on weekdays, 500M at weekends (no card)
zcode-daily-build-cards.highlight: The Zhipu ZCode client issues a GLOBAL BUILD card every night at 19:00: 300M GLM-5.3-Flash tokens on weekdays and 500M at weekends, active from 23:00 and zeroed at 09:00 next day (Monday 09:00 for weekend cards); free accounts qualify, no card needed, and new users also get a five-day trial of 8M tokens a day
zcode-daily-build-cards.regions: [Global/China] BigModel sign-in in China, Z.ai abroad; credit works only inside the ZCode client
zcode-daily-build-cards.value: 300M tokens a night (500M at weekends), roughly $10 of compute
zcode-daily-build-cards.content: Since 27 October ZCode hands out a GLOBAL BUILD card every night: claim it in the client's bottom-left from 19:00, it takes effect at 23:00 and clears at 09:00 next day (weekend cards carry 500M and last until Monday 09:00), and unclaimed, unused or stacked cards are void. After claiming, switch the channel to Global Building (the Start Plan provider) and the model to GLM-5.3-Flash, or the paid plan's quota is charged instead. The documentation also gives new users five days of Free Trial Quota after connecting BigModel with 3M GLM-5.3 and 5M GLM-5.3-Flash tokens a day. All of it is in-product credit that cannot become an API key or plug into Cursor or Claude Code.
zcode-daily-build-cards.conditions: Install the ZCode client (no claim entry below 3.10); any signed-in user, free accounts included, with no card; cards issue at 19:00, apply at 23:00 and clear at 09:00; switch to Global Building and GLM-5.3-Flash after claiming; in-product credit only, not exportable as an API; three concurrent tasks.
steps: Download and update ZCode from zcode.z.ai
Sign in and claim the day's GLOBAL BUILD card in the lower-left corner
Wait for the tokens to land at 23:00
Switch the model channel to Global Building and pick GLM-5.3-Flash
Confirm in Settings > Usage stats that usage is not hitting the paid plan
zcode-daily-build-cards.risk: Only covers the ten hours overnight, so nothing in the daytime; the tokens cannot be exported as an API; the wrong channel charges your paid plan; Zhipu publishes no public campaign page, so the card in the client governs and can change at any time; peak hours bring queues and rate limits, so keep important changes on a Git branch.
zcode-daily-build-cards.source: ZCode client campaign card + official Free Trial Quota docs, cross-checked with iGetoken (standing page from 12 Nov 2026) and allagent.wiki (14 and 16 Nov 2026)

kiro-students-year-1000.content: Students at listed universities (133 as of 28 October 2026, across 16+ countries) verify with SheerID and get 1,000 credits a month for 12 months, the equivalent of the $20 Pro tier, with no card and no trial countdown; the IDE, CLI, Kiro Web and Crew all work, with premium models rather than only the free plan's five open-weight ones. After a year the account drops to Kiro Free, with code and specs kept locally and in the repository.
kiro-students-year-1000.conditions: Enrolled at a university in the official dropdown and 18+; SheerID asks for name, birthday and school email and may request a student ID or enrolment proof; verification can be done only once in a lifetime; monthly credits do not roll over or top up; the plan downgrades to free after a year.
steps: Sign in at kiro.dev with Google, GitHub or AWS Builder ID (not the organization option)
Open Settings > Students, pick your university and press verify
Complete SheerID with your name, date of birth and university email, uploading a student ID if asked
Once the tier shows Kiro Students, this month's 1,000 credits are available
