google-flow-daily-50-credits.title: [Global] Google Flow gives 50 free credits a day: five 8-second Veo 3.1 Lite videos without a subscription
google-flow-daily-50-credits.highlight: Google's own help centre states every account gets 50 Flow credits a day with or without a subscription; Veo 3.1 Lite costs 10 credits for an 8-second 720p clip, so that is five clips and about 40 seconds of footage a day, plus Nano Banana storyboard images, with no card
google-flow-daily-50-credits.regions: [Global] 18+ in a supported country (Japan and the US are included; mainland China is not)
google-flow-daily-50-credits.content: Google's help centre (updated November 2026) says every account gets 50 Flow credits a day whether subscribed or not, triggered by the first generation and not carried over. The free tier can use Veo 3.1 Lite (4, 6 or 8 seconds at 720p, 10 credits each) and Omni Flash 1.2 (1 credit a second at 360p, 3 at 720p, up to 10 seconds), plus images and the Flow agent. Fifty credits buy five 8-second Lite videos, or one 720p 10-second Omni Flash 1.2 clip (30 credits) and more. Free users may queue behind paid ones for video between 14:00 and 17:00 UTC while images are unaffected. Workspace Business Starter, Standard and Plus and Education Standard and Plus also include 50 credits a day.
google-flow-daily-50-credits.conditions: Aged 18+ with age confirmation; a country on the Flow support list; 50 credits reset daily without carry-over; free users may be throttled at peak, though images still work; Japan and some regions cannot buy extra AI credits, so wait for the next day.
steps: Open Google Flow (labs.google/flow) with a Google account
In the prompt box settings confirm the model is Veo 3.1 Lite or Omni Flash 1.2 and check its credit cost
Generate storyboard images first and pick the good frames before spending credits on video
Spend the day's credits before midnight since they do not carry over
google-flow-daily-50-credits.risk: 50 credits a day go fast on serious work; Veo 3.1 Fast, Veo 3.1 Quality and Omni Flash 1.1 retire on 5 December 2026, so older tutorials pick models that will be gone; free users are throttled during the 22:00-01:00 Beijing peak.
google-flow-daily-50-credits.source: Google Flow official help pages on credits and availability (updated November 2026, read 2026-11-20) + MoviAI and Mi-Next write-ups (2026-11-05, 2026-11-19)

yepapi-5-free-credit.title: [Global] YepAPI: $5 of credit on sign-up with no card, one key for 190 data endpoints and 139 LLMs
yepapi-5-free-credit.highlight: Sign up with Google or GitHub and $5 lands immediately with no card; one API key reaches 184-190 endpoints across SERP, scraping, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit and X data from $0.01 a call, failed calls are free and the balance never expires
yepapi-5-free-credit.regions: [Global] The English site with Google or GitHub signup; AI model endpoints unlock after a first top-up
yepapi-5-free-credit.content: A pay-per-call unified API where one x-api-key covers 184-190 data endpoints (Google SERP, keywords, backlinks, scraping, Amazon, Walmart, Reddit, X, TikTok and YouTube data) plus 139 LLM chat models and 147 image, video and audio models. Pricing is per call: SERP at depth 10 costs $0.01, keyword research from $0.03, with no monthly fee, no minimum and failed requests free. Signup brings $5 of credit as the FAQ and docs state, with no card, though AI model endpoints need a first top-up, so the $5 mainly runs data endpoints. A @yepapi/mcp package and llms.txt plug into Claude Code or Cursor as MCP.
yepapi-5-free-credit.conditions: $5 once per account with no long-term free allowance, then pay per call; AI model endpoints need a top-up first; credit never expires but cannot be withdrawn; many signups on one card or batch may be judged abuse.
steps: Sign in at app.yepapi.com with Google or GitHub
Check the balance shows $5.00 and copy the key from Dashboard > API Keys
Call a /v1 endpoint with x-api-key or Bearer, starting with a $0.01 SERP or scrape call
Top up later if you want the LLM and media models
yepapi-5-free-credit.risk: The $5 is one-off and pay-per-call burns faster than a subscription; data endpoint quality and anti-bot stability vary by target; model endpoints need real money first, so $5 will not run a frontier LLM.
yepapi-5-free-credit.source: Visitor submission (Gmail 2026-11-20 09:01) + YepAPI official site and docs (Authentication, llms.txt) read 2026-11-20 + aifree.dev verification page (2026-11-15)

hellomobile-foreigner-180k-naverpay.regions: [KR] Foreigners in Korea: alien registration card (30+ days' stay) and a Korean card in their name
hellomobile-foreigner-180k-naverpay.value: 180,000 won Naver Pay (about $124) plus 15 GB a month
hellomobile-foreigner-180k-naverpay.content: The foreigner-only Data Speed USIM 7GB plan costs 22,900 won a month (7GB fast plus unlimited 3Mbps) and a store promotion adds 15GB a month (10GB for the launch plus 5GB from a friend referral). Self-activating any plan of 15,900 won or more with the promo code gives everyone 180,000 won of Naver Pay (30,000 a month for six months), and joining through a friend's referral link adds 90,000 won (15,000 a month for six months), up to 270,000 won. Go to direct.lghellovision.net, pick a plan of 15,900 won or more and enter the promo code
Pass simple authentication, the Alien Registration Card check and your own-name card check
Register for the payout after activation so Naver Pay arrives monthly
Join through a friend's referral link to add another 90,000 won

paypay-super-matsuri-scratch-2026.highlight: Live today: pay 200 yen or more in one go with PayPay and a scratch card appears — first prize refunds the whole amount, second 5%, third 0.5%; balance payments win one time in four, PayPay Credit or PayPay Card one in two, and PayPay Card through Apple Pay or Google Pay tap-to-pay always wins; referrals pay 500 points each
paypay-super-matsuri-scratch-2026.regions: [JP] Japanese stores and online merchants; PayPay eKYC identity verification required
paypay-super-matsuri-scratch-2026.value: Up to a 100% refund (capped at 100,000 points per payment and per period)
paypay-super-matsuri-scratch-2026.content: The Super PayPay Festival scratch cards run from 20 November to 23:59 on 27 December 2026: pay at least ¥200 including tax at a participating store with PayPay or PayPay Card and a scratch card appears, with first prize a full 100% refund, second 5% and third 0.5%, capped at 100,000 points per card and across the whole period. Odds depend on payment method: balance including balance cards wins one in four; PayPay Credit or PayPay Card one in two; balance payment with PayPay Bank balance linking also one in two; and PayPay Card tapped with Apple or Google Pay in store wins every time (a plastic card tap does not). Scratch cards last 30 days. Coupons run alongside, plus a referral paying 500 points each when a new cardholder sets up PayPay Credit and spends once, up to 10 referrals and 5,000 points.
paypay-super-matsuri-scratch-2026.conditions: Complete PayPay identity verification; set up PayPay Credit before paying with the card; one payment of ¥200+ including tax, with points-only, gift card, debit and third-party card vouchers excluded; winnings cap at 100,000 points per card and for the period; scratch cards expire after 30 days unused.
steps: Complete PayPay eKYC in the app (a My Number card is fastest, often same day)
Set up PayPay Credit, or add your PayPay Card to Apple Pay or Google Pay in the app
Pay 200 yen or more in one go at a store with the campaign poster and scratch the card on the spot
Use the points within 30 days before they expire
paypay-super-matsuri-scratch-2026.risk: The draw is not guaranteed and odds apply per scratch; raising your odds means opening a card and setting up credit, so do not spend more just to scratch; points cannot be withdrawn or transferred; overseas physical stores are excluded from this card.
paypay-super-matsuri-scratch-2026.source: PayPay official press release (2026-11-12) + PayPay Scratch Card campaign page (read 2026-11-20, campaign starts 20 Nov 00:00) + Kupomiru and nocash.news round-ups (2026-11-16)

racknerd-black-friday-2026.title: [Global] RackNerd Black Friday VPS: 1 GB / 20 GB SSD / 3 TB a month for $15.98 a year, same price on renewal
racknerd-black-friday-2026.highlight: 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 20 GB SSD and 3 TB of monthly transfer on a 1 Gbps port for $15.98 a year with the same price on renewal (the FAQ calls these specials lifetime recurring), several data centres, a free Clientexec licence and one-click Ollama or LibreChat images
racknerd-black-friday-2026.regions: [Global] Several US datacentres (Los Angeles, San Jose and others, chosen at checkout); direct mainland connectivity uses ordinary international routes
racknerd-black-friday-2026.value: $15.98 a year (about $1.33 a month, renews at the same price)
racknerd-black-friday-2026.content: The 2026 Black Friday page lists five KVM VPS tiers: 1GB/20GB SSD/3TB at $15.98 a year, 2.5GB/30GB/6TB at $27.98, 4GB/60GB/10TB at $47.98, 6GB/85GB/15TB at $74.98 and 8GB/140GB/20TB at $94.98, all on 1Gbps with a dedicated IPv4, full root and custom ISOs. The FAQ calls these specials lifetime recurring at the same renewal price, adds a Clientexec licence (retail $16.95 a month) and notes the control panel's one-click AdminBolt, Ollama, AnythingLLM, LibreChat and n8n images. On 20 November RackNerd posted to NodeSeek that hardware shortages rule out any Black Friday flash sale this year, so these are the year's lowest prices with tight stock; replies complain that $15.98 is dearer than past years.
racknerd-black-friday-2026.conditions: Annual billing paid up front; stock and datacentres vary by batch and sell out; renewals keep the price but only on the same plan; suited to international routes with no filing requirement.
steps: Open racknerd.com/BlackFriday/ and pick the 1 GB or 2.5 GB tier
Choose a location at checkout (Los Angeles DC03, San Jose and others) and confirm $15.98 a year
Log in with the root password from the email and run a system update first
Open a ticket to ask for doubled bandwidth, as NodeSeek reports
racknerd-black-friday-2026.risk: Cheap annual boxes are oversold, so neighbours can slow heavy workloads; international routing is unstable at peak, so anyone needing CN2 should look elsewhere; stock sells out between batches, so confirm the location and spec before paying.

altare-always-free-container.title: [Global] Altare Always Free: 6 GB RAM, 1.5 cores and 10 GB disk per team forever, up to 4 containers
altare-always-free-container.highlight: The help centre states the Always Free plan has no trial, no expiry and no card: 6 GB RAM, 1.5 cores, 10 GB disk and up to 4 servers, plus 10 GB of U3 object storage and 1 GB of KV; servers do not sleep when idle and can run Node, Bun, Python or Docker images
altare-always-free-container.regions: [Global] Sign up on the English site with an email; mainland China occasionally sees 522 or signup errors
altare-always-free-container.value: 6 GB RAM / 150% CPU / 10 GB disk ($0, no expiry)
altare-always-free-container.content: A host for game servers, bots and small apps whose help centre says every team gets Always Free: 6GB (6,144 MiB) of RAM, 150% CPU (1.5 cores), 10GB of disk and four server slots shared as one pool you divide yourself, plus 10GB of U3 object storage (five buckets, ten keys) and 1GB of KV (3M reads and 300k writes a month). There is no trial, no expiry and no payment method, and idle servers do not sleep; templates cover Minecraft, Rust, CS:GO, TF2 and ARK, and Node.js, Bun and Python runtimes work. Bolts earned from daily rewards, AFK and invites buy more RAM and disk. The free tier also uses Edge Functions (ten functions, 3M requests a month), managed Postgres 17, MySQL 8.4 and Valkey, Docker apps, free game servers and voice servers (TeamSpeak, Mumble), and there is a temporary Altare Go machine (8GB, 4 CPUs, 40GB, up to 12 hours each, three at once or 15 on Plus). Eleven regions include Ashburn, Los Angeles, Frankfurt, London, Helsinki and Karlskrona.
altare-always-free-container.conditions: Each team gets one 6GB/10GB pool, and extra accounts break the rules (two teams per person at most); long-running probes or mining have drawn bans; containers only, with no host directories, privileged images and some port mappings restricted.
steps: Sign up at console.altare.gg with an email (no card needed)
Link Discord to collect bolts and daily rewards
Create one server and give it the full 6 GB and 10 GB, which is steadier than splitting
Pick a Node, Python or Minecraft template and avoid privileged containers
altare-always-free-container.risk: The host's disk is tight and free containers can be reclaimed; running probes or staying at full load has led to bans; it is not a full VPS, so privileged images and host mounts fail; registration sometimes returns 522 and needs retrying later.
altare-always-free-container.source: NodeSeek thread (2026-11-19, including "cannot register / 522" and probe-ban reports) + Altare official help on the Always Free plan and account creation (updated 2026-11-10, read 2026-11-20) + aijp/jizhiku hands-on test

uupay-new-user-1usdt-card.content: A Hong Kong-registered crypto payment platform (Enterprise Square Three, Kowloon Bay) issuing USDT-funded Visa and Mastercard virtual and physical cards. The current offer opens a virtual card for 1 USDT and returns the 1 USDT, making it free, waives top-up fees (TRC-20 about a minute, BEP-20 about 30 seconds, ERC-20 3-5 minutes) and during the promotion waives FX conversion, with up to 50% commission for inviting friends. U Card Radar rated it D on 20 September 2026 with a risk score of 40-49: virtual card 1 USDT with 1 USDT back and no monthly fee, physical card a 100 USDT issuance fee, transaction fees of 0.9%-3% and cash withdrawal at €2.5 in pounds or €3 plus 1.5% in foreign currency.
uupay-new-user-1usdt-card.conditions: Tiered KYC with ID, passport or licence, and proof of address for some tiers; the 1 USDT back is once per new user; the 0% top-up is promotional with no end date published; wallet support and merchant acceptance vary by platform; the 100 USDT physical card is excluded from the rebate; a mainland ID passes KYC but merchant compatibility is patchy.
steps: Register with an email or phone number and complete KYC
Apply for the virtual card on the card page and pay the 1 USDT opening fee
Confirm the 1 USDT came back, then make a small USDT top-up to test
Bind a subscription you know is accepted, confirm it charges, and only then keep a balance
uupay-new-user-1usdt-card.risk: Crypto card platforms carry high risk (tier D on U Card Radar), so do not park large balances; funding depends on exchanges and chain congestion; KYC and merchant risk checks can tighten at any time; the "Black Friday" framing comes from the submission while the official page only says limited time, so the end date is unverified.
uupay-new-user-1usdt-card.source: Visitor submission (Gmail 2026-11-20 09:00, described as a Black Friday offer) + UUPAY official Chinese blog and promotions page (read 2026-11-20) + U Card Radar card page (updated 2026-09-20)

capital-one-360-checking-400.title: [US] Capital One 360 Checking: $400 bonus for two $500 direct deposits in 75 days (code MAKE400, ends Dec 9)
capital-one-360-checking-400.highlight: $400 for a new 360 Checking with code MAKE400 plus two $500+ direct deposits in 75 days; no monthly fee or minimum balance
capital-one-360-checking-400.regions: [US] US citizens or green card holders with a 50-state/DC address, US phone and SSN/ITIN
capital-one-360-checking-400.content: Open 360 Checking with code MAKE400 through the offer page before 23:59 Eastern on 9 December 2026 and take two qualifying direct deposits of $500+ each within 75 days for $400; the account has no monthly fee, no minimum balance and no overdraft fee. The bonus is assessed after the 75-day window and the bank says it may take up to 60 more days (135 days from opening). CHECKING250 ($250, no stated deadline) has the same terms and the codes cannot combine; the GET400 landing page now shows expired.
capital-one-360-checking-400.conditions: New customers only: no 360, Simply or Total Control Checking (including Money Teen Checking) as owner or joint holder since 1 January 2024; open through the offer page or enter MAKE400 at signup, as codes added later fail; the two deposits must be recurring ACH or real-time payments such as salary, pension or government benefits, not internal transfers, wires or app-initiated transfers; the account must be open and in good standing; forwarded links do not guarantee the bonus.
steps: Apply online from the Capital One 360 Checking page with code MAKE400 before 23:59 ET on 2026-12-09 (US address, US phone number and SSN/ITIN required)
Link a US-licensed bank account and agree to paperless statements
Route payroll or government-benefit direct deposits there and collect two deposits of $500+ within 75 days
Watch for the bonus after the deposit window (up to 60 more days) and keep the account open until it posts
capital-one-360-checking-400.risk: Capital One is strict about payroll descriptors and third-party transfers may not qualify; two $500 deposits must land within 75 days and the bonus can take up to 135 days; any checking account with Capital One since 2024-01-01 disqualifies you; the terms limit the offer to the original recipient, so forwarded links may be rejected; bonuses are reported as interest.
capital-one-360-checking-400.source: Capital One official 360 Checking terms (MAKE400 ends 2026-12-09 23:59 ET; two $500 direct deposits within 75 days) plus US Card Forum data points from 2026-10-29 onward, where members opened accounts through the public link in incognito mode

onepay-50-signup-bonus.title: [US] OnePay: $50 sign-up bonus and $100 for the referrer ($500 direct deposit or $5,000 month-end balance)
onepay-50-signup-bonus.highlight: $50 for opening OnePay through a referral and unlocking Cash+ in 45 days with $500 of direct deposits or a $5,000 balance; referrer gets $100
onepay-50-signup-bonus.regions: [US] Online nationwide (Coastal Community Bank and Lead Bank, FDIC); SSN or ITIN required
onepay-50-signup-bonus.content: Open a deposit account through an existing customer's link (or the in-app entry) and unlock Cash+ within 45 days for $50 cash, by either taking $500+ in qualifying direct deposits in a calendar month or ending a month with a $5,000+ total balance. The reward is 5,000 OnePay Points ($50), credited about five days after qualifying; the referrer gets $100 per successful referral (down from $200), up to 10. The account has no monthly fee, savings pays 3.35% APY and Walmart spending earns up to 3% once deposit conditions are met.
onepay-50-signup-bonus.conditions: New customers only; open through the referral link or in-app entry; referrals after 1 October 2026 count only the $500 monthly direct deposit route ($5,000 balances apply to earlier invites); deposits must be automatic salary, gig platform, pension or government payments, not P2P, cash, mobile cheque, wires, internal transfers or ACH and debit funding started in the app; rewards are Points, exchangeable for cash in the app.
steps: Get a referral link from an existing OnePay customer (or use Discover then Invite Friends in the app)
Open the OnePay deposit account and complete identity verification
Within 45 days, either take $500+ of direct deposits in one calendar month or close a month with a $5,000 balance
Check OnePay Points in the app within five days and redeem them for cash; the referrer gets $100 for the same referral
onepay-50-signup-bonus.risk: The direct deposit definition is strict and funding from the OnePay app or P2P transfers will not count, which is where most people fail; rewards are points rather than cash; the referrer amount moves with campaigns (it fell from $200 to $100), so check the app; OnePay skips ChexSystems, but unusual funding patterns can get a reward clawed back.
onepay-50-signup-bonus.source: OnePay official Refer-a-Friend help article (read in November 2026, including the 2026-10-01 threshold change) plus The Money Ninja (2026-08-23) and Miles to Memories (2026-09-10) term-by-term checks

xiaomi-mimo-tts-free-api.title: [Global/CN] Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5-TTS speech API is free for a limited time: three models, RPM 100, no plan credits consumed
xiaomi-mimo-tts-free-api.highlight: Three MiMo-V2.5-TTS speech models are free for a limited time and skip Token Plan credits, at RPM 100 and TPM 10M per model
xiaomi-mimo-tts-free-api.regions: [Global/CN] Xiaomi's MiMo platform (China and international sites bill and register separately)
xiaomi-mimo-tts-free-api.content: Xiaomi's MiMo platform lists three MiMo-V2.5-TTS models as free for a limited time: mimo-v2.5-tts synthesises preset premium voices including a singing mode, -voicedesign creates a new voice from a text description and -voiceclone reproduces a target voice from a few audio samples. The API pricing page, updated 18 November 2026, still says the TTS series is free for a limited time, and the usage FAQ of 19 November says the whole TTS line consumes no plan credits. Each model takes 8K tokens of context, outputs up to 8K, runs at 100 RPM and 10M TPM. The API is OpenAI-compatible at https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1, with text to speak in the assistant role and a user message for style such as speed, emotion or role-play.
xiaomi-mimo-tts-free-api.conditions: Register on Xiaomi's MiMo platform and create an API key (a mainland number for the China site); the limited free period is set and ended unilaterally with no date published; cloning and designing voices must not copy anyone without permission; commercial and compliance responsibility rests with the caller; streaming needs pcm16 for concatenation.
steps: Register on mimo.mi.com and create an API key
Point the OpenAI SDK at base_url https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1 with model mimo-v2.5-tts (or -voicedesign / -voiceclone)
Put the text in role=assistant and style instructions in role=user, and set format and voice under audio
Check the console billing detail to confirm usage still bills at zero, i.e. the promotion is still live
xiaomi-mimo-tts-free-api.risk: The free period can end or switch to per-use billing at any time with no committed end date, so check the pricing page before building on it; RPM 100 limits concurrency and long texts queue; voice cloning raises consent issues and may face extra review; the domestic site needs a mainland phone number and the overseas site bills in USD with separate quotas.
xiaomi-mimo-tts-free-api.source: Xiaomi MiMo official model page, API pricing page (updated 2026-11-18: TTS series free for a limited time, RPM 100 / TPM 10M) and the usage-and-quota FAQ (2026-11-19: TTS does not consume plan credits)

baidu-qianfan-1m-free-tokens.title: [CN] Baidu Qianfan new users: 1M tokens on each of 17 models (17M total, valid 90 days)
baidu-qianfan-1m-free-tokens.highlight: First-time Qianfan users get 1M tokens on each of 17 models, 17M in total and 90 days, including DeepSeek-V3.1 and Kimi-K2
baidu-qianfan-1m-free-tokens.regions: [CN] Baidu AI Cloud Qianfan (mainland number and real-name verification); base_url qianfan.baidubce.com/v2
baidu-qianfan-1m-free-tokens.content: Activating Qianfan for the first time and accepting the agreement automatically grants free tokens on listed models: the New User Free Quota document (updated 11 November 2026) lists 17 services, each with 1M tokens valid three months, 17M in total. The list covers ERNIE-4.5-Turbo-128K, 32K and VL, ERNIE-X1-Turbo-32K, DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-V3, V3.1 and V3.1-Think, Kimi-K2-Instruct, Qwen3-235B-A22B and 30B-A3B, Qwen3-Coder-30B and 480B, plus the non-chat models bge-large-en, bge-large-zh and qianfan-sug-8k. Each allowance is separate, and remaining quota shows under Model Square then the model version detail. The API is OpenAI-compatible at https://qianfan.baidubce.com/v2.
baidu-qianfan-1m-free-tokens.conditions: First activation only, with no retroactive grant; covers online inference on preset models but not batch inference; each model has 1M tokens for three months counted from activation, not first call; models off the list bill normally; quota is shared across sub-accounts of one primary account.
steps: Register on Baidu AI Cloud and complete real-name verification with a mainland phone number
Activate the Qianfan model and Agent platform for the first time; the quota posts automatically with no coupon to claim
Check each model page in Model Square for remaining free quota and time
Create an API key and call https://qianfan.baidubce.com/v2 through the OpenAI SDK, turning on the stop-at-zero option so overage does not bill automatically
baidu-qianfan-1m-free-tokens.risk: The official list still reflects the late-2025 model lineup, so what the console offers may have moved on; quota does not stack, does not cross models and is not reissued; a mainland phone number and real-name verification are required; overage bills automatically unless the stop-at-zero option is on; some listed models may be retired.
baidu-qianfan-1m-free-tokens.source: Baidu AI Cloud official New User Free Quota document (read directly 2026-11-20; page updated 2026-11-11, all 17 rows list 1M / 3 months) plus a term-by-term check published 2026-11-09

roamless-blackfriday50-5off.title: [Global] Roamless early Black Friday: 50% off all eSIM plans and FLEX top-ups, up to $25 off per order (code BLACKFRIDAY50)
roamless-blackfriday50-5off.highlight: BLACKFRIDAY50 takes 50% off every Roamless plan and FLEX top-up, capped at $25 per order, for new and existing users until 11/30
roamless-blackfriday50-5off.regions: [Global] The Roamless app and site across 200+ destinations; an unlocked eSIM device
roamless-blackfriday50-5off.content: Roamless's early Black Friday, from its own email: enter BLACKFRIDAY50 at checkout in the app or on the site for half off every country and regional data plan plus FLEX pay-as-you-go balances, capped at $25 off an order, so $50 maxes it out. It covers 200+ destinations for new and existing customers until Cyber Monday, 30 November 2026. FLEX balances are spent per megabyte at each country's rate and generally never expire, suiting stockpiling for the next trip, and it stacks with the separate free 500MB ($1.25) new-user credit.
roamless-blackfriday50-5off.conditions: The code works only at checkout and cannot be added later; $25 off per order, with split orders subject to fraud checks; new purchases only, not refunded and repurchased orders; no stacking with other codes; FLEX balances never expire but terms void them after 12 months of no use.
steps: Install the Roamless app or open roamless.com and sign in
Pick a country or regional plan, or top up FLEX pay-as-you-go credit
On the Review & Pay screen tap Apply Promo Code, enter BLACKFRIDAY50 and confirm the discount applied
Check the discounted total against the $25 cap and complete the order by 2026-11-30
roamless-blackfriday50-5off.risk: The code comes from an email and community posts rather than a line item on an official campaign page, so confirm in the app that the discount actually lands before paying; the cap is $25 per order and splitting orders may look like abuse to risk checks; FLEX credit is charged at each destination's rate, so expensive countries like China yield less data than the US; the eSIM needs an unlocked device and cannot be moved after installation.
roamless-blackfriday50-5off.source: OzBargain Roamless post dated 2026-11-20 quoting the company email (BLACKFRIDAY50, 50% off, $25 cap, ends 11/30), mirrored by WhatsCheap the same day; the Roamless promo-code page confirms codes are submitted at app checkout

netlify-server-free-early-access.title: [Global] Netlify Server is free during Early Access: long-lived Node servers, WebSockets, in-memory state and long-running AI agents
netlify-server-free-early-access.highlight: Free during Early Access: long-lived Node servers with WebSockets, in-memory state and long-running agent loops; one instance on the free plan
netlify-server-free-early-access.regions: [Global] Netlify's credit-based Free, Personal and Pro plans plus credit-enabled Enterprise; Netlify CLI 27.17.0+ locally, no card
netlify-server-free-early-access.content: Netlify launched Netlify Server in early access on 10 November 2026, running a backend as a long-lived Node.js process with native WebSockets and Server-Sent Events, in-memory pools and caches and one instance serving many requests concurrently, scaling to zero five minutes after going idle and waking on the next request. Netlify says it is free during early access: the credit-based Free and Personal plans get one instance and paid plans and credit-enabled Enterprise up to three. Existing Express, Hono, Fastify and Koa apps deploy unchanged, and an agent loop can run long in one process, keep state in memory and push progress to a page over WebSockets.
netlify-server-free-early-access.conditions: Free only during early access, with general availability billing reserved memory GB-hours plus active CPU vCPU-hours; Free and Personal get one instance, others three; idle scaling needs a cold start; bandwidth, function calls and requests still bill to the same project; APIs and behaviour may change; Netlify CLI 27.17.0+ or netlify init is needed.
steps: Create or open a project on Netlify and confirm it is on a credit-based plan
Upgrade to Netlify CLI 27.17.0 or later and run netlify init in the project to pull the latest agent skills
Write the server entry as a long-lived Node process (an existing Express, Hono, Fastify or Koa app works as-is) and deploy it with the project
Verify long connections and idle scale-down over WebSocket or SSE, and watch instance, memory and CPU usage on the project's Server page
netlify-server-free-early-access.risk: Free has a hard end: after GA you pay for resident memory and CPU, and an always-on backend can generate a bill quickly; the free plan has one instance and scales to zero after five idle minutes, so first requests wait on a cold start; state must live in Netlify Database or Blobs or it is lost when an instance is replaced; APIs and limits can change during Early Access.
netlify-server-free-early-access.source: Netlify's official Introducing Netlify Server post, the 2026-11-10 Early Access changelog and the docs.netlify.com/build/server pricing and limits sections (read 2026-11-20; all state it is free during Early Access)

upsolve-free-1000-credits.title: [Global] Upsolve free plan: 1,000 one-time credits (about 500 analytics questions, ≈$100), no card, with MCP and CLI
upsolve-free-1000-credits.highlight: Sign up for the $0 Free plan and get 1,000 one-time credits (worth about $100 at the $0.10 overage rate) with no credit card; its CLI and remote MCP server plug straight into Claude, Cursor or Codex
upsolve-free-1000-credits.regions: [Global] upsolve.ai in English, sign up with Google, GitHub or email; connect your own database
upsolve-free-1000-credits.content: An analytics agent for data warehouses: ask in plain language and it writes the SQL, produces charts and a written conclusion, and can push results to Notion or Linear. The free plan costs $0 for 1,000 one-time credits (about 500 analytics questions) with no card, then bills $0.10 a credit or moves to Team ($160 a month billed annually, 5,000 credits a month). A simple exchange costs under one credit, a normal query 0.5-1, a full analysis 1-3 and dashboards or data apps 10-50. The free plan includes the AI analyst, agentic dashboards and demos, data models, skills and knowledge bases, Playground, the CLI and remote MCP server (https://mcp.upsolve.ai/mcp) and Upsolve Local with your own key; row-level permissions, embedding and team collaboration are Team features.
upsolve-free-1000-credits.conditions: Register an account (18+); the 1,000 free credits are one-time, not monthly; connect your own data source to get anything done; row-level permissions and RBAC, embedding and multi-tenancy need Team; data is processed in the US and UK, so do not upload regulated or confidential material; credits do not renew, so upgrade or pay $0.10 a credit.
steps: Open upsolve.ai/pricing and press Get started on the Free plan — no card needed
Connect a data source (Postgres, Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift), or try Upsolve Local with your own key first
Ask a real question such as which channel lost the most customers this month, and watch it write SQL, chart the answer and write it up
To use it inside Claude, Cursor or Codex, add the remote MCP server https://mcp.upsolve.ai/mcp under Settings → Connectors and sign in with the same account
upsolve-free-1000-credits.risk: The 1,000 credits are one-time, not a monthly gift, and chatting or experimenting burns them. Row-level security and embedding are not in the free tier. Analysis means connecting real company data, so check compliance. Dashboards are expensive in credits at 10–50 each.
upsolve-free-1000-credits.source: Upsolve official pricing page (Free $0, 1,000 one-time credits, no credit card) read 2026-11-20 + official MCP server docs + a verification thread on X by @okeyccronald (2026-11-20)

celesto-5-trial-credit.title: [Global] Celesto: $5 cloud-computer credit without a card (AI agent sandboxes, ≈333 Micro hours; CI runners nearly 90% cheaper than GitHub's)
celesto-5-trial-credit.highlight: Sign up for $5 of Micro runtime with no credit card, valid 30 days: Micro is 1 vCPU / 2 GB / 20 GB at $0.015 an hour, so about 333 hours, with up to two retained sandboxes
celesto-5-trial-credit.regions: [Global] celesto.ai with email signup and no card; sandbox availability depends on host capacity
celesto-5-trial-credit.content: Cloud computers and CI runners for AI agents: each sandbox runs in its own microVM and can be created, entered over SSH, run commands, keep files and browser sessions for next time, and GitHub Actions only needs its runner label in runs-on, which Celesto says costs nearly 90% less per minute than GitHub's standard runner on the same hardware. Billing is pure runtime with no monthly fee: Micro at 1 vCPU, 2GB and 20GB costs $0.015 an hour, Small $0.020, Standard $0.030, Memory $0.040, Large $0.080 and XL $0.160, with the root disk kept free for 30 days after stopping. New accounts get a one-time $5 Micro credit without a card, expiring 30 days after activation, with up to two retained Micro sandboxes during the trial (stopped ones still count) and larger sizes needing a top-up from $2.01.
celesto-5-trial-credit.conditions: The one-time $5 covers Micro only and lasts 30 days; at most two retained sandboxes in the trial; larger sizes need a top-up; sandbox creation depends on host capacity; credit cannot be withdrawn or transferred.
steps: Sign up at celesto.ai and claim the $5 Micro trial credit (no card) under Settings → Billing
Install the CLI and run celesto computer create --cloud --size micro
Run celesto computer exec <ID> --cloud -- uname -a to test it, or use the coding-agent template when you need common coding tools
Stop rather than delete a computer to keep its files; stopped root disks are free for 30 days
celesto-5-trial-credit.risk: $5 covers only 333 Micro hours and expires after 30 days. Stopped sandboxes still use the two-slot trial limit, so repeatedly creating and deleting can get you throttled. Runtime billing means a forgotten machine keeps spending. It is a young service, so check its stability and data-retention terms yourself.
celesto-5-trial-credit.source: Celesto official pricing page and docs ($5 card-free Micro trial, 30 days, two retained sandboxes) read 2026-11-20 + Toolify 'Just launched' listing (2026-11-20)

apple-card-double-daily-cash.title: [US] Apple Card double Daily Cash: up to 6% back in year one, up to $1,000 in bonus cash (apply through the promo link by 12/10)
apple-card-double-daily-cash.highlight: Open a new Apple Card through the promo link by 12/10 and your first 12 months earn double: 6% at Apple and select merchants, 4% with Apple Pay, 2% on the physical card, for up to $1,000 in extra Daily Cash in total
apple-card-double-daily-cash.regions: [US] Eligible US applicants only (US credit history plus SSN/ITIN)
apple-card-double-daily-cash.value: Up to $1,000 in bonus cash back
apple-card-double-daily-cash.content: For 365 days after approval through the promo link (apple.co/cardoffer110326a), eligible purchases earn double: 6% at Apple and select merchants with Apple Pay (from 3%), 4% on other Apple Pay spending (from 2%), and 2% on the titanium card or virtual number (from 1%). The extra is Bonus Daily Cash, capped at $1,000 in total before rates return to 1%/2%/3%. MacRumors reckons maxing it out takes about $33,333 at 6%, $50,000 at 4% or $100,000 at 2%. The card has no annual fee, no foreign transaction fee and no late fee, and Daily Cash can go to interest-bearing Savings or Apple Cash.
apple-card-double-daily-cash.conditions: New cardholders only — a previous Apple Card or a pending or approved application disqualifies you; apply and open the card through the promo link's Apply now during the offer window, as other channels pay no double cash; credit approval required; Co-Owner and Participant spending on Apple Card Family does not earn double; returns reduce cash already paid; abuse forfeits eligibility.
steps: On your iPhone open learn.applecard.apple/double-your-daily-cash-promo and confirm the page shows the 2X / 6% offer
Apply from the Apply now button on that page — not the usual Wallet entry point, which does not qualify
Once approved, add the card to Apple Pay and choose whether Daily Cash goes to Savings or Apple Cash
Put everyday spending on Apple Pay during the first year, use Apple and bonus merchants such as Nike or Walgreens for the 6% tier, and watch the $1,000 cap
apple-card-double-daily-cash.risk: This is spend-more-to-earn-more, not free money: the full $1,000 needs over $33,000 of spending, and a normal spender may see only tens or a hundred-odd dollars. Applying is a hard credit pull. Spending extra just to earn the cash back is a net loss. It is effectively unavailable outside the US. Applying outside the promo link earns nothing, and Slickdeals reports several YMMV cases.
apple-card-double-daily-cash.source: Apple's official Double Your Daily Cash terms page (11/03–12/10, $1,000 bonus cap) read 2026-11-20 + MacRumors (2026-11-18) + 9to5Mac and Slickdeals discussion (2026-11-19, data points that the double rate requires the promo link)

dedirock-black-friday-2026.title: [Global] DediRock Black Friday VPS: from $9.88 a year (1C1G/10G/1TB), 2TB storage box at $27.68
dedirock-black-friday-2026.highlight: Nine US KVM annual plans on the Black Friday page: in both Los Angeles and New York, $9.88 (1 core, 1GB, 10GB SSD, 1TB), $17.68 (1 core, 2GB, 20GB, 2TB) and $27.68 (2 cores, 3GB, 40GB, 3TB), plus storage boxes from $11.88 with a 256GB disk; all on 1Gbps with a dedicated IPv4 and the Virtualizor panel
dedirock-black-friday-2026.regions: [Global] Los Angeles and New York datacentres, chosen at checkout; cards and PayPal, with Alipay reported by the community
dedirock-black-friday-2026.content: The Black Friday page lists nine annual plans at the same price in LA and NY: Promo VPS Saver at $9.88 a year (1 vCore, 1GB, 10GB SSD, 1TB, 1Gbps), Economy at $17.68 (1/2GB/20GB/2TB) and Value at $27.68 (2/3GB/40GB/3TB), plus storage boxes: Storage Promo Starter at $11.88 (256GB disk, 512MB, 1TB), Essentials at $17.68 (1TB disk, 1GB, 2TB) and Plus at $27.68 (2TB disk, 2GB, 4TB). All have one dedicated IPv4, a 1Gbps port and the Virtualizor panel, and the page states all prices are yearly plans. Hosted at ColoCrossing rather than on China-optimised routes. Last year's $6.45-6.50 2GB box is gone, making $9.88 this year's floor, and one thread reports every box being rebooted at some point.
dedirock-black-friday-2026.conditions: Annual billing paid up front, not monthly; limited stock restocked in batches; LA and NY share a price but not stock; the $9.88 tier is 1 core and 1GB, only for light hosting, probes and backups; no snapshots or backups included; check the refund policy before ordering.
steps: Open dedirock.com/black-friday/ and pick a tier under the Los Angeles, New York or Storage tab
Confirm the annual price and the specs (1GB at $9.88, 2GB at $17.68, 3GB at $27.68)
Order and pay, Alipay included, then ping the IP from your own network
For China traffic, build your own relay rather than expecting direct optimised routing
dedirock-black-friday-2026.risk: Very cheap annual boxes are oversold, so performance swings when neighbours compete and NodeSeek has reported whole batches being rebooted; the servers are in the US on ordinary international routing, so evening latency from Asia varies; reselling costs a $5 push fee, so second-hand liquidity is poor; a small host carries long-term business risk, so keep production elsewhere; stock can sell out or the price can rise.
dedirock-black-friday-2026.source: DediRock official Black Friday page (read live 2026-11-20 23:02, nine plans and prices) + NodeSeek trade thread reports (2026-11-13: 5 USD push fee, no $6.5 plan this year, batch reboots)

raksmart-black-friday-2026-vps.title: [Global] RakSmart Black Friday VPS: flash sale from $2.99/mo (2C2G), annual 2C4G NVMe at $49.90, CN2 from 35% off
raksmart-black-friday-2026-vps.highlight: Flash sale: a Taiwan 2C2G box with 50G and 3TB on BGP for $2.99/mo (was $8.81), and San Jose 2C4G with 50G on China Optimized VIP 5G 5TB or Enterprise CN2 1TB both at $4.99/mo (was $15.25 and $14.99); annual San Jose 2C4G with 50G NVMe on China VIP 3TB at $49.90 a year (was $129.10); plus $3, $30 and $60 spend-and-save coupons and a 30% off VPS coupon
raksmart-black-friday-2026-vps.regions: [Global] San Jose, Los Angeles, Hong Kong and Taiwan datacentres; CN2 and China VIP are optimised back to China

raksmart-black-friday-2026-vps.content: Black Friday 2026 comes in four parts. moomoo-us-black-friday-2026.content: Moomoo, Futu's US broker, stacks a Black Friday boost on top of its regular account bonus in November. The official campaign page pays Anthropic stock by first cumulative net deposit — $30 for $500, $100 for $2,000, $200 for $10,000, $400 for $50,000 and $1,000 for $100,000 — with 8.1% APY made of a 3.6% base plus a temporary 4.5% for the first two months on up to $20,000, and ten $10 trading coupons for deposits of $100 or more. Terms limit it to customers who have never deposited or transferred in since 1 January 2026, US residents 18+ with a valid SSN, and require holding assets 60 to 180 days by tier. The Black Friday extras of a $50 Amazon gift card and up to $300 in cash coupons come from two independent roundups that all say first deposit by 30 November and a campaign link, and do not appear on the official page. The shares are not IPO shares: Moomoo buys Anthropic stock on the open market after it lists, switching to equivalent NVDA if it has not listed by 31 December; ACATS transfers do not count as deposits and earn a separate 3% match up to $600.
moomoo-us-black-friday-2026.conditions: Register through the campaign link before opening, as a self-downloaded signup earns nothing; an SSN in the US; only first net deposits count (deposits minus withdrawals), not ACATS or FOP transfers in; rewards follow cumulative deposit tiers and require holding assets 60, 120 or 180 days, with early withdrawal forfeiting; the stock is shares rather than cash; 8.1% covers only the first two months on $20,000; mainland China residents cannot open; the gift card and coupons are partner-link only and missing from the official page (unverified).
steps: Enter through the activity link and follow the US or global application for your region
Open the account, cash and margin both if you want, and pass identity checks
Make the first deposit before 30 November, choosing $2,000 or $10,000 cumulative for the higher stock tiers
Activate the gift card, trading coupons and booster in the app's coupon centre before they expire
Keep the assets at the tier level for at least 60 days before moving money
moomoo-us-black-friday-2026.risk: The $50 gift card and up to $300 in coupons only come through partner links and are not on the official page, so they can change or end early; the stock waits on an Anthropic listing and defaults to NVDA, so the headline value is not cash in hand; pulling money inside the 60-to-180-day hold forfeits the reward; brokerage accounts do not protect principal and 8.1% is a promotional rate; mainland China users cannot take part.

alibabacloud-intl-200-credit.content: New International-site users registered after 1 April 2025 with no paid orders can apply from the offer page before their first purchase (company or project name, business phone, website and a description under 100 characters); a human reviews within three business days and $200 arrives as a coupon with no minimum spend, valid 60 days, usable on both prepaid and pay-as-you-go. Accounts granted $200 during the campaign (issue dates 1 July to 31 December 2026) also earn monthly rebates for up to three months on eligible spend: 5% on $800–4,000 (capped at $200), 10% on $4,000–8,000 ($800), 15% on $8,000–80,000 ($12,000) and 20% above $80,000 ($50,000).
alibabacloud-intl-200-credit.conditions: Alibaba Cloud International accounts only: registered after 1 April 2025, zero paid orders, a verified phone number, and not a reseller, channel partner, KA or KP customer; apply before the first purchase, since spending first forfeits it; real company or project details are required and review takes about three business days; domains, cloud communication, CDN and Cloud Academy courses cannot be offset, and orders through third-party agents do not qualify; orders paid with the credit are non-refundable, and the credit cannot be transferred or cashed out.
steps: Open the Alibaba Cloud International $200 campaign page and sign in or register an account (phone verification)
Click Apply for $200 Credits and fill in the company/project name, business phone, website and a short business description
Wait for the manual review, about 3 business days, and watch the phone number and email you submitted
Confirm the $200 coupon in the console (valid 60 days)
Spend it within 60 days on Model Studio (Qwen/Wan), ECS or other eligible products
alibabacloud-intl-200-credit.risk: There is a manual review: purely personal applications, inaccurate details or no visible business need get rejected. The credit is only valid for 60 days, so unused value is lost. Orders paid with the credit are not refundable. Domains, CDN, cloud communication and some other categories are excluded. Alibaba Cloud can change the rules or end the campaign at any time, and issuance depends on human approval.
alibabacloud-intl-200-credit.source: Alibaba Cloud International $200 Instant Credit campaign page and FAQ (read 2026-11-21) + taskpanel / FreeAIHub cross-checks + X lead @Jack1472004 (2026-11-19)

ovhcloud-black-friday-2026.regions: [US] OVHcloud US (separate from the European site); sale prices only at Vint Hill, Virginia and Hillsboro, Oregon
ovhcloud-black-friday-2026.content: OVHcloud US Black Friday (11:00 ET on 17 November to 15:00 ET on 1 December 2026) takes up to 20% off selected dedicated servers and waives setup fees on some models. The Eco KS-1-B at Vint Hill and Hillsboro costs $20.40 a month for the first year (15% off the $24 list, for up to 12 months) with the $24 setup fee waived: Xeon D-2123IT with 4 cores and 8 threads, 32-64GB DDR4 ECC, 2×500GB to 2×960GB SSD NVMe in software RAID, 500Mbps public bandwidth, one IPv4 and full root. ovhcloud-black-friday-2026.conditions: An OVHcloud US account (us.ovhcloud.com; European accounts do not carry over); sale prices such as KS-1-B, RISE-GAME-2 and SYS-GAME-2 only at Vint Hill and Hillsboro; new orders only, renewals excluded; base configurations only, with add-ons undiscounted; standard pricing after 12 months; limited stock.
steps: Register or sign in to an OVHcloud US account (us.ovhcloud.com)
Open the Deals page, or go straight to the Eco Kimsufi KS-1-B configuration page
Pick Vint Hill or Hillsboro and keep the base configuration (add-ons are excluded from the discount)
At checkout confirm the setup fee is waived and the first-year price shows $20.40/mo
From month 12 the price returns to $24/mo, so cancel in the console if you no longer need it

US data centers have high latency from mainland China and are a poor fit for sites aimed at Chinese visitors. The price rises 15% after 12 months and renews automatically unless cancelled. Dedicated servers usually deploy instantly, but limited stock can cause delays.
ovhcloud-black-friday-2026.source: OVHcloud US Deals page and Eco KS-1-B configuration page (prices, specs and promotional terms read 2026-11-21) + LowEndTalk order thread 2026-11-20

l53-ggff-free-domain-2y-2026.highlight: L53 Black Friday: order a .ggff.net subdomain for 2 years in the client area and enter code kxu26bf8k2y at checkout to pay $0; one per user for new and existing customers, with NS changes so it can be hosted on Cloudflare Free
l53-ggff-free-domain-2y-2026.regions: [Global] L53 (run by UK-based 1024 Ltd) at customer.l53.net; the .ggff.net suffix
l53-ggff-free-domain-2y-2026.content: L53's Black Friday (20 November to 3 December 2026): register at customer.l53.net, buy a .ggff.net subdomain for a two-year term and enter code kxu26bf8k2y at checkout for ¥0. New and existing users can take part, one domain each while stock lasts. .ggff.net is on the Public Suffix List, so nameservers can point at Cloudflare's free plan with its CDN and WAF, and the seller also has suffixes such as .filegear-sg.me. Use an overseas IP, a US address and a Gmail or Outlook mailbox to pass risk checks.
l53-ggff-free-domain-2y-2026.conditions: An L53 account first; the code works once per person for one domain; choose the two-year term before entering it or it fails; registering with a US address and overseas IP helps; the free service has no SLA, L53 can refuse or end a registration within 30 days, the upstream can reclaim subdomains and free renewal is not supported, with paid renewal costing more.
steps: Open customer.l53.net and register an account (overseas IP and US address recommended)
Go to Order, then Domain Registration, and search for the .ggff.net prefix you want
Set the registration term to 2 Years
Enter kxu26bf8k2y in the Apply Promo Code field at checkout and confirm the total becomes $0.00
Place the order, then add the domain in Cloudflare and switch the NS records as instructed
l53-ggff-free-domain-2y-2026.risk: The subdomain is still owned by L53 and can be reclaimed or suspended at any time, so it is unsuitable for a main or brand site. Renewals are not free. The free-service terms let L53 show ads on or redirect promotional domains. The code is single-use and stock is limited, so it can expire early. Inaccurate details or a flagged IP can get the account removed.
l53-ggff-free-domain-2y-2026.source: L53 official client area and registration terms (checked 2026-11-21) + Lengxi blog post 2026-11-20 with the tested code and 11/20–12/3 dates + NodeLoc Black Friday thread

rbs-select-reward-switch-200.highlight: Switch a current account to RBS Select or Reward with the Current Account Switch Service, pay in £1,250 and keep it there 24 hours, log in to the app once within 60 days, and £200 lands within 30 days
rbs-select-reward-switch-200.regions: [UK] UK residents 18+ without an RBS current account on 6 May 2026
rbs-select-reward-switch-200.content: Apply for a Select or Reward current account and switch in fully from another bank with CASS to enter the £200 offer; within 60 days of switching deposit £1,250 (in one or more payments, held on the account for 24 hours) and log into the Royal Bank app once, and £200 arrives within 30 days. The same page advertises a £500 Premier offer that needs Premier income or assets.
rbs-select-reward-switch-200.conditions: UK resident, 18+; open Select or Reward with a full CASS switch (partial switches or manually moved Direct Debits do not count); £1,250 deposited and held 24 hours plus an app login within 60 days; no NatWest group cash switch bonus before, for you or anyone on the account, and no switching from NatWest or Ulster Bank; Reward costs £2 a month.
steps: Apply for a Select or Reward current account on rbs.co.uk and ask for a full switch with the Current Account Switch Service
Within 60 days of switching, pay in £1,250 in total and leave it in the account for at least 24 hours
Log in to the Royal Bank mobile app once in the same 60-day window
Check your statements: £200 is paid within 30 days of meeting the conditions

rbs-select-reward-switch-200.source: RBS official current accounts page (switch offer £200, checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

jpm-personal-investing-invest-1000-100.title: [UK] J.P. Morgan Personal Investing: invest £1,000 in one payment by 30 Nov, hold 6 months, get £100 cash
jpm-personal-investing-invest-1000-100.highlight: Register first, open an account with the same email, put £1,000 in one payment into any managed product and hold it six months; £100 cash follows within 55 days
jpm-personal-investing-invest-1000-100.regions: [UK] UK residents only; new J.P. Morgan Personal Investing customers (or invited existing ones) passing identity and suitability checks
jpm-personal-investing-invest-1000-100.content: J.P. Morgan Personal Investing, the bank's UK platform of managed portfolios only, pays £100 cash: its page says invest at least £1,000 in one payment by 30 November 2026 and keep it invested for at least six months. Register an email on the campaign page, open the account with the same email and pick a managed product (managed GIA, Stocks and Shares ISA, Lifetime ISA, Junior ISA or Personal Pension), putting in £1,000 or more in a single payment of new money rather than split payments or a transfer in, then keep net investment at £1,000 for six months; market moves do not matter, but withdrawing does. Within 55 days of the six months the £100 arrives as unallocated cash you can withdraw. Rechecked on 21 November 2026, the deadline remains 23:59 GMT on 30 November.
jpm-personal-investing-invest-1000-100.conditions: UK residents who have not invested with JPM PI before (or invited existing customers); register first and open with the same email; £1,000 or more in one payment of new money into a managed product, with no split payments, transfers in or all-cash holdings; keep net investment six months; no stacking with other new-customer offers.
steps: Register your email on the £100 offer page
Open a JPM PI account with the same email and choose a managed product: Stocks and Shares ISA, Lifetime ISA, Junior ISA, Personal Pension or managed GIA
Pay in £1,000 or more in a single payment by 23:59 GMT on 30 November 2026 and set your investment style and risk level
Hold net contributions of £1,000 or more for six months; the £100 arrives as cash within 55 days of the period ending
jpm-personal-investing-invest-1000-100.risk: Investments can fall, so the £1,000 may be worth less after six months (that does not affect eligibility, but the loss is yours); managed products carry platform and fund charges; the deadline is 30 November, so allow time for the account and the payment to clear; only one new-client offer per customer.
jpm-personal-investing-invest-1000-100.source: J.P. Morgan Personal Investing official offer page and terms (closing 30 November 2026, 23:59 GMT; checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

chase-uk-referral-50.title: [UK] Chase UK referral: £50 each when you enter a code in the app and deposit £1,000 within 30 days
chase-uk-referral-50.highlight: Anyone who did not apply to Chase before 3 December 2025 can enter a referral code in the app's Rewards section and deposit a total of £1,000 within 30 days, and both sides get £50
chase-uk-referral-50.regions: [UK] UK residents 18+; new to Chase (no application before 3 December 2025)
chase-uk-referral-50.content: After opening a first Chase account in the app, enter the referrer's code on the Rewards page and deposit £1,000 in total within 30 days of opening, and both sides get £50 into their Rewards balance, transferable to a current or savings account for withdrawal. chase-uk-referral-50.conditions: UK resident, 18+, UK mobile number, UK tax resident and passing a soft check; no Chase application before 3 December 2025; use the code and deposit £1,000 within 30 days of opening; JPMorgan group staff and their customers cannot refer each other.
steps: Open your first Chase current account in the app using a friend's referral code
Within 30 days, open Rewards in the app, choose refer a friend and enter the code to link to the referrer
Deposit a total of £1,000 into the Chase account within 30 days, in one or several payments
Move the £50 from your rewards balance to a current or saver account and withdraw it before closing anything
chase-uk-referral-50.risk: Chase rolls the referral entry out to customers in batches, so no entry in the app means you were not picked this time; the reward sits in a rewards balance that must be transferred out before leaving Chase; opening an account involves a soft search and Chase offers no overdraft.
chase-uk-referral-50.source: Chase UK official Refer a friend terms page (£50, 30 days, £1,000, 3 December 2025 cut-off; checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

chip-uk-referral-50.title: [UK] Chip referral: £50 each when you deposit £1,000 and hold it 90 days, all within 120 days
chip-uk-referral-50.highlight: A referred new customer who puts £1,000 into any eligible Chip account and holds it for 90 days triggers £50 for both sides, with everything done within 120 days of the referral
chip-uk-referral-50.regions: [UK] UK residents 18+ who are UK tax residents and new to Chip
chip-uk-referral-50.content: Register through a referral link, deposit at least £1,000 into any eligible Chip account and keep the balance for 90 calendar days for £50 each. Eligible accounts are Smart Cash ISA, Instant Access, Prize Savings, Everyday Saver, General Investment Account and Stocks and Shares ISA, but not Chip Pension; the £1,000 can be split across accounts as long as the balance never drops below it for 90 days. chip-uk-referral-50.conditions: UK resident, 18+, UK tax resident; new to Chip with no account before; register through the referral link (app 4.56.0 or later); deposit £1,000 and hold it 90 days; meet everything within 120 days of the referral.
steps: Sign up to Chip through a friend's referral link and pass identity checks
Put £1,000 into eligible accounts such as Instant Access, Cash ISA or Prize Savings (it can be split)
Keep the balance at £1,000 or more for 90 days
Once all conditions are met inside the 120-day window, £50 lands in your Instant Access or Prize Savings account
chip-uk-referral-50.risk: Withdrawing during the 90 days drops the balance below £1,000 and loses the bonus; the bonus can only be paid into an Instant Access or Prize Savings account; the 120-day clock starts on the day you are referred.
chip-uk-referral-50.source: Chip official Refer a friend terms page (£50 / £1,000 / 90 days / 120 days; checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

wealthify-referral-50.highlight: Open through a referral link, invest £1,000 in a Stocks and Shares or Junior ISA (or £5,000 in a GIA or SIPP), then keep that balance another six months, and both sides get £50
wealthify-referral-50.regions: [UK] UK residents 18+ new to Wealthify, after risk and identity checks
wealthify-referral-50.content: Open through the referral link and make a first investment within six months: £1,000+ in a Stocks and Shares ISA or Junior ISA, or £5,000+ in a General Investment Account or SIPP, then hold the same balance for another six months, and both sides get £50 paid into their plans. wealthify-referral-50.conditions: UK resident, 18+, new to Wealthify; open through the referral link; £1,000+ in a Stocks and Shares or Junior ISA, or £5,000+ in a GIA or SIPP; hold the balance another six months; the reward is invested money, not cash.
steps: Register through a friend's Wealthify referral link and complete the risk questionnaire and identity checks
Within six months of opening, invest £1,000 in an ISA (or £5,000 in a GIA or SIPP)
Keep at least that amount invested for a further six months
The £50 is added to your plan automatically, with nothing to claim

freetrade-free-share-10-100.title: [UK] Freetrade free share: £10-£100 random share for funding £50, cash out after 180 days
freetrade-free-share-10-100.highlight: UK tax residents who open through a referral link, finish W-8BEN and fund £50 net get a random share worth £10-£100 within 30 days, usually at the £10 end
freetrade-free-share-10-100.regions: [UK] UK tax residents only; new Freetrade customers, excluding US citizens and dual nationals

steps: Sign up through a friend's Freetrade referral link and complete identity checks and W-8BEN
Bring the account's net cash to £50 or more within 30 days
Wait for the share to be issued, usually within 28 business days, and find it in your portfolio
Sell whenever you like, but proceeds unlock for withdrawal 180 days after the award
freetrade-free-share-10-100.risk: Most recipients get the £10 end despite the £100 headline; share values move with the market; sale proceeds are locked for 180 days; this is an investment account with KYC and market risk.
freetrade-free-share-10-100.source: Freetrade official Free Share terms v7 and /free-share offer page (checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

investengine-referral-20-200.regions: [UK] UK residents only; new InvestEngine customers (business accounts also need an LEI)

Stay invested for 12 months with net funding of at least £100 plus the bonus, or the money is reclaimed

investengine-referral-20-200.source: InvestEngine official Term Incentives page (Referral Program V1.4 with the weighting table and 12-month rule; checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

Open a new personal savings account and fund it with at least £2,000 within 14 days
Keep at least £2,000 in it for 30 calendar days

Choose a fixed rate bond with a term of one year or longer and fund it with £10,000 or more in one go
Make sure all £10,000 sits in that one bond rather than an easy access or shorter account first

£30 arrives as a cash credit within 35 calendar days of opening
