fidelity-uk-refer-100-amazon.highlight: Open through a referral link and put a £5,000 lump sum into a Stocks and Shares ISA, SIPP or investment account that passes validation, and both sides get a £100 Amazon.co.uk gift card
fidelity-uk-refer-100-amazon.regions: [UK] UK residents 18+ who are new to Fidelity and hold no investment account there
fidelity-uk-refer-100-amazon.content: The referred customer enters through the referral link, opens a Stocks and Shares ISA, Self-Invested Personal Pension or investment account and funds it with a £5,000 lump sum, and once the account is open and verified both sides get a £100 Amazon.co.uk gift card. Deposits under £5,000 do not qualify, and the reward is a gift card rather than cash.
fidelity-uk-refer-100-amazon.conditions: UK resident, 18+; new to Fidelity with no prior investment account; open through the referral link; one lump sum of £5,000+ into a Stocks and Shares ISA, SIPP or investment account; the account must pass verification.
steps: Register through a friend's Fidelity referral link
Open a Stocks and Shares ISA, SIPP or investment account and pay in a £5,000 lump sum
Complete account validation, including identity and source-of-funds checks
Both sides receive a £100 Amazon.co.uk gift card once the account is validated
fidelity-uk-refer-100-amazon.risk: The £5,000 threshold only makes sense if you were investing anyway; the reward is a gift card, not cash; investments can fall; funding below £5,000, or in several payments, may not qualify.
fidelity-uk-refer-100-amazon.source: Fidelity UK official Refer a friend page (£100 / £5,000; checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

currensea-referral-10.title: [UK] Currensea referral: £10 each when you spend £100 abroad, free-tier card included
currensea-referral-10.highlight: Apply for a Currensea travel debit card through a friend's link and spend £100 abroad, and both sides get £10 while the offer lasts
currensea-referral-10.regions: [UK] UK residents 18+ holding a UK current account
currensea-referral-10.content: Currensea is a travel debit card linked to a UK current account that uses the live exchange rate with no added fee, avoiding the overseas charges on ordinary bank cards. Its refer a friend offer pays £10 each once the referred customer applies through the link and spends £100 abroad. The free Essential tier charges only a one-off £4.95 for delivery, while Pro and Elite are annual plans with the same reward. The page says both sides get £10 when you spend £100 abroad, running from 12:00 BST on 29 June 2026 until withdrawn.
currensea-referral-10.conditions: UK residents 18+ with a UK current account; apply through the referral link; spend £100 in total abroad on the Currensea card; the offer can be withdrawn at any time, so follow the page when applying.
steps: Apply for a Currensea card through a friend's referral link - the free Essential tier is enough
Link the card to your UK current account and complete identity checks
Use the card abroad until you have spent £100 in total
£10 cashback appears in your Currensea account for both sides
currensea-referral-10.risk: Only worth it if you actually spend abroad rather than spending just to qualify; Pro and Elite tiers carry annual fees; the offer can be withdrawn at any time; the card debits your current account directly.
currensea-referral-10.source: Currensea official Refer a friend page and terms (£10 / £100 abroad; checked 21 November 2026); original listing on My Side Gig

hsbc-premier-switch-500.title: [UK] HSBC Premier switch offer: £500 for a full CASS switch with £100k income or savings
hsbc-premier-switch-500.highlight: Move a full current account into HSBC Premier with the Current Account Switch Service and meet the £100,000 salary or £100,000 savings/investments test and HSBC pays £500; the account itself has no monthly fee and the bank bills it as the biggest UK switch bonus
hsbc-premier-switch-500.regions: [UK] UK residents aged 18+ with £100k income or assets
hsbc-premier-switch-500.content: Move a full account to HSBC Premier through the Current Account Switch Service and meet either £100,000 personal income paid into Premier or £100,000 held or moved into HSBC UK savings or investments, and HSBC pays £500; qualifying for Premier in another country also works. Premier has no monthly fee, and HSBC values the travel insurance and worldwide medical cover at up to £1,500 a year. This is separate from HSBC's £220 ordinary switch offer (Bank Account, two direct debits, £2,000 deposited and £500 card spend). New customers get 90 days to meet the criteria; anyone who held an HSBC or first direct account since 1 January 2025 is not new, and the offer can be withdrawn at any time.
hsbc-premier-switch-500.conditions: UK resident, 18+; no HSBC or first direct account since 1 January 2025; earn £100,000 paid into Premier, hold £100,000 in HSBC UK savings or investments (excluding M&S, first direct and HSBC Expat), or already qualify for Premier elsewhere; a full CASS switch is required, with 90 days to meet the criteria.
steps: Open the Premier page on hsbc.co.uk and start the application
Pass identity, address and residency checks and prepare proof of income or move £100,000 of savings/investments
Use the Current Account Switch Service to move the old account across, direct debits included
HSBC credits the £500 once the conditions are met; the income or savings test can be completed within 90 days
hsbc-premier-switch-500.risk: The bar is high: either £100,000 of income or £100,000 sitting with HSBC, which most people cannot meet; HSBC can withdraw the offer at any time and the payout timing follows its terms; a full switch closes the old account and moves direct debits, so check salary and bills first; the travel insurance and health benefits only apply once applied for.
hsbc-premier-switch-500.source: HSBC UK Premier Bank Account page (£500 and Current Account Switch Service conditions, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals UK banking bonus table

tide-business-referral-100.title: [UK] Tide business account referral: £100 each after £500 of card spend in three months
tide-business-referral-100.highlight: Open a Tide business account with an existing member's referral code and spend £500 on the Tide card within three months to collect £100 each, paid within eight weeks; UK companies, sole traders and freelancers all qualify
tide-business-referral-100.regions: [UK] UK-registered companies, sole traders and self-employed people; new Tide customers
tide-business-referral-100.content: New customers enter the referral code on the Add referral code screen during signup (Tide's FAQ allows it within seven days after), and after approval spend £500 on the Tide card within three months; both sides then get £100 paid into their Tide accounts within eight weeks. The £500 must be card spending, excluding disputed transactions and top-ups, subscription and account fees, gift cards and bill payments; both accounts must be active at payout; one member can refer five businesses a month and each business earns once. The referrer's amount rises with their plan (Lite £100, Smart £125, Pro £150, Max £200), while the new customer always gets £100.
tide-business-referral-100.conditions: A UK-registered business or self-employed person; no Tide account before; enter the referral code at signup or within seven days; spend £500 on the Tide card within three months (disputed transactions, top-ups, subscription and account fees, gift cards and bill payments excluded); both accounts active at payout; one reward per business and at most five per member a month.
steps: Ask a friend with a Tide account for their referral code, generated in the app
Apply for the business account in the Tide app and enter the code on the 'Add referral code' screen
Pass KYC and credit checks, then start spending on the Tide card
Reach £500 of card spend within three months and both sides receive £100 within eight weeks
tide-business-referral-100.risk: Tide's paid plans (Smart, Pro, Max) carry a monthly fee and only Lite comes close to free, so check the fee before choosing; the £500 must be card spend, not transfers, bills or top-ups; business accounts need KYC and a UK-registered business; Tide can change the terms, and the referrer-side tiers come from app terms.
tide-business-referral-100.source: Tide Refer a Friend page and key terms (£100 each, £500 of card spend in three months, eight-week payout, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals UK banking bonus table

quidco-refer-10.title: [UK] Quidco referral: £10 for a new member after £5 of confirmed cashback
quidco-refer-10.highlight: Join Quidco through a friend's personal referral link, earn £5 of confirmed cashback within 180 days and £10 lands in the account automatically; the friend's side pays £20 or £25 depending on their membership
quidco-refer-10.regions: [UK] quidco.com UK site only; new members must register through the personal referral link
quidco-refer-10.content: The page says up to £25 for you and £10 for each friend: once a new friend registers through the personal link and reaches £5 of confirmed cashback (accumulated across transactions), both rewards land in their Quidco accounts. Gift cards, Bonus Cashback promotions and no-spend offers such as free SIMs, surveys and insurance quotes do not count toward the £5; one person can earn up to 10 referral rewards in a rolling 12 months, and multiple accounts get banned. The amount follows whatever the landing page shows when the friend registers.
quidco-refer-10.conditions: New UK-site members 18+; register through a friend's personal link (finding the site yourself does not count); reach £5 of confirmed cashback within 180 days, across several transactions; gift cards, Bonus Cashback and free SIM, survey or insurance offers excluded; up to 10 rewards per rolling 12 months on both sides; no multiple accounts.
steps: Ask a friend for their Quidco referral link and clear browser cookies before opening it
Register a new Quidco account through the link and verify the email
Click through Quidco to a retailer and shop normally until £5 of cashback is confirmed
The £10 referral reward is paid into the account once that cashback confirms
quidco-refer-10.risk: Cashback takes weeks or months to move from pending to confirmed, so the £5 is not a same-day step; sign up without the link and Quidco will not pay; the reward amount can change and the landing page on the day of signup decides; website and app amounts can differ.
quidco-refer-10.source: Quidco Refer a Friend page and help centre (£10 for the new member, £5 of confirmed cashback, ten referrals a year, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals Quidco entry

clearpay-invite-10.title: [UK] Clearpay invite a friend: £10 off a £50+ order, valid for 90 days
clearpay-invite-10.highlight: Accept a friend's Clearpay invite as a new customer and £10 of referral credit is applied to your next £50+ Clearpay order; the credit lasts 90 days, is single use, and the friend gets £10 off too
clearpay-invite-10.content: An invited newcomer with no active account at signup and none in the past 12 months registers through the invite link and gets a £10 voucher for any Clearpay order of £50 or more, while the inviter gets £10 off their next £50+ order. The voucher expires 90 days after issue, works once and is clawed back on refunds. A referrer can invite five people for up to £50; the voucher cannot be transferred or cashed and does not apply to existing orders; it sits in the account's Promos area and applies automatically at checkout.
clearpay-invite-10.conditions: New UK Clearpay customers 18+; no active account at signup and none in the past 12 months; register through the personal invite link; the voucher needs a single £50+ order, lasts 90 days and works once; up to five invitees and £50 per referrer.
steps: Ask a friend for their Clearpay Invite a Friend link
Open it, install the app and register with your mobile number so the code attaches to the account
Check the Promos tab in the app to confirm the £10 credit has arrived
Place an order of £50 or more and choose Clearpay at checkout; the credit applies automatically
clearpay-invite-10.risk: The credit is not cash: it only reduces the value of a Clearpay instalment order and only above £50; it dies after 90 days; returns and cancellations let Clearpay take it back; missed instalments affect UK credit files because Clearpay reports to the three agencies; smaller orders cannot use it.
clearpay-invite-10.source: Clearpay Invite a Friend terms and help centre (£10 credit, £50 minimum order, 90-day validity, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals Clearpay entry

zilch-refer-5.title: [UK] Zilch referral: £5 in Rewards each after the friend's first Tap and Pay
zilch-refer-5.highlight: A new Zilch user joins through a friend's link, passes ID checks, gets the Zilch card and makes one Tap and Pay purchase in store, and both sides receive £5 in Rewards; Zilch sets no cap on referrals
zilch-refer-5.regions: [UK] UK residents 18+ who are new to Zilch
zilch-refer-5.content: The referral page promises both sides £5 in Rewards once the friend makes a first Tap and Pay purchase: the friend registers through the personal link, verifies within 30 days, gets the Zilch card, adds it to a mobile wallet and pays in store by tap, and both get £5 of Rewards, with the amount subject to promotional change at the friend's signup. Zilch is a UK buy-now-pay-later virtual card whose Rewards offset spending in the app rather than cash, and while referrals are described as unlimited, risk checks watch for bulk signups on one device or address.
zilch-refer-5.conditions: UK residents 18+; new to Zilch; register through the personal link and verify within 30 calendar days, obtaining the Zilch card; add it to a mobile wallet and make one in-store Tap and Pay purchase; the amount follows the signup day.
steps: Ask an existing Zilch user for their referral link
Register through the link, complete ID checks and get approved for the Zilch card
Add the Zilch card to Apple Pay or Google Pay
Make one Tap and Pay purchase in store and both sides receive £5 in Rewards
zilch-refer-5.risk: Rewards can only be spent inside Zilch, not withdrawn as cash; a real in-store Tap and Pay is required, so registering without buying earns nothing; Zilch is buy-now-pay-later and credit limits affect your file, with fees for missed payments; the referral page and help centre describe the trigger slightly differently, so follow the app.
zilch-refer-5.source: Zilch Refer and earn page and Zilch help centre (£5 in Rewards, Tap and Pay trigger, 30-day window, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals Zilch entry

rebtel-invite-10.title: [Global] Rebtel invite: $10 of call credit each after a $1+ first payment
rebtel-invite-10.highlight: A friend signs up through your Rebtel invite link and makes a first payment of at least $1, and both sides get $10 of Rebtel credit for international calls or mobile top-ups; up to 50 invites per account
rebtel-invite-10.regions: [Global] New Rebtel users; register in the app or on the site with a number that receives codes
rebtel-invite-10.content: The help centre says a personal invite link brings a friend in, and once they register and make a payment of at least USD 1, both sides get USD 10 of Rebtel Credit instantly for international calls or topping up overseas numbers, with up to 50 invites each; credit expires after 12 months of account inactivity and cannot be transferred or cashed out. The legal Invite bonus terms set the trigger at a successful payment of USD 5 or more, excluding free credit, trials and discounted payments, so paying $5+ on the first top-up avoids the grey zone.
rebtel-invite-10.conditions: New Rebtel customers only, never having used it before; register through an existing user's link; one payment of at least $1 per the help centre or $5 per the legal terms; credit works only on Rebtel calls and top-ups, expires after 12 months of inactivity and cannot be transferred or withdrawn; up to 50 invites each.
steps: Ask an existing Rebtel user for their invite link, generated in the Accounts section
Register a new account through the link and verify the phone number
Top up at least $5, which clears both the $1 and $5 wording in Rebtel's documents
Both accounts receive $10 of credit for international calls or mobile top-ups
rebtel-invite-10.risk: Rebtel's two official documents disagree on the first-payment threshold ($1 against $5), so top up $5 to be safe; credit is not cash and only works inside Rebtel, expiring after 12 months of inactivity; self-referral with several accounts is treated as abuse and the credit can be clawed back.
rebtel-invite-10.source: Rebtel help centre article on Rebtel Credits and the legal invite-bonus terms ($10 each, first-payment threshold, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals Rebtel entry

voxi-friends-with-benefits-20.title: [UK] VOXI Friends with Benefits: up to £20 gift card each after the friend pays two months
voxi-friends-with-benefits-20.highlight: Join VOXI through a friend's Friends with Benefits link, pay two monthly bills and both sides get a tiered gift card worth £10, £15 or £20 - Amazon, Just Eat or PayPal cash - with double rewards up to £40 in promotional periods
voxi-friends-with-benefits-20.regions: [UK] UK residents who are new VOXI customers on a £10+ plan
voxi-friends-with-benefits-20.content: New VOXI customers join through a friend's Friends with Benefits link and, once they have paid for two months, both sides get a gift card scaled to the plan: £10 or £12 plans pay £10 each, £15 pays £15 and £20 or more pays £20, as an Amazon or Just Eat card or PayPal cash, doubling to up to £40 in promotional periods. The triggers are strict: two monthly payments within 60 days of signing up without pausing, a plan of at least £10, and no promo or student free-month code at checkout or the whole order is void; both plans must be active when claiming. Choose the card within 90 days of the reward or lose it, and each person is capped at £2,000 of rewards a year.
voxi-friends-with-benefits-20.conditions: UK residents; new VOXI customers on a £10+ plan; two consecutive monthly payments within 60 days without pausing; no promo or student code at checkout; an active plan on both sides when claiming; choose the card within 90 days; £2,000 a year per person.
steps: Ask a current VOXI customer for their Friends with Benefits link
Pick a £10+ plan through the link and complete sign-up without using a promo code
Pay two consecutive monthly bills within 60 days and keep the plan active
Choose an Amazon or Just Eat gift card, or PayPal cash, within 90 days of the email
voxi-friends-with-benefits-20.risk: The voucher only lands after two months of payments, so you pay two bills first; any promo code at checkout voids the referral; miss the 90-day claim window and it is gone; the £20 tier needs a £20+ plan, so most people get £10; VOXI runs on the Vodafone network and indoor signal varies by area.
voxi-friends-with-benefits-20.source: VOXI Friends with Benefits help page and terms PDF (£20 tiers, two-month trigger, double rewards up to £40, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals VOXI entry

talkmobile-150gb-half-price-3m.title: [UK] Talkmobile 150GB at £5.97 for the first three months on a 12-month plan, then £11.95
talkmobile-150gb-half-price-3m.highlight: Vodafone-owned Talkmobile halves the first three months of its 12-month 150GB SIM-only plan to £5.97 with unlimited calls and texts plus EU roaming in 47 countries; the 100GB tier is £4.98 for the same period
talkmobile-150gb-half-price-3m.regions: [UK] UK address and UK bank card; a new 12-month plan passing a credit check
talkmobile-150gb-half-price-3m.content: Vodafone-owned Talkmobile's SIM-only plans: 150GB on a 12-month contract costs £5.97 for the first three months, then £11.95 (the page says from 20 February 2027), and 100GB costs £4.98 then £9.95. Both include unlimited calls and texts, support eSIM, roam in 47 EU countries on local allowances (5GB fair use) and switch automatically between Vodafone and Three. Over three months that saves £17.94 on 150GB or £14.91 on 100GB, suiting a short UK stay or heavy data use.
talkmobile-150gb-half-price-3m.conditions: UK address and bank card; a new 12-month SIM-only contract passing a credit check; half price for three months only, then £9.95 (100GB) or £11.95 (150GB) from 20 February 2027; early cancellation means paying the remaining months; 47-country EU roaming with 5GB fair use.
steps: Open the SIM-only page on talkmobile.co.uk and choose the 12-month 150GB (or 100GB) plan
Enter a UK address and payment details and pass the credit check
Activate the eSIM QR code or the physical SIM
Pay £5.97 for three months, then £11.95 from 20 February 2027
talkmobile-150gb-half-price-3m.risk: It is a 12-month contract, so leaving early means paying the remaining months; the half price only covers three months and the standard price is ordinary; a UK address, UK card and credit history are required, so overseas users cannot sign up; EU roaming data is capped at 5GB under fair use.
talkmobile-150gb-half-price-3m.source: Talkmobile SIM-only page (three months half price, 12-month term, return to standard pricing, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals Talkmobile entry

railway-referral-20.title: [Global] Railway referral: $20 of credit once the new account upgrades to a paid plan
railway-referral-20.highlight: Sign up to Railway through an existing user's invite link and the new account can receive $20 of platform credit, equivalent to a month of Pro; Railway support confirms it is applied when the account upgrades to a paid plan
railway-referral-20.regions: [Global] New Railway accounts; the referral link must be clicked before signing up
railway-referral-20.content: The documentation says any referred user gets $20 of Railway credit, a free month on Pro, while the referrer earns 15% commission on each payment; one account per person, cross-checked by email, GitHub and payment method. Timing matters: support said in the official community (station.railway.com, 1 October 2026) that the $20 is not granted at signup but applies when the referred account upgrades to Hobby or Pro, and the $5 a new account sees is the one-off trial everyone gets. The $20 is worth several months of Hobby or one of Pro, cannot be withdrawn or transferred, and overage needs a card.
railway-referral-20.conditions: A brand-new Railway account created after clicking the referral link (clicking later does nothing); one account per person; the $20 applies only on upgrading to Hobby or Pro; the credit has no cash value and cannot be transferred or refunded; overage requires a card.
steps: Ask an existing Railway user for their invite link, found on the Refer page of the dashboard
Sign up through the link and connect GitHub
Deploy a project, then upgrade the workspace to a Hobby or Pro paid plan
The $20 credit offsets the bill, roughly a free month on Pro
railway-referral-20.risk: The $20 is not granted at sign-up - it applies only after upgrading to a paid plan, which means binding a card first; signing up before opening the link forfeits it; one account per person, and duplicates get closed; the credit cannot be withdrawn.
railway-referral-20.source: Railway docs Accounts and Affiliate Program pages, plus Railway's own community reply that the credit applies on upgrading to a paid plan (1 October 2026) and the TopReferrals Railway entry

nordvpn-black-friday-2026.title: [Global] NordVPN Black Friday: 2-year Basic at $2.99/mo plus 3 extra months (save about $232)
nordvpn-black-friday-2026.highlight: Up to 78% off two-year plans plus three extra months: Basic works out at $2.99 a month, $80.73 for 27 months up front, Complete at $3.99 and Prime at $6.99, with the deal running to 9 December and a 30-day money-back guarantee
nordvpn-black-friday-2026.regions: [Global] Order on NordVPN's site; discounts vary (79% off in Japan, 78% in US, UK, France and Germany, 77% in Canada and Australia)
nordvpn-black-friday-2026.content: The Black Friday sale runs 21 October to 9 December 2026: Basic is $2.99 a month on a two-year plan, $80.73 for 27 months, Complete $3.99 a month ($107.73) and Prime $6.99 a month ($188.73), up to 78% off. The promotional price covers only the first term before auto-renewal at list price (Basic $139.08 a year, Complete $219.48, Prime $296.28), and the three bonus months are already inside the 27. The 30-day refund still applies. From 22 November 2026 Rakuten raised NordVPN cashback from 20% to 100% at rakuten.com/nordvpn.com: US-site first orders by new customers only, once per Rakuten member, only the Basic portion counts, codes from outside the Rakuten page void it, it pays quarterly and refunded orders get nothing.
nordvpn-black-friday-2026.conditions: New NordVPN customers ordering through the Black Friday or pricing page; pay the full two-year (27-month including bonus) term up front; the discount covers the first term only before auto-renewal at list price; refunds within 30 days; some regions get slightly less; the 100% Rakuten cashback needs a click on Shop Now from Rakuten's NordVPN page in the same browser session with an empty cart and ad blockers off, and applies only to US-site first orders.
steps: Open nordvpn.com/black-friday or the pricing page and switch the term to two years
Pick Basic ($2.99 a month) or Complete ($3.99 a month) and confirm the bill is for 27 months
Pay by card or PayPal, then download and sign in to the app
Ask for a full refund within 30 days if it is not for you; decide on renewal before the term ends
nordvpn-black-friday-2026.risk: Requires $80+ up front; auto-renewal is on by default and would charge $139.08 a year at the standard rate; the three extra months are already counted inside the 27; the discount only covers the first term; the refund has to be requested within 30 days.; the 100% Rakuten rate is a limited-time boost (normally about 20%), pays quarterly, and refunded or declined orders earn nothing
nordvpn-black-friday-2026.source: NordVPN Black Friday and pricing pages (discounts, 27-month bill, deadline 9 December 2026, renewal prices, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals NordVPN entry; rechecked 2026-11-22 against nordvpn.com/pricing (27 months at $80.73) and the Rakuten NordVPN merchant page (100% cash back, new customers' first order, US site only, Basic portion only)

shopify-uk-1-pound-3-months.title: [UK] Shopify: three days free then £1 a month for three months (Basic is £25 a month)
shopify-uk-1-pound-3-months.highlight: New Shopify merchants in the UK get three free days and then three months at £1 a month against the £25 Basic monthly price, saving about £72; the trial needs no card, but selling needs a paid plan
shopify-uk-1-pound-3-months.regions: [UK] New shopify.com/uk merchants with UK business details and a card that can take a £1 charge
shopify-uk-1-pound-3-months.content: For new shopify.com/uk merchants, Basic is £25 a month or £19 billed annually, Grow £65 or £49, Advanced £344 or £259 and Plus from £1,800, with the first three months at £1 before list price resumes. The three-day trial needs no card, but opening a real shop that takes payments means choosing a paid plan, which is when the card is added. During the trial the store is private and checkout is off, so real orders need a paid plan; promotion-period fees are not refunded, so avoid annual billing for convenience, and the trial cannot be extended. Against Basic at £25 a month, three months at £1 saves £72 (about $94).
shopify-uk-1-pound-3-months.conditions: New shopify.com/uk merchants; the three-day trial needs no card, but selling requires a paid plan and a card; £1 a month for three months, then list price (Basic £25 monthly or £19 annually); checkout stays closed during the trial; promotion-period fees are not refunded and the trial cannot be extended.
steps: Open the shopify.com/uk free trial page and create a store with your email, no card needed
Set up products, theme, shipping and taxes during the trial
Choose the Basic plan and add a card, billed £1 a month for three months
From month four it bills £25 a month (or £19 on yearly); cancel in Settings > Plan if you do not want it
shopify-uk-1-pound-3-months.risk: You cannot sell during the trial, and going live means binding a card; promotional fees are non-refundable so yearly billing inside the window is risky; the price jumps to £25 a month after three months; third-party payment providers add transaction fees; forgetting to cancel keeps the monthly charge running.
shopify-uk-1-pound-3-months.source: Shopify UK pricing and free-trial pages (£1 a month for three months, three-day trial, standard prices, checked 21 November 2026) plus the TopReferrals Shopify entry

names-free-co-uk-domain.title: [UK] Names.co.uk: a free .co.uk domain for a year (and a .com for £1.99)
names-free-co-uk-domain.highlight: Names.co.uk gives new customers one .co.uk domain free for a year and lets them add a .com for £1.99, both on annual registration paid online; renewal then follows the standard price
names-free-co-uk-domain.regions: [UK/Global] New Names.co.uk customers; online payment verification; some suffixes need a UK presence
names-free-co-uk-domain.content: The homepage footnote says a single .co.uk domain is free for a year and a .com costs £1.99 on a one-year registration; the same block lists first-year prices for other suffixes (.uk, .org.uk and .me.uk at £3.99, .net £8.99, .org £7.99, .info £6.99, .biz £6.99), all on annual terms. Year one is free and year two renews at list price (.co.uk is usually around £10), making it a starting point for a UK site, landing page or branded email.
names-free-co-uk-domain.conditions: New Names.co.uk customers; pay online on an annual term for the first-year price; one free .co.uk per account; renewals at list price; ownership and WHOIS details must be genuine, with some suffixes needing a UK contact address.
steps: Open names.co.uk and search for the .co.uk name you want
Add it to the basket and confirm the first-year price shows as £0 on annual registration
Optionally add a .com for £1.99 at the same time
Pay online to register it, then point the DNS wherever you like, including Cloudflare
names-free-co-uk-domain.risk: Only the first year is free and the renewal bills at the standard rate, so cancel if you do not want it; most registrars require a valid payment method for first-year offers; some .co.uk registrations need a UK address; the domain alone is not hosting, so a site still needs a host or something like GitHub Pages.

antideploy-free-1vcpu-1gb.source: free8.net thread on the free 1 core / 1 GB Antideploy offer with no card (2026-11-08, 11 replies) plus the Antideploy official pricing page (checked 2026-11-21) and hands-on tests (2026-11-08 and 2026-11-14)

smarterasp-60-day-free-windows.title: [Global] SmarterASP.NET 60-day free Windows hosting: ASP.NET/.NET to Node, no card
smarterasp-60-day-free-windows.highlight: 60 days of Windows shared hosting with no credit card: ASP.NET through .NET 10, Node.js, MSSQL, MySQL and PostgreSQL, a free temporary domain with SSL, and GitHub auto-deploy.
smarterasp-60-day-free-windows.regions: [Global] US or Netherlands datacentres; email or GitHub signup with no card
smarterasp-60-day-free-windows.content: Running Windows hosting since 1999, it offers a 60-day free trial with no card and instant activation: register by email or GitHub, take the verification email, choose a site type in the panel and receive a temporary subdomain such as yourname.smarterasp.net, with SSL live in minutes from the panel. The trial runs ASP.NET and ASP.NET Core (the page says up to .NET 10), Node.js with auto-deploy and PHP, with MSSQL 2008-2025, MySQL and PostgreSQL; GitHub repos build on push, and ZIP uploads work through the file manager, all with 24/7 support. Wording differs: the trial page says unlimited space and bandwidth while third-party directories list the W60 trial as 5GB, 10GB a month and one site, so trust the signup page.
smarterasp-60-day-free-windows.conditions: 60 days free with no card; one site with a free temporary subdomain supporting ASP.NET, .NET Core, Node.js, PHP and MSSQL, MySQL or PostgreSQL; the site stops at expiry and data must be exported; repeated trial signups are not promised; NodeSeek tests found no SSH and slow access from mainland China.
steps: Open smarterasp.net/free_trial and click Free Trial, then Continue to Registration
Register with email or GitHub and activate through the verification email
Create a site in the control panel, choose ASP.NET or Node.js, and get the xxx.smarterasp.net temporary domain
Enable free SSL in the security settings, then deploy code through GitHub or the file manager
smarterasp-60-day-free-windows.risk: Windows, .NET and Node sites only, with no SSH or root. The forum measured slow access from mainland China, so it is not a proxy box. The official page says unlimited space while third-party records show 5 GB and 10 GB of monthly traffic, which may be capped. The site stops after 60 days and repeated trials risk being flagged as abuse.
smarterasp-60-day-free-windows.source: free8.net thread on SmarterASP.NET (2026-10-24) plus the official 60-day free trial page (checked 2026-11-21) and NodeSeek / NodeLoc hands-on feedback (2026-10-23)

trae-oneclick-deploy-free.highlight: TRAE's one-click deploy publishes a page or Node app to the public web, and during the free period a running site costs no credits: 10 GB a day and 100 QPS per site, on a platform subdomain with HTTPS.
trae-oneclick-deploy-free.regions: [CN] The TRAE China client (agent window, then My Sites) with a mobile-number signup
trae-oneclick-deploy-free.value: 10 GB a day and 100 QPS per site (free period, $0)
trae-oneclick-deploy-free.content: TRAE, ByteDance's AI coding IDE, builds one-click deploy into its client: tell the agent to deploy and a finished page or Node app is packaged, built and published with a traesite.cn link, after which you can change the address, access level, roll back versions and watch traffic and logs. The docs say sites run continuously and that running normally costs credits, waived during the current free period. A community tutorial of 12 November gives the limits: 10GB a day and 100 QPS per site, static publishing of up to 99 files or 50MB (larger goes to remote-build dynamic hosting), static output and Node.js 20 full-stack apps only, no databases and no custom domains. Access defaults to private, so switch to public or visitors see a blank page.
trae-oneclick-deploy-free.conditions: A TRAE China account with a mobile number; static pages and Node.js 20 full-stack apps only, with no databases or Python, Java or Go; 10GB a day and 100 QPS per site, and 99 files or 50MB static; a traesite.cn subdomain with no custom domains or ICP filing; the free period's end is unannounced.
steps: Install the TRAE China desktop client, sign in with a phone number, and open My Sites in the Agent window
Click New deployment, or add the one-click deploy plugin in the conversation and point it at the artifact
Answer whether to reuse or create a site and whether it is private or public, then wait for the build and the link
In the site details switch to visible to everyone, change the URL, watch traffic, and pause the site when you are done so it does not bill credits after the free period
trae-oneclick-deploy-free.risk: The free period can end at any time, after which a running site consumes credits, and a site left running keeps spending them. Only a platform subdomain is offered, with no custom domain or ICP filing. 10 GB a day and 100 QPS per site are not enough for a real service. Projects with a database or a non-Node backend cannot be deployed. Links are private by default, so switch to public before sharing.
trae-oneclick-deploy-free.source: free8.net thread on TRAE site building and deployment (2026-11-19) plus the official TRAE deploy documentation and the official community tutorial (checked 2026-11-21)

Sign in to lennysproductpass.com with the subscribing email and accept the terms (no refund afterwards)
Claim the codes you want from the dashboard, starting with in-demand ones like Cursor Pro and Google AI Pro
Redeem each code on the partner's site; the free year starts on the day you redeem it

umobile-ultra5g-tourist-esim-my.regions: [MY] U Mobile's Malaysian 5G/4G only; scan at KLIA T1 or T2, Kota Kinabalu or Langkawi arrivals
umobile-ultra5g-tourist-esim-my.content: An official tourist eSIM for Visit Malaysia 2026: foreign passport holders scan a dedicated QR code in the arrivals area at KLIA T1 or T2, Kota Kinabalu or Langkawi and claim a 100GB, 24-hour ULTRA5G tourist eSIM in the MyUMobile app, with full-speed 5G/4G, no throttling, hotspot sharing and no physical option. The line stays 14 days after the 24 hours (free incoming calls) and more data costs RM3 for 1GB a day, RM6 for 10GB a day, RM12 for 10GB a week and RM15 for 20GB a week, all full speed with hotspot. The separate Free ULTRA5G Trial (10GB, seven days, MyKad holders) is for locals.
umobile-ultra5g-tourist-esim-my.conditions: Non-Malaysian foreign passport holders, once in a lifetime; scan the official code at one of the four airport arrivals, as the web cannot claim it; passport and face verification; eSIM only on an unlocked compatible phone; Malaysian data only with no mainland China roaming; the campaign runs to 31 December 2026.
steps: After landing, find the U Mobile QR code in the arrival area of KLIA T1/T2, Kota Kinabalu or Langkawi and connect to airport Wi-Fi
Install and update the MyUMobile app to 3.13.11 or newer, then scan the code to open the ULTRA5G Tourist page
Accept the terms, tap Redeem, upload your passport, complete face verification, fill in your details and tap Verify
Download and install the eSIM in the app, set it as the data line and turn on data roaming
umobile-ultra5g-tourist-esim-my.risk: Only 24 hours, so use it on landing day; the 100GB is a trial allowance and any further data on the same eSIM must be bought; the code is only available at the airport, so you cannot get it after leaving; face verification fails if your passport details do not match; Malaysia local network only, so it does not roam, including in mainland China.

mypal-kolet-free-1gb-esim.regions: [Philippines/Global] For any Philippine Airlines international passenger; Kolet covers 190 countries including mainland China roaming

steps: Open the PAL myPAL eSIM page and click Try it for Free, or register in the Kolet app with promo code FLYPAL
Register with your email, install the Kolet app and sign in with the same address so the free 1GB is credited
Install the eSIM in the app as prompted (under two minutes for most people), then set it as the data line and enable data roaming on arrival
Top up in the app after the 48 hours if you need more (from $3.99 per GB)

alrajhi-gigsky-free-unlimited-esim.regions: [SA] Al Rajhi cardholders only; destinations follow GigSky's Visa Destinations list
alrajhi-gigsky-free-unlimited-esim.content: A Visa partnership between Al Rajhi Bank and GigSky: qualifying Al Rajhi credit or prepaid cards get a free GigSky eSIM with unlimited data at designated destinations on arrival. alrajhi-gigsky-free-unlimited-esim.conditions: Saudi Al Rajhi qualifying credit cards (Infinite, Signature, Platinum) and prepaid cards only; once every 365 days; free data runs from activation and auto-activates after a year; destinations are limited to the Visa Destinations list; GigSky itself covers mainland China via China Unicom, but whether this tier includes it awaits the official list.

Add the card in the GigSky app and claim the free plan from the Visa Destinations section
Open Regions, View Details, Countries in the app to confirm the destination list, including whether mainland China is covered
Install and activate the eSIM on arrival, then turn on data roaming

mpt-po-pyaw-po-ya-10x-data.content: MPT's Po Pyaw, Po Ya running from November: prepaid users dial *7711# once to register free, then every pay-as-you-go local call longer than five minutes returns ten times its length in data, so six minutes gives 60MB and eight 80MB. Make local calls at pay-as-you-go rates and keep each call above five minutes
Check the data received with *224# or in the MPT4U app and use it within two days

thai-aipass-free-ai-models.title: [Thailand] TH-AI Passport (AiPASS): more than 30 AI models free until 31 August 2027
thai-aipass-free-ai-models.highlight: Thailand's Ministry of Digital Economy and Society runs AiPASS: Thai citizens aged 15 and over register with ThaID and use more than 30 models for free, including DeepSeek, Meta AI, Mistral, Moonshot, MiniMax, Alibaba Cloud, Z.ai and Pathumma ThaiLLM, with the top tier for the first 30 days if you register by 30 November
thai-aipass-free-ai-models.regions: [Thailand] Thai citizens 15+ with ThaID verification; 5 million places
thai-aipass-free-ai-models.value: 30+ models free for a full year (about $240)
thai-aipass-free-ai-models.content: A nationwide AI access programme run by BDE under Thailand's Ministry of Digital Economy and Society, at aipass.go.th and its app, free from 31 August 2026 to 31 August 2027 for 5 million Thai citizens aged 15 and over. Sign-up needs the ThaID (or ทางรัฐ) app, a Google, Microsoft or Apple email and a connected device: create the account with an email, accept the terms and PDPA, verify with ThaID, then fill in the profile. The official model list is Alibaba Cloud, DeepSeek, Meta AI, MiniMax, Mistral AI, Moonshot AI, Pathumma ThaiLLM, SpaceXAI and Z.ai; Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity mentioned in Thai media are subject to that list and run inside the platform on project quota, not as paid accounts with each vendor. Registering by 30 November 2026 gives the top tier for 30 days from first use, after which at least 100 learning points a month keep it; quota resets daily with no five-hour or weekly caps, and user data is not used for training and is protected under the PDPA.
thai-aipass-free-ai-models.conditions: Thai citizens only, 15+ on the registration date; verify in the ThaID or ทางรัฐ app yourself, as nobody can register for you; 5 million places; free for the project period; the top first 30 days need registration by 30 November, then 100+ learning points a month; models run on platform quota rather than as official vendor accounts.
steps: Install the ThaID or Thang Rat app on your phone and complete identity verification
Sign up at aipass.go.th or in the AiPASS app with a Google, Microsoft or Apple email
Accept the terms and PDPA consent and verify with ThaID
Fill in your profile and start using; registering by 30 November gives the top tier for the first 30 days
thai-aipass-free-ai-models.risk: Requires a Thai national ID and ThaID verification, so foreigners, tourists and Chinese nationals working in Thailand cannot join; 5,000,000 places are first come first served; the top-tier first 30 days must then be maintained with learning points; the models are platform calls rather than official vendor accounts; the official model list differs from media reports, so trust the site.
thai-aipass-free-ai-models.source: AiPASS official homepage (checked 21 November 2026: eligibility, places, programme period, model list and the top tier for registrations by 30 November) + The Standard (6 November 2026 on the Gemini Enterprise add-on) + SV News and MGR Online launch coverage

steps: Open the eligible account for your age band through ADCB digital channels
In the opening month and the following three months, pay for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Perplexity subscriptions with your ADCB card
Keep the balance or complete the salary transfers for your age band so the welcome bonus posts automatically
Cashback needs no registration and settles monthly; for draws keep AED 5,000 at month-end or receive a salary

singlife-nomad-free-1gb-esim.regions: [SG] Singlife travel insurance policyholders only (single-trip, annual or corporate)
singlife-nomad-free-1gb-esim.content: A joint campaign from Singapore insurer Singlife and Nomad (Lotusflare Inc): buy eligible travel insurance in your own name during the campaign, whether single-trip, annual (new or renewal) or corporate, and redeem a free 1GB Nomad global eSIM. singlife-nomad-free-1gb-esim.conditions: Until 31 December 2026; eligible travel insurance in your own name; one 1GB eSIM per policy, accumulable; the policy active with premiums paid; the email arrives 7-10 days after it starts; mainland China roaming is unverified (the Nomad app shows destinations from the emailed link).
steps: Buy a Singlife single-trip or annual travel policy during the promotion period, or corporate travel insurance for a company
Confirm the policy is in force and the premium is paid
Watch the policy email address for the redemption email 7 to 10 days after inception
Redeem the 1GB global eSIM from the email link and install it on an eSIM-capable phone

dito-esim-cloud-number-63.title: [Philippines] DITO cloud-activated eSIM: a real +63 number for PHP 99, kept alive for about PHP 10-20 a year (receives SMS in mainland China)
dito-esim-cloud-number-63.highlight: Buy the eSIM online at DITO's eShop or in the app, receive the QR code by email, install it and register in the DITO app to get a real +63 carrier number; PHP 99 includes 9GB for 15 days and a small top-up of about PHP 10-20 a year keeps the number, with community tests receiving SMS in mainland China
dito-esim-cloud-number-63.regions: [PH] A +63 carrier number opened entirely online; passport registration required under the SIM law
dito-esim-cloud-number-63.content: DITO, the Philippines' third carrier, has the cheapest cloud-activated prepaid eSIM with a real number and low upkeep: order ₱99 on the eShop or in the app, take the QR code by email, install it and complete real-name registration in the app for a +63 carrier number rather than VoIP. The pack includes 9GB for any use, unlimited texts on any network, unlimited DITO-to-DITO calls and video plus 150 minutes to other networks for 15 days, so the first year costs ₱99 (about ¥12). Keeping it relies on top-ups, with the community using a small load of ₱10-20 a year; there is no official keep-alive plan, so the smallest top-up follows the app. Texts in mainland China worked from a November 2025 activation through August 2026, needing no data pack with data roaming off and voice roaming on. Real-name registration is mandatory: the SIM Registration Act needs a passport, foreign visitors usually also a Philippine address and return ticket, and tourist SIMs are legally valid 30 days.
dito-esim-cloud-number-63.conditions: Buy on the DITO eShop or in the app from ₱99 with 9GB for 15 days; register with a passport in the DITO app; under RA 11934 foreign tourists generally need a passport, Philippine address and return ticket, with tourist SIMs valid 30 days; an unlocked eSIM phone; texts in mainland China are community-tested rather than officially promised.
steps: Choose the prepaid eSIM (PHP 99 tier) in the DITO eShop or DITO app and pay
Receive the eSIM QR code by email and add the eSIM by scanning it in your phone settings
Install the DITO app, complete passport SIM registration and activate the number
To keep the number, make one lowest-tier top-up in the app before expiry (about PHP 10-20); turn data roaming off in mainland China if you only need SMS
dito-esim-cloud-number-63.risk: Registration is mandatory and a tourist SIM is legally limited to 30 days in principle, so long-term use sits in a grey zone; there is no official keep-alive package, so the app's lowest top-up governs, and third-party small top-up channels change; mainland China SMS reception is a community test rather than an official promise; some platforms risk-check Philippine ranges, so avoid using it as the only recovery route for a bank or main email; Wi-Fi Calling is not documented.
dito-esim-cloud-number-63.source: DITO official eSIM page and blog (checked 21 November 2026: PHP 99, 9GB for 15 days, online eShop and app purchase, app registration, device list) + Gao Notes 2026 eSIM-with-number comparison (12 August 2026, including mainland China SMS tests and keep-alive costs) + Deepchain eSIM guide (31 October 2026)

sosim-hk-esim-33-number.title: [Hong Kong] 3HK SoSIM eSIM: a +852 number for HK$33 with 50GB for 30 days, kept alive by topping up
sosim-hk-esim-33-number.highlight: 3 Hong Kong's SoSIM sells a HK$33 eSIM online or in its WeChat mini programme, with a QR code by email and a +852 number live in about ten minutes; a new card gets 50GB for 30 days in Hong Kong or 5 days of Asia-Pacific roaming, the number lasts 120 days and a top-up of HK$20 or more extends it, and with Hong Kong registration the card receives SMS while roaming
sosim-hk-esim-33-number.regions: [HK] A +852 number; the web store takes Visa, Mastercard, AlipayHK, mainland Alipay, WeChat Pay and UnionPay
sosim-hk-esim-33-number.content: A stored-value brand from Hutchison (3HK): new customers buy an eSIM for HK$33 at the SoSIM web store or WeChat mini-program, receive the QR code at a verified email and activate a real +852 number in about ten minutes. For HK$33 choose either 50GB of full-speed local data for 30 days with 1,500 local minutes, or five days of Asia-Pacific roaming (24 markets including Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand) plus 3GB of extra Hong Kong data for 30 days, switched in the account within 48 hours. Number validity is counted separately from the starter bundle and starts at 120 days, extended by a top-up of HK$20+ or a designated purchase, which the community usually does at about HK$60 a year. A first eSIM transfer is free and a nice number costs HK$8 (transfer alone is HK$28). The FAQ allows activation outside Hong Kong; local service needs real-name registration (passport or permit, manual review of 1-2 hours up to 48), which is optional for roaming data only, and after registration incoming texts are free abroad within validity while travelling in the mainland.
sosim-hk-esim-33-number.conditions: New customers buy at the SoSIM web store or mini-program from HK$33; install and activate within 60 days of payment; local Hong Kong service needs real-name registration (up to 48 hours) while roaming data does not; number validity from 120 days, extended by a HK$20+ top-up or designated purchase; incoming texts on mainland roaming depend on plan status.
steps: Buy the HK$33 eSIM on the SoSIM web store or in the WeChat mini programme, which accepts mainland Alipay and WeChat Pay
Scan the eSIM QR code from the email, connect to the network and receive the activation SMS with your number
Install the SoSIM app and complete registration with your passport or mainland travel permit if you need Hong Kong local service
Switch to the 50GB Hong Kong or Asia-Pacific package within 48 hours of activation, and top up at least HK$20 in the app before expiry to keep the number
sosim-hk-esim-33-number.risk: Hong Kong local use requires registration, and an unregistered card gets data only with no calls or SMS; number validity starts at only 120 days and forgetting to top up loses the number and the balance with no recovery; mainland China SMS reception is not itemised officially and depends on the package; Hong Kong ranges are often refused by AI platforms such as ChatGPT and Claude; eSIM support differs between Hong Kong and China-market iPhones, and China-market phones usually need an external eSIM adapter.
sosim-hk-esim-33-number.source: SoSIM official eSIM guide, web store, FAQ and new-joiner offer pages (checked 21 November 2026: from HK$33, ten-minute activation, 50GB for 30 days or 5 days Asia-Pacific, 120-day validity, top-up extension, registration required for Hong Kong use, roaming can skip it) + Deepchain eSIM guide and Digital Nomad LC keep-alive comparison (2026 figures of about HK$60 a year)

saily-us-number-annual.highlight: Saily from Nord Security adds a US +1 number inside its app: $0.99 to $1.99 a month or $11.99 a year, with incoming SMS free and unlimited so no calling pack is needed; a passport and face check are required after purchase, and keeping the number means keeping the subscription
saily-us-number-annual.regions: [US] A US +1 number opened in the Saily app anywhere in the world, with no US address or carrier
saily-us-number-annual.content: Nord Security's travel eSIM app began selling phone numbers in June 2026: a US +1 number that receives texts, takes calls and handles 2FA codes without a US address, carrier contract or physical SIM. It costs from $0.99 a month (the blog says $1.99) or $11.99 a year; incoming texts are free and unlimited, so code-only use needs no calling pack, while calling or texting needs a pack for the country you are in from $0.99. The number carries no data, which is bought as a separate Saily eSIM in the same app. After buying, upload a passport or government ID for a face check that usually clears in minutes with no US residency needed. Letting the subscription lapse loses the number, so annual is safer. Saily calls it a real US wireless number, but some services flag it as VoIP, so banks and exchanges are unreliable.
saily-us-number-annual.conditions: Buy in the Saily app; $0.99 a month or $11.99 a year (check the live price); incoming texts free, with calls and outgoing texts on a paid pack; complete passport or ID plus face KYC after purchase; no data included; a lapsed subscription loses the number; some platforms treat it as VoIP.
steps: Download the Saily app and open Phone number to pick a US +1 number
Choose annual ($11.99) or monthly billing and skip the destination data plan, since incoming SMS needs no pack
Upload a passport or government ID and complete the face check in the app
Activate the number and connect it through a Saily eSIM data plan; keep the subscription active to keep the number
saily-us-number-annual.risk: Some platforms treat the number as VoIP, so banks and exchanges may refuse it; letting the subscription lapse loses the number and there is no keep-alive package; KYC must pass or the purchase is wasted; the number has no data and needs a separate plan; the product page and the official blog quote different monthly prices ($0.99 and $1.99), so check the app before ordering; no third-party invite or discount code is used here.
saily-us-number-annual.source: Saily official Get an eSIM with a phone number page (checked 21 November 2026: +1 number, from $0.99 a month, in-app KYC) + Saily official blog How to get a US phone number overseas (9 November 2026: $1.99 a month, call and SMS plans from $0.99, incoming texts included)

bot-hosting-net-free-panel.title: [Global] bot-hosting.net free panel host: 256MB with any runtime (Node, Python) and no card, always on
bot-hosting-net-free-panel.highlight: A free container with no credit card: 256MB RAM, 25% CPU, 512MB storage and one deployment, any runtime from Node.js and Python to Go and Rust, with a custom port, static IP and free HTTPS subdomain, and no sleep mode according to the official page
bot-hosting-net-free-panel.regions: [Global] A web panel open worldwide; the free tier needs no card but renews manually every four days
bot-hosting-net-free-panel.content: A web panel host for Discord and Telegram bots and small services whose free tier unusually combines no card, any runtime and no sleeping: 256MB of RAM, 25% CPU, 512MB of storage and one deployment, with resources pooled so one allowance can split across several. Runtimes include Node, Python, Java, PHP, Go, Rust, C++, Lua and Bun, with one-click static or PHP sites, Lavalink and Uptime Kuma, and deploys from GitHub, ZIP uploads or the bh deploy CLI. Each deployment gets a port and static IP, a free HTTPS subdomain, environment variables, logs, a console and crash restarts. Free costs two things: manual renewal in the panel every four days or the server stops, and ads in the free panel. The notes of 17 November 2026 split free and paid capacity in the new panel, limit each user to one free server and retire the old panel.
bot-hosting-net-free-panel.conditions: Free gives 256MB, 25% CPU, 512MB and one deployment with no card; renew manually every four days or lose the server; one free server per user; ads in the free panel; custom ports; self-bots and other breach-of-terms uses are banned.
steps: Open bot-hosting.net and register, since the free tier needs no credit card
Create a deployment in the panel, pick a runtime such as Node.js or Python, and upload code from GitHub, a ZIP or the CLI
Set the start command and environment variables, and note the assigned port, static IP and free HTTPS subdomain
Return to the panel every four days to renew so the service keeps running
bot-hosting-net-free-panel.risk: Renewal every four days is manual and forgetting it stops the service; only one free server and the free panel carries ads; 256MB runs out on anything heavier and the process is killed; the official docs already cut free capacity for cost, so it can shrink again; abuse or terms violations lead to a ban.

katabump-free-pterodactyl-panel.content: Free Pterodactyl hosting: the free tier gives 308MB of RAM, 716MB of NVMe, 25% CPU and I/O 100 with no card, and the FAQ says the basic hosting plan is entirely free. Node.js (with package.json and index.js) and Python (requirements.txt and main.py) both work, running npm install or pip install on first start; files arrive by drag-and-drop ZIP up to 100MB, SFTP at fr-node-xx.katabump.fr:2022 with the server ID as the account, or git clone in the console, with environment variables, live logs and start-on-boot. Renew manually every four days, only within two days of expiry, since expiry stops the server immediately and files are deleted for good a day later; paid plans renew automatically. Only SQLite is free, with MariaDB paid and external MongoDB Atlas welcome.
katabump-free-pterodactyl-panel.conditions: 308MB, 716MB of NVMe and 25% CPU with no card; renew every four days, within two of expiry, or lose the server and, a day later, the files permanently; SQLite only; self-bots and terms breaches banned; custom start commands supported.

Choose the Node.js or Python runtime and upload package.json plus index.js, or requirements.txt plus main.py, over SFTP or with git clone

digitalplat-freedomain-dpdns.title: [Global] DigitalPlat FreeDomain: free .dpdns.org and .qzz.io names, ready for Cloudflare
digitalplat-freedomain-dpdns.highlight: The non-profit DigitalPlat gives away second-level domains: .dpdns.org, .qzz.io and .qd.je cost nothing to register or renew, and you delegate the NS records to Cloudflare to run DNS yourself; registration needs real WHOIS details and GitHub verification, with one domain per account by default
digitalplat-freedomain-dpdns.regions: [Global] Register on the web at dash.domain.digitalplat.org; DNS can live at Cloudflare
digitalplat-freedomain-dpdns.content: An open-source (AGPL-3.0) free public domain service with a GitHub repository in the hundreds of thousands of stars; its README claims over 500,000 domains registered. Registration and renewal are both free rather than just the first year, with suffixes currently .dpdns.org, .us.kg, .qzz.io, .xx.kg and .qd.je. It only registers names and delegates nameservers (bring your own DNS), so A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT and MX records stay at Cloudflare or your own authoritative DNS. The usual flow is adding the full domain at Cloudflare for two nameservers, then entering the prefix, suffix and nameservers in the dashboard, accepting the policy and, once active, adding records. Registration needs real name, email, phone and postal address (WHOIS may be public by default, with privacy available) and GitHub-based KYC; one domain per account by default; renew within 180 days of expiry at no charge.
digitalplat-freedomain-dpdns.conditions: A DigitalPlat account with genuine WHOIS details and GitHub KYC; one free domain per account by default, with allowances and suffix availability per the dashboard; external nameservers such as Cloudflare's two are required; free registration and renewal, within 180 days of expiry; phishing, spam and other abuse get domains reclaimed.
steps: Add the full domain you want, such as myname.dpdns.org, in Cloudflare and note the two name servers it assigns
Register at dash.domain.digitalplat.org with your real name, email, phone and address, and complete GitHub verification
Under Domain Registration enter the prefix, choose a suffix such as .dpdns.org, paste Cloudflare's name servers and submit
After the NS delegation goes live add A or CNAME records in Cloudflare, and renew free in the dashboard within 180 days of expiry
digitalplat-freedomain-dpdns.risk: Free does not mean permanent: suffixes, quotas and renewal rules can change and the operator can adjust them; free suffixes carry low reputation, so mail and ad network reviews are harder; WHOIS needs real details and may be public; DNS control sits with a third party such as Cloudflare, so outages are yours to debug; not suitable as a commercial primary domain or sole entry point.
digitalplat-freedomain-dpdns.source: DigitalPlat FreeDomain official dashboard and FAQ (checked 21 November 2026: free suffix list, one domain per account, starring not required, bring your own DNS) + DigitalPlatDev/FreeDomain docs on GitHub + community guides from Dorabc, China-ChatGPT and SEUS (2026)

waifly-free-nodejs-panel.title: [Global] Waifly permanent free Node.js panel host: 300MB RAM, 1GB storage and one MySQL database
waifly-free-nodejs-panel.highlight: A Pterodactyl panel host in Paris with a permanent free tier at zero cost, no card and no time limit: 300MB RAM, 30% of a vCPU, 1GB storage, one MySQL database and one port, plus a live console, web file manager, SFTP, scheduled tasks and backups; a server offline for three days is suspended
waifly-free-nodejs-panel.regions: [Global] Register on the web panel at dash.waifly.com; servers in Paris FR1 and FR2
waifly-free-nodejs-panel.content: Free Node.js hosting from a French team: the free tier is €0 forever rather than a trial, with no expiry, no card and no monthly hour limit, so a process can run continuously. It gives 300MB of RAM, 30% of a core, 1GB of storage, one MySQL database and one port in a Pterodactyl container on Proxmox and Docker, without root or SSH but with a live console, a browser file manager with an editor, SFTP, cron jobs, backups and DDoS protection. Register at dash.waifly.com, create a server with the NodeJS egg in Paris, and a package.json triggers npm install on start, with the entry point set on the Startup page and the port supplied by environment variable. Point an A record at the server IP and register it for automatic Nginx config. Discord and Telegram bots, Express or Fastify APIs, scrapers and webhooks fit in 300MB, while Next.js builds, Puppeteer and transcoding need the €4 a month Nano tier. A server offline over three days is paused, and one account per person is enforced against duplicates.
waifly-free-nodejs-panel.conditions: Free means 300MB, 30% vCPU, 1GB, one MySQL and one port at €0 forever with no card or hour limit; offline over three days pauses it; one account per person; no root or SSH, only the panel, SFTP and MySQL.
steps: Register at dash.waifly.com, since the free tier needs no credit card
Open Servers, click Create, choose the NodeJS Egg and the FR1 or FR2 location, and the free limits apply automatically
Upload the project with its package.json and set the entry file and start command on the Startup tab
Start it and read the npm install output and logs in the live console; keep the server online, since three days offline suspends it
waifly-free-nodejs-panel.risk: No root and no SSH means no system packages; 300MB is a hard ceiling, so builds and Puppeteer do not run; three days offline suspends the server, so the process must stay active; one account per person is enforced by automated checks; only Paris nodes are available, so latency from Asia is high.
waifly-free-nodejs-panel.source: Waifly official free Node.js hosting guide (updated 12 August 2026, written by the founder: 300MB, 1GB, MySQL, permanently free, three-day offline suspension, one account per person) + Waifly official site and docs.waifly.com

In the dashboard click Create Server and fill in the server name and description
Upload code or connect a Git repository, then set the start command and environment variables
Press Start to run it, and log into the panel once every 14 days to keep it

makefun-ai-agent-bounties-usdc.title: [Global] make.fun: AI agents win USDC on coding bounties, mostly free to enter, plus a top-1,000 participation reward
makefun-ai-agent-bounties-usdc.highlight: Build a bounty with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any other agent, submit a public repo plus the AI session transcripts, and a sandbox ranks entries on a published metric; rewards sit in an on-chain Solana escrow and pay out in USDC, most bounties are free to enter, and since 18 November a top-1,000 finish without a paid place still earns a small participation reward, claimable once the balance reaches $0.25
makefun-ai-agent-bounties-usdc.regions: [Global] Online and open worldwide; a public GitHub repo, AI session log and Solana wallet are needed
makefun-ai-agent-bounties-usdc.content: A skills contest where AI agents build software for cash: each bounty states the task, prize and metrics, entrants use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot or similar to produce the work, submit a public repo at a fixed commit plus the AI session log that produced it, and the platform checks the two against each other before scoring every entry twice in the same sandbox. Prizes sit in USDC escrow on Solana (open source and checkable), and winners claim them to their own wallets rather than being paid out. Since 9 November 2026 it has paid $5,967.50 to 413 accounts. Almost all bounties are free, any entry fees go into that pot, and model costs are yours unless the bounty supplies a sponsor build key. From 18 November a top-1,000 finish without a prize slot earns a share of an extra pool, larger with rank, usually under a cent but accumulating across bounties, claimable to a Solana wallet at $0.25. Live bounties run $35 to $1,666 ($35 poems, $50 spot-the-difference and posters, $100-250 news images and data forecasts, $250 GTA 6 covers and trophy guides, $500 video edits and a 4KB Python chess engine, $1,000/$1,325/$1,666 higher-end tasks).
makefun-ai-agent-bounties-usdc.conditions: Register and connect a Solana wallet; submissions need a fixed-commit public repo plus the AI session log, which must pass the automatic check; most bounties are free and any fee is stated; model costs are yours; only ranked prize slots pay, with the top-1,000 share as a small extra; claim within at least seven days of winning, pass sanctions screening and file US tax forms where required; unclaimed prizes return to the funder.
steps: Sign up at make.fun and prepare a public GitHub repository and a Solana wallet
Pick a free-to-enter bounty under Live bounties and read its requirements, reward, paid places and deadline
Build the work with your own AI coding agent and submit the repository at one commit with the session transcripts
Wait for the automatic checks and two sandbox runs, then press Claim on your profile to move the USDC to your own Solana wallet
makefun-ai-agent-bounties-usdc.risk: Earnings are entirely unguaranteed: the platform calls a bounty a competition rather than a wage, an entry outside the paid places earns nothing, and participation rewards are often under a cent; model calls are your own cost and can exceed the reward; submitting requires public source and full session transcripts, exposing your code and prompts; claiming needs a sanctions screen and possibly a US tax form, and unclaimed rewards return to the funder; the platform only launched in November 2026, so its long-term policies and payout reliability are untested.
makefun-ai-agent-bounties-usdc.source: make.fun official homepage and documentation (checked 21 November 2026: most bounties free, rewards in on-chain escrow, $5,967.50 paid to 413 accounts, public repo plus transcripts required, rewards by rank) + official X account @makefunai announcement of 18 November 2026 (top-1,000 participation reward, claim from $0.25) + official escrow repository github.com/makefunai/prize-escrow

boa-advantage-tiered-1000.risk: The $1,000 tier requires a direct invitation and the public offer tops out at $500; any Bank of America checking account in the past 12 months disqualifies you; direct deposit rules are strict and transfers or Zelle do not count; an unwaived monthly fee takes a chunk of the bonus; the bonus is taxable interest reported on a 1099-INT.
boa-advantage-tiered-1000.source: Bank of America's official offer page and terms (read 21 November 2026: open by 31 January 2027, 90-day direct deposits, paid within 60 days, targeted version described) plus USCard.io (13 October 2026 bonus chart check), usdailyrewards' bonus roundup (18 November 2026) and yunjumin (16 October 2026, including the $1,000 targeted tier and ITIN experience)

pnc-virtual-wallet-400.regions: [US] US residents who are new PNC personal checking customers
pnc-virtual-wallet-400.content: Open Virtual Wallet by 7 January 2027 and take $500+ in qualifying direct deposits into the Spend account within 60 days for $100; open Virtual Wallet with Performance Select and take $5,000+ within 60 days for $400. Bonuses post 60–90 days after qualifying as a Credits Check Reward, with the account still open. Monthly fees are $7 (waivable) and $25 (waivable); stay in the product you opened, since switching mid-way can change eligibility and the amount.
pnc-virtual-wallet-400.conditions: New PNC personal checking customers only: no PNC consumer checking account for the applicant or any signer, none closed in the past 12 months and no PNC promo bonus in the past 24 months; open online from the offer page or at a branch with the coupon code; qualifying deposits are only recurring employer or government payments such as salary, pension and Social Security into Spend, not cash advances, wires, P2P, internal transfers or teller, ATM or mobile check deposits; extra accounts under the same signers count once.
steps: Open Virtual Wallet online from the PNC offer page, or take the code to a branch
Bring $500 or $5,000 of qualifying direct deposits into the Spend account within 60 days
Keep the account and product unchanged and wait 60 to 90 days for the reward
Meet the fee waiver for your tier, especially the $25 monthly fee on Performance Select

pnc-virtual-wallet-400.source: PNC's official bonus offer page and legal disclosures (read 21 November 2026: 1 September 2026 to 7 January 2027, $100 and $400 tiers, 60-day deposits, 60 to 90 day payout) plus yunjumin (11 September 2026, with ITIN and non-resident limits)

etrade-max-rate-checking-400.highlight: Open Max-Rate Checking online with code MAXRATE26 and take two direct deposits of $1,500 or more within 90 days for $400, paid around day 120; no monthly fee, no minimum balance and global ATM fees refunded
etrade-max-rate-checking-400.regions: [US] Online nationwide (Morgan Stanley Private Bank, FDIC); US tax ID and address
etrade-max-rate-checking-400.content: Open Max-Rate Checking online by 10 January 2027 with code MAXRATE26 at application (it cannot be added later) and receive at least two direct deposits of $1,500+ within 90 days for $400, paid around day 120 as DIRECT DEPOSIT BONUS DOLLARS. etrade-max-rate-checking-400.conditions: New customers with no E*Trade checking account, joint included, in the past 12 months; enter MAXRATE26 at application; two qualifying direct deposits of $1,500+ each (salary, pension or government benefits via ACH) within 90 days, excluding internal transfers, Zelle, RTP, wires and checks; the account must be in good standing at day 90 and at payout; once per person, and a joint application pays only the first applicant.
steps: Open Max-Rate Checking online from the offer page, entering MAXRATE26 and saving a screenshot
Confirm the limited-time promotional offer email arrives, and contact support if it does not
Route two paychecks of $1,500 or more each into the account within 90 days
Use it as a normal checking account with bill payments and card purchases, then check for the bonus around day 120
etrade-max-rate-checking-400.risk: The code cannot be added after opening, so a missed code wastes the application; E*Trade is strict on risk and locking, and moving all the money out at once can restrict the account or forfeit the bonus; the terms name low-balance, no-activity behaviour as possible gaming; the bonus is taxable; non-residents do not qualify.
etrade-max-rate-checking-400.source: E*Trade's official Max-Rate Checking product page and offer terms (checked 20 October 2026: MAXRATE26, 10 January 2027, two $1,500 deposits) plus StackTheDeal (20 October 2026) and usdailyrewards (21 October 2026, with lock-up and direct-deposit data points)

wells-fargo-everyday-checking-325.title: [US]Wells Fargo Everyday Checking $500: $1,000 in qualifying electronic deposits within 90 days (open by 2027-01-12)

wells-fargo-everyday-checking-325.regions: [US] US residents with an SSN/tax ID; non-residents filing W-8 and foreign entities excluded
wells-fargo-everyday-checking-325.content: Open from the official offer page with at least $25 and the offer code, by 13 January 2027, then receive $1,000+ in qualifying electronic deposits within 90 calendar days for $325, paid within 30 days of qualifying. wells-fargo-everyday-checking-325.conditions: New checking customers and primary account owners only; no Wells Fargo consumer checking bonus in the past 12 months; not for non-resident aliens or foreign entities filing any version of IRS Form W-8; only Everyday Checking can be opened online, other accounts need an emailed code for a branch; cannot be combined with other deposit offers, one per customer; the account must stay open and unrestricted at payout.
steps: Open Everyday Checking from accountoffers.wellsfargo.com/checkingoffer so the code is applied automatically
Deposit at least $25 and route payroll or other qualifying electronic deposits into the account
Reach $1,000 within 90 days and check for the bonus within the following 30 days
Pick a fee waiver that fits you so the $15 monthly fee does not eat the bonus
wells-fargo-everyday-checking-325.risk: The site carries $325, $400 and $500 versions at the same time, so the amount depends on which page you apply from; an unwaived $15 monthly fee eats most of the bonus; the bonus is taxable income (1099-INT); closing early can claw it back; non-residents filing W-8 do not qualify.
wells-fargo-everyday-checking-325.source: Wells Fargo official $500 offer page welcomebonus (read 2026-11-26: $500, open by 2027-01-12, $1,000 qualifying electronic deposits in 90 days) + official $325 checkingoffer page still live the same day + uscard.io (2026-11-11, three tiers) + usdailyrewards and Doctor of Credit (reporting the $500 return since 11-10)

amex-rewards-checking-300.title: [US] Amex Rewards Checking $300: $7,500 of direct deposits within 90 days (open by 1 February 2027)

amex-rewards-checking-300.regions: [US] US Amex personal cardholders or Amex High Yield Savings/CD customers with a US tax ID and address
amex-rewards-checking-300.content: Open your first Amex Rewards Checking by 1 February 2027 and take $7,500+ in qualifying direct deposits within 90 days for $300, paid in 8-12 weeks.
