amex-rewards-checking-300.conditions: You must already hold a US Amex personal Basic Consumer Card as primary or supplementary holder, or an Amex High Yield Savings account or CD; no prior Rewards Checking, and one per customer; $7,500+ in qualifying direct deposits within 90 days, counting only employer or government ACH salary, pension, Social Security and tax refunds, not P2P, account transfers, internal Amex savings transfers, checks or MR redemptions; the account must stay open until payout.
steps: Confirm you hold an Amex US consumer card or Amex savings account or CD
Apply for Rewards Checking from the official American Express page
Fund the account within 60 days and route payroll direct deposits into it
Reach $7,500 within 90 days and check for the bonus within 8 to 12 weeks
amex-rewards-checking-300.risk: Open only to people who already have an Amex relationship, including a three-month card history, so many applicants are blocked; the $7,500 direct deposit bar is high; direct deposit rules are strict and P2P or transfers do not count; an unfunded account is closed after 60 days; the bonus is taxable interest.
amex-rewards-checking-300.source: American Express official welcome bonus terms PDF ($300, open by 1 February 2027, $7,500 in 90 days, paid in 8 to 12 weeks, read 21 November 2026), the official product page eligibility note, Frequent Miler (3 September 2026) and Perkful (19 November 2026 recheck)

icbc-global-travel-plus-2pct.title: [China] ICBC Global Travel Plus credit cards: 2% back on overseas spending, ¥500 a month on platinum (to 31 December)
icbc-global-travel-plus-2pct.highlight: ICBC Global Travel Plus cards on the Mastercard or Visa network earn 2% cashback on spending outside mainland China including Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan, in stores or online, capped at ¥500 a month and ¥5,000 a year on platinum and ¥200 a month on gold
icbc-global-travel-plus-2pct.regions: [CN] ICBC Global Travel Plus cards issued in mainland China (Mastercard or Visa); overseas and HK/Macau/Taiwan spend
icbc-global-travel-plus-2pct.value: 2% cashback, ¥500 a month and ¥5,000 a year on platinum (≈$70 a month)
icbc-global-travel-plus-2pct.content: From 1 January to 31 December 2026, Global Travel Plus cards on Mastercard or Visa earn 2% back on spending outside mainland China, including Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan, online or in store. Platinum caps at ¥500 a customer a month and ¥5,000 a year; gold at ¥200 a month and ¥2,000 a year. Monthly pools (¥209,000 on Visa, ¥349,000 on Mastercard) are first come, first served, and cashback posts to the card in the transaction's billing currency the day after the posting date.
icbc-global-travel-plus-2pct.conditions: Global Travel Plus cards on Mastercard or Visa only, with different caps for platinum and gold; spending must run on the Mastercard or Visa network, so transactions routed through third-party payment channels do not count; overseas cash advances, transfers, repayments, returns, tax refunds, reversals and cancellations earn nothing; monthly pools are first come, first served; primary and supplementary cards share one customer-level cap.
steps: Confirm you hold an ICBC Global Travel Plus card and pay over the Mastercard or Visa network
Spend abroad or on cross-border shopping directly on the card network, not through Alipay or WeChat Pay
Check the cashback line the day after posting and watch whether the monthly pool has run out
Plan large purchases around the platinum or gold monthly cap
icbc-global-travel-plus-2pct.risk: Only the Global Travel Plus card qualifies, not other ICBC cards; the monthly pool is first come first served, so large purchases near month end can miss out; third-party payment routing never counts, so a habitual Alipay checkout earns nothing; overseas transactions still carry conversion costs that can exceed 2%.
icbc-global-travel-plus-2pct.source: ICBC's official Global Travel Plus credit card product page and benefit terms (1 January to 31 December 2026, ¥500 a month on platinum, ¥200 on gold, Visa and Mastercard monthly pools, read 21 November 2026), with FLYERT's overseas cashback coverage as the lead

boc-unionpay-overseas-3pct.title: [China] Bank of China UnionPay credit cards: 3% cashback on overseas offline spending, capped at ¥200 a month (to 31 December, enrolment required)
boc-unionpay-overseas-3pct.highlight: Mainland-issued Bank of China UnionPay credit cards earn 3% cashback on offline purchases through the UnionPay network abroad including Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan, capped at ¥200 per person per month, after enrolling in the campaign
boc-unionpay-overseas-3pct.regions: [CN] Bank of China UnionPay cards issued in mainland China (62 single-brand or 40/43 dual-brand); overseas and HK/Macau/Taiwan
boc-unionpay-overseas-3pct.content: From 8 April to 31 December 2026, overseas offline spending in Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan and beyond on the UnionPay clearing network earns a chance of 3% cashback per transaction, capped at ¥200 per cardholder per calendar month on UnionPay. The reward pool totals ¥3.186 million (¥334,000 each in April, June, July, September and November, ¥379,000 each in May, August, October and December) and fills by UnionPay's recorded transaction time; cashback posts within 25 working days to the first qualifying card of that month. Enrol before spending, since earlier transactions are not counted and the bank neither enrols customers nor backfills.
boc-unionpay-overseas-3pct.conditions: A UnionPay-branded BOC card issued in mainland China (62 single-brand or 40/43 dual-brand, supplementary cards can enrol separately); enrol first in the China Bank Credit Card WeChat account or BOC app and tick the card; only overseas offline transactions on the UnionPay network count, including in-store Apple Pay; cash advances, offline electronic cash, tax refunds, pre-authorisations and third-party payment channels do not; pools are first come, first served monthly; a replaced card must enrol again; refunded or reversed transactions earn nothing and cashback already paid can be clawed back.
steps: Follow the Bank of China credit card WeChat account and bind your card, or open the Bank of China app
Go to Campaigns, cross-border enrolment, UnionPay overseas spending enrolment, tick the cards and confirm
Spend offline abroad or in Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan through the UnionPay network by card, tap, UnionPay QR or mobile tap
Check the statement line for the 3% cashback within 25 working days of the transaction posting
boc-unionpay-overseas-3pct.risk: Enrolment is mandatory and forgetting it means no cashback; the monthly pool runs out first come first served, so late-month large purchases may earn nothing; the terms say purchases may earn the reward rather than guaranteeing it; only UnionPay offline settlement counts, so online and third-party payment routes fail; overseas purchases carry currency conversion costs that eat into 3%; refunds claw back paid cashback.
boc-unionpay-overseas-3pct.source: Bank of China credit card official WeChat terms (8 April to 31 December 2026, 3% cashback, ¥200 monthly cap, ¥3.186 million pool and enrolment path, read 21 November 2026) plus the FLYERT card news article (a-524651) on the same campaign

octopus-mobile-welcome-150.title: [Hong Kong] HK$150 mobile Octopus new-customer welcome: add the card, spend HK$100 in one go, register (to 3 January 2027)
octopus-mobile-welcome-150.highlight: First-time mobile Octopus users who spend HK$100 or more in a single transaction and register on the promotion page get HK$150 of stored value, plus a free card face
octopus-mobile-welcome-150.regions: [HK] Mobile Octopus on iPhone, Apple Watch, Android, Samsung Pay, Huawei Wallet or Citi Octopus on iPhone
octopus-mobile-welcome-150.content: From 5 November 2026 to 3 January 2027, add a mobile Octopus to an eligible device for the first time or move a physical card onto the phone (iPhone and Apple Watch, Android, Samsung Pay, Huawei Wallet or Citi Octopus on iPhone), register the card number at octopus.com.hk/mo and spend HK$100 or more in one transaction on it for HK$150 of added value, limited to the first 13,210. Android also needs the latest Octopus app signed into an Octopus Wallet account and the Android Octopus in Google Wallet. Claim from day seven to day 30 after qualifying in the Octopus app or at a service station, and pick a free custom card face by 10 January 2027.
octopus-mobile-welcome-150.conditions: Customers and devices that had never held a mobile Octopus before the campaign; cards added through the Tourist Octopus app are excluded by clause 7; top-ups and card, debit or wallet funding do not count as spending, which must be a real merchant transaction of HK$100+ in one go; register before spending; one reward per person; the card must still exist and not be removed or refunded at claim, or the reward is forfeited; JoyYou on mobile has separate terms.
steps: Add a new mobile Octopus in the Octopus App or Apple Wallet, or move a physical card onto the phone
Register the full card number (including the digits in brackets) at octopus.com.hk/mo
Spend HK$100 or more in a single transaction with that card (top-ups do not count)
Turn on Octopus App notifications and collect the HK$150 within 30 days from day seven
octopus-mobile-welcome-150.risk: Tourist-app cards are excluded and many online guides wrongly use that route; Android phones need Google services and Google Wallet, which mainland models often lack; only 13,210 rewards exist; registering in the wrong order or mistyping the card number forfeits the reward; the value cannot be cashed out and removing or refunding the card cancels it.
octopus-mobile-welcome-150.source: Octopus official promotion page and terms PDF (5 November 2026 to 3 January 2027, 13,210 rewards, Android must use Google Wallet) plus an ecitizen.forum thread (20 November 2026) with a data point of no reward after spending on 15 November

usims-free-esim-1gb.title: [Global] USIMS free first 1GB eSIM: 120+ countries (ended; a top-up is now required, non-+86 number needed)
usims-free-esim-1gb.highlight: Archived: the free first 1GB has ended. On 2026-11-22 the Data Plans page at usims.com listed paid bundles only, from $9 (France and UK, 10GB over 10 days) with most countries from $10, so USIMS now needs a top-up or a paid plan to use; the detail page stays for reference, with alternatives listed on top
usims-free-esim-1gb.regions: [Global] 120+ countries including the US, UK, France, Germany, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia and the Middle East; a non-+86 number to register
usims-free-esim-1gb.content: Archived, as the free first gigabyte is no longer issued. USIMS advertised Your First GB is On Us: install the app, register and activate an eSIM for 1GB free across 120+ countries, with sample prices of $15 for 10GB over ten days in the US, $9 for ten days in France and the UK and $10 in Germany and Spain. Tests also found an Activate Free Data button issuing a permanent low-speed tier around 128kbps, enough for text apps, maps and WhatsApp with an exit on Orange in France, plus $3 each for referrals. Rechecked on 22 November 2026, the Data Plans page sells only paid plans from $9 with no free entry point, so the free gigabyte has ended with no published end date and a recorded cutoff of 21 November 2026.
usims-free-esim-1gb.conditions: Archived and now paid: historically an eSIM phone and a real non-+86 number for codes; the first gigabyte only for new accounts; the low-speed tier a separate pack rather than the gigabyte; allow a minute or two before the eSIM shows.
steps: Download the USIMS app or sign up at usims.com
Verify with a real non-+86 phone number
Pick a destination, activate the eSIM and claim the free first GB
For the always-on low-speed tier, return to the homepage and tap Activate Free Data
usims-free-esim-1gb.risk: Archived as expired: the free first 1GB is no longer issued and USIMS now needs a top-up or paid plan (the cheapest listed bundle is $9), so do not register expecting the free GB. Historic risks remain: the low-speed tier ran at about 128kbps, so video and hotspot use were out; +86 numbers could not register and virtual numbers often failed; paid bundles have to be topped up when used up; eSIM support and network locks still apply.
usims-free-esim-1gb.source: USIMS official site (read 21 November 2026: the first-GB gift and country pricing) and an ecitizen.forum thread (20 September 2026) covering the 128kbps tier and a +372 number test

google-ai-blackfriday-annual-50.title: [Multi-region] Google AI Plus / AI Pro annual Black Friday deal: up to 50% off, US Pro $99.99 for the first year (early access to Nov 27 noon Beijing, new customers from Nov 27)
google-ai-blackfriday-annual-50.highlight: Accounts already paying for Google AI or Google One storage keep the early-access price until 26 November US time, which is noon Beijing on 27 November with banners down by 15:59 at the latest; accounts without a subscription get a separate offer from Black Friday, 27 November, whose end date Google has not published
google-ai-blackfriday-annual-50.regions: [Multi-region] Priced by account region and current plan (US Pro $99.99 a year, Taiwan NT$3,250)
google-ai-blackfriday-annual-50.content: Google's early Black Friday from 20 to 26 November 2026 Eastern: accounts already paying for Google AI or Google One storage can switch Google AI Plus or annual Google AI Pro to the discounted annual price, up to 50% off depending on plan and account. US Google AI Pro (5TB, Gemini 4 Neon, YouTube Premium Lite individual) drops from $199.99 to $99.99 for the first year and renews at $199.99 after 12 months; Taiwan Pro falls from NT$6,500 to NT$3,250, and AI Plus (400GB, Gemini 4 Hydrogen) is included. Ultra (20TB or 30TB) and Pro 10TB are monthly only and excluded. Accounts without a subscription see no entry point. Google has confirmed free accounts get a separate new-customer offer from Black Friday, 27 November, but had not published the size of the discount or its end date as of 26 November; past years closed around Cyber Monday, so the plan page decides. Community tests add that Plus 2TB and account holders already annual often miss it, and that monthly Pro users may need to switch to monthly and back for $99.99 to appear. Australia and New Zealand: Plus 400GB A$44.99, Plus 2TB A$74.99 and Pro 5TB A$184.99 a year.
google-ai-blackfriday-annual-50.conditions: Existing paid Google AI or Google One storage subscribers only, with free accounts excluded; the discount tops out at 50% and varies by plan, so checkout decides; AI Plus and annual AI Pro only, without Ultra or Pro 10TB; no stacking with other Google One offers; year one renews at list price unless cancelled; a valid Google Payments method. The early-access window closes at noon Beijing time on 27 November (15:59 at the latest), and free accounts can buy from 27 November with no published end date.
steps: Open one.google.com/ai or the Google One all-plans page with the subscribed account
Check whether your account shows the annual discount (some see 50%, some only 25%, some nothing)
Pick annual Google AI Pro or AI Plus and confirm the first-year amount at checkout
Cancel before the year ends if you will not pay full price; the remaining period stays usable
google-ai-blackfriday-annual-50.risk: The discount varies by account and region, so the advertised 50% is not universal; the annual plan renews at full price and is easy to forget; student pricing or a family group may be cheaper; some regions or payment methods never see an annual option; changing region or payment method can cost you eligibility. Google has published neither the size nor the end date of the new-customer offer, so the price then may differ from the early-access tier.
google-ai-blackfriday-annual-50.source: Google Gemini subscription lead Vikas Kansal's 20 November 2026 announcement, the official Google One plan page (checked 21 November 2026: US Pro $99.99 first year, $199.99 after), and an ecitizen.forum thread (21 November 2026); rechecked 26 November 2026 against Sulat, scriptbyai, whichaitopay and Canaltech reports of 24 and 25 November (early access to 26 November US time, non-subscribers from 27 November, Ultra excluded), a NodeSeek roundup of 26 November (existing subscribers until 12:00 Beijing on 27 November, 15:59 at the latest, free accounts after noon) and the Google One page still carrying the member early-access banner

a1-croatia-prepaid-esim.title: [Croatia] A1 Croatia prepaid eSIM: a +385 number cloud-activated for EUR 3 with EUR 3 back as credit, kept alive from EUR 2 for 92 days
a1-croatia-prepaid-esim.highlight: Buy the eSIM for EUR 3 on the official SIM-promo page; the QR code and number arrive by email and the EUR 3 comes back as account credit. A EUR 2-14 top-up buys 92 days, EUR 50-100 buys 360 days, and a 270-day window after expiry still receives SMS.
a1-croatia-prepaid-esim.regions: [HR] A +385 number opened fully online; mainland roaming partners are China Mobile and China Unicom
a1-croatia-prepaid-esim.value: EUR 3 starter (EUR 3 back as credit); about EUR 8 a year to keep
a1-croatia-prepaid-esim.content: The eSIM option on the SIM-promo page costs €3: choose eSIM, enter an email and contact details, pay online and the QR code arrives immediately, then scan, activate and get a +385 number, with the €3 returned as credit since the terms give €3 for registering details. A free physical SIM on the same page ships only inside Croatia, so eSIM is the only remote option. Validity runs 180 days from activation, after which top-ups buy days: 2-14 euros gives 92, 15-29 gives 120, 30-49 gives 180 and 50-100 gives 360; for 270 days after expiry the line only receives calls and texts and a top-up rescues it before the number closes. In mainland China the roaming partners are China Mobile and China Unicom on 4G/LTE with incoming texts free; Wi-Fi calling is closed to prepaid, since support confirmed prepaid VoLTE was withdrawn and Wi-Fi calling remains a business-plan feature.
a1-croatia-prepaid-esim.conditions: Buy the eSIM on the SIM-promo page for €3, with the QR code and number by email and €3 back as credit; outside Croatia only eSIM is sold (physical SIMs ship domestically); validity follows the terms: 180 days from activation, then 2-14 euros for 92 days, 15-29 for 120, 30-49 for 180 and 50-100 for 360, recoverable within 270 days of expiry; an unlocked eSIM phone; an international card; no passport upload in community tests, though Croatian law requires registration, so follow the page; the €3 credit is a promotion that may end.
steps: Choose the eSIM option on the official SIM-promo page, enter an email and contact details and pay EUR 3
Receive the QR code and number by email, install the eSIM and finish activation on the web page
Top up as needed: EUR 2 adds 92 days, or one EUR 50 top-up adds 360 days
Inside the 270-day window after expiry, one top-up keeps the number; after that it is closed
a1-croatia-prepaid-esim.risk: The EUR 3 credit-back is a webshop promotion that can end anytime; Croatian prepaid registration requirements apply and the order page's actual fields govern; validity depends on the top-up amount, so a small top-up buys only 92 days and the claim of EUR 2 keeping a number for a year does not hold; roaming in mainland China guarantees SMS reception only, as data is expensive; VoWiFi is closed to prepaid per A1 support; cards may fail fraud checks and credit is not refundable. Third-party eUICC: a community test in July 2026 found 9eSIM writes the profile but it is incompatible and never goes online, so use eSTK instead.
a1-croatia-prepaid-esim.source: A1 Hrvatska official SIM-promo page and the Uvjeti korištenja A1 usluge na bonove effective 1 December 2025 + official roaming tariff and partner network pages (checked 21 November 2026: China Mobile and China Unicom as partners in China, received SMS not charged) + Digital Residents forum thread on the Croatian A1 eSIM (2 April 2026)

vodafone-nl-prepaid-esim.title: [Netherlands] Vodafone Netherlands prepaid eSIM: a Dutch number from EUR 14 with no monthly fee, kept alive by one paid action every 6 months
vodafone-nl-prepaid-esim.highlight: Buy a prepaid eSIM on act.vodafone.nl: 7 days of unlimited data for EUR 14 (down from EUR 24), 14 days for EUR 24, 30 days for EUR 44, including a Dutch number that can receive SMS. Afterwards there is no monthly fee, and one paid use or top-up every 6 months keeps the number.
vodafone-nl-prepaid-esim.regions: [NL] A +31 number bought online with no ID; 2GB a day roaming in the EU
vodafone-nl-prepaid-esim.value: From EUR 14 (7 days unlimited data plus a Dutch number)
vodafone-nl-prepaid-esim.content: Order at act.vodafone.nl/prepaid-esim and get an activation link or QR code, connect straight away and receive a Dutch number that takes calls and texts; calling or texting out needs a top-up on the prepaid account first. Prices are €14 for seven days of unlimited data (down from €24), €24 for 14 days and €44 for 30, with 25GB a day fair use in the Netherlands and 2GB a day roaming in the EU. Validity starts at the first data connection and ends at 23:59 Dutch time on day 7, 14 or 30 without auto-renewal. Keeping the number depends on the prepaid account: paid use or a top-up keeps the balance and number, only six months with no paid activity starts a restriction period (calls and texts still arrive for two months) before the number closes; texts cost €0.15.
vodafone-nl-prepaid-esim.conditions: Pay online with an international card (VISA passes in tests, some cards are blocked); the pack's Dutch number takes calls and texts, while outgoing needs a top-up; validity runs from first connection without auto-renewal; keep it alive with paid use or a top-up every six months; an unlocked eSIM phone; no ID upload; Wi-Fi calling needs a Dutch IP and does not work abroad; incoming texts are free on China roaming, outgoing cost €0.60.
steps: Choose the 7, 14 or 30 day bundle on act.vodafone.nl/prepaid-esim and pay
Install the eSIM from the activation link or QR code on the confirmation page or email
Top up the prepaid account before making calls or sending texts
Do one paid action every 6 months, such as a top-up or a EUR 0.15 text, to keep the number
vodafone-nl-prepaid-esim.risk: EUR 14 is a promotional price against a EUR 24 list price and moves with campaigns; this is a travel data product, so long-term keeping relies on separate top-ups and is bound by the 6-month rule; the eSIM includes no outbound call or SMS credit; inbound SMS in China are free with sending at EUR 0.60 and VoWiFi needs a Dutch IP; international cards can be declined. Third-party eUICC: a community test in September 2026 found 9eSIM cannot write this card because Vodafone profiles clash with ARA-M, so use eSTK or a native eSIM.
vodafone-nl-prepaid-esim.source: Vodafone Netherlands official prepaid eSIM page (checked 21 November 2026: 7 days EUR 14 down from EUR 24, 14 days EUR 24, 30 days EUR 44, Dutch number included, validity rules, 25GB daily fair use) + official prepaid FAQ on the 6-month keep-alive rule (relayed item by item in November 2026) + Digital Residents forum thread (13 October 2026)

asda-mobile-payg-esim.title: [UK] Asda Mobile pay-as-you-go eSIM: no monthly fee, 10p a text, kept alive by one paid action every 180 days plus free Wi-Fi calling
asda-mobile-payg-esim.highlight: A UK prepaid card on the Vodafone network: no monthly fee, 15p a minute, 10p a text and 10p a megabyte. One paid use or top-up every 180 days keeps the number, with a 90-day recovery window after that, and Wi-Fi calling is free for every customer.
asda-mobile-payg-esim.regions: [UK] A +44 number on Vodafone; eSIM for phones only, not tablets or watches
asda-mobile-payg-esim.value: No monthly fee; kept alive for 10p every 180 days (about GBP 0.20 a year)
asda-mobile-payg-esim.content: The MVNO of UK supermarket Asda on Vodafone's network, prepaid with either a monthly plan or pay-as-you-go and no credit check or contract. Pay-as-you-go rates are 15p a minute, 10p a text and 10p a megabyte with no monthly fee. Validity runs 180 days from activation, a top-up or a plan purchase and resets with any paid call, text, data use or top-up; 180 idle days bring a restricted state with no outgoing calls but incoming calls and texts still arriving, and 90 more days ends it all. One 10p text every six months keeps a UK number indefinitely. Choose eSIM at checkout and download the QR code from the online account, with a free physical-to-eSIM swap; Wi-Fi calling is free for every customer seven days after activation, so a UK number calls and texts over Wi-Fi in the mainland.
asda-mobile-payg-esim.conditions: Choose eSIM at checkout (phones only), with the QR code in the online account; 15p a minute, 10p a text and 10p a megabyte with no monthly fee; keep it with one paid action every 180 days, recoverable within 90 days of expiry; top-ups need a UK-registered Visa or Mastercard; Wi-Fi calling free from seven days after activation; 46-country EU roaming follows the plan, while mainland China sits in the World Group at £1.40 a minute to answer and £0.20 a text.
steps: Choose a one-month plan or plain pay-as-you-go on the Asda Mobile site and select eSIM at checkout
Install and activate the eSIM from the QR code in the online account after paying
Top up or make one paid call or text within every 180 days to keep the number
In mainland China use Wi-Fi calling for calls and texts instead of roaming
asda-mobile-payg-esim.risk: Top-ups require a card registered to a UK address, so non-UK cards are often declined; 180 days without a paid action restricts the line and 270 days expires it with no credit refund; eSIMs are phone-only; roaming in mainland China costs GBP 1.40 a minute to receive calls and the received-SMS rate is not listed; Wi-Fi calling depends on network registration and is not promised to work from mainland China.
asda-mobile-payg-esim.source: Asda Mobile official eSIM, rates and charges, topping up and Wi-Fi calling pages (checked 21 November 2026: 15p calls, 10p texts, 10p per MB, 180 plus 90 day rules, UK-card top-up limit, free Wi-Fi calling) + Digital Residents forum thread comparing Asda with Voxi (12 November 2026)

lebara-uk-payg-esim.title: [UK] Lebara UK pay-as-you-go eSIM: no monthly fee, 19p a text, kept alive by one paid action every 90 days
lebara-uk-payg-esim.highlight: A UK prepaid card on the Vodafone network: no monthly fee, 25p a minute, 19p a text and 9p a megabyte. One paid call, text or data session every 90 days keeps it, with 365 days to restore a suspended line; the eSIM must be chosen at order and supply is limited.
lebara-uk-payg-esim.regions: [UK] A +44 number on Vodafone; choose eSIM at checkout, though supply and handset support are limited
lebara-uk-payg-esim.value: No monthly fee; kept alive for 19p every 90 days (about GBP 0.80 a year)
lebara-uk-payg-esim.content: One of the UK's most-used number-keeping prepaid cards, on Vodafone with no contract or monthly fee and pay-as-you-go at 25p a minute, 19p a text and 9p a megabyte from a £5 top-up. Validity needs a paid action every 90 days — a call, text or data use — or the balance clears and the SIM suspends, restorable by a top-up or plan within 365 days and gone after that; Lebara's community manager confirmed 90 days plus 365 to recover on 16 September 2026. One 19p text every 90 days costs under £1 a year. eSIM is chosen at checkout with the QR code by email and activation within 30 days, but community and comparison-site records from October 2026 show limited new-customer supply, sometimes only for particular handsets (one report says iPhone Air alone). Online signup needs no ID or UK address, though non-UK billing addresses and foreign cards often trip fraud checks; in countries outside Roam Like Home, mainland China included, incoming texts are free and outgoing 49p; Lebara confirms Wi-Fi calling on handsets in Vodafone's list.
lebara-uk-payg-esim.conditions: No monthly fee, with 25p a minute, 19p a text and 9p a megabyte; a paid action every 90 days keeps it, recoverable within 365 days after suspension and lost after that; eSIM at checkout with activation within 30 days, supply and handset support limited; foreign cards are often refused.
steps: Choose a prepaid SIM or eSIM on the Lebara site and select eSIM at payment if offered
Install and activate the eSIM within 30 days of the QR code email arriving
Send one text or use a little data every 90 days to keep the number
Restore a suspended line by topping up or buying a bundle within 365 days
lebara-uk-payg-esim.risk: eSIM supply and model support are limited, so cloud activation is not guaranteed; the 90-day rule conflicts with 215-day reminder emails, so plan for 90 days; non-UK cards are frequently declined; received SMS in mainland China are free with sending at 49p; credit is not refundable.
lebara-uk-payg-esim.source: Lebara official pay-as-you-go page (restricted in November 2026, so rates and the 90-day rule follow the official community manager reply of 16 September 2026 and the ISPreview terms of 20 August 2025) + 4g.co.uk on eSIM for pay as you go (6 October 2026, limited eSIM models) + DeepChain eSIM data (31 October 2026) + Digital Residents forum thread on the Lebara EU plan (2 November 2026)

play-pl-prepaid-esim-rwk.title: [Poland] Play Poland prepaid eSIM: mandatory online identity check, and a PLN 100 top-up buys 365 days of validity
play-pl-prepaid-esim-rwk.highlight: Buy a prepaid eSIM online through Play24 or the website with free activation, but Polish law requires registration: a document plus a live photo check, or verification through a bank or mojeID. Validity scales with the top-up from 5 to 150 days, and the Rok Ważności Konta tier turns a PLN 100 top-up into 365 days.
play-pl-prepaid-esim-rwk.regions: [PL] +48 number; online purchase needs identity verification (ID plus face, bank or mojeID)
play-pl-prepaid-esim-rwk.value: PLN 100 for 365 days of validity (about USD 27)
play-pl-prepaid-esim-rwk.content: Play prepaid eSIM is fully online: order on the site or in the Play24 app, verify your identity and the QR code arrives by email, with eSIM activation free. Since March 2026 photo verification (ID photo plus face recording) works remotely, as do bank login and mojeID. Base rates are 0.99 zł a minute or text; top-ups run 5-300 zł and validity follows the amount: 5-9 zł gives 5 days, 10-29 zł 10 days, 30-49 zł 30 days, 50-99 zł 90 days and 100-300 zł 150 days, with incoming validity of 65-210 days. To top up once for a year, choose Play na Kartę Rok Ważności Konta: 100-300 zł buys 365 days of outgoing and 455 of incoming, and a 20 zł Wydłużenie ważności konta service extends it.
play-pl-prepaid-esim-rwk.conditions: Online purchase requires identity verification by passport or ID plus a face photo, or through a bank or mojeID, with a PESEL or document number; unverified cards do not work; eSIM activation is free and a store swap from physical to eSIM costs nothing; EU roaming follows the plan; Wi-Fi calling is officially supported on prepaid and works worldwide; incoming SMS on China roaming is free; the phone must support eSIM and be unlocked.
steps: Order a prepaid eSIM on the Play website or in the Play24 app
Complete registration as the page asks, with a document and live photo check or bank verification
Top up as needed: PLN 100 for 365 days, or smaller amounts for the 5 to 90 day tiers
For long gaps use the PLN 20 extension service or a tier-appropriate top-up
play-pl-prepaid-esim-rwk.risk: Mandatory registration is a real barrier and a passport plus live face check may be refused; the forum figure of USD 1.30 a year does not match the official price list, where the lowest PLN 5 top-up buys only 5 days; the PLN 100 year tier ties up more balance at once; inbound SMS roaming in China are free and Wi-Fi Calling is supported worldwide; the phone must support eSIM and be unlocked. Third-party eUICC: a community test in September 2026 found Play blocks the 9eSIM EID, so an eSTK-class (G+D chip) card is needed; test a download first to see whether the EID is blocked.
play-pl-prepaid-esim-rwk.source: Play official Cennik Taryfy Play na Kartę 3.0 from 1 June 2026 and the Rok Ważności Konta price list + official help page on registering and keeping a prepaid number (5 October 2026) + photo verification announcement (3 March 2026) + Digital Residents forum thread (27 September 2026)

ctexcel-hk-gba-prepaid.regions: [HK] +852 number; real-name registration with a HK ID or eligible travel document, BN(O) excluded
ctexcel-hk-gba-prepaid.value: A HK$100 card (kept alive for HK$50 every 180 days, about USD 13 a year)
ctexcel-hk-gba-prepaid.content: China Telecom HK's Greater Bay Area stored-value card, the Blue Card: no monthly fee, a real +852 number and data packs shared across the mainland, Hong Kong and Macau. Order online at the stored-value page for a typical HK$100 face value, and register with real-name details for local service (a non-holder can use an eligible travel document, not BN(O)). Keeping it costs HK$50 every 180 days, which extends validity another 180 days from the top-up date, about HK$100 a year, and the balance buys data packs. eSIM support arrived in November 2026 for prepaid and contract cards but not annual or some roaming cards, only on Hong Kong or Macau model phones and only in person at the service point on 18/F of Kwong Fai Centre, 108 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai (Monday to Friday 9:30-11:30 and 14:30-16:30); the first eSIM is free with up to three downloads, replacement costs HK$30 and one free swap a year.
ctexcel-hk-gba-prepaid.conditions: Order at the stored-value page (HK$100 typical); real-name registration for local service; top up HK$50 every 180 days; eSIM only on Hong Kong or Macau handsets and only in person in Wan Chai; annual and some roaming cards unsupported; not a remote-activation card, so the physical SIM matters and replacement carries a fee.
steps: Order the Greater Bay Area stored-value card on the official CTExcel Hong Kong page
Activate the card per the email instructions and complete registration
Top up HK$50 within every 180 days to keep the number, and buy data packages separately as needed
For eSIM, bring a Hong Kong or Macau model phone and your documents to the Wan Chai counter in Hong Kong
ctexcel-hk-gba-prepaid.risk: eSIM cannot be activated remotely and needs an in-person visit in Hong Kong; registration is mandatory; HK$50 every 180 days works out to about HK$100 a year; data roaming in the mainland is expensive without a package; a lost physical card costs HK$30 to replace; the exact data allowance follows the card wallet and current official page.
ctexcel-hk-gba-prepaid.source: China Telecom Hong Kong official stored-value card purchase and activation pages (checked 21 November 2026) + the carrier's eSIM announcement as reported by IT Home (3 November 2026: prepaid and postpaid support, Hong Kong and Macau model phones only, Wan Chai counter required) + stored-value terms of HK$50 every 180 days (third-party summary, 8 September 2026) + Digital Residents forum thread (30 October 2026)

starryblu-60sgd-signup.highlight: The official X account still promoted up to S$60 in rewards on 19 November 2026; a mainland passport, a +86 phone number and an ID card as proof of address are enough to register, and the credit sits under My Vouchers in the app, applied automatically at checkout.
starryblu-60sgd-signup.regions: [Global] A mainland passport, +86 number and ID as address proof are enough; the account is issued by Singapore's Wotransfer
starryblu-60sgd-signup.value: Up to S$60 in spending credit (about USD 45)
starryblu-60sgd-signup.content: A multi-currency account from Singapore's Wotransfer (sister company of Panda Remit, MAS major payment institution licence PS20200501) whose official X account still advertised up to S$60 in rewards on 19 November 2026. The reward is spending credit: after signup and KYC, claim it under Me then My Vouchers and it applies automatically to card spending (community tests show about a tenth off small purchases), valid about a month. An invite code must be entered at registration and cannot be added later; without one you usually get only S$10. Onboarding suits mainland users: Chinese passport, face check, address proof (a mainland ID works) and a +86 number, fully online in about ten minutes; the account holds CNY, SGD, USD, EUR, HKD and GBP, the virtual card is free, the physical card costs about US$9.9 to post and card applications queue.
starryblu-60sgd-signup.conditions: Register through the invite link or enter the code at signup, as it cannot be added later; passport, face check and address proof; the S$60 is several vouchers valid about a month and applied automatically to spending; the virtual card is free but queued and the physical card costs about US$9.9; it is a payment account, not a bank deposit, so segregated custody is not deposit insurance.
steps: Register through an invite link or a registration page with the code prefilled, choosing China as country of residence with a +86 number
Complete passport, face and proof-of-address KYC in the app
Check Me then My Vouchers to confirm the S$60 credit arrived
Apply for the free virtual card and let the vouchers apply at checkout
starryblu-60sgd-signup.risk: The credit is not cash, applies proportionally and expires in about a month, so the real value falls well short of S$60; an invite code is mandatory; card queues can run months; the payment account is not a bank deposit; cross-border withdrawal and QR spending carry noticeable loss; the official rules change.
starryblu-60sgd-signup.source: Starryblu official X account post (19 November 2026: up to S$60 in rewards) + official blog and third-party tests (6 November 2026: vouchers under My Vouchers, valid one month, about 10 percent off, invite code cannot be added later) + Digital Residents forum thread on the S$60 bonus

urnetwork-free-tier-30gib.title: [Global] URnetwork free residential-exit VPN: 30 GiB a day, no card
urnetwork-free-tier-30gib.highlight: Get 30 GiB of free data every day (about 900 GiB a month) with no card and no trial, on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux, up to 2 devices at once.
urnetwork-free-tier-30gib.regions: [Global] Every platform on one account; exits are member residential nodes in 108 countries
urnetwork-free-tier-30gib.content: An open-source decentralised privacy network from BringYour, Inc. (Delaware) whose site counts 106,524 providers across 108 countries. The Community tier is neither a trial nor card-bound: each account gets 30GiB daily at 00:00 UTC, about 900GiB a month, without carry-over, and once used, new connections simply stop rather than throttling. Sign in with email or phone and password, Google, Apple or a wallet, or take an Instant Account that needs no details and issues a recovery phrase. Two devices can be online at once; Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux and the Chrome, Edge and Firefox extensions share one account, with system clients routing all traffic and extensions only the browser. Free also includes five hosted HTTPS proxies, while SOCKS5 and WireGuard belong to Pro at $5 a month or $40 a year with 10TiB a month; an Operator API and urn_ API keys allow programmatic JWTs and exit selection.
urnetwork-free-tier-30gib.conditions: No card and not a trial; the allowance resets at 00:00 UTC without carry-over; at most two devices online; using others' exits does not require sharing your network, since Provide defaults to Never; free has hosted HTTPS proxies only; data counts both ways, including traffic between your own devices.
steps: Sign up at ur.io with an email or phone number and password, Google, Apple or a wallet; if you use an Instant Account, save the recovery phrase
Install the app on your phone or computer (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS or Linux) and sign in to the same account
Connect, keep Best available for automatic picking, or choose a low-latency country or city yourself
At 00:00 UTC the allowance resets to 30 GiB; when it runs out, wait for the refresh or buy a one-time data pack
urnetwork-free-tier-30gib.risk: Exits are members' home connections, so availability and latency swing with which providers are online, and no fixed node or uptime is promised on the free tier; residential addresses still hit bot checks and captchas; 30 GiB counts both directions and stops when used up; the free tier is capped at 2 devices and leaves SOCKS5 and WireGuard to UR Pro; before July 2026 the Android app shared your connection by default, new installs default to Never, so confirm Provide is set to Never under Account, Settings.
urnetwork-free-tier-30gib.source: URnetwork official plans page and docs at ur.io/products and ur.io/docs/about-your-data (rechecked 2026-11-21) + X community hands-on posts (@taiyanghere, 2026-11-21, and others)

klook-rewards-free-esim.title: [Global] Klook Rewards free eSIM: 500MB on sign-up, 2x1GB for Gold, 2x3GB for Platinum
klook-rewards-free-esim.highlight: Signing up for Klook already gives a 500MB / 1-day eSIM coupon with no booking; Gold members (USD 500 a year) get 2x1GB for 7 days and Platinum 2x3GB, taken off at checkout
klook-rewards-free-esim.regions: [Global] 100+ destinations; tiers are Explorer at signup, Gold at US$500 and Platinum at US$1,500
klook-rewards-free-esim.content: Klook Rewards eSIM benefits, still live on 21 November 2026: Explorer gets one 500MB pack for a day at signup, Gold with US$500 of orders in 12 months gets two 1GB packs for seven days and Platinum, a further US$1,500, gets two 3GB packs. Claim on the Rewards page, choose Use to browse eligible eSIM products and apply the voucher at checkout for its face value, with a cap noted in the voucher terms. Packs cover 100+ destinations, last for the tier's validity and expire with the tier without carrying over.

steps: Register or sign in to Klook and open the Rewards page
Tap Claim on the eSIM perk to add the 500MB coupon to your account
Tap Use, pick a destination and an eligible eSIM plan
Apply the coupon at checkout, confirm the discount, and install the QR code from the email or app

airfrance-klm-kolet-free-1gb.highlight: KLM's official partner page states first-time Kolet users get 1GB free for 2 days across 190+ countries, with no flight booking needed, plus 10% off a first plan and 10 Flying Blue Miles per euro
airfrance-klm-kolet-free-1gb.regions: [FR/NL] Air France, KLM and Transavia France travellers and Flying Blue members; no flight booking needed to claim
airfrance-klm-kolet-free-1gb.content: A partnership between Air France, KLM and French eSIM provider Kolet (live since 25 November 2024 and still running in 2026): enter FBDEAL in KLM's Flying Blue Kolet portal or the Kolet app (Air France also gives AFKLDATA) and a first-time customer gets 1GB free for two days across 190+ countries, plus 10% off every data plan, 10 Flying Blue miles per euro spent, 250 miles each when a friend buys their first plan and, in France and the Netherlands, mileage payment through Flying Blue+. airfrance-klm-kolet-free-1gb.conditions: New Kolet customers only; install the Kolet app or go through KLM's Flying Blue portal and register by email; link the Flying Blue number before paying to earn miles; the free 1GB lasts two days; data only with no number; the 10% excludes monthly plans and stacks with nothing else.
steps: Open KLM's Flying Blue Kolet page and choose Explore with Kolet, or sign up in the Kolet app
Enter FBDEAL (or AFKLDATA for Air France), add your email and claim the free 1GB
Choose the destination and travel date, then install the eSIM on stable Wi-Fi before flying
Turn the eSIM on after landing; add the Flying Blue number under Profile to earn Miles

air-india-kolet-free-1gb.regions: [IN, mainly] Air India Maharaja Club members; Vietnam Airlines Lotusmiles, Corendon and TAAG use the same template across 190+ destinations

Pick a destination and plan; first-time users see the free 1GB and a zero total

sas-travel-esim-hubby.title: [Nordics] SAS x Hubby travel eSIM: 2 days of free data with eligible bookings in 190+ countries

sas-travel-esim-hubby.regions: [Nordics] International SAS flights, initially mostly outside the EU, covering 190+ countries

Open My trip for the upcoming journey and find the included eSIM

Activate after landing as the app instructs; top up in the app when the two days end

sas-travel-esim-hubby.source: SAS official Travel eSIM page (checked 2026-11-21: 2 days of free mobile data, 190+ countries, EuroBonus login) plus Travolution (2026-06-16) and OpenSim review (2026-08-13, noting the missing 1GB figure and eligibility definition)

tarom-ubigi-free-1gb.title: [RO] TAROM x Ubigi: 1GB of free global eSIM for every passenger plus 30% off a first plan
tarom-ubigi-free-1gb.highlight: After booking a TAROM ticket, the confirmation page, My Booking or online check-in shows an eSIM banner that gives 1GB free across 200+ destinations; the same eSIM can be reused on later trips
tarom-ubigi-free-1gb.regions: [RO] Passengers holding a TAROM booking; Ubigi covers 200+ destinations
tarom-ubigi-free-1gb.value: 1GB free (about USD 5) plus 30% off the first plan
tarom-ubigi-free-1gb.content: A partnership between TAROM, Romania's SkyTeam carrier, and Transatel's Ubigi (live December 2025): after booking, an eSIM banner appears on the confirmation page, My Booking and online check-in, offering each passenger 1GB of free data plus 30% off a first paid plan. tarom-ubigi-free-1gb.conditions: A TAROM booking, with entry only on the confirmation page, My Booking or check-in; 1GB per passenger with paid top-ups after; an unlocked eSIM phone; data only with no local number.
steps: Book on tarom.ro and stay on the confirmation page after payment
Tap the eSIM banner, or find the same entry in My Booking or online check-in
Install the Ubigi app, claim the free 1GB and install the eSIM
Smart Start activates it on arrival; buy more data in the app with the 30% first-order discount

sun-phuquoc-free-esim-5gb.title: [VN] Sun PhuQuoc Airways: free 5GB eSIM for international arrivals (24 hours on MobiFone)
sun-phuquoc-free-esim-5gb.highlight: International passengers arriving in Vietnam on Sun PhuQuoc Airways claim a free 5GB / 24-hour eSIM with a PNR, surname and email, then activate it by calling 900 after landing; the promotion runs to 2027-08-31
sun-phuquoc-free-esim-5gb.regions: [VN] Adult and child passengers arriving in Vietnam on a Sun PhuQuoc international flight; 5GB on MobiFone
sun-phuquoc-free-esim-5gb.content: A zero-dong eSIM from Sun PhuQuoc Airways with VTC and MobiFone: international passengers enter their PNR or ticket number, surname in capitals without accents, and email at connect.sunphuquocairways.com, pass eKYC with a passport photo page and a selfie, and get a QR code on the spot with a copy by email. The 5GB starts its 24 hours when dialling 900 after landing, so installing early costs nothing; more data can be bought on the same page without repeating eKYC. Registration opens four days before a one-way arrival and before departure for returns.
sun-phuquoc-free-esim-5gb.conditions: Arriving on the airline's international flight, with refunded, invalid or fraudulent bookings excluded; one eSIM per passport every 30 days; eKYC with passport page and selfie; an unlocked eSIM phone; the 24 hours or 5GB end at whichever comes first; top-ups cost extra.
steps: Open connect.sunphuquocairways.com and enter the 6-character PNR or ticket number, surname and email
Choose the passenger, accept the terms and complete MobiFone eKYC with a passport page and a portrait photo
Install the eSIM from the QR code, ideally on stable Wi-Fi before departure
After landing in Vietnam call 900 free of charge; the 5GB and the 24 hours start then
sun-phuquoc-free-esim-5gb.risk: Only genuine flights on this airline qualify and codeshare or charter handling is unpublished; 24 hours is short and day two needs a top-up; eKYC means uploading a passport and a selfie; an unactivated eSIM expires.
sun-phuquoc-free-esim-5gb.source: Sun PhuQuoc Airways official offer page (2026-09-01 to 2027-08-31) plus the connect.sunphuquocairways.com policy and user guide, and the Vietnamese terms summary on abay.vn

trip-com-member-free-esim.title: [Global] Trip.com Platinum and above: free global eSIM from 1GB/3 days up to 8x3GB
trip-com-member-free-esim.highlight: The rewards page lists a free eSIM at every high tier: Platinum gets 1GB for 3 days, Diamond 3GB for 5 days, Diamond+ two of them and Black Diamond eight; book a member-labelled eSIM in the app and pay nothing
trip-com-member-free-esim.regions: [Global] Trip.com Platinum, Diamond, Diamond+ and Black Diamond members; packs cover 70+ countries

trip-com-member-free-esim.conditions: Reach the right tier first; order in the app and apply the benefit; only tagged eSIM products count, with size and destination per the product page; a freely cancellable order returns the allowance, otherwise it is lost; data cards carry no number.
steps: Sign in to the Trip.com app and open Member Rewards for the Free Global eSIM Data Package
Tap Use Now to open a member-labelled eSIM product and check the destination and allowance
Apply the reward at checkout and confirm the total is zero
Install the eSIM from the emailed QR code and enable roaming on arrival

trip-com-member-free-esim.source: Trip.com official loyalty page (checked 2026-11-21 for each tier's allowance and threshold) plus the published terms for the Free Global eSIM Data Package

agoda-vip-diamond-free-esim.title: [Global] Agoda VIP Diamond: free 1GB / 7-day global eSIM
agoda-vip-diamond-free-esim.highlight: Agoda VIP Diamond members activate a free 1GB, 7-day eSIM inside the Agoda app for eligible destinations, so the phone is online the moment they land
agoda-vip-diamond-free-esim.regions: [Global] AgodaVIP Diamond members; coverage varies by eligible destination in the app
agoda-vip-diamond-free-esim.content: Agoda's press release of 11 February 2026 launched a free eSIM for VIP Diamond members: 1GB for seven days, activated in the Agoda app on iOS or Android before departure at several eligible destinations, covering the gap before a local SIM. steps: Sign in to the Agoda app and confirm VIP Diamond status
Open the VIP benefits page and find the free eSIM entry
Choose a destination and activate, installing the eSIM on Wi-Fi before departure
Enable data roaming for that eSIM after landing and use it within the seven days

omio-kolet-free-1gb.conditions: An Omio account and a completed booking; free data only for first-time Kolet users; claim from the order email or Manage My Booking; the 1GB follows Kolet's trial terms, about two days from activation; data only with no number.
steps: Book and pay for a train, coach or flight ticket on Omio
Find the Kolet entry in the confirmation email or under Manage My Booking
Install the Kolet app, register and claim the free 1GB through that link
Install the eSIM on Wi-Fi before departure and activate it on arrival

jegotrip-cmlink-free-20gb-uk.title: [UK] JegoTrip (CMLink) free 20GB UK eSIM with a UK number, restocked in limited batches
jegotrip-cmlink-free-20gb-uk.highlight: Archived: the campaign is over. No restocks after July 2026, a visitor reported it dead on 2026-11-21, the official download page returns 500 and Google Play only shows generic wording; the detail page stays for reference with alternatives listed on top
jegotrip-cmlink-free-20gb-uk.regions: [UK] CMLink UK from China Mobile International, data limited to the UK; the app needs a number from the UK, Japan, Thailand or Singapore
jegotrip-cmlink-free-20gb-uk.value: 20GB plus a UK number (about GBP 9 / USD 12)
jegotrip-cmlink-free-20gb-uk.content: Archived, as restocks stopped after July 2026. JegoTrip-CMLink, an app from China Mobile International, recruited with a free CMLink UK eSIM for new users registering a UK number: a +44 number with 20GB of UK high-speed data worth £9. Restocks in May, June and July 2026 released about 1,000 each, mostly taken the same day, while Japanese, Thai or Singaporean numbers only got 1GB of China and Hong Kong travel data. The number carries no monthly fee for life and receives texts free indefinitely without voice, activating within a year for 28 days of the 20GB, and activation needs to happen outside the mainland on a UK or Hong Kong cell or over Wi-Fi calling. Rechecked on 22 November 2026, the site's download page returns 500, Google Play keeps only generic text, the last restock post is 28 July and a visitor on 21 November reported it dead.
jegotrip-cmlink-free-20gb-uk.conditions: Archived: a UK number to register; one per device and account; activate outside the mainland; activate within a year for 28 days of data; texts only, no calls; limited restocks first come.
steps: Install JegoTrip-CMLink from the UK App Store or Google Play and register with a UK number
After signing in, open the 20GB UK data banner on the home screen or under Profile and order it for zero
Install the eSIM on an unlocked, eSIM-capable phone
Activate in the UK or Hong Kong, or through Wi-Fi Calling; the 20GB then runs for 28 days
jegotrip-cmlink-free-20gb-uk.risk: Archived as expired: no restocks since July 2026, a visitor reported it dead on 2026-11-21, the download page returns 500 and Google Play shows generic wording only. Historic risks remain: irregular limited restocks, a UK number is required, activation must happen outside mainland China, and the Wi-Fi Calling route has been unreliable since late 2026.
jegotrip-cmlink-free-20gb-uk.source: JegoTrip official download and product pages (still promoting the new-user welcome benefit in 2026-11) plus Naixi forum thread-12499 (2026-06-12), NodeSeek posts 845619 and 845273 (2026-07-28), Huoke's test (2026-05-13) and Chinese media summaries (2026-06 and 2026-10)

genixnode-kvm-nvme-14-loc.title: [Global] GenixNode KVM NVMe VPS: 4GB RAM from $2.99/mo in 14 locations (dedicated IPv4, full root with SSH, +1 week for LET)
genixnode-kvm-nvme-14-loc.highlight: 2 vCPU / 4GB / 40GB NVMe / 1Gbps / unmetered (fair use); $2.99/mo in Istanbul, $28.70/yr; KVM full root with SSH and one dedicated IPv4, 14 locations
genixnode-kvm-nvme-14-loc.regions: [Global] Istanbul $2.99; Europe, US and Canada $6.19; Hong Kong and Sydney $7.63; Dallas and Singapore out of stock
genixnode-kvm-nvme-14-loc.content: KVM VPS from GenixNode LLC (registered in Wyoming, founded May 2026): Nova x4 has 2 cores, 4GB, 40GB NVMe, a shared 1Gbps port, unmetered traffic under fair use and one dedicated IPv4, at $2.99 a month in Istanbul or $2.39 a month annually ($28.70 a year), $6.19 in Europe, the US and Canada and $7.63 in Hong Kong and Sydney; Pulse x8 (8GB) and Apex x12 (12GB) are also offered. Quarterly billing takes 10% off, half-yearly 15% and annual 20%. The site promises full KVM root, VNC console, rescue mode, DDoS protection and free backups, provisioning in 1-2 minutes, and takes Stripe cards, Alipay and crypto. Replying to the official LowEndTalk thread with an order number adds a week, and Black Friday pricing appears there on 23 November.
genixnode-kvm-nvme-14-loc.conditions: $2.99 applies only to Istanbul and other regions add a surcharge, so trust the checkout total (button and dropdown prices differ); unmetered traffic follows fair use, with a temporary throttle above 100Mbps averaged over six hours; one dedicated IPv4 rather than NAT or IPv6-only; full KVM root with SSH, though no blocked-port list is published, so ask support about 25 and others before ordering; signup needs only an email.
steps: Open genixnode.com/vps, pick Nova x4 and a region (Istanbul is cheapest) and check the cart summary before paying
After payment take the IP and root password from the panel and connect over SSH or the VNC console
Reply to the official LET thread with your order number for the extra free week
If the run-away risk worries you, stay monthly instead of prepaying years
genixnode-kvm-nvme-14-loc.risk: Founded in May 2026, so under a year old, with run-away risk; only a 7-day refund. No long-term community report yet, so do not put anything important on it. Several LET posters found the button, region and summary prices disagreeing; trust the summary. $2.99 is Istanbul only, and other regions cost more than double. The Black Friday specials only appear on 23 November, so buying now may not be the lowest price.
genixnode-kvm-nvme-14-loc.source: Visitor submission (2026-11-22 00:31) + LowEndTalk official offer thread (2026-11-21) + genixnode.com/vps and the Istanbul page (read 2026-11-22) + LowEndBox (2026-11-09)

razer-gold-8th-anniversary-bonus.title: [Multi-region] Razer Gold 8th anniversary: wallet payments earn tiered Bonus Gold, up to ¥3,412 / $21 (11/16-12/20)
razer-gold-8th-anniversary-bonus.highlight: Pay for games or entertainment from your Razer Gold wallet and get 9-10% back in Bonus Gold by single-transaction tier; all four tiers add up to ¥3,412
razer-gold-8th-anniversary-bonus.regions: [Multi-region] Accounts registered in 20 markets including the US, Canada, HK, China, Taiwan, Japan, Korea, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and others
razer-gold-8th-anniversary-bonus.value: Up to ¥3,412 (about $22) / $21 in Bonus Gold for the US
razer-gold-8th-anniversary-bonus.content: From 12:00 on 16 November to 24:59 on 20 December 2026 (Japan time; terms say to 00:59 on 21 December), single Razer Gold wallet payments earn Bonus Gold by tier: in Japan ¥4,488 pays 448, ¥7,688 pays 688, ¥10,888 pays 988 and ¥14,088 pays 1,288, once each for ¥3,412 across all four; the US has five tiers up to $21. Bonus Gold lasts two months, cannot be transferred or cashed out. Partner events run alongside for Honor of Kings (1,200 or 4,000 tokens for chests), Arena Breakout (top 15 spenders get 3,000 cosmetic vouchers) and iQIYI (3, 6 or 12 months buys seven days of Standard).
razer-gold-8th-anniversary-bonus.conditions: Pay with the Razer Gold wallet; tiers count per single payment, not combined; once per person per tier; a verified account; only the 20 listed registration markets; spend Bonus Gold within two months of receipt.
steps: Sign in at gold.razer.com and confirm your account region is one of the 20 and that it is verified
Open the campaign page for your region (/promotions/8thanni-bonusgold) and check your local tiers
Pay from the wallet in a single transaction at or above a tier; Bonus Gold lands automatically
When clearing several tiers, keep the payments separate instead of merging the amounts
razer-gold-8th-anniversary-bonus.risk: The reward is Bonus Gold usable only inside the Razer Gold ecosystem, expiring after two months and not withdrawable. You have to spend first for roughly 9-10% back, so topping up extra to chase the rebate loses money. Tiers and currencies differ by account region, so do not copy someone else's screenshot. Razer can change the terms at any time, and some categories such as Steam are excluded depending on the region.
razer-gold-8th-anniversary-bonus.source: Razer Gold official campaign pages and terms (JP and US 8thanni-bonusgold, read 2026-11-22) plus the 8anni-ichiran roundup page

vodafone-samoa-ding-tuesday-data.highlight: Top up a Vodafone Samoa prepaid number with $10 or more through Ding every Tuesday and get 5, 10 or 25GB added automatically; the top-up credit stays yours
vodafone-samoa-ding-tuesday-data.regions: [WS] Vodafone Samoa prepaid numbers only, topped up through Ding
vodafone-samoa-ding-tuesday-data.content: A Tuesday campaign between Vodafone Samoa and Ding (10 November 2026 to 10 February 2027, every Tuesday from 00:00 to 23:59): top up a Vodafone Samoa prepaid number with $10+ through Ding and bonus data is added automatically — 5GB for $10-19, 10GB for $20-49 and 25GB for $50+. The bonus lasts two days and cannot be carried over, transferred or cashed out, while the paid top-up arrives as usual.
vodafone-samoa-ding-tuesday-data.conditions: Vodafone Samoa prepaid customers; top up $10+ through Ding on a Tuesday; other days and channels do not count; spend the bonus within two days; Vodafone Samoa can change or end it at any time.
steps: Open ding.com or the Ding app, choose Samoa - Vodafone and enter the recipient's number
Place the order on a Tuesday (Samoa local time, 00:00-23:59) for $10 or more
The bonus data is added once the top-up lands; use it within 2 days
For the full 25GB, send $50 or more in one go
vodafone-samoa-ding-tuesday-data.risk: The bonus data lasts only 2 days, so the practical value is limited. It only helps people topping up Samoan numbers, which for most users means family there. Ding adds its own exchange rate and fees. The terms do not state a per-number weekly limit, so treat it as once per Tuesday (to be confirmed). Vodafone can change or withdraw the promotion during the period.
vodafone-samoa-ding-tuesday-data.source: Vodafone Samoa official promotion page and terms (published 2026-11-09, read 2026-11-22) plus ding.com

norma-connect-start-esim.title: [DE] NORMA connect Start eSIM: no monthly fee, EUR 2.99 starter pack with EUR 10 credit (a real German Telekom number, passport accepted)
norma-connect-start-esim.highlight: A no-monthly-fee prepaid card on the Telekom 5G network: the Start plan charges 9 euro cents a minute or text. During Black Week the starter pack drops from EUR 9.95 to EUR 2.99 and activating Start returns EUR 10 of credit, so the pack nets about EUR 7; the eSIM arrives by email, Wi-Fi Calling works and top-up credit never expires.
norma-connect-start-esim.regions: [DE] A +49 German number on Telekom; EU/EEA plus UK, Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein roam at home rates
norma-connect-start-esim.value: EUR 2.99 starter pack including EUR 10 credit (about EUR 7 net), no monthly fee
norma-connect-start-esim.content: A prepaid brand from the NORMA supermarket chain and Deutsche Telekom on Telekom 5G (D-Netz). The Start base plan has no monthly fee or contract, charging 9 euro cents a minute or text in 60/60 billing with no data included, bought in the app when needed. Over Black Friday the starter pack, physical or eSIM, drops from €9.95 to €2.99 and activating Start returns €10 of starting credit, about €7 ahead, usable for calls, texts and data and never expiring per the FAQ. The NORMA Plus app has it at €1.99 (teltarif, 30 October 2026, to 29 November). Activation does a German §172 TKG identity check through NECT, which visitors report passing first time with a Chinese passport, and the eSIM arrives as an emailed QR code with no German address needed. Incoming texts roam free in China in tests, and Wi-Fi calling works.
norma-connect-start-esim.conditions: A §172 TKG identity check to activate (a passport works, passing first time in tests); €2.99 until 29 November 2026, then €9.95 (€1.99 in the NORMA Plus app); no monthly fee but 9 cents a minute or text and no data; an eSIM phone (*#06# shows the EID); the €10 offsets usage and cannot be withdrawn; calls and data outside the EU bill at roaming rates.
steps: Order a starter pack (physical SIM or eSIM) at norma-connect.de at the EUR 2.99 Black Week price
Complete the NECT identity check from the email (passport photo page plus a face check) and install the eSIM QR code
Choose the Start plan on activation and confirm the EUR 10 credit lands in the prepaid balance
Top up EUR 5 every 12-15 months to keep the line active (official terms say credit never expires; this is the community habit)
norma-connect-start-esim.risk: An identity check is mandatory and there is no public list of accepted passport types, with only one or two Chinese-passport reports so far; the EUR 10 is call credit that cannot be withdrawn or transferred; EUR 2.99 is a Black Week price and returns to EUR 9.95 after 29 November; a zero-fee card includes no data, so overseas data is a separate purchase; changing phones means requesting the eSIM again; German fraud checks occasionally decline foreign payment methods.
norma-connect-start-esim.source: Official Start plan page, FAQ and price notes (read 22 November 2026) + teltarif Black Week report (30 October 2026) + sim.gratis comparison page (data as of 22 November 2026) + visitor submission (22 November 2026 01:02) + X reports from @nmyx888 and @Lovislexus (22 November 2026)

dtcpay-esim-5gb-6m.title: [Singapore] dtcpay eSIM: 5GB a month for 6 months free after signup (97 countries, Singapore residential IP, passport plus overseas address)
dtcpay-esim-5gb-6m.highlight: dtcpay, a MAS-licensed Singapore payment institution, hands out a free eSIM in its app after KYC: community reports put it at 5GB a month for six months across 97 countries with a Singapore residential IP exit, and the same account also opens a free Visa Platinum virtual card. The eSIM itself lasts about ten years and is data-only.
dtcpay-esim-5gb-6m.regions: [SG] The account is Singapore-based; the eSIM works in 97 countries including mainland China with a Singapore residential IP
dtcpay-esim-5gb-6m.value: Six months at 5GB a month of global data (about 30GB, 97 countries) with an eSIM valid about ten years
dtcpay-esim-5gb-6m.content: A Singapore-licensed digital payment institution (MAS major payment institution, plus a Luxembourg EMI) whose app opens multi-currency accounts and a free Visa Platinum card, virtual or physical, along with a data-only eSIM. After KYC, free data packs appear under Me then eSIM: community tests through 2026 found 5GB a month for six months across 97 countries with a Singapore Singtel residential IP (reputation 97), though in October 2026 some got only two one-off 1GB and 5GB packs, so follow the app as rules change monthly. The eSIM costs nothing, lasts about 10 years, has no number, cannot receive texts and is data only; it can be written to a physical eUICC such as 9eSIM or Xesim and re-enabled in the app after changing phones.
dtcpay-esim-5gb-6m.conditions: Passport KYC plus overseas address proof (a bill from the past 3-6 months matching the chosen residence) and a non-+86 number; automated checks often reject address proof, and community experience is that resubmitting the same photo usually passes, with review in 1-3 business days; the eSIM is data only with no SMS; free pack size and length vary by account and campaign; a free Visa virtual card can be opened and funded with USDT, USDC or foreign currency.
steps: Download dtcpay from a non-China app store, register with an email and open the emailed link on the same phone
Prepare a passport, an overseas address proof and a non-+86 number, pick the country on the address proof as residence and finish KYC
Once approved, open the eSIM section, claim the free data packs and install them or scan the code into a physical eUICC
Before travelling, check the pack's validity and volume, and optionally open the free Visa virtual card from the card section
dtcpay-esim-5gb-6m.risk: The address proof is the main obstacle and machine review often rejects it, with mainland China statements basically never passing; reports disagree on the free data (six months of 5GB versus a one-off 1GB plus 5GB), so do not pay anything for this data; the eSIM has no number and cannot receive verification codes; the account is held with a Singapore institution and incomplete documents or risk checks can close it; it is data-only, so emergency calls do not work.
dtcpay-esim-5gb-6m.source: Official dtcpay.com site and terms of business (read 22 November 2026) + NodeSeek report on a completed signup (12 June 2026) + macin.top walkthrough (2 September 2026, updated 30 October) + Digital Residents forum (8 August 2026) + visitor submission (22 November 2026 09:03)

zcode-new-user-5day-8m.highlight: Zhipu's official coding client ZCode gives new users 8 million tokens a day for five days from first use after connecting a BigModel (China) or Z.ai (rest of world) account: 3 million GLM-5.3 plus 5 million GLM-5.3-Flash a day, refreshed daily and expiring after five days, with no payment or card required.
zcode-new-user-5day-8m.regions: [Global] BigModel in China, Z.ai abroad; credit works only inside the ZCode client (Mac, Windows, Linux)
zcode-new-user-5day-8m.value: About 40 million tokens over five days (8 million a day) at no cost
zcode-new-user-5day-8m.content: Zhipu's coding client for GLM-5.3 documents a free trial allowance: a new user who downloads the client and connects a BigModel account gets 8 million tokens a day for five days from first use, split into separate quotas of 3 million GLM-5.3 and 5 million GLM-5.3-Flash, each refreshing daily, about 40 million in total. Overseas users connecting a Z.ai account get the same daily flagship allowance through the same flow; the documentation says no payment is required, with no card and no mention of real-name checks. zcode-new-user-5day-8m.conditions: New users only, within five days of first connecting; daily quotas refresh each day and cannot be spent at once; credit works only inside ZCode and not with your own API key; it lapses after five days without charging; no overall end date is published.
steps: Download the ZCode client from zcode.z.ai (Mac, Windows or Linux) and sign in
On the first-run welcome page connect BigModel in China or Z.ai elsewhere and authorise
Start using it to enter the five-day trial and watch today's balance and usage on the provider page
Finish the tasks you want to try within five days, then decide about a coding subscription
zcode-new-user-5day-8m.risk: Five days is short and setting up a project can eat half of it; the documentation gives no end date, so the offer can change at any time; the quota cannot leave the client or be used with other tools; do not confuse it with the nightly token giveaway.
zcode-new-user-5day-8m.source: ZCode official documentation on the free trial quota and the welcome page (read 22 November 2026) + Cyber Eggs (11 November 2026) + AI Deals Radar community vote, 75% still valid (9 November 2026) + visitor submission (22 November 2026 09:04)

tencent-lightvela-free-month.title: [China] Tencent LightVela cloud AI assistant: first month free, 2 vCPU / 8GB with 4,500 AI credits a month (5 bots)
tencent-lightvela-free-month.highlight: LightVela from Tencent's Lighthouse cloud team is an always-on cloud AI assistant built on Hermes Agent that plugs into WeChat, QQ, WeCom, Feishu and DingTalk. A new user's first Launch AI plan is free for one month: 2 vCPU, 8GB RAM, 50GB storage, 4,500 AI credits a month and 5 bots, with no automatic charge at the end.
tencent-lightvela-free-month.regions: [CN] Mainland ID verification on the China site; the international free-trial page lists the same offer
tencent-lightvela-free-month.value: First month free (normally CNY 68 a month): 2 vCPU / 8GB / 50GB cloud host plus 4,500 AI credits and 5 bots
tencent-lightvela-free-month.content: A cloud AI assistant from Tencent's Lighthouse team, built on the open-source Hermes Agent and pitched as online around the clock and finishing tasks while you are away: it includes a separate Ubuntu cloud computer with long-term memory, installable skills and scheduled tasks (notification and script tasks marked as 0 tokens), connecting to WeChat, QQ, WeCom, DingTalk and Feishu, with WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord and Slack on the international site. The trial comes from Tencent Cloud's official free-trial page: 2 cores and 8G with 4,500 AI credits, matching the ¥68-a-month AI takeoff plan with five bots, 2 cores, 8G, 50G of storage and 4,500 credits a month, free for the first month (30 days from activation) without auto-charging. A Cruise AI plan is 40% off the first month at ¥94.80 with 10,000 credits, 10 bots, 4 cores and 16G. It is not a bare VPS: there is no self-service SSH, port opening or dedicated IPv4 entry.
tencent-lightvela-free-month.conditions: First orders for new users only; mainland ID verification before activation; the free month runs 30 days from activation with no published campaign end; renewal is ¥68 a month, so switch off auto-renewal; three days of activity within 30 days adds a time extension card.
steps: Open the LightVela China site, sign in with WeChat or QQ and complete the one-time ID verification
Pick Launch AI on the subscription page, activate at the free first-order price shown and confirm 4,500 credits
Create an assistant, connect WeChat or QQ and hand it the work you want done
Note the date 30 days out and decide whether to renew or switch off auto-renewal
tencent-lightvela-free-month.risk: Free only for the first order and first month; it renews at CNY 68 a month afterwards and forgetting auto-renewal means a charge; mainland ID verification is mandatory, so overseas users can only use the international site; Tencent publishes no end date, so the offer can be pulled or reworded; it is not a bare cloud host, with no self-service SSH, ports or dedicated IP, so it cannot host a site or a proxy; credits are tied to the 30-day plan and expire with it.

databricks-free-edition.title: [Global] Databricks Free Edition: a perpetually free data and AI platform (notebooks, assistant, agents, model serving)
databricks-free-edition.highlight: Databricks Free Edition is free to sign up for and covers notebooks, the in-product AI assistant, agent building, model training and API serving, ETL pipelines, Genie natural-language BI and the Academy courses. The official FAQ calls it free for all users and perpetually free, restricted to personal, non-commercial use.
databricks-free-edition.regions: [Global] A cloud workspace at signup; personal learning and non-commercial use only
databricks-free-edition.value: Perpetually free for personal learning: notebooks, AI assistant, agents, ETL, model serving and Academy courses
databricks-free-edition.content: Databricks' free data and AI platform, an expansion of Community Edition: one workspace builds Python and SQL notebooks, writes code with the built-in Assistant, assembles LLM agents and knowledge-base Q&A, trains classic ML models and serves them as APIs, runs ETL pipelines with schema-drift and data-quality checks, and uses Genie to question data in plain language and build dashboards. The FAQ says it is free and permanent for all users at the cost of smaller compute and warehouse sizes under fair use, limited to personal learning rather than production or commercial work, with Community Edition continuing this year before migration. Academy courses and training are free too. It is not an SSH-able cloud host and has no dedicated IP or ports.
databricks-free-edition.conditions: Personal learning and non-commercial use only, with commercial use against the terms; small compute and warehouse sizes under fair use; Community Edition works this year before migration; the workspace is managed, so no SSH, dedicated IP or ports.
steps: Open databricks.com/learn/free-edition and start free
Sign up with an email, create a workspace and run a first Python or SQL notebook
To try agents, build a knowledge-base Q&A or a model serving endpoint in the workspace
Take the free Databricks Academy courses; limits follow what the workspace shows
databricks-free-edition.risk: Commercial use is not allowed and can get the account suspended; clusters are small and quota-bound, so large model training queues or gets cut off; the vendor can adjust limits and terms at any time; it is not a general cloud host, so proxies and VPNs are out.
