mistral-vibe-pro-mistralvibe-1m.title: [EU] Mistral Vibe Pro: one month free with code MISTRALVIBE as the cap is lifted
mistral-vibe-pro-mistralvibe-1m.highlight: Last week's three-month trial sold out in an hour, so on 23 November Mistral switched to one month with no cap: European users add a card, redeem the code and get Vibe Pro at $0 with about EUR 280 of usage
mistral-vibe-pro-mistralvibe-1m.regions: [EEA] European users only, with the redemption page needing a European IP; a card is checked at $0, and other IPs are told they are not eligible
mistral-vibe-pro-mistralvibe-1m.value: One month of Pro ($14.99, about EUR 280 of usage)
mistral-vibe-pro-mistralvibe-1m.content: The earlier LECHONK offer of three months sold out in under an hour, so on 23 November 2026 Mistral announced on its official X account that the cap is gone: European users redeem code MISTRALVIBE for one month of Vibe Pro, normally $14.99 a month and EUR 17.99 with tax in France, with no end date published. Pro bundles about EUR 255 of Vibe and Studio usage plus EUR 25.50 of API usage, roughly EUR 280 in total, and reaches GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3 Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Mistral Large 4 from the web, CLI, IDE and desktop app. Dozens of Linux.do users report claiming it, some with a mainland Mastercard debit card passing the $0 check; one card covers at most three accounts and it cannot stack on the earlier LECHONK trial. Cancelling within 14 days drops the account straight back to Free, so wait until day 15 to keep the whole month.
mistral-vibe-pro-mistralvibe-1m.conditions: A European IP, a Mistral account and a valid payment method (mainland Mastercard debit cards have worked); one claim per account and no stacking with LECHONK; renews at $14.99 a month unless cancelled.
steps: Connect through a European node (UK, Germany, France or the Netherlands all work) and sign in or register a Mistral account
Open the redemption page, check that code MISTRALVIBE is filled in and add a payment method
Confirm the total reads $0 and that Pro is active
Before the month ends, cancel under Subscriptions in the admin panel, and do it only after day 15 so the benefit stays
mistral-vibe-pro-mistralvibe-1m.risk: No end date is published, so the offer can close at any time; cancelling in the first 14 days drops you to Free at once, and only a cancellation after day 15 keeps the month without renewing; mainland cards have been declined or flagged; one card covers at most three accounts; without cancelling it renews at $14.99 a month; separate API credit for the developer console is not included according to testers.
mistral-vibe-pro-mistralvibe-1m.source: Mistral AI announcement on X (23-24 November 2026, no more capped drops, code MISTRALVIBE) + aifree.dev and aipromonow coverage (Pro benefits, about EUR 280 of usage, 14-day withdrawal period) + Linux.do claim reports (three accounts per card, no stacking with LECHONK) + several X posts the same day + visitor submission email (24 November 2026, 09:02)

videodb-20-free-credits.title: [Global] VideoDB: $20 of free credits without a card, edit video straight from the Claude or ChatGPT plugin
videodb-20-free-credits.highlight: The vendor states new accounts get $20 of credits with no card; added as a Claude or ChatGPT plugin or an MCP server, the agent finds the moment, cuts the clip and returns a playable link
videodb-20-free-credits.regions: [Global] Sign up on the website with no regional limit; the plugins need a working Claude or ChatGPT account
videodb-20-free-credits.content: VideoDB treats video as a queryable database: upload a file or paste a link and the AI agent finds moments, edits them and returns a playable link. The official agents and pricing pages state that new accounts get $20 of credits with no credit card, connected either as a Claude or ChatGPT plugin from the plugin directory (added and authorised once) or as the MCP server at https://mcp.videodb.io/mcp, which also works in Claude Code and Cursor. Credits burn by usage: uploads $0.09 per GB, transcoding $0.004 a minute for SD and $0.009 for HD, transcription $0.01 a minute, search $1.50 per thousand queries, storage $0.03 per GB a month, while generation is the expensive part at $0.5 a second for video and $0.15 a minute for audio. The $20 covers roughly 200 minutes of HD transcoding plus a number of edits and searches, and generation drains it quickly.
videodb-20-free-credits.conditions: A VideoDB account is enough, with no card; the Claude or ChatGPT side needs the plugin added and authorised once; the $20 is a one-off allowance per account and usage after that is billed.
steps: Register at videodb.io and take an API key from console.videodb.io
Add VideoDB from the plugin directory in Claude or ChatGPT and authorise it, or point an MCP client at mcp.videodb.io/mcp
Paste a video link or upload a file and ask the agent for the moment you want
Watch usage in the console and stay away from video generation to keep the credits
videodb-20-free-credits.risk: The $20 is one-off and burns by usage, and generation at $0.5 a second empties it fast; the vendor makes no promise that the allowance stays; media sits in its cloud (or your own bucket) so confirm before deleting; the plugin authorisation reads your Claude or ChatGPT account details.
videodb-20-free-credits.source: VideoDB official agents and pricing pages (verified 24 November 2026: $20 of credits, no card, plugin and MCP access, full rate card) + official video-db/skills repository + visitor submission email (24 November 2026, 09:03)

rev-ai-5h-free-credits.title: [Global] Rev AI: new accounts get credits worth 5 hours of transcription across every product, no card
rev-ai-5h-free-credits.highlight: The pricing page states free credits equivalent to 5 hours of Reverb ASR that work on all products, with an account and an API key enough to start
rev-ai-5h-free-credits.regions: [Global] Sign up online with no regional limit; credits are counted in hours and usage after that is billed
rev-ai-5h-free-credits.content: Rev AI's pay-as-you-go column says free credits are equivalent to 5 hours of Reverb ASR and notes they work across all products. Rates: Reverb transcription at $0.20 an hour for English and $0.30 for foreign languages, Whisper Large at $0.005 a minute, forced alignment and language identification at $0.003 a minute, standard machine translation at $0.002 a minute, with sentiment and summarisation billed by word or minute. Billing rounds up to the nearest second with a 15-second minimum. Five hours works out to about $1-1.5, enough to get an ASR pipeline working before paying for volume.
rev-ai-5h-free-credits.conditions: An account and an API key are enough with no card; the allowance counts as 5 hours and usage after that is billed per minute or hour.
steps: Register at rev.ai, no card needed
Create an API key in the console
Spend the five hours on the audio you need, English being the cheapest per hour
rev-ai-5h-free-credits.risk: The allowance is worth about $1, so it is small; Reverb costs $0.20 an hour for English and $0.30 for foreign languages while Whisper and translation bill separately; extra usage is charged at once; the vendor makes no promise that free credits stay.
rev-ai-5h-free-credits.source: Rev AI official pricing page (verified 24 November 2026: free credits equal to 5 hours of Reverb ASR, valid on all products, full rate card) + visitor submission email (24 November 2026, 09:03)

luckysim-hk-3y-138.title: [Hong Kong] Lucky SIM three-year number keeper: HKD 138 for 30GB of Hong Kong data and 2,000 minutes, eSIM included
luckysim-hk-3y-138.highlight: A three-year prepaid card on the CSL network: HKD 138 buys a +852 number with 30GB of Hong Kong data at 42Mbps and 2,000 local minutes over 1,095 days, as a physical SIM or an eSIM
luckysim-hk-3y-138.regions: [Hong Kong] A +852 number on the CSL network; the plan covers Hong Kong data and calls only and roaming is bought separately
luckysim-hk-3y-138.content: LuckySIM leases the CSL network and sells this as plan code LSPG#1095D_30G42M_2000: HKD 138 brings 30GB of Hong Kong data capped at 42Mbps plus 2,000 minutes of local calls, valid for 1,095 days with the number kept throughout, and local calls beyond the allowance cost HKD 0.1 a minute. A physical SIM or an eSIM both work, but the eSIM installs only once and cannot move to another phone, and sales are final. Hotspot sharing and VoLTE work while IDD international calls do not. Hong Kong services require real-name registration at rnr.luckysim.com.hk, checked within two working days at most, and the line stays blocked until the check clears; the vendor also converts between SIM and eSIM. The plan covers Hong Kong alone, so data abroad needs a separate roaming bundle such as 24GB across 17 countries including China for HKD 150 over two years, while roaming voice deducts local minutes.
luckysim-hk-3y-138.conditions: Buy from the official shop or an authorised agent for HKD 138, with overseas postage extra; real-name registration with a passport or Hong Kong ID is mandatory before use; the eSIM installs once with no refund; numbers are random; roaming data is a separate bundle.
steps: Order the three-year 30GB plus 2,000-minute plan at shop.luckysim.com.hk for HKD 138
Register the card at rnr.luckysim.com.hk and wait for the confirmation SMS, at most two working days
Insert a physical card, or write the eSIM QR code from the email, remembering it installs once only
Put the activation date plus 1,095 days in your calendar and renew or replace the card before it ends
luckysim-hk-3y-138.risk: The eSIM installs once, so changing phones or wiping the device kills it; real-name registration is mandatory and a Hong Kong ID or passport is required; the plan covers Hong Kong only, so roaming data must be bought separately and the 30GB does not roam; numbers are random; agents may charge different prices and number transfers or overseas shipping cost extra; an expired prepaid card loses the number.
luckysim-hk-3y-138.source: LuckySIM official shop listing (verified 24 November 2026: HKD 138, 30GB at 42Mbps, 2,000 minutes, 1,095 days, eSIM installs once, no refunds, real-name portal, VoLTE, no IDD) + luckysim.com.hk main site (real-name rules, add-on data, SIM and eSIM conversion) + official roaming bundle listing (24GB across 17 countries including China, HKD 150 over two years) + stepstepinfo Lucky SIM guide (1 April 2026: free SMS abroad, eSIM transfer process) + visitor submission email (24 November 2026, 09:02)

zed-student-pro-1y.title: [Global] Zed for students: a year of Pro free with $10 of AI credit a month, edu.cn accepted
zed-student-pro-1y.highlight: Enrolled students get Zed Pro free for a year with a university email: $10 of token credits a month, unlimited edit predictions and real-time collaboration, and mainland edu.cn addresses have passed
zed-student-pro-1y.regions: [Global] Students at accredited universities worldwide; the school domain has to be in JetBrains' open university list
zed-student-pro-1y.value: A year of Pro plus $10 a month (about $120)
zed-student-pro-1y.content: Zed's education page states that enrolled students aged 18 and over get Zed Pro free for a year by verifying a university email, including $10 a month in token credits, unlimited edit predictions and real-time collaboration, after which the account drops back to Free. Verification needs a GitHub account older than 30 days to sign in and a valid university email, matched against JetBrains' open-source university domain database, and a missing domain can be submitted. The student plan excludes Claude Fable, Claude Opus and GPT Pro models. A NodeSeek user confirmed on 31 October 2026 that an edu.cn address passes, with Claude Sonnet and other models available and $10 a month of credit.
zed-student-pro-1y.conditions: Enrolled students at least 18 years old; a GitHub account older than 30 days plus a valid university email, with edu.cn confirmed working; Claude Fable, Opus and GPT Pro are excluded; the plan reverts to Free after a year.
steps: Sign in at zed.dev/education with a GitHub account older than 30 days
Submit the university email and verify it, submitting the domain yourself if it is missing
Install Zed and confirm in settings that Pro and the monthly $10 are active
zed-student-pro-1y.risk: Students only, so graduating or losing the email ends it; a domain missing from the database waits for review; the priciest models such as Claude Fable and Opus are excluded; $10 a month runs out quickly with heavy use; it downgrades to Free after a year and needs re-verification.
zed-student-pro-1y.source: Zed official education page (verified 24 November 2026: a year of Pro, $10 a month in credits, GitHub account older than 30 days plus university email, domain database, excluded models) + NodeSeek post-1022195 (31 October 2026: edu.cn passes) and post-901489 (30 August 2026: model list)

kaggle-free-gpu-30h-weekly.title: [Global] Kaggle free GPU: about 30 hours of NVIDIA compute a week inside Notebooks
kaggle-free-gpu-30h-weekly.highlight: A free Kaggle account registered with an email opens NVIDIA P100 or T4x2 sessions in Notebooks with a weekly quota of about 30 hours that resets every week
kaggle-free-gpu-30h-weekly.regions: [Global] Used online with no regional limit, though direct access from mainland China is unreliable and needs a working network
kaggle-free-gpu-30h-weekly.value: About 30 hours of free GPU a week
kaggle-free-gpu-30h-weekly.content: Kaggle's official Efficient GPU Usage Tips page states that it provides free NVIDIA Tesla P100 GPUs, with T4x2 on some notebooks, under a per-week quota of about 30 hours that resets weekly and can be higher when resources allow. Usage is visible in the settings menu of the notebook editor, at the top of kaggle.com/notebooks, on your profile and in the session manager. The savings that matter: leave the GPU off unless the code uses it; an interactive session stays alive until the 60-minute idle timeout, so stopping it yourself can save up to an hour; batch commits run every cell from top to bottom and cost more quota, and an unfinished commit should be cancelled before another is started. An account needs only an email, with no card and no identity check.
kaggle-free-gpu-30h-weekly.conditions: A free Kaggle account by email with no card; about 30 GPU hours a week per account that cannot be transferred; the GPUs are P100 or T4 class rather than the newest cards; direct access from mainland China is unreliable.
steps: Register a Kaggle account with an email address, no card required
Open a notebook and set Accelerator to GPU P100 or T4x2 in the session options
Stop the session as soon as the run ends instead of waiting for the 60-minute idle timeout
Check remaining weekly GPU hours on your profile or at the top of the notebooks page
kaggle-free-gpu-30h-weekly.risk: The 30 hours is approximate and the page says it can be higher or lower with demand; only P100 and T4 class cards are offered, not enough for large models; interactive sessions drop after 60 idle minutes so long jobs need checkpoints; free tiers can change at any time; kaggle.com often fails to load directly from mainland China.
kaggle-free-gpu-30h-weekly.source: Kaggle official Efficient GPU Usage Tips documentation (verified 24 November 2026: NVIDIA P100, about 30 hours a week with weekly reset, where to check usage, 60-minute idle timeout, commits cost more) + NodeSeek post-1066396 (November 2026: T4x2 and 30 hours a week in practice)

contabo-black-friday-2026.title: [Global]Contabo Black Friday: Cloud VPS Plus 2 (2 EPYC cores/4GB/75GB NVMe) at €7.20 a month, price locked for 24 months
contabo-black-friday-2026.highlight: The new Performance entry plan gives 2 AMD EPYC vCPU, 4GB RAM, 75GB NVMe, a 300Mbit port and unlimited traffic for €7.20 a month averaged over a 24-month term (€9.00 before), with Core VPS from €4.40 and Max Performance VDS from €43.20
contabo-black-friday-2026.regions: [Global] EU locations are free; some, such as the UK, add a monthly surcharge (Plus 2 in the UK is €2.54 more)
contabo-black-friday-2026.value: €43.20 saved over 24 months (20% off, price locked for two years)
contabo-black-friday-2026.content: This year's headline plan is Cloud VPS Plus 2: 2 AMD EPYC vCPU, 4GB RAM, 75GB NVMe, a 300Mbit/s port and unlimited traffic subject to a fair usage policy. A 24-month term averages €7.20 a month excluding VAT (€8.71 with 21% VAT) against a €9.00 list price, saving €43.20 and locking that price for two years; 12 months is €7.65 a month (15% off) and 1, 3 or 6 month terms get no discount. Core VPS starts at €4.40 a month on 24 months (4 vCPU, 8GB, 100GB SSD, 200Mbit) and Max Performance VDS at €43.20 (6 dedicated cores, 24GB, 180GB NVMe). Every KVM instance includes one static IPv4 plus a /64 IPv6, root SSH with key injection, a free network-level firewall that drops all inbound traffic until you open ports (any port from 0 to 65535), 30-day snapshots, a VNC console and DDoS protection; Windows is an add-on licence. New monthly contracts for Cloud VPS 4 carry a one-time setup fee.
contabo-black-friday-2026.conditions: The discount requires the 24-month term, paid up front; prices exclude VAT, EU locations are free and others add a surcharge; outbound traffic falls under a fair usage policy and disruptive usage can be throttled; the minimum renewal term equals the first term, and post-paid contracts need four weeks' notice.
steps: Open contabo.com/en/black-friday/ and look at the 24-month price for Cloud VPS Plus 2
On the order page pick a location (EU is free, the UK and others cost more) and the 24-month term, then check the tax-inclusive total
Log in over SSH as root with the emailed password, or reinstall with your own SSH key
Open the ports you need in the control panel firewall, which drops all inbound traffic by default
contabo-black-friday-2026.risk: The low price is a two-year prepayment, about €172.80 in total for Plus 2; shared vCPU cores mean noisy neighbours and route quality you should test yourself, so keep latency-sensitive production databases elsewhere; unlimited outbound traffic is subject to fair use; non-EU locations and taxes add cost; prepaid terms are not refunded on cancellation.
contabo-black-friday-2026.source: Contabo official Black Friday and VPS pages (read 24 November 2026: €7.20 on 24 months, Core from €4.40, VDS from €43.20, UK location +€2.54) + official docs.contabo.com (1 IPv4 and /64 IPv6, root SSH, firewall ports, snapshots) + NodeSeek thread (23 November 2026)

westpac-altitude-qantas-black-90k.title: [Australia]Westpac Altitude Qantas Black: 90,000 Qantas points plus 50 status credits for A$9,000 of spend
westpac-altitude-qantas-black-90k.highlight: Spend A$9,000 on eligible purchases within 90 days of approval for 90,000 Qantas points and 50 status credits; another A$9,000 in year two adds 60,000 points; the annual fee is A$295 plus a A$155 Qantas Rewards fee, or A$200 in year one for existing Westpac customers
westpac-altitude-qantas-black-90k.regions: [Australia] Australian or New Zealand citizens, permanent residents or holders of a visa valid for at least a year, with a fixed Australian address and A$75,000+ income
westpac-altitude-qantas-black-90k.value: 90,000 Qantas points plus 50 status credits (about A$1,350), and 60,000 more points in year two
westpac-altitude-qantas-black-90k.content: New cardholders of Altitude Qantas Black earn 90,000 Qantas points and 50 status credits after A$9,000 of eligible spend within 90 days of approval, then a further 60,000 points after another A$9,000 in the first 90 days of the second membership year, for up to 150,000 points and 50 status credits across two years. The annual card fee is A$295 plus a A$155 Qantas Rewards programme fee; existing Westpac customers who sign in before applying pay A$200 in year one, and some customers invited by email get the first-year fee waived. Points accrue at 1.5 per A$1 on international spend, 0.8 on everyday categories (supermarkets, department stores, fuel, utilities) and 0.4 elsewhere, dropping to 0.25 above A$10,000 in a statement cycle. The card also includes two Qantas Club lounge invitations a year, travel insurance and concierge. At 1.5 Australian cents a point, 90,000 points are worth roughly A$1,350.
westpac-altitude-qantas-black-90k.conditions: The sign-up bonus requires no Westpac credit card in the past 24 months; applicants must be 18 or over, live at a fixed Australian address, have a verifiable Australian taxable income of at least A$75,000 and a minimum A$6,000 credit limit; citizenship, permanent residency or a visa valid for at least a year is required, along with a credit check.
steps: Check that you have held no Westpac credit card in the past 24 months and that you have a Qantas Frequent Flyer number
Apply from the Westpac Altitude Qantas Black page, signing in first as an existing customer to see the A$200 or waived first-year fee
Put A$9,000 of eligible spend on the card within 90 days of approval, then another A$9,000 in the same window of year two for 60,000 points
Use the two Qantas Club invitations and, if you do not want to keep the card, downgrade or close it before the second annual fee
westpac-altitude-qantas-black-90k.risk: A credit card application leaves a hard enquiry that affects later credit and mortgage approvals; A$9,000 in 90 days is a hard threshold and missing it wastes the A$450 in fees; the waived first-year fee is a targeted invitation, not a public offer; point value assumes 1.5 Australian cents each and depends on Classic Reward availability; status credits cannot be transferred and do not count towards loyalty bonuses; foreign transactions cost 3%.
westpac-altitude-qantas-black-90k.source: Westpac official Altitude Qantas Black page (read 24 November 2026: 90,000 points and 50 status credits for A$9,000 in 90 days, 60,000 points in year two, A$295 fee, A$200 for existing customers, A$155 Qantas Rewards fee, A$75,000 income floor) + Qantas newsroom release + OzBargain post (24 November 2026, 12:40, targeted fee waiver)

perch-ai-starter-free-20-monthly.title: [Global]Perch AI Starter: a free tier with $20 of usage a month, no card, across web, desktop and CLI
perch-ai-starter-free-20-monthly.highlight: The pricing page lists Starter at $0 with $20 of hosted usage each month and one account across web, desktop and CLI, running DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash and Laguna S 2.1 plus the Flock financial suite
perch-ai-starter-free-20-monthly.regions: [Global] Sign up on the site or in the app with no regional limit; Starter usage data feeds its training programme by default
perch-ai-starter-free-20-monthly.value: $20 a month on a permanent free tier
perch-ai-starter-free-20-monthly.content: The official pricing page (read 24 November 2026) lists Starter at $0 a month including $20 of hosted usage, covering Laguna S 2.1, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash, Flock and the financial suites, citation checks and Writing Studio. One account works across web, desktop and CLI, and you can plug in your own API key to bypass its limits. Pro is $10 a month during Early Access against a $20 list price and includes up to $150 of usage a month, $75 of it on models you pick, plus Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Carbon, Claude Opus 5.5 and 32 other models, and keeps your work out of training. Ultra is $30 a month with no 5-hour window and up to $450 of weekly-usage room a week. Starter works only inside its own clients and includes no public API, so it cannot feed Cline or Cursor.
perch-ai-starter-free-20-monthly.conditions: Registering a Perch account is enough and no card is needed; Starter has the Data Program on by default, where deidentified usage may feed commercially licensed training, and it must be switched off under Settings then Privacy; the model list rotates, so check the in-app picker.
steps: Open perchai.app or chat.perchai.app, register and choose the $0 Starter plan
Turn off the Data Program under Settings then Privacy before using it for real work
Install the desktop app or CLI and sign in with the same account, then pick DeepSeek or GLM in the model picker
For third-party tools use your own API key, since Starter usage cannot be exported
perch-ai-starter-free-20-monthly.risk: It is a third-party hosting and relay platform, so keep sensitive material out and do not sign in with an important identity provider; Starter data feeds training by default; there is no public API and no way into Cursor or Cline; testers report the web client cannot pick models and that busy periods queue, so heavy use means Pro or another service; allowances and models can change at any time.
perch-ai-starter-free-20-monthly.source: Perch AI official pricing page (read 24 November 2026: Starter $0 with $20 a month, Pro $10 Early Access, Ultra $30, supported models and data programme) + AIJP and NodeSeek posts (11 November 2026, with field reports that the web client cannot choose models and the desktop app is needed)

kiroween-2026-4000-credits.title: [Global] Kiroween 2026 hackathon: entrants can request 4,000 Kiro credits (about $80, ask by Dec 1)
kiroween-2026-4000-credits.highlight: AWS's Kiroween 2026 hackathon: registered entrants can request a one-time 4,000 Kiro credits, worth about $80 at the Pro rate of $20 per 1,000 credits; request by Dec 1, 12:00 PM PT, redeem by Dec 4, spend them by Dec 31, with a Devpost signup and a Didit ID check
kiroween-2026-4000-credits.regions: [Global] Devpost registration plus a Kiro account; residents of Quebec, Argentina, Brazil, Italy, the Philippines, Russia, the UAE and similar regions cannot enter
kiroween-2026-4000-credits.value: 4,000 Kiro credits (about $80, or $160 at add-on prices)
kiroween-2026-4000-credits.content: Kiro is AWS's agentic IDE: the free tier gives 50 credits a month with Claude Sonnet 4.5 and open-weight models such as DeepSeek, GLM-5 and Qwen3 Coder Next under rate limits, while Pro costs $20, Power costs $200 for 10,000 included credits (about $0.02 each) and add-on credits are $0.04 each. Kiroween 2026 opened registration on October 13 with submissions from October 30 to December 4, 2:00 PM PT. Entrants can request 4,000 credits from the Resources page: one grant per person with no top-ups, a code within 48 business hours, requests close December 1 at 12:00 PM PT, codes must be redeemed by December 4 and redeemed credits expire December 31 at 11:59 PM PT. Requests need a Didit check (selfie and government ID) and the Devpost profile name must match the ID; credits are only for building the submission and have no cash value.
kiroween-2026-4000-credits.conditions: Register on kiroween.devpost.com and hold a Kiro account (or an AWS account ID); be of legal age where you live; Quebec, Argentina, Brazil, Italy, the Philippines, Russia, the UAE and sanctioned regions cannot enter; a failed ID check means no code; the grant is one-time and not topped up.
steps: Create a Kiro account at kiro.dev and note your Kiro user ID (an AWS account ID if you sign in that way)
Register at kiroween.devpost.com and pick one category: Resurrection, Frankenstein, Skeleton Crew or Costume Contest
Open the credit request form on the Resources page, fill in your name, Devpost email and profile, and complete the Didit ID check
Submit before December 1, 12:00 PM PT; when the code arrives, open the redemption link while signed in to Kiro before December 4
Confirm the kiroween-prefixed balance on app.kiro.dev and spend it before December 31
kiroween-2026-4000-credits.risk: Credits are reviewed and handed out first come, first served, so approval is not guaranteed; you hand a selfie and government ID to Didit; you must actually register and build in one category, so a bare credit request can be declined; expired codes are not replaced; only projects started after October 30 count; Kiro's models and features vary by region and the free tier gives only 50 credits a month, so continuing after the grant means paying for Pro.
kiroween-2026-4000-credits.source: Official Kiroween 2026 Resources page and Official Rules (read 24 November 2026: 4,000 credits, requests by December 1, 12:00 PM PT, redeem by December 4, expiry December 31, Didit ID check, excluded regions) + Kiro's official pricing page (read 24 November 2026: 50 free credits, Pro $20, Power $200 with 10,000 credits, add-on credits at $0.04, used for the about $80-160 estimate)

queryra-black-friday-club.title: [Global] Queryra Black Friday Club: 1,000 extra AI searches a month free for 6 months (join Nov 23-30)
queryra-black-friday-club.highlight: An AI semantic search plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce: join the Black Friday Club from your dashboard between November 23 and 30 and get 1,000 extra AI searches every month for six months on top of your plan, the same as the $9.99 Essential plan, with no card and no code
queryra-black-friday-club.regions: [Global] A free Queryra account for your own WordPress or WooCommerce store; works on every plan including the free one, no card needed
queryra-black-friday-club.value: About $60 (six months of the $9.99 Essential plan)
queryra-black-friday-club.content: Queryra is an AI semantic search plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce that indexes up to 10,000 products: the free Community plan gives 100 AI searches a month and Essential at $9.99 gives 1,000. Join the Black Friday Club from the Club page in your dashboard between November 23 and 30, with no code and no card, and for the next six months you get 1,000 extra AI searches a month on top of whatever plan you are on, the same as Essential for free. If your store had already burned this month's searches, AI search switches back on within six hours. After six months the account returns to its normal plan with nothing deleted, charged or to cancel.

ipv64-free-dyndns.title: [DE] IPv64.net free DynDNS: 3 domains per account across 19 suffixes
ipv64-free-dyndns.highlight: A free DynDNS run by Germany's Prox IT UG: registration and use cost nothing, each account gets 3 DynDNS domains under 19 suffixes including ipv64.net, ipv64.de, home64.de, nas64.de and vpn64.de, with DynDNS2, separate A/AAAA updates and IPv6 prefixes, plus Let's Encrypt through acme.sh or Certbot DNS challenges
ipv64-free-dyndns.regions: [DE] Operated by Prox IT UG in Mülheim an der Ruhr, Germany; registration open worldwide, with 3 DynDNS domains per account on the free tier
ipv64-free-dyndns.content: IPv64.net is a free DynDNS service from Germany's Prox IT UG. Registration and use cost nothing, and the free tier allows 3 DynDNS domains per account under 19 suffixes such as ipv64.net, ipv64.de, home64.de, nas64.de and vpn64.de. It speaks DynDNS2, updates A and AAAA records together or separately, supports IPv6 prefixes and ignores the shared IPv4 behind DS-Lite or CGNAT. Ready-made update URLs exist for FRITZ!Box, Speedport, UniFi, MikroTik, OPNsense, Synology and a Linux cron job. You can issue Let's Encrypt certificates through the DNS challenge with acme.sh or Certbot, and the DNS servers sit behind load balancers with DDoS protection and failover. You can also point your own domain's nameservers here to manage records, though IPv64 is not a registrar.
ipv64-free-dyndns.conditions: Free registration is enough; the free tier caps you at 3 DynDNS domains per account; it is DNS only, with no web hosting or mailboxes; free subdomains cannot be hosted on Cloudflare (the service only supports NS records and does not guarantee it works); the subdomains belong to IPv64.net and cannot be transferred out; your own domain needs to stay registered elsewhere with nameservers pointed here.
steps: Open ipv64.net/dyndns and click Register now (free, no card)
Pick a suffix and prefix in your account and register up to 3 DynDNS domains
Copy the device-specific update URL into your router or client (FRITZ!Box, Synology, cron and others)
For HTTPS, issue a Let's Encrypt certificate via the DNS challenge with acme.sh or Certbot on a machine you control
ipv64-free-dyndns.risk: The subdomains stay the property of IPv64.net, so free limits, suffixes and terms can change at any time; free subdomains can't be hosted on Cloudflare directly (IPv64 only supports NS records and does not guarantee it, and it does not work as commonly claimed), so treat any "Cloudflare-ready" advice as unverified; three domains are enough for a home network, NAS or self-hosted service entry point but not for a real site; it cannot act as a registrar or transfer domains out; it is a small German company with no SLA, so a shutdown means moving your DNS yourself.
ipv64-free-dyndns.source: IPv64.net's official DynDNS page (read 24 November 2026: 3 DynDNS domains on the free tier, 19 suffixes, DynDNS2, A/AAAA, ACME support, run by Prox IT UG in Germany) + a 2Libra post (23 November 2026) noting the 3-domain limit

Leave auto-renewal on and the bill drops to £14 from the sixth renewal and £13 from the twelfth

vpsfree-io-free-nat-vps.highlight: A Dutch LXC box you sign up for with an email and no card or KYC: root SSH, but only 20 NAT ports, and a short sponsor step every 10 days keeps it free
vpsfree-io-free-nat-vps.regions: [Global] Sign-up with any email; servers only in Amsterdam and Frankfurt
vpsfree-io-free-nat-vps.value: 10 days of free server, renewals free ($0.29 per 30 days to skip the sponsor step)
vpsfree-io-free-nat-vps.content: The free tier at VPSFree.io is a small LXC server in Amsterdam: 1 vCPU at 30% (EPYC 7402P), 192MB of RAM plus 64MB swap, 3GB of NVMe, a 30Mbit port and 100GB of monthly traffic, with L3/L4 DDoS protection. You get root over SSH (port 20000 in the example), Ubuntu 24.04 or Debian 12, Docker and Nginx, and a `vpsfree` menu once logged in. Networking is a shared IPv4 NAT with only 20 ports, and the free plan has no IPv6; the site showed 38 free slots when checked. Sign-up is email only, with no card and no KYC. A short sponsor step every 10 days renews it for free, or $0.29 per 30 days skips the ads. No support and no SLA on the free plan.
vpsfree-io-free-nat-vps.conditions: Register and confirm an email address; no card and no KYC. Complete the sponsor step every 10 days to renew, or the server expires. Port scanning, attacks, mining and other abuse get the account closed.
steps: Register at vpsfree.io with an email and confirm the message
In the console pick the free 192MB NAT VPS and start it in Amsterdam or Frankfurt
Log in with root over SSH on the IP and one of the 20 NAT ports (password or your own ED25519 key)
Return to the panel before expiry to renew through the sponsor step, or pay $0.29 to skip it
vpsfree-io-free-nat-vps.risk: Shared NAT IPv4 with only 20 ports and no IPv6, so anything needing full fixed ports will not work. A new platform with no SLA and no support, so keep nothing important on it. The renewal step sends you through an ad page. Only two European locations.

ghost-downloader-3.content: A cross-platform downloader written in Python and Qt (PySide6), GPL-3.0, 17,300 stars on GitHub, with v4.5.11 shipped on 20 November 2026. It covers HTTP, magnet/BT, FTP, M3U8, MPEG-DASH and eD2k; YouTube and Bilibili support clip selection, any quality and subtitles, playlists and multi-part episodes, and GitHub/HuggingFace downloads get mirror acceleration. A browser extension puts a download button next to the video and carries your login state over. Smart chunking avoids file merging, bandwidth is detected automatically, real-browser TLS fingerprints get past anti-bot checks, and you can change the URL, headers or proxy mid-download. It exposes an aria2-compatible RPC for third-party tools and has a Feature Packs plugin ecosystem. No account, no ads, no card.
ghost-downloader-3.conditions: Free and open source under GPL-3.0, so just install the release; no account needed; YouTube/Bilibili downloads need your own signed-in session; Android needs 9.0 or later and Linux needs glibc 2.35+.

ghost-downloader-3.risk: Open-source software, so compile it yourself or use the official package rather than a repack; downloading copyrighted material (Bilibili and YouTube included) is still your own compliance risk; BT downloads carry seeding and bandwidth costs; plugins come from the community and individual ones can fall out of date.

esimnote-free-1gb-esim.highlight: Archived after testing: on 25 Nov 2026 we read claim.php and its inline JS - "share to unlock" just opens a share window and after two seconds flips to "Share Verified!" with no check, a 30-second progress bar ends in showFinal(), whose comment reads "// Generate Dummy QR", and the QR image is drawn by api.qrserver.com with a made-up "LPA:1$esimnote.com$TRIAL-<timestamp>" payload; the page has no form, fetch or backend at all, so scanning it installs nothing. The detail page stays for reference, with alternatives at the top
esimnote-free-1gb-esim.regions: [Global] 12 destinations: US, Europe (33 countries), UK, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Canada, Australia, Japan, Turkey, Singapore; mainland China is not included (only paid plans on the homepage list China at $2.50/GB)
esimnote-free-1gb-esim.value: 1GB / 10 days of data (≈$5, not actually obtainable)
esimnote-free-1gb-esim.content: Archived: the free eSIM cannot be installed. eSimNote's homepage pushes "Stop Paying Roaming Fees. Start with 1GB Free." and "1,000+ Free Trials Claimed Today", and claim.php offers a $0.00 "1GB Data Pack / 10 Days • 5G Speed" through three steps: pick a destination, share with one friend to unlock, scan the QR code. The 12 destinations are the US, Europe (33 countries), the UK, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Canada, Australia, Japan, Turkey and Singapore - mainland China is missing. Reading the whole page and its inline JS on 25 November 2026: "unlockShare()" only opens a WhatsApp, Facebook or Messenger share window and after two seconds unconditionally prints "Share Verified!" and unlocks the next step; "startGeneration()" runs a fake 30-second progress bar (Allocating 5G Bandwidth... then Generating Unique ID... then Finalizing...) and its "showFinal()" is commented "// Generate Dummy QR", drawing a QR image from api.qrserver.com whose payload is "LPA:1$esimnote.com$TRIAL-<timestamp>" - an invented activation string, not a carrier profile. There is no form, fetch or backend, no email is sent, and the page still carries three AD SPACE placeholders.
esimnote-free-1gb-esim.conditions: Archived and unobtainable. Historic terms: an eSIM-capable phone (the page lists iPhone XS-14, Galaxy S20-S23, Pixel 3-7, Huawei P40 and Mate 40); the flow asks you to share the link with one friend before the QR code unlocks; none of the 12 destinations include mainland China.
steps: Open esimnote.com and press Claim Free 1GB to reach claim.php
Pick a destination (US, Europe 33, UK, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Canada, Australia, Japan, Turkey, Singapore) and press Continue
Share via WhatsApp, Facebook or Messenger, wait two seconds for "Share Verified!", then press Generate QR Code
The progress bar finishes after 30 seconds and shows a QR code, but it is only a front-end drawing that installs nothing - there is no point retrying
esimnote-free-1gb-esim.risk: Archived as unusable: the QR code is just a picture drawn by api.qrserver.com, encoding an invented "LPA:1$esimnote.com$TRIAL-<timestamp>" string rather than a carrier profile, so a phone cannot install it and no data follows. "Share to unlock" is not verified at all - it passes after two seconds. The page has no form, endpoint or email delivery, so do not enter personal data or pay anything here; the homepage and claim page use "1,000+ Free Trials Claimed Today" and "256-Bit SSL Secure Connection" plus ad slots to look legitimate, which is bait-page behaviour.
esimnote-free-1gb-esim.source: eSimNote claim page and inline JS read on 25 Nov 2026 (fake share check, 30-second progress bar, `// Generate Dummy QR`, api.qrserver.com payload, no backend) + Ur.io team's test reporting the download fails, relayed by their assistant (25 Nov 2026)

travelkon-bfcm-50off-esim.content: TravelKon's Black Friday and Cyber Monday sale: from 26 to 30 November one eSIM is 50% off each day between 12:00am and 11:59pm AWST, and everything else on the site is 30% off, applied automatically at checkout with no code. 26 Nov Vietnam Viettel 5GB/day at A$9.50 for 7 days, A$14.50 for 15 days, A$22.50 for 30 days; 27 Nov Japan KDDI fixed plans from A$7.50 for 12GB over 4 days with true unlimited from A$9.50 for 3 days and A$59.50 for 31 days; 28 Nov Orange Global covering 180+ countries, 30 days up to 20GB for A$29.50; 29 Nov Europe Llamaya with EU calls at A$12.50 for 25GB, A$24.50 for 50GB and A$34.50 for 80GB over 28 days; 30 Nov Southeast Asia 5 (Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Hong Kong) 300GB over 30 days for A$22.50. travelkon-bfcm-50off-esim.conditions: The 50% price applies only to that day's product during its 24-hour window in AWST; buying on another day gets 30% off. Needs an unlocked eSIM phone. Choose duration and data tier, add it to the cart; the discount is applied at checkout
Pay and receive the redemption code by email, then redeem it just before you travel
Add the eSIM to your phone and switch on data roaming when you land

Prices are in AUD, so non-Australian cards face exchange differences and possible 3-D Secure failures. Viettel states OTP texts may not arrive and the plan has no calls or texts; Llamaya calls work only inside the EU. ethena-pay-black-friday-50-cashback.highlight: Official promotion terms: from 00:00 on 27 November to 00:00 on 1 December 2026 (UTC+8), every active cardholder regardless of tier earns 50% AVAX cashback on the first $200 of qualifying spend, capped at $100 per person; the same window runs a Weekend Draw for ten winners paid their total qualifying spend up to $1,000, entered by spending $200 on any single day or via the free entry form
ethena-pay-black-friday-50-cashback.regions: [47 non-US markets] Matches Ethena Pay's card coverage: US, UK and EU residents are not eligible, mainland China and Taiwan are not open yet, and an overseas ID is required
ethena-pay-black-friday-50-cashback.value: Up to $100 cashback plus a draw prize of up to $1,000
ethena-pay-black-friday-50-cashback.content: Ethena Pay's official promotion terms, section 3.1: from 00:00 on 27 November to 00:00 on 1 December 2026 (UTC+8), every active cardholder in good standing earns 50% crypto cashback in AVAX on the first $200 of qualifying spend, capped at $100 per cardholder; spending above that earns the standard cashback of your tier, and the promotion replaces rather than stacks on it. The same window runs the Weekend Draw: ten winners receive a reward equal to their total qualifying spend during the promotion, capped at $1,000 each, entered automatically by spending $200 on any single day (UTC+8) or through the free entry form, with equal odds and a certified independent draw. Rewards are valued at the AVAX settlement price and paid in the order qualifying transactions settle (one to three business days). The promotion budget is limited and the offer ends for everyone when it runs out. Gambling, cash advances, gift cards and crypto purchases, which are excluded from standard cashback, do not count.
ethena-pay-black-friday-50-cashback.conditions: Requires an active Ethena Pay card in good standing, any tier. Only qualifying purchases count; gambling, cash advances, gift cards, crypto purchases and P2P transfers are excluded. The budget is limited and can end the promotion early. KYC is required, mainland China and Taiwan are not open, and refunded or reversed purchases do not count and may have rewards clawed back.
steps: If you already hold a card, check it is active and spend with it during the window; otherwise complete Ethena Pay KYC and open one first
From 00:00 on 27 November (UTC+8) put the first $200 of qualifying spend on the card
To enter the draw, spend $200 on any single day or use the official free entry form once per person
Watch for the AVAX cashback after transactions settle; draw winners are emailed after the promotion ends
ethena-pay-black-friday-50-cashback.risk: Cashback is paid in AVAX, so its value moves with the price; the promotion budget is limited and can end early, so check the remaining budget shown on the terms page before spending. Rewards are calculated on the settled amount at the AVAX price of that moment, and refunds are clawed back while still counting against your cap. Draw winners must still pass KYC before payment. Many exclusions apply, so do not use gift cards or crypto purchases to reach the threshold.
ethena-pay-black-friday-50-cashback.source: Ethena Pay official Promotion Terms (updated 23 Nov 2026, section 3.1 Black Friday Offer: 50%, $100 cap, $200 threshold, 27 Nov-1 Dec UTC+8, Weekend Draw of ten winners up to $1,000, free entry form, budget-limited) + Ethena announcement (24 Nov 2026) + APPDO Digital Life Guide Telegram (25 Nov 2026)

Open LifeGreen Checking online or in a branch by 01/31/2027 (use code EZV3F2M if asked)
Have $1,000+ in payroll or government ACH direct deposits post within 90 days
Wait for the $400 within 60 days of qualifying and keep the account open until it posts

usmobile-bf-18mo-unlimited-288.highlight: 12-hour flash sale on 11/27 from 11:00 to 23:59 ET: pay $288 once for 18 months of the flagship unlimited plan (normally $390 a year) and get the Pixel 11 Pro for $299 (normally $1,099); port-in required, VoIP numbers excluded
usmobile-bf-18mo-unlimited-288.regions: [US] United States only; port-in from another carrier required, limit 3 plans and 1 phone per household
usmobile-bf-18mo-unlimited-288.content: Official Black Friday page: the sale opens on 11/27 from 11:00 to 23:59 ET. Unlimited Premium is $288 paid up front for 18 months, about $16 a month against the regular $390 annual price, a saving of $297. It includes unlimited priority data, 50GB of hotspot, 20GB of roaming in 180+ countries, a free smartwatch plan on Warp, and works on all three networks (Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile); after the term it renews at $390 a year. Be on the offer page at 11:00 ET on 11/27 and pick the 18-month Unlimited Premium option
Add the Pixel 11 Pro ($299) at checkout and pay $288 plus the phone price
Activate the SIM or eSIM and complete the port-in when it arrives

cli-anything-open-source.title: [Global] CLI-Anything (open source): turn any software into a CLI your AI agent can drive (Apache-2.0, 65k stars)
cli-anything-open-source.highlight: From HKUDS: generates command-line harnesses for CAD, 3D, Office and other software so Claude Code or Codex can call them; install via CLI-Hub, Apache-2.0 licensed
cli-anything-open-source.regions: [Global] Public GitHub repository, no regional limits
cli-anything-open-source.value: Free and open source (65k GitHub stars)
cli-anything-open-source.content: CLI-Anything, maintained by HKUDS, turns desktop software into command-line interfaces that agents such as Claude Code and Codex can call directly. The repository ships harnesses for individual applications plus a unified entry point, CLI-Hub (pip install cli-anything-hub, then cli-hub install). It is Apache-2.0 licensed, created in March 2026, and now has 65k stars and 312 open issues with active community contributions. You can also write your own harness and open a PR, which is reviewed and added to the hub.
cli-anything-open-source.conditions: Needs Python and pip; some harnesses require the host application or its licence; it is a local tool with no cloud credits or compute.
steps: Clone the repository or pip install cli-anything-hub
Use cli-hub to search for the target software and install its harness
Add the generated CLI to your Claude Code or Codex configuration
Run the examples in the repository and check the output
cli-anything-open-source.risk: It moves fast with many open issues, so interfaces and harnesses can change; third-party harnesses in CLI-Hub are not individually audited, so read the code before running it; some applications need a valid licence to work.
cli-anything-open-source.source: GitHub repository read on 26 Nov 2026 (Apache-2.0, 65,564 stars, 5,957 forks, 312 open issues, created 2026-03-08) + GitHub Trending of the day (1,094 stars today)

Submit with a company email and wait about a week for the review
Once approved, the credits are applied to the account you applied with
Confirm the Scale plan and 33M characters are active in the dashboard before integrating the API

affine-open-source-workspace.highlight: A local-first workspace for docs, whiteboards and a knowledge base: MIT editor with a self-hostable backend, unlimited workspaces and members when you host it; cloud Basic is free with 100GB, 100MB files and 10 collaborators
affine-open-source-workspace.regions: [Global] Self-hosting has no regional limits; the free cloud tier allows 10 members per workspace
affine-open-source-workspace.value: Free and open source (cloud Basic free with 100GB)
affine-open-source-workspace.content: AFFiNE is an open-source alternative to Notion plus Miro: the same content flips between a document view and an infinite whiteboard (Edgeless), local-first and offline-capable, with a backend you can self-host to keep the data. The GitHub repo has 78,400 stars and 5,719 forks and was still being pushed on 2026-11-26. The pricing page states: self-hosted FOSS is free with unlimited workspaces and members; cloud Basic is free with 100GB of storage, 100MB per file, up to 10 members per workspace and 30 days of version history; Team is $10 per seat per month and the AFFiNE AI add-on starts at $8.9 per month.
affine-open-source-workspace.conditions: Self-hosting means deploying it yourself (Docker and similar) and running the server; cloud Basic is free with no card; AFFiNE AI and team add-ons cost extra; the editor is MIT but the backend is source-available, not pure MIT.
steps: Download the desktop or mobile app from affine.pro, or sign up for the free cloud Basic
To self-host, bring up the backend with Docker per the docs and point the client at your server
Keep docs, whiteboards and tasks in one workspace and invite members as needed
Add the AFFiNE AI add-on only if you want the AI features
affine-open-source-workspace.risk: The backend is source-available rather than pure MIT, so read the licence before commercial use or redistribution; the free cloud tier caps members and storage; self-hosting means maintaining backups and upgrades yourself; AI features are billed separately.

snowflake-trial-400.title: [Global]Snowflake free trial: $400 for 30 days, email signup with no card
snowflake-trial-400.highlight: Sign up with a work email for $400 of usage over 30 days on AWS, Azure or GCP; load and query data, run Snowpark and Streamlit, while AI features need a card
snowflake-trial-400.regions: [Global] Needs a valid work email; the cloud platform, region and edition cannot be changed after signup
snowflake-trial-400.content: Snowflake's self-service trial needs only a valid email and no credit card: $400 of usage over 30 days, deducted by the actual consumption of virtual warehouses and storage, ending when either runs out. You pick the cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP), region and edition at signup and cannot change them later. The account can load data from S3, Azure or GCS, run SQL and Snowpark, host Streamlit apps and connect BI tools. AI features are off by default until a card is added; external network access, hybrid tables and Openflow are not available on trials. Without an upgrade the account is suspended when the trial ends and leftover credit expires.
snowflake-trial-400.conditions: Sign up with a valid email, one trial per person; ends after 30 days or when the $400 is used up; AI features need a card first (adding a card does not upgrade the account); trials exclude external network access, hybrid tables and Openflow; the account is suspended and unused credit lost if not upgraded.
steps: Open the trial page on snowflake.com and choose Start for free with a work email
Choose cloud platform, region and edition (fixed after signup) and accept the self-service terms
Activate the account from the email, set a username and password, and enter Snowsight
Watch the remaining balance in the left navigation and practise on an XS warehouse
snowflake-trial-400.risk: AI features stay off until a card is added; trials lack some features such as external network access; the account is suspended and the balance expires at the end; adding a card and upgrading starts metered and threshold billing.
snowflake-trial-400.source: Snowflake official trial page (read 2026-11-26: $400 / 30 days, two trial options) + official Trial accounts documentation (email only, AI features need a card, trial limitations)

mufg-emutoku-4000.content: MUFG's "En-tame de Entertainment! Emutoku" campaign: people aged 15-29 on 2026-04-01 who have never held an MUFG ordinary deposit account can open one in the MUFG Smart Account app or the MDC app between 2026-11-09 and 2027-04-30 and enter the campaign in MUFG Direct by the end of the month after opening, which earns 4,000 giftee Box Select points (about 4,000 yen) exchangeable for restaurant e-tickets, streaming coupons and similar. Account holders can also join the monthly "Ataru Emutoku" lottery from a 20,000 yen month-end balance, rising 10,000 yen a month.

Register MUFG Direct after opening and confirm email address 1 receives mail
Complete the entry under Home > News & Campaigns > Campaign Entry by the end of the month after opening
Around three months later, open the reward email and exchange the giftee Box Select points

chatgpt-business-first-month-free-5seats.regions: [Multi-region] Needs an IP in a target market (Japan, US and others) plus a card that charges; eligibility is rolled out per account, so an original price at checkout means you are not included
chatgpt-business-first-month-free-5seats.content: OpenAI is giving some ChatGPT accounts a free first month of Business. Open the promo link while signed in, switch the pricing page to Business, choose monthly billing, and keep five Standard seats with zero Premium seats; if checkout shows $0 due today the account qualifies and the $125 monthly price is waived. From month two it renews at $25 per seat per month. Workspaces created between 23 and 30 November also get double the weekly included usage through 31 December, which OpenAI's help centre states officially. In community tests a Japanese IP produced eligibility most often; Google Pay with an Infini card went through while Bybit, Gate and Plasma virtual cards were mostly declined. Ineligible accounts see $0 on the outer page and the original price at checkout.
chatgpt-business-first-month-free-5seats.conditions: Eligibility is rolled out per account and is not universal: checkout must show $0, and an original price means trying another account; a target-market IP and a card that actually charges are required, and most virtual cards are declined; the quote assumes five Standard seats on monthly billing, since Premium seats are not free; auto-renew charges $125 after month one, so cancel right after signing up.
steps: Connect through a target-market node (Japan has the highest hit rate) and open chatgpt.com/?promo_campaign=team-1-month-free#pricing while signed in
Choose Business, switch to monthly billing and confirm the free first month with five Standard seats and zero Premium seats
At checkout confirm $0 due today, then enter a card and a local billing address to subscribe
After it goes through, turn off auto-renew under Settings > Subscription and assign the seats to colleagues or friends

freedns-my-free-domains-permanent.title: [Global] FreeDNS now registers free domains permanently: 16 zones with no renewal fee, listed in the PSL, custom NS allowed (kz.ci, pvf.cc, us.ci and more)
freedns-my-free-domains-permanent.highlight: Registration is free, renewal is free and no ads are inserted: pick from 16 zones such as kz.ci, pvf.cc, xyz.ci, us.ci and nl0.net, get manual review within a few days, and point PSL zones at your own name servers
freedns-my-free-domains-permanent.regions: [Global] No regional restriction; manual review usually takes a few days and you must supply the IPv4/IPv6 addresses the name should point to
freedns-my-free-domains-permanent.value: Free forever (about $10 a year in domain fees saved)
freedns-my-free-domains-permanent.content: freedns.my runs its own free registry: 16 zones are open for requests, kz.ci, pvf.cc, xyz.ci, nl0.net, vc.ci, asia.ci, us.ci, de5.net, ddns.ge, l.cd, cc.cd, cn.mt, new.tg, ccwu.cc, bbroot.com and bot.cd. Registration and renewal are both free, no advertising is inserted, and the source is open. Give the A/AAAA records the name should publish and a human reviews the request, usually within a few days; once active you can add sub-names such as www plus CNAME and TXT records yourself, each change reviewed by an operator. For zones on the Public Suffix List such as us.ci and de5.net you can point the name at your own name servers and the change applies immediately. The operator says there is no per-account limit and 12,108 names are currently active.
freedns-my-free-domains-permanent.conditions: The request needs the IPv4/IPv6 records to publish and a human may reject it; custom name servers work only for PSL zones, since the registry answers for the rest; sub-name and record changes are reviewed manually; upstream cc/ci registry policy changes can affect a zone.
steps: Open freedns.my/request.php and pick a zone, preferably a PSL one such as us.ci or pvf.cc
Fill in the name, the IPv4/IPv6 it should point to and your email, then wait for manual review (a few days)
Once approved, add sub-names and CNAME/TXT records on the manage page; PSL zones can switch to your own NS
Point the domain at Cloudflare or directly at your server
freedns-my-free-domains-permanent.risk: These are second-level names that depend on upstream registries, and small cc/ci suffixes have been reclaimed before; review and record checks are run by a very small team, so responses can be slow; do not use them for important services or mail; a free service promising permanence can change its mind, so keep a paid domain for anything that matters.
freedns-my-free-domains-permanent.source: freedns.my official site read 2026-11-26 (16 open zones, free including renewals, no ads, A/AAAA/CNAME/TXT, custom NS for PSL zones, 12,108 active names, manual review within days) + the NodeLoc post of 2026-11-23 (registrations made permanent to celebrate pvf.cc, kz.ci and xyz.ci joining the PSL, earlier names switched automatically, operator says no per-account limit)

arena-ai-50-starter-credits.title: [Global] Arena AI gives new accounts $50: Claude 5.5 and GPT-6 at list price, no card
arena-ai-50-starter-credits.highlight: A new account shows $50.00 in starter funds with no card; the default Arena Router plugs straight into Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode at the vendors' own list prices, with no markup
arena-ai-50-starter-credits.regions: [Global] Sign up with an email and start; developer preview, credit tied to your own workspace
arena-ai-50-starter-credits.content: Arena (arena.ai) is a gateway that fronts frontier models such as Claude, GPT and Gemini at the vendors' list prices, with its console at platform.arena.ai. A new account shows $50.00 in starter funds on the settings page, and the first request starts drawing on it without any card on file. The official Quickstart ships a curl script that finds Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode on your machine, opens a browser to approve the connection, then creates an API key and writes the model menus. The default model is coding-router-preview, where Arena Router picks a model per request; you can also connect by hand through the OpenAI-compatible https://api.arena.ai/v1 or Anthropic-compatible https://api.arena.ai endpoints.
arena-ai-50-starter-credits.conditions: An email account is enough and no card is needed; the $50 is one-off starter credit and ends when spent; the docs say calling one named model directly requires paid or promotional funds, so stay on the default Router to use starter credit; still a developer preview, so rules and the model list can change.
steps: Sign up at arena.ai, verify the email and open the console at platform.arena.ai
Check that the settings page shows $50.00 in starter funds
Run the official curl setup script, or create an API key on the Keys page and point Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode at the OpenAI or Anthropic compatible base URL
Send a short request and confirm the charge and balance on the Usage page
arena-ai-50-starter-credits.risk: The amount is whatever your own settings page shows: some accounts start at once, others were asked to wait for review; named single models do not draw on starter credit and need the Router; policies can change during the preview; requests pass through Arena's servers to the model vendor, so do not send confidential code.
arena-ai-50-starter-credits.source: Arena official docs at platform.arena.ai/docs (OpenAI and Anthropic compatible base URLs, coding-router-preview routing, direct single-model calls need paid or promotional funds) + linux.do post of 2026-11-24 (works on signup, $50 is what the settings page shows, some replies report waiting for review) + kkzui tutorial of 2026-11-24 (settings page shows $50.00 starter funds, no card, first top-up of $250 is doubled)

shopback-30-signup-bonus-bf.content: ShopBack is a cashback platform, and for Black Friday it doubled the whole referral programme: a new user who signs up through someone's invite link or code before 2026-11-30 sees $30 attached to the account, up from the usual $15. steps: Open a ShopBack account through an invite link or by entering an invite code, and verify the phone number
Install the browser extension or app and shop at qualifying merchants through ShopBack until you pass $10 in spend
Wait for that cashback to turn Confirmed and reach $10 in total
Link PayPal under Withdraw Money; the $30 signup bonus can be withdrawn once confirmed

simba-16-recharge-roamfree-500.highlight: One top-up of exactly S$16 puts S$16 straight into your SIMBA wallet and inserts a free RoamFree 500 Pack: 500GB of roaming data for China, Japan and South Korea, valid 360 days from the top-up. Any other amount does not count, and new plans or renewals of S$18 or more do not trigger it.
simba-16-recharge-roamfree-500.regions: [SG] Singapore SIMBA lines only (postpaid, prepaid, business and data-only); the roaming pack works only in China, Japan and South Korea
simba-16-recharge-roamfree-500.content: SIMBA's official Recharge Pack: top up exactly S$16 through topup.simba.sg, the My SIMBA App or cash at a service centre, and the full S$16 lands in your SIMBA wallet with no expiry, usable for plan renewal and excess usage. The same recharge inserts a free RoamFree 500 Pack: 500GB of roaming data for China, Japan and South Korea, valid for 360 days from the top-up date. While roaming there the pack is used first, before the roaming allowance included in your plan. You can recharge S$16 again for a new pack; the new one replaces the old one and restarts the 360 days.
simba-16-recharge-roamfree-500.conditions: You need an active SIMBA mobile plan, including business and data-only lines. The top-up must be exactly S$16; S$18 or more, or a new sign-up or renewal, does not qualify. Only one 500 Pack can be active at a time and it ends the day your plan is changed or terminated.
steps: Get a SIMBA SIM or eSIM and keep an active mobile plan
Open topup.simba.sg or the My SIMBA App and pick the $16 Recharge Pack
Confirm the amount is exactly S$16 and choose to insert the RoamFree 500 Pack
Check the $16 balance and the 500GB pack with its 360-day term in the app; recharge S$16 again when it runs out
simba-16-recharge-roamfree-500.risk: SIMBA publishes no end date and can change or withdraw the offer at any time. The roaming pack covers only China, Japan and South Korea. The 500GB is subject to fair use and real network speeds. Wallet credit is non-refundable and non-transferable. A plan change terminates the pack that day. SIMBA is a Singapore carrier, so a local number and local registration are required.
simba-16-recharge-roamfree-500.source: SIMBA official Recharge Pack and terms pages read on 26 Nov 2026 (exactly $16 top-up, $16 credit plus 500GB China/Japan/Korea roaming, 360 days, cannot be bought separately, $18 and above excluded) checked against the official support FAQ

Standard and the extra $350 Reward Cash post per the terms; a first cash-instalment plan adds $200

packet-token-factory-free-models.title: [Global] Packet.ai Token Factory: open-weight model API free until Dec 16 (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and 2 more, no card)
packet-token-factory-free-models.highlight: OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so you only change base_url in your existing code: input and output tokens cost $0 during the free window, with just an email or Google account plus one SMS check and no card.
packet-token-factory-free-models.regions: [Global] Sign up with an email or Google account; one SMS verification from a phone number, no card
packet-token-factory-free-models.content: Packet.ai's managed inference service, Token Factory, serves open-weight models behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint: point base_url at api.packet.ai/v1, use your own key and your existing OpenAI SDK keeps working, with the same parameters for streaming, JSON mode and tool calling. Three models are live: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1M context, image input), MiniMax M3.1 Flash (1M context, image and video input) and Qwen2.5 1.5B Instruct (32K). Input and output tokens are billed at $0 until 16 December 2026; after that each model is metered separately, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at $0.23 in and $0.85 out per million tokens, MiniMax M3.1 Flash at $0.15 and $0.60, and Qwen2.5 1.5B at $0.10 each.
packet-token-factory-free-models.conditions: Register at dash.packet.ai with an email address or Google account and complete one SMS phone verification, because unverified accounts cannot send requests. The free window ends on 16 December 2026 and billing starts automatically after that. No public rate limit has been published for the free tier, and the model list and model IDs follow the Serverless page in the console.
steps: Register at dash.packet.ai with an email address or Google account and verify your phone
Copy a model ID from the Serverless models page and create an API key
Set the OpenAI SDK base_url to https://api.packet.ai/v1 and pass the key
Send one chat completion request and check that the usage block comes back
Watch for the switch to paid billing before 16 December; delete the key if you do not want to pay
packet-token-factory-free-models.risk: Billing starts automatically when the free window ends and is charged to the account wallet. No rate limit is published, so requests can be throttled at peak times. DeepSeek runs as NVIDIA's 4-bit NVFP4 build, so results may differ slightly from the official release. The platform is newly launched and the model list can change; Kimi K3 is only announced.
packet-token-factory-free-models.source: Packet.ai official Token Factory page read on 26 November 2026 (three models, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash NVFP4, MiniMax M3.1 Flash and Qwen2.5 1.5B Instruct, page states free at launch for one month) plus the official blog post of 24 November 2026 (input and output tokens free until 16 December 2026, no card, SMS verification only, per-model prices afterwards)

bt-panel-new-user-free-dv-ssl.title: [China] BT Panel: new users on 13.2.0 get a free one-year commercial DV SSL certificate (4,000 only, ends Nov 30)
bt-panel-new-user-free-dv-ssl.highlight: A newly registered BT Panel account that installs and signs in to Linux panel 13.2.0 for the first time claims it under SSL, Certificate management, Commercial SSL; only 4,000 are issued, and the certificate can be issued later, until Dec 30.
bt-panel-new-user-free-dv-ssl.regions: [China] Newly registered BT Panel accounts; needs a Linux server you can access as root
bt-panel-new-user-free-dv-ssl.content: A new-user benefit for BT Panel 13.2.0: after a newly registered account installs and signs in to the Linux panel official release for the first time, the SSL section opens a Commercial SSL tab under Certificate management with a claim button that grants one one-year single-domain commercial DV certificate. After claiming, open the record and fill in the domain (pick an existing site or enter a single domain), the validation method (DNS CNAME is recommended) and the contact details, then add the CNAME record or place the validation file. Once the status shows as issued, deploy it and the site has HTTPS.
bt-panel-new-user-free-dv-ssl.conditions: You must be a newly registered BT Panel account and install and sign in to Linux panel official release 13.2.0 for the first time. Only 4,000 certificates are available, first come first served: claim by 23:59 on 30 November and finish domain validation and issuance by 23:59 on 30 December or the entitlement is cancelled. One per account, and .su domains are not supported.
steps: Download and install Linux panel official release 13.2.0 from the BT Panel site as root
Sign in to the panel in a browser and bind your newly registered BT Panel account
Open SSL, Certificate management, Commercial SSL and press claim
Open the new record, add the domain, validation method and contact details
Add the CNAME record or place the validation file, then run domain validation and wait for the CA review
Deploy the certificate once the status reads issued
bt-panel-new-user-free-dv-ssl.risk: Claiming does not mean the certificate is issued: if domain validation or the CA review fails you get nothing. Only 4,000 are available and they can run out early. The panel needs a server with a public IP, and file validation needs the site reachable over port 80 or 443. The certificate lasts one year, so you have to renew or switch to a free one later. .su domains are not supported.
bt-panel-new-user-free-dv-ssl.source: BT Panel official notice on the free DV certificate for new 13.2.0 users, read on 26 November 2026 (4,000 certificates, claim by 30 November 23:59, issuance by 30 December 23:59, one per account, no .su domains) plus the official NodeLoc promotion post of 25 November 2026

Enter BLACKFRIDAY in the promo field before paying and confirm the price drops 20%
Take the QR code from the email and install the eSIM before you travel
Turn the eSIM on after landing; the validity period starts at first connection

Check the console usage page after the first calls to confirm the billing is zero

Generate an API key in the console
In your client set base_url to https://api.regolo.ai/v1 and pick a core model
Watch the remaining days and daily token usage in the console and decide before the trial ends

privjet-free-esim-1gb-74.content: PrivJet, a private-jet marketplace run by OnlineBuilders LLC, gives every account one free eSIM: 1GB of data, valid at least 7 days from the first connection, running on local networks through eSIM Access (Redtea Mobile) in 74 countries including Japan, Korea, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Hong Kong, Macao, the US, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Turkey and Kazakhstan. privjet-free-esim-1gb-74.conditions: 18 or over, one claim per account; claim in the app and verify the number by WhatsApp or voice call (no virtual or disposable numbers); limited stock per country each day; claim before travelling and install within 7 days for at least 7 days of use after landing; data-only with no number and no SMS.
steps: Install the PrivJet app on iOS or Android and sign up, then wait 10 minutes before claiming
Confirm the mobile number with the prepared WhatsApp message or the voice call reading a 6-digit code
Accept SMS and WhatsApp offers, choose the destination country and claim the eSIM
Install from the app or QR code before departure and switch the line on after landing
privjet-free-esim-1gb-74.risk: Only a few free eSIMs are released per country each day, so popular destinations often run out; marketing SMS and WhatsApp consent is required (unsubscribe any time); no number, so verification texts cannot be received; coverage and speed depend on the local partner network.

uppcoder-free-spark-paas.content: Uppcoder puts dev environments and production hosting on one platform, and its pricing page says the free Spark tier has no time limit and needs no card: every stack includes a cloud editor, a terminal, SSH you can open from your own VS Code, automatically renewed TLS certificates and nightly backups (the last seven days plus one per week for four weeks). Templates deploy Django, FastAPI, Flask, Express, Next.js or Laravel with PostgreSQL, MySQL or MariaDB, and ready-made apps include WordPress, Gitea, n8n and Mattermost; each app gets a live URL on an Uppcoder subdomain. Apps answer only on the platform subdomain, with no dedicated IPv4 and no custom DNS; a community test put the first stack at about 2 GB of RAM and 2 GB of disk, and more resources need a paid plan.
uppcoder-free-spark-paas.conditions: Sign up with an email or GitHub and no card; the terms ban proxies, VPNs, tunnels and mining, and violations get accounts closed; no custom domains, ports only through the platform subdomain, no dedicated IPv4; the free tier is small, so no heavy loads or long-term production; containers only, with no host root.
steps: Sign up at uppcoder.com with an email or GitHub account, no payment method needed
Pick a template from the catalogue (Django with PostgreSQL, n8n, WordPress and so on) or describe the app and let the builder create it
Open the subdomain once the container is up, or SSH in from your own editor to change code
Confirm nightly backups are running, and still keep your own copy of important data
uppcoder-free-spark-paas.risk: A small team runs its own hardware, so the free tier can shrink or change rules at any time; without a custom domain or dedicated IPv4 it is not a long-term public service; proxies and tunnels are explicitly banned; backups live only inside the platform.
uppcoder-free-spark-paas.source: Uppcoder official pricing page (read 2026-11-26: free tier with no time limit, no card, editor/SSH/terminal/certificates/nightly backups, and 60 days' email notice if the free plan changes) + template list on the Uppcoder site + NodeLoc free-container roundup (2026-11-24, with the roughly 2 GB RAM / 2 GB disk test, the no-custom-domain limit and the no-proxy rule)

linemo-perplexity-pro-6m-free.title: [Japan] LINEMO x Perplexity Pro: first 6 months free for line subscribers, saving JPY 2,950 a month
linemo-perplexity-pro-6m-free.highlight: LINEMO subscribers can add Perplexity Pro for SoftBank for JPY 0 for six months, then JPY 2,950 a month renewing automatically; the condition is never having had Perplexity Pro for SoftBank or any other free Perplexity Pro campaign
linemo-perplexity-pro-6m-free.regions: [Japan] LINEMO Japanese line only; signing up needs Japanese ID and address, so it cannot be done from abroad
linemo-perplexity-pro-6m-free.content: LINEMO, SoftBank's online brand, states on its official service page that subscribers can take Perplexity Pro for SoftBank as an option for JPY 0 for the first six months, then JPY 2,950 a month renewing automatically, and you have to cancel yourself to stop. The service matches Perplexity Pro and LINEMO bills it with the line. Signing a LINEMO line does not switch it on by itself: use the email sent once the line is live to submit the real application on the dedicated page, and store or web orders add an SMS link. You also need a Perplexity account, which the application can create, and the email you register cannot be changed later.
linemo-perplexity-pro-6m-free.conditions: You must hold a LINEMO Japanese line (signing up needs Japanese ID and address) and have a Perplexity account; turn Wi-Fi off or apply from a computer; anyone who already had Perplexity Pro for SoftBank or used the one-year or any other free Perplexity Pro campaign does not qualify; under-13s, 13-18s without guardian consent and companies cannot apply; from month seven JPY 2,950 is charged monthly.
steps: Order LINEMO with the Perplexity Pro for SoftBank option, or apply from the official Perplexity page if you already have a line
Open the email sent after the line goes live (or the SMS link for store and web orders) and submit the real application with Wi-Fi off
Sign in to or create a Perplexity account and confirm the subscription is active
Note the free period end date in My Menu or My SoftBank and cancel before it to avoid the JPY 2,950 charge
linemo-perplexity-pro-6m-free.risk: This is a carrier bundle: signing a monthly Japanese line just for the AI is not worth it, and it needs Japanese ID and address; the subscription auto-charges after the free period and keeps charging without cancellation; the registered email cannot be changed; cancelling the line cancels Perplexity Pro too.
linemo-perplexity-pro-6m-free.source: LINEMO official Perplexity Pro service page (read 2026-11-26: six months at JPY 0, JPY 2,950 a month from month seven, a second application via the emailed page after ordering LINEMO, unchangeable email, no prior free campaigns) + SoftBank official Perplexity Pro page + Smartphone fee guide (2026-11-19, same terms)
